AI.result: 在真实与仿真的SPAD及量子图像传感器（QIS）基准上，重建质量达SOTA，时序一致性与色彩保真度优于现有方法，且长序列下仍无幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性引导的融合-去噪解耦是替代生成先验的有效路径，可扩展到任意长度突发并保持物理可信的时序一致性；对低光/高速成像与物理感知前端具有参考价值。

title: Passage-Focused Soft Coordination for Hierarchical Multi-Robot Navigation in Bottleneck Environments
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: In multi-robot navigation, rigid global schedules are sensitive to execution deviations, while local methods lack long-horizon coordination. We propose a passage-focused framework combining soft global coordination with flexible local execution. A passage-induced graph of convex sets supports priority-ordered planning with two levels of soft coordination. Passage-aware route selection accounts for passage usage and traversal directions, while route-restricted continuous space-time planning penalizes temporal conflicts. The resulting references guide a model predictive path integral controller that avoids collisions online. Adaptive temporal and geometric tracking accommodates execution deviations, while selective replanning maintains coordination without rigid trajectory reservations. Across 1,200 instances in 4 different environments with 5-30 robots, the framework achieves a near-perfect success rate and outperforms evaluated baselines in makespan and flowtime. Hardware experiments with 8 robots demonstrate successful completion of all trials without collisions. These results highlight the effectiveness of passage-focused coordination in balancing long-horizon cooperation with flexible execution.

AI.tldr: 提出以"通道"为核心的软-硬结合多机器人导航框架:基于通道诱导的凸集图做优先级排序规划,含通道感知路径选择与通道约束的连续时空规划两级软协调,配合MPPI控制器与自适应跟踪、选择性重规划。
AI.motivation: 刚性全局调度对执行偏差敏感,局部方法缺乏长时域协调,需在长时域合作与灵活执行间取得平衡。
AI.method: 1) 构造通道诱导的凸集图,支持按优先级有序规划;2) 第一级软协调:路径选择考虑通道占用与通行方向;3) 第二级软协调:在路径受限的连续时空空间规划并惩罚时间冲突;4) 生成参考轨迹驱动MPPI在线避碰;5) 自适应时间/几何跟踪应对执行偏差,结合选择性重规划维持协调而无需刚性轨迹预留。
AI.result: 4种环境下1200个实例、5–30机器人,成功率近乎完美,makespan与flowtime优于所评估基线;8机器人硬件实验全部无碰撞完成。
AI.conclusion: 以通道为中心的协调机制能有效兼顾长时域协作与灵活执行,并具备实机可迁移性。

title: RAVEN-Bench: A Paired EO-IR Video QA Benchmark for Aerial Multimodal Understanding
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track)
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly in image and video understanding, yet their ability to reason over paired aerial electro-optical and infrared (EO-IR) videos remains poorly understood. Such video poses a harder test than standard RGB video QA: targets are often small, evidence may appear only briefly, viewpoints change with the platform, and useful cues may appear in only one stream. We introduce RAVEN-Bench (Reasoning over Aerial Videos with EO-IR aligNment), a paired EO-IR video QA benchmark for low-altitude aerial multimodal understanding. RAVEN-Bench contains 100 temporally aligned EO-IR video pairs and 1,200 human-authored four-way multiple-choice questions, each independently audited for answer keys, modality requirements, evidence intervals, and group validity. It supports EO-only, IR-only, and paired EO+IR evaluation, and uses hierarchical capability levels and structured question groups to diagnose paired-input gain beyond the stronger unimodal condition, unimodal reliance, target consistency, and evidence-chain coherence. We evaluate frontier, open-weight, and remote-sensing MLLMs, showing that aggregate accuracy can overstate evidence-supported EO-IR reasoning. RAVEN-Bench provides controlled modality conditions and group-level diagnostics for auditing whether progress on RGB video benchmarks transfers to aerial cross-spectral understanding. Code and data are available at this https URL and this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 RAVEN-Bench：100 对时间对齐的低空航拍可见光—红外（EO-IR）视频与 1200 道人工四选一问题的配对跨谱段视频问答基准，支持 EO-only / IR-only / EO+IR 三种模态条件，并用分层能力等级与结构化题组诊断配对增益、单模态依赖、目标一致性与证据链连贯性。
AI.motivation: MLLM 在图像与常规 RGB 视频理解上进展迅速，但其在航拍配对 EO-IR 视频上的推理能力几乎未被评估。该任务比标准 RGB 视频 QA 更难：目标小、证据短暂、视角随平台移动、有效线索可能只出现在单一模态；现有基准无法控制模态条件，也难以区分"聚合准确率"是否真正来自跨谱段证据整合。
AI.method: 构建 100 对时间对齐 EO-IR 视频、1200 道人工撰写四选一问题，逐题审计答案键、模态需求、证据时间区间与题组有效性；评测协议同时覆盖 EO-only、IR-only 与配对 EO+IR 三种条件；采用分层能力等级（hierarchical capability levels）与结构化题组，度量配对输入相对较强单模态的增益、单模态依赖度、跨模态目标一致性和证据链连贯性。评测对象包括前沿模型、开源权重模型与遥感专用 MLLM。
AI.result: 实验显示聚合准确率会高估"证据支撑的 EO-IR 推理"水平：模型在配对条件下并非稳定优于最强单模态条件，且在单模态依赖、目标一致性与证据链连贯性维度上暴露出明显短板。
AI.conclusion: RAVEN-Bench 以受控模态条件和题组级诊断，为"RGB 视频基准上的进展能否迁移到航拍跨谱段理解"提供可审计的检验手段；但属基准/数据集类工作，不含可迁移的方法创新。

title: Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

AI.tldr: 通过任务向量SVD分解与标量混合系数学习，将VLM与其VLA微调衍生模型进行免训练参数合并，同时保留动作预测与视觉语言能力，缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: VLA模型由VLM在机器人示范数据上微调得到，但该微调引发灾难性遗忘，显著削弱原VLM的语义与视觉grounding能力；作者希望无需重新训练任一模型来恢复两方面能力。
AI.method: 提取任务向量（VLA权重减VLM权重），用SVD分解为若干分量；对每个分量学习一个标量混合系数，控制保留多少VLA适配量，并以联合保持动作预测与视觉语言能力为目标优化这些系数，最后合并得到模型。
AI.result: 合并后的模型在动作预测与视觉语言能力两个维度上同时表现良好，一致优于已有模型合并基线。
AI.conclusion: SVD任务向量分解加每分量标量系数是一种有效的免重训练VLM-VLA合并方案，可缓解VLA微调带来的灾难性遗忘。

title: CISyn: Human Mesh Recovery in Close Interactions with Physics-Simulated Synthetic Data
summary: 3D human mesh recovery (HMR) in close-interaction scenarios is hindered by the lack of large-scale, accurately annotated training data: real capture is expensive, and existing synthetic datasets rarely include physical contact. We introduce CISyn, a large-scale synthetic dataset purpose-built for close human-human interactions, generated via physics simulation and Blender-based rendering. By simulating collision dynamics between SMPL-X-rigged humanoids, CISyn naturally produces the contact, mutual occlusion, and pose entanglement that characterize close-interaction scenes, with no manual annotation effort. The released set provides 25,000 sequences with accurate 3D annotations. We further propose an uncertainty-aware loss that allows models to learn more effectively from the heavily occluded examples in our data. Augmenting state-of-the-art HMR training with CISyn and replacing the regression loss with our uncertainty-aware variant yields consistent improvements on close-interaction benchmarks, validating CISyn as a scalable complement to real-world data. The dataset, generation pipeline, and code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CISyn：基于物理仿真+Blender渲染生成2.5万条近距离人体交互序列（SMPL-X）的合成数据集，并配套不确定性感知回归损失，用于提升遮挡严重的紧密交互场景三维人体网格恢复。
AI.motivation: 紧密交互场景下的HMR缺乏大规模且标注精确的训练数据：真实采集代价高，现有合成数据集几乎不含物理接触，导致接触、互遮挡、姿态缠绕等关键现象缺失。
AI.method: 用SMPL-X骨骼化人体在物理引擎中模拟碰撞动力学，再由Blender渲染，自动产生接触、互遮挡与姿态缠绕，无需人工标注；同时提出不确定性感知损失，使模型能更有效地从重度遮挡样本中学习。
AI.result: 发布25,000条带精确3D标注的序列；在SOTA HMR训练中加入CISyn并将回归损失替换为不确定性感知版本，在紧密交互基准上取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: CISyn可作为真实数据可扩展的补充，数据集、生成流水线和代码均开源；属于数据集+训练目标层面的增量方法，未涉及机器人/手物交互或世界模型等核心议题。

title: Lasso: Towards Sustainable AI-Generated Media Detection with Intel QAT On-Chip Compression
summary: Synthetic text, images, and video are rising. Software-only detectors are power-hungry, too slow, and costly, and do not scale with demand. When software cannot scale, historically hardware often comes to the rescue. We perform the first reverse engineering of a compression accelerator--Intel QuickAssist Technology (QAT) microarchitecture and--find different amount of time on each, a novel data structure-dependent property. Using this information, we then build Lasso, a low-cost, high-performance detector for AI-generated content that turns the accelerator into a measuring instrument. For text detection, Lasso achieves 100% accuracy on original DetectRL text and retains 92% average accuracy after paraphrasing, compared with 78% for Binoculars and 55% for DetectGPT. Across original, paraphrased, and perturbed text, it achieves 82% average accuracy, outperforming all five baselines. With topic, length, and formatting matched, accuracy reaches 95% for instruction-tuned generators, including when the tested generator is unseen. On RAID, accuracy averages 82% when trained on one generator and tested on another, and 74% across eight held-out domains. Detection takes 0.74 microseconds, a speedup of at least 83,784x across five baselines. At the same time, Lasso consumes over 99% less energy per document than both Binoculars and DetectGPT. At the same time, Lasso detects AI-generated videos, software code, and images with 67.5%, 70% and 78% accuracy, respectively, with low latency and power opening avenues for practical real time and edge device detection of multimodality AI artifacts for the first time. No other compared technique supports detection across all four modalities: text, video, images, and code.

AI.tldr: 通过对Intel QAT压缩加速器微架构做首次逆向工程，发现其压缩耗时与数据结构相关，据此构建低成本、高能效的AI生成内容检测器Lasso，覆盖文本、视频、图像与代码四种模态。
AI.motivation: 合成文本、图像、视频激增，纯软件检测器功耗高、速度慢、成本高且难以扩展；当软件难以扩展时，硬件往往可提供替代路径，因此作者探索利用现成硬件加速器作为检测介质。
AI.method: 逆向分析Intel QuickAssist Technology（QAT）压缩加速器微架构，发现其在不同数据上的处理时间存在差异（数据结构相关性质），将加速器转化为"测量仪器"，基于耗时特征构建Lasso检测器。
AI.result: 文本：DetectRL原文100%准确率，改写后92%（Binoculars 78%、DetectGPT 55%），原文/改写/扰动平均82%，优于全部5个基线；主题长度格式匹配时对指令微调生成器达95%（含未见生成器）；RAID跨生成器82%、八个留出域74%。检测耗时0.74微秒，至少83,784倍加速，能耗降低99%以上。视频67.5%、代码70%、图像78%。
AI.conclusion: Lasso以极低延迟和能耗实现跨文本、代码、图像、视频四模态的AI生成内容检测，为实时与边缘端多模态伪造检测开辟路径；为唯一支持全部四模态的对比方法。

title: Correcting Persistent Failures in Point-Cloud Grasping Policies using Human Demonstrations in Virtual Reality
summary: Robots in homes, warehouses and farms must pick up objects they have never seen, usually without a 3D model or a category label. A grasping policy that works directly on the point cloud from a depth sensor needs only the geometry the robot observes, so it applies to any new object. Offline grasp generators such as Contact-GraspNet work this way, but they rank grasps by learned plausibility rather than by whether the grasp actually lifts the object. Reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize for that directly and make a point-cloud grasping policy much better on average, yet it leaves specific grasps persistently unsolved. We present a human-in-the-loop failure loop that targets those grasps: situations an RL policy keeps failing are mined automatically, sent to a virtual-reality application where a person picks the object up with their own hands, and returned to training as two grasp points. The person contributes only where to grasp; the robot chooses its own approach. In simulation, RL raises success on unseen objects from 55% with Contact-GraspNet to 83%. Adding 58 human demonstrations nearly doubles success on the hard cases RL kept failing, from 24% to 45%, and recovers performance that RL alone loses on similar cases that were never demonstrated, without reducing success on unseen objects.

AI.tldr: 提出人在回路失败挖掘循环：自动挖掘RL点云抓取策略持续失败的情形，经VR由人类以双手示范抓取，转为两个抓取点回灌训练；仿真中RL将未见物体成功率从55%(Contact-GraspNet)提升至83%，再加入58条人类示范使困难案例成功率从24%提升至45%。
AI.motivation: 家庭、仓储与农场场景中的机器人需抓取从未见过、无3D模型也无类别标签的物体，因此需要直接作用于深度传感器点云、仅依赖观测几何的抓取策略。Contact-GraspNet等离线抓取生成器按学习到的"合理性"排序抓取，而非按是否真正抬起物体排序；RL虽能直接优化抓取成功，但会残留持续失败的特定抓取情形。
AI.method: 构建人在回路失败闭环：(1)自动挖掘RL策略持续失败的抓取情形；(2)将其送入VR应用，由人以双手主动抓取物体；(3)将人类示范转译为两个抓取点(抓取接触点先验)注入训练。人类仅提供"抓哪里"，机器人自行决定接近轨迹与执行方式，从而保持策略的端到端点云输入特性。
AI.result: 仿真中，RL相较Contact-GraspNet在未见物体上将成功率从55%提升至83%；额外加入58条人类示范使RL持续失败的困难案例成功率从24%提升至45%（接近翻倍），并且在未被示范的相似案例上也恢复了RL单独训练所损失的性能，同时未降低未见物体上的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 以少量人类"抓取位置"示范定向修补RL失败模式，是一种高效、低标注成本的示范增强范式：仅需58条示范即可显著提升困难案例鲁棒性并获得正向泛化，说明人类稀疏意图与RL自主执行解耦的结合优于纯离线抓取生成或纯RL。局限在于证据为仿真结果，尚缺真实机器人验证与人机交互成本分析。

title: Dependable Voice Command for Multi-UAV Swarms Using Small Language Models
summary: Supervisory control of multiple autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) imposes high visual and cognitive demands on human operators, particularly when communicating mission objectives and system constraints. Voice command provides a natural interaction modality that can reduce operator workload; however, its reliability is affected by environmental noise, speech variability, and recognition errors. This paper presents a dependable voice command framework for multi-UAV swarm supervision using Small Language Models (SLMs). The proposed architecture integrates an Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) module with an SLM-based semantic processing layer to transform spoken operator commands into structured task definitions for downstream multi-UAV planning and execution. To evaluate robustness, an end-to-end assessment pipeline is developed using a Probabilistic Context-Free Grammar (PCFG) to generate synthetic supervisory commands, which are converted into audio samples with varying operator accents and environmental signal-to-noise ratios (SNR). The resulting speech signals are processed by the ASR module, and the SLM performs contextual interpretation and phonetic correction of transcriptions when required. The evaluation isolates the resilience of the voice command pipeline under acoustic degradation and speech variation, demonstrating reliable task generation for multi-UAV supervision in challenging operational conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出基于小语言模型（SLM）的多无人机集群可靠语音指令框架，将ASR与SLM语义处理层结合，把口语指令转化为结构化任务定义，并用PCFG合成含口音与噪声扰动的语料做端到端鲁棒性评估。
AI.motivation: 多无人机监督控制对人机交互的视觉与认知负荷很高，语音是自然模态，但受环境噪声、口音变异与识别错误影响，可靠性不足；同时大模型在机载/边缘端难以部署，故选用SLM。
AI.method: ASR模块 + SLM语义层（上下文解释与必要时音素级纠错）构成流水线，输出结构化任务定义供下游多UAV规划执行；评估侧用概率上下文无关文法（PCFG）生成合成监督指令，再合成不同口音与SNR的音频，输入整条链路。
AI.result: 在声学退化与语音变异条件下，语音指令流水线仍能生成可靠的任务定义，可分离出各模块在噪声/口音下的韧性表现；但评估全部基于合成语音，缺少真实飞手语音与真机集群的实证。
AI.conclusion: SLM+ASR的语音交互可作为多UAV监督控制的可行接口，鲁棒性评估流程可复用；后续需引入真实语音数据与实机部署验证。

title: Optimal Operating-Point Selection for Single-Linearization Trajectory Planning of Nonlinear Robot Manipulators
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Advances in Computing (IEEE ICAC 2026)
summary: Single-point linearization provides a computationally efficient basis for optimization-based trajectory planning of nonlinear robot manipulators. However, planning performance depends on the selected linearization point. This paper presents an offline performance-driven approach that treats the location of a single linearization as an optimization variable. Candidate operating points are sampled from a common cubic seed trajectory, and each corresponding affine model is used to solve an identical constrained finite-horizon quadratic program (QP). The resulting control sequences are executed on the original nonlinear dynamics, and the operating point minimizing the nonlinear trajectory objective is selected through grid search and bounded refinement. Evaluation on four point-to-point motions of a three-degree-of-freedom UR5 manipulator yields optimal normalized operating-point locations between 0.325 and 0.935, demonstrating trajectory-dependent selection. Compared with the best-performing conventional initial, midpoint, or terminal linearization, the proposed approach reduces the nonlinear trajectory objective by 17-18%, 21-22%, 37-38%, and 7-8% across the four tasks, respectively. Additional nonlinear execution with identical PID feedback correction confirms that the performance advantage persists for a representative task. These results demonstrate that systematic operating-point selection can substantially improve single-linearization trajectory planning while preserving a fixed affine planning model.

AI.tldr: 该文将单点线性化的线性化位置视为优化变量，通过从三次种子轨迹采样候选工作点、对每个仿射模型求解同一约束有限时域QP、在原非线性动力学上执行并结合网格搜索与有界细化，选出使非线性轨迹目标最小的操作点。
AI.motivation: 单点线性化计算高效，但规划性能高度依赖所选线性化点；作者希望借助离线性能驱动的系统化选取来弥补这一依赖，同时保持固定的仿射规划模型。
AI.method: 离线性能驱动方法：在公共三次种子轨迹上采样候选工作点，为每个工作点构造仿射模型并求解相同的约束有限时域QP；将控制序列在原始非线性动力学上执行，按非线性轨迹目标通过网格搜索与有界细化选择最优工作点。实验为三自由度UR5机械臂的四个点对点运动，并附加含相同PID反馈修正的非线性执行验证。
AI.result: 最优归一化工作点位置落在0.325–0.935之间，体现任务依赖性；相对最佳的常规初始/中点/末端线性化，非线性轨迹目标在四项任务上分别降低17–18%、21–22%、37–38%、7–8%；附加PID反馈修正的非线性执行在代表性任务上仍保持性能优势。
AI.conclusion: 系统化的工作点选择能在保持固定仿射规划模型的前提下显著改善单线性化轨迹规划性能。

title: Learned Regularization for Sparse-View CT: Accuracy, Lesion Detectability and Distribution Shift of a Plug-and-Play Prior against Tuned Total Variation
comment: 62 pages, 22 figures, and 30 tables. Preprint (not peer-reviewed); also available on Zenodo: this https URL . Code and stored results are available at: this https URL
summary: Learned image priors are often proposed to replace hand-crafted regularizers in sparse-view computed tomography (CT), yet they are usually judged by PSNR on data resembling their training set. We evaluate one noise-conditioned DnCNN denoiser used as a Plug-and-Play prior against filtered back-projection (FBP), Tikhonov and total-variation (TV) regularization, with every method tuned on validation data and all differences paired. On synthetic 28x28 digit images, the prior beats box-constrained TV by about 3.4 dB at moderate noise (sigma = 0.05, 20 angles), but the advantage shrinks at low noise and reverses under distribution shift: an MNIST-trained prior is 3.1 dB (Fashion-MNIST) and 4.3-4.6 dB (Shepp-Logan phantom) below TV, whereas a Fashion-MNIST-trained prior beats TV by 2.2 dB on Fashion-MNIST, consistent with prior mismatch rather than a failure of PnP itself. In a lesion-insertion test the prior detects lesions worse than TV in distribution despite its higher PSNR, and under mismatch it produces more lesion-like false blobs than box-constrained TV for seven of eight lesion types. On real LoDoPaB-CT slices (patient-disjoint split; 30, 60 and 120 angles; three dose levels; 40 test patients), the prior does not consistently outperform a well-tuned TV in PSNR (-0.93 to +0.33 dB) and has lower SSIM in eight of nine conditions. Its lesion-detection AUC is higher than this TV's in all nine conditions (significant in six) but never significantly higher than that of Hann-filtered FBP, which the PSNR-tuned TV falls below in detection in all nine conditions (seven significant). On non-anatomical phantoms its PSNR falls below TV in all six conditions. PSNR and lesion detectability thus rank the methods differently. Our conclusions concern one small denoiser, and the CT analysis was developed after seeing results, without pre-specified primary comparisons.

AI.tldr: 评估噪声条件化DnCNN作为PnP先验在稀疏视角CT中的表现，发现其相对TV的优势仅在分布内成立，分布偏移下显著退化，且PSNR与病灶检测能力排序不一致。
AI.motivation: 学习型图像先验常被用来替代手工正则项，但评价多局限于与训练集同分布的PSNR指标，缺乏在分布偏移、下游任务（病灶检测）以及真实数据上的系统性配对比较。
AI.method: 以噪声条件化DnCNN去噪器作为Plug-and-Play先验，与FBP、Tikhonov、总变分(TV)正则化在统一验证集调参、配对差异统计下对比；实验包含28x28合成数字（MNIST/Fashion-MNIST交叉迁移）、Shepp-Logan体模、病灶插入测试，以及LoDoPaB-CT真实切片（患者不相交划分，30/60/120视角，三种剂量，40例测试患者），指标含PSNR、SSIM与病灶检测AUC。
AI.result: 中噪声(σ=0.05, 20视角)下先验较box-constrained TV高约3.4 dB，但低噪声优势缩小；分布偏移时MNIST先验在Fashion-MNIST低3.1 dB、Shepp-Logan低4.3–4.6 dB，而Fashion-MNIST先验在Fashion-MNIST上高2.2 dB，支持"先验失配"解释。真实数据上PSNR仅-0.93至+0.33 dB且九种条件中八种SSIM更低；病灶AUC在九种条件均高于该TV（六种显著），但从未显著高于Hann滤波FBP。
AI.conclusion: 学习型PnP先验的增益高度依赖训练分布，PSNR与病灶可检测性给出不一致的方法排序；结论限于单一小型去噪器，CT分析为事后设计、无预设主要比较，提示需以任务相关指标和分布偏移场景评价先验。

title: Effects of Conventional, Adaptive, and AI-Powered Upscaling on the Legibility of License Plates
summary: Small details in digital images -- a face, a street sign, a license plate -- are routinely upscaled in hopes of making them interpretable. Upscaling options now range from conventional interpolation, whose operations are spatially invariant and fully explainable, to AI-powered methods that synthesize detail potentially absent from the source. Here, we ask which of these techniques most reliably helps human readers. In two online experiments, we measured legibility of 255 US license plates ranging in resolution from 128 to 8 pixels tall, as well as their legibility after upscaling by eight different methods. Legibility of the un-upscaled plates collapsed from ceiling to floor across a narrow band of plate heights (32 to 10 pixels). Conventional upscaling techniques (bilinear, bicubic, and Lanczos interpolation) gave modest gains of about 5-9 percentage points within this range. Nearest-neighbor interpolation, however, was harmful, rendering unreadable many plates that were readable without any upscaling. Advanced methods diverged: SwinIR, an open-source AI enhancer, raised performance by up to 38 points relative to no upscaling, while an adaptive denoiser-based image prior and commercial AI upscaler tended to impair legibility. We found no strong evidence of consistent character hallucinations across methods. Decomposing the task, conventional interpolators mainly helped readers count characters, whereas SwinIR alone made the characters themselves more identifiable.

AI.tldr: 两项在线实验比较了8种上采样方法对255张低分辨率车牌（128→8 px高）可读性的影响：传统插值小幅提升5-9个百分点，最近邻有害，SwinIR可提升最多38个百分点，而自适应去噪先验与商业AI放大器反而降低可读性。
AI.motivation: 数字图像中的关键小细节（人脸、路牌、车牌）常被上采样以期变得可读，但插值方法与AI生成方法孰优孰劣缺乏以人类读者为基准的量化证据，尤其缺乏对"AI是否合成虚假细节损害判读"的实证检验。
AI.method: 两项在线人类判读实验，被试阅读255张美国车牌，原始高度覆盖8-128像素；对每张图施加8种上采样方法（双线性、双三次、Lanczos、最近邻、SwinIR、自适应去噪先验类、商业AI放大器等）后进行可读性测量；并将任务分解为字符计数与字符识别两个子能力进行分析，另检查跨方法的字符幻觉现象。
AI.result: 无上采样时车牌可读性在32至10像素高度区间内由接近满分骤降至接近零；传统插值在该区间提升约5-9个百分点；最近邻插值有害，使许多原本可读的车牌变为不可读；SwinIR相对不上采样最高提升38个百分点；自适应去噪先验与商业AI放大器倾向于损害可读性；未发现跨方法一致的字符幻觉证据；传统插值主要帮助字符计数，唯有SwinIR使字符本身更易辨识。
AI.conclusion: 上采样并非普遍有益，方法选择至关重要：简单空间不变插值提供有限但可靠的增益，最近邻应避免，特定开源AI增强器效果显著，而部分高级去噪式与商业AI方法存在负向风险；同时"可读性"需分解为计数与识别两类人因指标进行评估。

title: TMA: Sim-to-Real Forceful Humanoid Manipulation via Tactile-Driven Motor Adaptation
summary: Recent humanoid loco-manipulation in articulated environments has largely focused on geometry-dominant interactions, where success is primarily determined by geometric alignment and motion execution. In contrast, forceful multi-finger manipulation requires the robot to adapt to real-world uncertainties in contact and interaction dynamics. We present Tactile-Driven Motor Adaptation (TMA) and an integrated whole-body system for zero-shot sim-to-real forceful humanoid manipulation, and study round-doorknob opening as a challenging benchmark requiring stable multi-finger frictional grasping, sufficient torque generation without slip, force-regulated pushing, and whole-body stability. TMA structures policy learning around interactions observable through tactile feedback, uses cone geometry as an inductive bias for multi-finger contact representation, and adapts motor behavior online from tactile history. An upper-body manipulation policy is trained alongside a pretrained general locomotion controller to coordinate dexterous interaction and whole-body stabilization. Trained entirely in simulation, TMA transfers zero-shot to a Unitree G1 humanoid with BrainCo Revo2 multi-fingered hands and substantially outperforms standard Rapid Motor Adaptation (RMA) and reactive tactile policy baselines across four commercial round doorknobs in the real world.

AI.tldr: TMA：以触觉可观测交互为结构、以锥形几何为多指接触归纳偏置、用触觉历史在线调整电机行为的零样本sim-to-real人形全身有力操作框架，在真实门把开门任务上超越RMA与反应式触觉基线。
AI.motivation: 现有人形loco-manipulation多聚焦几何主导任务（几何对齐+动作执行即可成功），而多指有力操作需应对接触与交互动力学不确定性；现实中的摩擦抓握、无滑移扭矩、力调控推压等难以纯靠视觉几何泛化。
AI.method: 提出TMA（Tactile-Driven Motor Adaptation）：1）将策略学习围绕触觉可观测的交互量建模，而非隐式历史；2）以锥形（摩擦锥）几何作为多指接触表征的归纳偏置；3）基于触觉历史在线自适应调整电机行为（motor adaptation）；4）上身灵巧操作策略与预训练通用locomotion控制器联合训练，兼顾交互与全身稳定；全仿真训练，零样本迁移至Unitree G1+BrainCo Revo2多指手。
AI.result: 四款商用圆形门把真实实验中零样本迁移成功，明显优于标准RMA与反应式触觉策略基线（摘要未给出定量指标）。
AI.conclusion: 触觉驱动的在线电机自适应是几何主导方法之外的可行路径，可实现有力人形操作的高效sim-to-real；圆形门把开门可作为触觉操作的综合基准任务。

title: Probing Where Surprise Happens: Localized Violation-of-Expectation Evaluation of Video World Models
summary: Violation-of-expectation (VOE) benchmarks evaluate intuitive physics in video world models by testing whether physically impossible events produce greater prediction errors than matched possible events. However, conventional VOE evaluations aggregate prediction errors across space and time, making it unclear whether successful discrimination reflects model's understanding of physical violations at the locations and time where they occur. To address this limitation, we introduce localized VOE evaluation, a framework that measures prediction error differences between possible and impossible events within spatial regions and temporal intervals associated with physical violations. We compare global, temporally localized, and spatiotemporally localized evaluations of V-JEPA models pretrained on developmental egocentric videos or large-scale natural video datasets. Our results reveal that global and localized judgments can diverge in both directions: global aggregation can either obscure correct localized discrimination or produce apparent discrimination without corresponding localized evidence. During continued pretraining on developmental egocentric videos, agreement between global and localized judgments changes non-monotonically, while confidence in localized judgments increases despite modest improvements in accuracy. Together, these findings establish localized VOE evaluation as a complementary diagnostic for assessing intuitive physics in video world models and demonstrate that global prediction errors do not necessarily reflect the spatiotemporal evidence of physical violations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"局部化VOE（Violation-of-Expectation，违反预期）"评测框架，只在物理违反发生的空间区域与时间区间内计算"可能/不可能"事件的预测误差差异，并对比全局、时间局部化、时空局部化三种评测，发现全局聚合会双向掩盖或伪造局部判别能力。
AI.motivation: 传统VOE基准将预测误差在时空上整体聚合，无法判断模型的高分是否真的来自物理违反发生的位置与时刻，因而不能作为直觉物理能力的可信诊断。
AI.method: 构建局部化VOE评测：在标注的违反区域与时段内比较possible/impossible事件的预测误差差（空间局部化、时间局部化、时空局部化）；在V-JEPA模型上评测，预训练数据分别为发展性自我中心视频与大规模自然视频，并在发展性自我中心视频上继续预训练以观察演化。
AI.result: 全局与局部判断可在两个方向上背离：全局聚合既可能掩盖正确的局部判别，也可能在缺乏局部证据时产生表观判别；持续预训练中两者一致性呈非单调变化，局部判断置信度上升但准确率提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 局部化VOE可作为视频世界模型直觉物理评估的补充诊断工具；全局预测误差并不必然反映物理违反的时空证据。

title: Robot Demonstration Videos Should Include Transparency Disclosures
summary: This paper argues that the robotics and AI community should adopt disclosure standards for demonstration videos. As physical and financial constraints limit direct public access to embodied AI, public dissemination of progress in robotics is mainly through curated demonstration videos rather than direct experience with the technology. In a large-scale (N=9,341), pre-registered experiment across six countries, we find that the general public struggles to discern both the visual authenticity (e.g., distinguishing real footage from CGI) and behavioral authenticity (e.g., distinguishing autonomy from teleoperation) of robot demonstration videos. The omission of these details distorts public perception, leading people to overestimate the ability of robots to perform tasks and navigate real world environments. Using evidence from behavioral science, we design a disclosure intervention and demonstrate that the inclusion of clear disclosures in robot demonstration videos significantly improves discernment of visual and behavioral authenticity, as well as understanding robots' capabilities. We propose the adoption of disclosure standards for robot demonstration videos to accurately calibrate public expectations and promote transparency in robotics research.

AI.tldr: 大规模预注册实验(N=9,341，六国)表明公众难以辨别机器人演示视频的视觉真实性(真实影像 vs CGI)与行为真实性(自主 vs 遥操作)，并因此高估机器人能力；基于行为科学设计的披露干预可显著改善辨别力，作者据此倡议建立机器人演示视频披露标准。
AI.motivation: 实体AI受物理与成本限制，公众对机器人进展的认知主要经由精选演示视频而非直接体验；若视频隐含CGI、剪辑、遥操作等未披露信息，将系统性扭曲公众预期与研究透明度。
AI.method: 六国、N=9,341的预注册大规模对照实验，测量公众对视觉真实性与行为真实性的辨别能力；随后基于行为科学证据设计披露干预(在视频中加入清晰标注/提示)，并检验其对辨别力与能力理解的影响。
AI.result: 公众在无提示条件下对CGI与真实画面、自主与遥操作的辨别能力均较弱，并显著高估机器人在真实环境中的任务执行能力；加入清晰披露后，视觉与行为真实性辨别力及对机器人能力的理解均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 建议机器人学与AI社区采纳演示视频披露标准，以校准公众预期并提升研究透明度；该文属科学传播/人机信任层面的政策倡议，不含具身方法或系统贡献。

title: Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers: Global Rule Isolation and Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Github Repo: this https URL
summary: We present Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers (RoSeDiT), a new diffusion transformer architecture that isolates the global rule from the image tokens. RoSeViT showed in visual reasoning that a vanilla ViT spreads a shared rule over all $L$ tokens at an entropy of order $Ld$, whereas an enforced controller route reduces it to order $d$. In class-conditional DiT and SiT, the class and the noise level are explicitly conditioned by adaLN, so a RoSeViT-style controller channel on the ViT side is insufficient to establish the full role separation. By introducing the adaLN listening mechanism, which makes adaLN compute under the controller's command, RoSeDiT brings the entropy theorem and role separation into the latent diffusion domain. Under the same SiT training and evaluation protocol at the same level of parameter count, RoSeDiT surpasses SiT at all four model scales at 400K steps, and RoSeDiT-L/2 even surpasses SiT-XL/2's 17.2 FID with 15.34 and 32% fewer parameters. RoSeDiT-XL/2 surpasses SiT-XL/2's 7M-step FID of 8.3 at 1.4M steps with 7.98, using one-fifth as many training steps. We further observe that models with the same denoising loss can have a large FID gap, which indicates a misalignment between the denoising objective and the image manifold. We formalize this phenomenon into Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression (DSMC), a two-stage training schedule with which RoSeDiT-XL/2 surpasses SiT + REPA's 4M-step FID of 5.9 at 2.4M steps with 5.84.

AI.tldr: RoSeDiT 在 DiT/SiT 中引入"角色分离"与 adaLN 监听机制，把 RoSeViT 的熵定理推广到潜空间扩散，并提出 DSMC 两阶段训练调度，在同等参数量与步数下大幅超越 SiT。
AI.motivation: vanilla ViT 会把共享规则摊到全部 L 个 token 上（熵量级 Ld），而带控制器的路由可降到 d；但在类条件 DiT/SiT 中，类别与噪声水平已由 adaLN 显式注入，仅加一条 RoSeViT 式控制器通道无法实现完整的角色分离。另外观察到相同去噪损失的模型 FID 差距很大，暗示去噪目标与图像流形错位。
AI.method: 提出 RoSeDiT 架构，将全局规则与图像 token 隔离；关键设计是 adaLN listening 机制，使 adaLN 在控制器指令下计算，从而在潜扩散域恢复熵定理与角色分离。进一步将"同去噪损失、FID 差距大"的现象形式化为确定性采样流形压缩（DSMC），给出两阶段训练调度。
AI.result: 同等 SiT 训练/评估协议、同等参数量下，400K 步时四个模型尺度全部超越 SiT；RoSeDiT-L/2 以少 32% 参数取得 15.34 FID（优于 SiT-XL/2 的 17.2）；RoSeDiT-XL/2 在 1.4M 步达到 7.98，优于 SiT-XL/2 7M 步的 8.3，训练步数仅其 1/5；结合 DSMC，2.4M 步达到 5.84，超越 SiT+REPA 4M 步的 5.9。
AI.conclusion: 角色分离与 adaLN 监听可作为扩散 Transformer 的通用高效化改造，配合 DSMC 调度能显著提升采样质量与训练效率；去噪目标与图像流形的错位值得作为独立问题研究。

title: Refinement vs. Replanning: Inference Compute Allocation in Robot Policies
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Post-Training Adaptation of Robot Foundation Models
summary: A frozen chunked robot policy can spend deployment-time inference compute in two coupled ways: more work within each policy call to refine a predicted action chunk, or more frequent policy calls to replan from fresh observations. We study this allocation without updating model weights. Our evaluation procedure reports success with both nominal compute rate and complete attempt cost, selects comparisons on discovery tasks, and tests prespecified comparisons on held-out tasks. Comparisons added after inspecting the held-out results only summarize observed patterns. We demonstrate the procedure with one frozen SmolVLA checkpoint in synchronous LIBERO simulation, using denoising count as the refinement control and fixing chunk length at K=50. Arithmetic and latency characterize cost differently: at d=10, 82.1% of counted arithmetic is independent of denoising, whereas a descriptive affine fit to fixed-input host time assigns 17.7% to its intercept. At h=2, d=2 succeeds on 139/160 attempts versus 122/160 for d=5 (+10.6 percentage points; task-conditional 95% interval: +4.4 to +16.9), while using 5.9% less arithmetic per control step. Executing h=5 rather than h=2 at d=2 yields 138/160 versus 139/160 successes and 60.7% lower arithmetic per attempt; equivalence is not established. The case study shows why deployment adaptation must evaluate generation effort and feedback frequency jointly; it does not define a universal setting.

AI.tldr: 冻结的chunked机器人策略在部署时可把推理算力分配给"单次调用内更多去噪精炼"或"更频繁重规划"，论文提出同时报告标称算力与完整尝试成本的评测流程，并在LIBERO/SmolVLA上发现算力指标与延迟指标度量含义不同，h=2,d=2优于d=5，h=5等价性未确立。
AI.motivation: 部署期推理算力有限，chunked策略存在两种耦合的分配方式（单call内精炼 vs 提高重规划频率），但现有工作常只报告成功率而忽略算力/延迟度量口径差异，缺乏可预注册、可分发现与验证阶段的公平比较流程。
AI.method: 不更新权重，仅做推理时分配研究。以冻结SmolVLA在同步LIBERO仿真中演示：去噪步数d控制精炼强度、chunk长度固定K=50、重规划间隔h控制反馈频率。评测流程：在discovery任务上选比较，在held-out任务上做预设比较，事后新增比较仅作描述性总结；同时报告成功率、标称算力速率与完整尝试成本，并对算术计数与host wall-clock（affine拟合）两种成本口径作对比。
AI.result: d=10时82.1%的算术与去噪无关，而固定输入host时间的仿射拟合仅17.7%归入截距，说明算术与延迟刻画成本口径显著不同。h=2,d=2成功139/160，优于d=5的122/160（+10.6pp，任务条件95%区间+4.4~+16.9），且每控制步算术少5.9%。d=2时h=5为138/160（对比139/160），每次尝试算术降60.7%，但未能确立等价性。
AI.conclusion: 案例表明部署期自适应必须联合评估"生成努力"与"反馈频率"，单项成功率不足以指导算力分配；方法论贡献在于可复现的预注册式评测协议，而非一个普适的最优超参设置。

title: Hard or Mislabeled? Failure Screens Enrich Vision Benchmarks for Label Errors
summary: Hard vision benchmarks often keep images that strong classifiers get wrong. Since a classifier is also marked wrong when the label is wrong, such failure screens may collect label errors. We measure this on ImageNet's twice-relabeled validation set with 103 classifiers. Among the 1,892 images that all 66 supervised classifiers get wrong, 61% have a wrong label, versus 11.1% overall. The fewer images a screen lets through, the more of them are mislabeled, along approximately one curve. Fit on one model family, this curve predicts the screens of two held-out model families with a mean error of 2.4 percentage points, and replays of ImageNet-D's and ImageNet-Hard's screens within 0.1 and 6.3 points. On new pools, ImageNet-V2 and CIFAR-10, enrichment at the strictest screens is stronger than the curve predicts: on ImageNet-V2, by human relabeling, 67% of the images that all 66 classifiers get wrong are mislabeled, against 46% predicted. Screens that let models choose among only some of the classes, as ImageNet-A's does (200 of 1,000), fall below the curve. By ReImageNet, 32% of ImageNet-Hard's ImageNet images have no correct label. ScreenAudit, which comprises an audit tool, a script that rebuilds corrected answer sets for the 5,464 decided ImageNet-Hard images (of 5,646) from ReImageNet's gated release, and per-image audits of 1,198 benchmark images, will be released later.

AI.tldr: Hard vision benchmarks trap label errors: 61% of images all 66 supervised classifiers fail on ImageNet val are mislabeled (vs 11.1% overall), and this enrichment follows a predictable curve tied to screen strictness.
AI.motivation: Hard/exhaustive benchmarks select images that strong classifiers get wrong, but such failure screens also select label errors, biasing benchmark conclusions; the authors quantify and model this contamination.
AI.method: Empirical audit on ImageNet's twice-relabeled validation set with 103 classifiers; fit an "error-enrichment vs. screen pass-rate" curve on one model family and test its transfer to two held-out families, replays of ImageNet-D/ImageNet-Hard screens, and new pools (ImageNet-V2 with human relabeling, CIFAR-10); release ScreenAudit tool, corrected answer sets for 5,464 ImageNet-Hard images, and 1,198 per-image audits.
AI.result: 61% mislabeled among the 1,892 images all 66 supervised classifiers fail vs 11.1% overall; curve predicts held-out screens with 2.4pp mean error and replays ImageNet-D/ImageNet-Hard within 0.1/6.3pp; ImageNet-V2 shows stronger-than-predicted enrichment (67% vs 46%); 32% of ImageNet-Hard's ImageNet images have no correct label per ReImageNet.
AI.conclusion: Failure-based hard benchmarks are systematically contaminated by label errors, with a quantifiable, transferable strictness–error-rate law; audits and corrected answer sets are needed before drawing conclusions from hard-benchmark gaps.

title: Certify, Then Select: Viability-Aware Runtime Steering of Frozen Diffusion Policies
summary: Diffusion policies, which generate short action sequences by denoising random noise, are a leading way to learn robot skills from demonstrations. Once deployed, they meet constraints the demonstrations never contained, and retraining for each is impractical. A safety filter edits the policy's action to satisfy them, but the edit ignores the task, and a large edit can leave the policy where it cannot continue. We propose CAST (Certified Action Selection at Test time): draw a few action chunks from the frozen policy, certify each with a barrier condition, and execute the certified chunk that a learned value ensemble ranks highest. We prove that a certified step is safe whatever the critic does; that, whenever a certified sample exists, the executed chunk stays within log N nats of the policy conditioned on feasibility, while a safety-filter projection can be singular to it; and that an exact closed-loop identity splits the gain of ranking into availability, spread and the critic's target. Certifying the next chunk is not enough: a generative controller can have safe actions available now and none later. We characterise the safe control authority of a frozen policy under finite sampling, and CAST-V preserves it through a policy-conditioned viability, estimated with a model under a finite-sample guarantee or learned from the controller's own logs (CAST-VL). On robomimic manipulation, a planar quadrotor, a MuJoCo humanoid and a unicycle, with frozen policies, CAST raises joint task-and-constraint success above the output filter in nearly every setting; certifying before ranking is decisive where a filter's edit is large, and viability removes most dead ends that one-step certification cannot see. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: CAST：测试时从冻结扩散策略采样多个动作块，先用障碍（barrier）条件逐一认证其安全性，再按学习到的价值集合筛选并执行排名最高的认证块；并给出认证步骤安全性、与可行条件策略的KL接近性、以及闭环增益分解的理论保证，进一步提出CAST-V/VL以保持冻结策略的安全控制权限，避免单步认证导致的后续死锁。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略在部署时会遇到示范中未包含的状态约束，逐一重训练不现实；传统安全滤波器对动作做投影式修正会忽略任务目标，且修正幅度大时可能把策略推入不可恢复的区域。同时，"当前有安全动作"不蕴含"之后仍有安全动作"，单步认证不足以保证长期可行。
AI.method: 从冻结策略采样N个动作块；用障碍/控制障碍条件对每个候选块做认证，只在认证通过的集合内由一个价值集成（critic ensemble）排序并执行最优者（certify-before-rank）。扩展CAST-V引入策略条件下的可行性（viability）估计，可由带有限样本保证的模型或由控制器自身日志学习（CAST-VL）得到。理论侧给出三条结果：认证步的安全性不依赖critic、认证样本存在时执行块与"条件于可行性的策略"的KL差距有log N界而滤波投影可能奇异、以及闭环恒等式将排序收益分解为可用性、分散度与critic目标三项。
AI.result: 在robomimic机械臂操作、平面四旋翼、MuJoCo人形与独轮车上，配合冻结策略，CAST在几乎所有设置下将"任务与约束联合成功率"提升至超过输出滤波器；在滤波修正幅度大的情形，先认证后排序的优势尤为显著；viability项消除了大部分单步认证看不到的死锁。理论部分刻画了有限采样下冻结策略的安全控制权限。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把安全约束满足从动作后处理转为候选采样+认证+排序的测试时选择框架，并补上多步可行性，可在不重训练的前提下为冻结生成式策略提供可证明的部署安全性与任务性能保证。

title: SearchChord: Prompt Preselection and Field Recomposition for One-Step Image Editing
summary: Finding effective prompts and seeds for one-step image editors requires balancing edit fidelity, source preservation, and computational cost. To address this challenge, we explore a large collection of candidate edits, where each candidate is defined by a unique prompt-seed pair, and generate corresponding images on demand. We present SearchChord, a training-free framework that leverages a large pool of such candidates, combining text-based preselection, image verification, and latent-field recomposition. Our ablation studies across pool sizes up to 200 candidates show that a pool of 100 offers a cost-effective operating point. Compared with feeding all 100 candidates into recomposition, TextSim preselects a subset of 10 candidates. Rather than uniform averaging, we incorporate image-verifier scores to weight each candidate during recomposition. Experiments on PIE-Bench and the proposed CropWeed-EditBench reveal a trade-off: candidate selection improves target-text alignment, while recomposition better preserves unmodified source content. The oracle verifier achieves the best performance in both preservation and target-text alignment. Practical verification partially recovers semantic alignment, but recomposition still compromises edit fidelity, including in agricultural image edits. These results motivate text-first preselection and stronger verification to balance preservation, fidelity, and cost. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: SearchChord: 无训练框架，用 prompt-seed 候选池 + 文本预选(TextSim) + 图像验证 + 潜场重组来实现单步图像编辑的质量/保真/成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 单步图像编辑器对 prompt 与 seed 敏感，需同时平衡编辑保真度、源内容保持与计算开销，而现有多样化采样与平均/重组策略缺乏系统性分析。
AI.method: 构建最多200个候选(prompt-seed对)的池子并按需生成；用 TextSim 文本相似度从100个候选中预选10个；用图像验证器打分作为重组权重（而非均匀平均）在潜空间做加权场重组；提出 CropWeed-EditBench，并在 PIE-Bench 上做消融。
AI.result: 100个候选是性价比最优工作点；候选选择改善目标文本对齐，重组更好保持未编辑源内容；oracle 验证器在保持与对齐上均最佳；实际验证器仅部分恢复语义对齐，重组仍损失编辑保真度（含农业图像编辑场景）。
AI.conclusion: 提出"文本优先预选 + 更强验证"的组合方向以平衡保持、保真与成本；方法免训练、可直接接入现有编辑管线，代码数据将开源。

title: RoboCoEvo: Expanding Robot Capabilities through Agent-Policy Co-Evolution
summary: Integrating MLLM-based agents with robotic foundation models has attracted increasing attention as a means of enhancing robotic capabilities. However, the improvement of such integrated systems remains largely decoupled across their agent and model components, with advances in one component not necessarily benefiting the other, substantially limiting the capabilities of the combined system. As both MLLMs and robotic foundation models become increasingly capable, fully realizing their combined potential calls for co-evolution, an iterative process in which improvements in agents and robotic foundation models reinforce one another. We propose RoboCoEvo, a failure-guided co-evolution framework that couples the refinement of the agent's explicit and reusable executable knowledge with parameter learning in robotic foundation models, such as vision-language-action (VLA) models. Through a code-as-policy formulation, the agent develops and refines executable failure-detection and recovery programs, generating targeted corrective experience. Post-training consolidates the resulting corrective behaviors into the robotic model's end-to-end policy, improving autonomous task execution. Changes in the updated policy's failure distribution, in turn, guide subsequent revisions to the agent's programs. Experiments on BEHAVIOR-1K, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin demonstrate sustained improvements in autonomous VLA task performance across successive co-evolution rounds.

AI.tldr: RoboCoEvo：以失败为驱动的MLLM智能体与机器人基础模型（VLA）协同进化框架，将智能体可执行"代码即策略"的失败检测/恢复程序与VLA参数后训练闭环耦合。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM智能体与机器人基础模型的集成多为"解耦式"改进：智能体侧或模型侧的进步难以互相增益，限制了组合系统的上限。作者主张需要协同进化（co-evolution），使二者迭代互促。
AI.method: 提出失败引导的协同进化框架。智能体以code-as-policy形式编写并迭代精炼可执行的失败检测与恢复程序，产生针对性纠错经验；随后通过后训练把这些纠错行为固化进VLA模型的端到端策略；更新后策略的失败分布变化再反哺智能体程序的下一轮修订，形成闭环。
AI.result: 在BEHAVIOR-1K、RoboCasa、RoboTwin三个基准上，多轮协同进化后自治VLA任务性能呈持续提升；摘要未给出具体数值与实机验证细节。
AI.conclusion: 表明"智能体可执行知识精炼↔机器人策略参数学习"的迭代闭环是提升VLA自主执行能力的有效路径，为智能体与基础模型的联合演进提供了可复用范式。

title: Reliable Conditioned Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability via Subsolution Learning on Exact Local Windows
summary: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability computes the maximal safe set and a safety filter for a given obstacle configuration, but it must be re-solved whenever the obstacles change, which a deployed robot cannot afford. Learning a single value function conditioned on the obstacle set removes the re-solve, yet it sharpens the central weakness of learned reachability: one network must now cover a whole family of safety problems, and its approximation error carries no preferred sign, so rare obstacle configurations silently produce false-safe states. To address these challenges, we present a conditioned reachability model designed so that the remaining error falls on the conservative side. Specifically, our method caps the obstacle margin, which makes the value function provably local, in the sense that obstacles farther than a known threshold cannot affect it, so the model reads only a body-frame window, trains on small scenes, and transfers to scenes of any size with millisecond per-scene preparation. Moreover, the output structure builds the value bound into the model. By training with counterexample mining over the finite-dimensional window configuration space, we maximize the claimed safe volume subject to the HJ inequality, so the learned set grows toward the true safe set from the conservative side. Across all tested obstacle settings, ours is the only method that combines recovery comparable to per-scene DeepReach training with near-zero rollout collisions. We also extend the method to a 10D quadrotor, again with markedly lower collision rates than the baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种条件化HJ可达性模型：通过限制障碍物margin使值函数可证明局部化，仅在body-frame窗口内训练并可迁移至任意规模场景；输出结构将值界嵌入模型，配合反例挖掘在HJ不等式约束下最大化安全体积，使误差落在保守侧。
AI.motivation: HJ可达性需在障碍变化时重复求解，部署机器人无法承受；单网络条件化学习虽免去重解，但近似误差无符号偏好，罕见障碍配置会静默产生"假安全"状态。
AI.method: 1) 采用cap on obstacle margin（障碍裕度截断）使值函数具备可证明的局部性：距超过已知阈值的障碍不影响值函数，因此只需读取body-frame局部窗口，小场景训练、任意规模场景迁移，每场景准备时间为毫秒级；2) 在输出结构中内建值界（value bound）；3) 在有限维窗口配置空间上做反例挖掘训练，在满足HJ不等式约束下最大化声称的安全体积，使学习到的安全集从保守侧逼近真实安全集。
AI.result: 在所有测试的障碍设置下，是唯一同时达到与逐场景DeepReach训练相当的恢复效果和近零rollout碰撞率的方法；并扩展至10维四旋翼，碰撞率显著低于基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过局部化值函数、结构化值界与保守侧反例挖掘训练，实现免重解、可迁移且误差保守的安全滤波器，适用于多场景与高维系统。

title: FDAM: A Frequency-Direction-Aware Multi-Task Framework for Pavement Crack Grid Localization
summary: Pavement crack grid localization remains challenging for thin and tiny cracks due to weak visual cues and background interference. Box detection often misses these cracks, while supervised semantic segmentation faces limited pixel-wise annotations and high labeling costs. In this paper, we propose a Frequency-Direction-Aware Multi-Task framework (FDAM) with box detection and grid classification branches. The core grid classification branch comprises Frequency-Domain Enhancement (FDE) and Directional Feature Refinement (DFR). FDE adaptively weights spectral bands and fuses reconstructed features with spatial features. DFR captures thin crack patterns through multi-scale strip convolutions, direction-sensitive modulation, and feature recalibration. Sparse positive cells and ambiguous local predictions motivate adaptive grid supervision. Adaptive Importance Reweighting emphasizes uncertain predictions and local label transitions, with focal supervision for all cells. Our contribution is to couple the box detection and grid classification branches through shared feature learning for pavement crack grid localization. We validate FDAM on our RoadDistress2026 dataset of thin and tiny cracks and further evaluate it on public datasets Crack500 and DeepCrack. The code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出频率-方向感知多任务框架FDAM，联合箱检测与网格分类实现薄细路面裂缝的网格定位，通过频域增强、方向特征细化与自适应网格监督提升细裂缝判别，并在RoadDistress2026、Crack500、DeepCrack上验证。
AI.motivation: 薄而细小的路面裂缝视觉线索弱、背景干扰强，箱检测易漏检；有监督语义分割依赖昂贵像素级标注。因此需要一种兼顾定位精度与标注成本的裂缝网格定位方案。
AI.method: FDAM含箱检测与网格分类双分支，共享特征学习。网格分类分支由频域增强FDE（自适�应加权频谱并融合重建特征与空间特征）与方向特征细化DFR（多尺度条带卷积、方向敏感调制、特征重校准）构成；并以自适应重要性重加权（关注不确定预测与局部标签跳变）结合焦点监督进行稀疏正样本的网格级监督。
AI.result: 在自建RoadDistress2026薄细裂缝数据集及公开数据集Crack500、DeepCrack上完成验证，代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享特征学习耦合箱检测与网格分类，可在标注成本较低条件下提升薄细路面裂缝的网格定位性能；属细粒度裂缝感知的领域专用方法。

title: DEFDVO: Deformable Deep Visual Odometry for Equirectangular Images
summary: Omnidirectional ($360^\circ$) cameras capture the full surrounding scene in every frame, providing a strong advantage for visual odometry (VO) over pinhole sensors with a limited field of view. However, their equirectangular projection (ERP) introduces latitude-dependent distortion, an artificial seam at the image border, and a sampling bias toward the poles. Existing $360^\circ$ VO methods address these challenges only partially. DEFDVO closes this gap with a patch-based deep VO method that operates directly on ERP imagery, combining spherically initialized deformable feature extraction, end-to-end seam-aware estimation, and spherical-gradient patch selection. The deformable feature extractor combines spherical geometric priors with learned sampling offsets, while seam-aware processing preserves ERP continuity, and spherical-gradient selection reduces polar sampling bias. Trained exclusively on synthetic TartanAirV2 ERP imagery, DEFDVO improves the best prior average absolute trajectory error (ATE) by $4.8\times$ (0.201 m to 0.042 m) on the TartanAirV2 evaluation set defined by 360DVO and achieves the lowest average ATE on both splits of the real-world 360DVO benchmark. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DEFDVO：一种直接在ERP全景图上运行的patch级深度视觉里程计，联合球面初始化可变形特征提取、端到端接缝感知估计与球面梯度patch选择，在合成数据训练下显著降低轨迹误差并刷新全景VO基准。
AI.motivation: 360°相机可获取全向视野，对VO有利，但ERP投影带来纬度相关畸变、图像边界人为接缝和两极采样偏置三大问题；现有全景VO方法仅部分解决。作者希望用一个统一框架同时处理这三类几何/表示缺陷。
AI.method: patch-based深度VO，直接消费ERP图像，包含三部分：(1) 球面几何先验初始化+学习偏移的deformable特征提取器；(2) 端到端联合优化的seam-aware处理以维持ERP左右边界连续性；(3) 球面梯度引导的patch采样以缓解极区采样偏置。仅在合成TartanAirV2 ERP数据上训练。
AI.result: 在360DVO定义的TartanAirV2评测集上，最优平均ATE从0.201 m降至0.042 m，提升4.8×；在真实世界360DVO benchmark两个split上均取得最低平均ATE。
AI.conclusion: 显式嵌入球面几何先验与接缝/极区分辨感知，可有效弥补ERP表示缺陷；方法具备从合成到真实场景的零样本泛化能力，代码已开源。

title: Leaning Over to Reach Far-Away Objects
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Under review at ICRA 2027. Videos and code at this https URL
summary: We study supported reaching to extend a humanoid robot's workspace by bracing against the environment for stabilization using a straightforward yet capable whole-body model predictive control (MPC) approach, exclusively with local sensing and fiducial markers. While typical solutions for whole body humanoid control aim at avoiding or accommodating contact, contact is explicitly required to reach objects placed on surfaces far out of normal reach. We employ sampling-based MPC for whole-body leaning, bracing, reaching, and recovery on a Unitree H1-2 humanoid. The controller runs in real-time at 34 Hz on a laptop, transfers sim-to-real, extends reach by about 50 cm beyond the unbraced standing workspace, and sustains the loaded posture for over four minutes, before pose estimation drifts. The controller reaches the commanded target in 89% of trials and completes the full reach-and-recovery cycle in 81%, across 54 trials spanning six targets and three table heights. We further characterize why such a small real-time sampling budget is sufficient, finding that temporal persistence of sampled actions and exploration scale strongly govern success, while CEM provides the widest operating region over planning rate and model mismatch. These results establish a real-world baseline for online, contact-rich humanoid manipulation. Code, videos, and full hardware details are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 用采样MPC实现人形机器人支撑（bracing）式全身伸展：仅靠本体感知与视觉标记，实时34Hz，伸展范围+50cm，89%成功到达。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人常规全身控制以避碰或被动适应接触为目标，但触及远处台面物体必须主动利用接触；需要验证简单采样MPC能否在真实硬件上完成支撑-伸展-恢复的接触丰富任务。
AI.method: 在Unitree H1-2上部署采样型全身MPC（含CEM等采样优化器对比），仅用局部传感与fiducial标记做位姿估计；实时34Hz运行于笔记本，分析采样预算充足的原因（时间连续性、探索尺度、规划频率与模型失配）。
AI.result: sim-to-real迁移成功；伸展范围较无支撑站姿扩展约50cm；负载姿态维持超4分钟（至位姿估计漂移）；54次试验、6目标、3桌面高度下到达成功率89%，完整reach-and-recovery 81%；CEM在规划率与模型失配下工作区间最宽。
AI.conclusion: 为在线、接触丰富的人形操作提供了真实世界基线：轻量采样MPC即可实现支撑式全身伸展，关键在动作时间连续性与探索尺度而非采样规模。

title: DecoEdit: Beyond Flat Control for 3D-Aware Unified Image Editing
summary: While recent advances in multimodal image editing have achieved impressive results, current frameworks remain largely confined to ``flat" 2D controls (e.g., text prompts, bounding boxes, or masks). Precise 3D-aware geometric manipulation -- such as coordinating an object's location, physical scale, and 3D orientation while strictly preserving its fine-grained identity -- remains an elusive challenge, typically suffering from severe detail degradation or requiring expensive per-instance fine-tuning. In this paper, we present DecoEdit, an all-in-one image editing framework that goes beyond flat control by seamlessly integrating 1D textual, 2D spatial, and 3D volumetric inputs under a unified architecture. First, to power this unified model, we establish a data curation pipeline and curate a large-scale dataset, namely DecoDataset, containing 1.6 million samples, encompassing diverse multi-dimensional (1D/2D/3D) tasks and their complex compositions. Furthermore, we establish a comprehensive image editing benchmark named DecoBench to systematically evaluate multi-task editing performance. Finally, to address the fundamental trade-off between complex spatial transformations and identity preservation, we propose a novel decoupled pipeline: DecoEdit factorizes the editing process by utilizing structural guidance from SAM-3D to anchor the target geometry, scale, and spatial orientation, while concurrently leveraging a detail-preservation path to lock in high-fidelity textures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoEdit achieves state-of-the-art results. Notably, on the challenging 3D spatial pose and orientation control tasks, DecoEdit significantly outperforms leading closed-source models such as Seedream 5.0 in both geometric accuracy and identity consistency.

AI.tldr: DecoEdit：统一支持1D文本、2D空间、3D几何（位置/尺度/朝向）控制的图像编辑框架，配套1.6M数据集DecoDataset与基准DecoBench，采用SAM-3D结构引导与细节保持解耦双路径。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态图像编辑多局限于"扁平"的2D控制（文本、框、掩码），难以在严格保持细粒度身份的同时精确操控物体位置、物理尺度与3D朝向；常规方法易出现细节退化或需昂贵的逐实例微调。
AI.method: 构建数据策管管线生成1.6M规模DecoDataset（覆盖1D/2D/3D任务及其复合）；建立DecoBench评测基准；提出解耦式编辑流程：由SAM-3D提供结构引导以锚定目标几何、尺度与空间朝向，并并行以细节保持路径锁定高保真纹理。
AI.result: 大量实验显示达到SOTA；在3D空间位姿与朝向控制任务上，几何精度与身份一致性均显著优于Seedream 5.0等闭源领先模型。
AI.conclusion: 解耦结构引导与细节保持是缓解"复杂空间变换 vs 身份保持"权衡的有效范式，为统一1D/2D/3D控制的图像编辑提供了可扩展的数据—模型—评测一体化方案。

title: Wireless Edge-Assisted Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Physical AI
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE ICC
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable embodied artificial intelligence (AI) by translating visual observations and language instructions into robotic actions. Emerging use cases in physical AI are expected to drive the need for efficient inference and communication, as the computational demands of the VLA models pose challenges for real-time control with limited onboard resources. Test-time scaling through latent reasoning allows these models to refine hidden representations without generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens, but introduces a trade-off between task success, inference latency, and energy consumption. In this paper, we address the efficient collaborative inference under a realistic communication scenario. We propose a wireless edge-assisted framework for adaptive latent reasoning (WEALR) that augments onboard computation with edge computing. A decision-making agent jointly selects the execution location and latent-reasoning convergence threshold. We formulate this joint adaptation as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). A Lagrangian-constrained deep reinforcement learning (CDRL) approach, namely trust region policy optimization Lagrangian (TRPO-Lag), learns to balance task performance and resource consumption under varying wireless conditions and task requirements. We evaluate the framework using LIBERO manipulation tasks, profiled VLA inference costs, and ray-traced wireless channels. Experimental results demonstrate that TRPO-Lag achieves up to 23% higher feasibility-weighted task success rate compared to benchmark CDRL methods.

AI.tldr: 无线边缘辅助的自适应潜在推理框架WEALR，用拉格朗日约束深度强化学习(TRPO-Lag)联合决策VLA推理执行位置与潜在推理收敛阈值，在时变无线信道下平衡任务成功率、时延与能耗。
AI.motivation: VLA模型推理开销大，端侧算力与实时控制需求矛盾；test-time latent reasoning可在不生成显式CoT token的前提下提升成功率，但带来成功率—时延—能耗的权衡。真实无线通信场景下的协同推理尚缺自适应机制。
AI.method: 将"执行位置(端侧/边缘)+潜在推理收敛阈值"的联合选择建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP)，采用TRPO-Lag（拉格朗日约束TRPO）学习策略，在资源约束下最大化任务收益。实验基于LIBERO操作任务、实测profile的VLA推理开销与射线追踪无线信道。
AI.result: 相比基准CDRL方法，TRPO-Lag的可行性加权任务成功率最高提升23%。
AI.conclusion: 在真实通信条件下对VLA潜在推理做端边协同的自适应调度是可有效提升资源效率的方向；但验证限于仿真操作基准与信道模型，缺少真实机器人/硬件部署证据。

title: SuperGlance: Driving at a Glance with a Vision-Language Model
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures, 20 tables. Project page: this https URL ; code: this https URL
summary: Autonomous driving is turning to vision-language-action models (VLAs). They answer and plan by decoding, one step at a time. Each step is another forward pass, so a plan can take over a second of GPU time. Embodied AI often pairs such a slow, reasoning System 2 with a fast System 1 that acts. Human drivers plan at a glance, with System 1. Faster designs usually put System 1 outside the vision-language model (VLM), in a planner without its abilities. Yet before a VLM writes its first token, it has already read the scene into one hidden state. We show that, once trained, this hidden state is enough to drive and to answer questions about what the model sees. SuperGlance reads it to turn a decoder-only VLM into an encoder-style driving policy. Its linear head scores a fixed set of 5,273 candidate trajectories. With the set fixed, rewards are computed offline, so supervised targets can be reward-weighted and reinforcement learning maximizes the exact expected reward. Before and during policy training, multiple-choice training keeps the VLM's visual abilities in one pass, so the policy still answers questions about driving scenes. Training questions are built against shortcuts. Each must be answered right in two option orders. Against drift, a KL term keeps each stage near its starting model. One pass offers VLAs a more plausible path to System 1. SuperGlance answers visual multiple-choice questions as well as its base VLM does by decoding. It plans in 84 ms of GPU time, six times faster than Qwen-Drive-1.0, and at least as well on NAVSIM, PAI-AV and WOD-E2E. In AlpaSim closed loop, km per at-fault incident holds for both planners up to a 300-ms delay and drops beyond. With GPU time charged as delay, SuperGlance's lead over Qwen-Drive-1.0 grows from 2.8 to 3.9 times. Delayed by 1.2 s, our model falls below Qwen-Drive-1.0 at its own 518 ms.

AI.tldr: SuperGlance将decoder-only VLM首个token前的隐含状态读出，用线性头对固定5,273条候选轨迹打分，把VLM转为编码器式驾驶策略，单次前向仅84ms，比Qwen-Drive-1.0快6倍且保持视觉问答能力。
AI.motivation: VLA逐token解码规划耗时超过1秒，难以满足具身驾驶的System 1快速反应需求；而现有快速方案把System 1置于VLM之外的规划器中，丢失了视觉语言模型的推理与问答能力。
AI.method: 利用VLM编码完场景后的单一hidden state：线性头对固定轨迹集合打分（固定集合使奖励可离线计算，监督目标可奖励加权，RL可最大化精确期望奖励）；同步用多选题训练（每题需在两种选项顺序下均答对以抗捷径）维持视觉能力，并用KL项约束各阶段不漂移。
AI.result: 视觉多选题表现与基座VLM解码相当；规划84ms，比Qwen-Drive-1.0快6倍，在NAVSIM、PAI-AV、WOD-E2E上不劣于其性能；AlpaSim闭环中两规划器在300ms延迟内每责任事故里程稳定，超此则下降；将GPU时间计入延迟后，相对Qwen-Drive-1.0的优势由2.8倍增至3.9倍；延迟1.2s时跌破Qwen-Drive-1.0自身518ms的表现。
AI.conclusion: 单次前向的hidden state足以同时驱动与回答视觉问题，为VLA提供更可行的System 1路径；方法清晰、效率收益明确，并有闭环延迟鲁棒性分析，属高端相关但非所评核心区（VLA本身）的直接方法突破。

title: Puzzle: One Pass Is Not Enough for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary remote sensing image segmentation (OVRSIS) enables the segmentation of unseen classes without additional annotation or retraining. By analyzing the predictions of existing OVRSIS methods, we find that many misclassified patches coexist with visually similar, correctly classified patches of the same class within the same image. Unfortunately, most of these methods stop after a single inference rather than using their predictions to guide further inference. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Puzzle}, a plug-and-play iterative re-inference framework that combines prediction history with a visual-similarity prior to progressively refine patch-level attention. Puzzle employs a lightweight history-conditioned controller to regulate each patch's contribution as an information source and its reliance on visually similar patches, while an adaptive stopping rule determines when to stop. It keeps the segmentation model frozen and reuses the same controller across different models and datasets without retraining. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements across diverse OVRSIS models and datasets, highlighting the strong transferability of Puzzle. Moreover, Puzzle can further improve the performance of SOTA methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 Puzzle：一种即插即用的迭代重推理框架，利用预测历史与视觉相似性先验逐步细化 patch 级注意力，提升开放词表遥感图像分割（OVRSIS）对未见类别的分割效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 OVRSIS 方法单次推理即停止，但预测结果中常出现「同图内视觉相似、却分类正确与错误并存」的 patch，这一可利用的误差模式未被用于后续推理。
AI.method: 框架保持分割模型冻结，用轻量级、以历史预测为条件的控制器，为每个 patch 调节其作为信息源的贡献度及对视觉相似 patch 的依赖度，并以自适应停止规则终止迭代；控制器跨模型、跨数据集复用，无需重训。
AI.result: 在多种 OVRSIS 模型与数据集上取得一致的性能提升，显示良好迁移性，并可进一步提升 SOTA 方法的表现。
AI.conclusion: 迭代式重推理是低成本、可插拔的增益手段，适用于多种已有 OVRSIS 模型；但仅在遥感分割场景验证，与机器人/3D/具身任务无直接关联。

title: ImpedanceMimic: Learned Impedance as Action Space for Force-Accurate Motion Imitation
comment: 39 pages, 13 figures, 28 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Recovering the forces behind a motion is ill-posed: different controllers can reproduce the same movement while generating different contact forces. Physics-based motion imitation resolves this ambiguity through simulation, but relies on fixed-gain proportional-derivative (PD) control. We show that fixed gains impose a trade-off between motion and force tracking, as contact and swing place conflicting demands on joint stiffness and damping. We introduce ImpedanceMimic, a reinforcement-learning policy that modulates per-joint stiffness, damping, and position setpoints from motion and force measurements, but requires only motion at inference. Across 129 participants and six activities, ImpedanceMimic outperforms matched fixed-gain PD under every integration scheme, direct-torque, muscle-actuated and existing imitation controllers in kinematic and force fidelity, approaching a dedicated motion-to-force regressor. By expressing gains as multiples of inertia-scaled priors, a single policy controls subject-specific biomechanical models without explicit anthropometric input and transfers zero-shot to unseen humans and a humanoid robot. The learned impedance forms a low-dimensional representation of motor state, shared across bodies, that generalizes to withheld activities: stiffness scales with load, and damping anticipates unloading.

AI.tldr: 提出ImpedanceMimic：用强化学习策略从运动与力测量中逐关节调制刚度、阻尼与位置设定点，推理时仅需运动输入；以惯性缩放先验的倍数表达增益，实现跨身体（受试者生物力学模型、未见人类、人形机器人）零样本迁移，并在129名受试者六项活动上超越固定增益PD与现有模仿控制器。
AI.motivation: 从运动反推力（力）是病态问题：不同控制器可复现同一运动却产生不同接触力。基于物理的运动模仿依赖固定增益PD控制，而接触与摆动阶段对关节刚度/阻尼需求冲突，固定增益在运动跟踪与力跟踪间形成固有权衡。
AI.method: ImpedanceMimic：RL策略以运动与力测量为输入，输出每关节的刚度、阻尼与位置设定点（变阻抗控制）；训练后推理仅需运动。增益参数化为惯性缩放先验的倍数，使单一策略控制不同受试者特定生物力学模型而无需显式人体测量输入。
AI.result: 在129名受试者、六项活动中，运动学与力保真度均优于匹配固定增益PD（所有积分方案）、直接力矩、肌肉驱动及既有模仿控制器，接近专用运动到力回归器；零样本迁移至未见人类与人形机器人；学习到的阻抗构成跨身体共享的低维运动状态表示，可泛化到留出活动：刚度随负载增大，阻尼预期卸载。
AI.conclusion: 变阻抗是消解运动-力歧义的关键控制表征；惯性缩放先验下的增益调制可实现跨身体、跨任务的通用且可解释的运动状态表示。

title: From zero-target transfer to target-site personalization: multi-source training across fall-detection models
summary: Video-based fall detection could support timely assistance when a person cannot call for help. Unfamiliar cameras and scarce local labels challenge deployment. We examine whether joint training improves cross-dataset detection and subsequent local training. We analyze 2,697 clips from eight OmniFall datasets and one AI-Hub dataset. Positive clips contain a fall or collapse transition, while negative clips do not. We hold out each dataset in turn, training on the other eight. We evaluate three vision-language models (VLMs), Qwen, LLaVA, and InternVL, and three visual baselines, CLIP-temporal, VideoMAE, and Pose-TCN. We evaluate the stored source model without target data for training or selection. For each label budget, we update a separate copy using labeled clips from the held-out target dataset. We call this target-site personalization. We compare the Source-initialized model with Target-only, which skips source training but uses identical target clips and updates. Across nine targets, source training raises mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) from frozen-model values of 0.821 to 0.912 for Qwen, 0.883 to 0.947 for LLaVA, and 0.939 to 0.962 for InternVL. With five target examples per class and 26 updates per run, 95% confidence intervals for the AUROC benefit over Target-only lie above zero for Qwen, CLIP-temporal, VideoMAE, and Pose-TCN. With full-target training, they lie above zero only for Qwen and LLaVA. Separate VLM analyses reveal threshold sensitivity and post-fall false detections. The benefit varies by model and label budget.

AI.tldr: 论文在OmniFall等9个数据集上做留一数据集交叉验证，比较Qwen/LLaVA/InternVL三种VLM与CLIP-temporal/VideoMAE/Pose-TCN三种视觉基线，检验"源域联合训练+目标站点个性化微调"对视频跌倒检测跨域泛化的增益。
AI.motivation: 视频跌倒检测需要及时救助，但部署现场摄像头陌生、目标站点标注稀缺，需回答跨数据集联合训练是否有助跨域检测与后续本地微调。
AI.method: 2697个片段（8个OmniFall数据集+1个AI-Hub数据集），正样本含跌倒/倒地过渡；逐数据集留出，用其余8个训练源模型；在目标域不参与训练与选择的前提下评估，再按不同标签预算用目标域有标注片段做target-site personalization，与Target-only（跳过源训练、用相同目标片段与更新）对比。
AI.result: 源训练将冻结模型平均AUROC从0.821提至0.912（Qwen）、0.883提至0.947（LLaVA）、0.939提至0.962（InternVL）；每类5个目标样本、每次26步更新时，Qwen、CLIP-temporal、VideoMAE、Pose-TCN相对Target-only的AUROC增益95%置信区间下限大于0；全量目标训练时仅Qwen与LLaVA显著。VLM分析揭示阈值敏感性与跌倒后误检。
AI.conclusion: 源域联合训练可提升跨域跌倒检测，并可作为本地个性化的有效初始化，但增益随模型与标签预算变化；VLM用于该任务存在阈值敏感和后跌倒误检问题，需针对性校准。

title: EviRef: Evidence-Specific Memories for Logical Anomaly Detection across Capture Conditions
summary: Logical anomalies arise when every component looks normal but their combination violates the scene rules. In practical inspection, these rules must hold under varying backgrounds, illumination, and imaging quality, with only a few dozen normal images per scene, whereas existing methods couple normality with appearance and merge different constraints into one reference. We model logical normality as decomposable constraints and propose EviRef, a training-free method that builds a separate reference memory for each family of evidence. Component prototypes built once per scene parse images under any capture condition into one label space, on which occupancy and relation constraints are verified. Semantic constraints are verified with whole-image embeddings independent of parsing, and additional evidence such as text is admitted through a task-level gate without modifying existing memories. On VID-AD, EviRef attains a mean image-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 92.1% (88.9% with visual evidence alone), the highest among the compared methods under each of five capture conditions, with a standard deviation of 0.5. Even with memories built from only 20 normal images per task, it surpasses all compared methods that use 50 normal images per task.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 EviRef 框架，将逻辑异常检测拆解为可分解约束（组件原型、占用/关系、语义、文本），每类证据独立建参考记忆，在 VID-AD 上达 92.1% 图像级 AUROC。
AI.motivation: 逻辑异常指各部件正常但组合违反场景规则；实际检测需在背景、光照、成像质量变化下、仅几十张正常图成立。现有方法把"正常性"与外观耦合，且将不同约束混入单一参考。
AI.method: 将逻辑正常性建模为可分解约束：每场景一次性构建组件原型，把任意拍摄条件下的图像解析到统一标签空间，在其上验证占用与关系约束；语义约束用与解析无关的整图嵌入验证；额外证据（如文本）经任务级门控接入而不改动已有记忆。全程免训练。
AI.result: VID-AD 上图像级 AUROC 均值 92.1%（仅视觉证据 88.9%），在五种拍摄条件下均为最优，标准差 0.5；每任务仅用 20 张正常图即超过所有使用 50 张的对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 可分解的约束+独立参考记忆设计能在低样本、多成像条件下稳健检测逻辑异常，且支持无缝扩展新证据模态。

title: Isolating Perception for Multi-View Planning under Occlusion-Induced Partial Observability
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are beginning to saturate visual planning benchmarks, yet they fail to resolve depth ambiguity and degrade sharply with problem size under occlusion-induced partial observability (PO). We introduce BW-PO based on the Blocksworld domain, a controlled benchmark that reduces existing VLM planners and formalizers to near-zero performance, and propose VLM-as-perceiver, a paradigm that narrows the VLM's role to local perception while delegating cross-view evidence reconciliation and plan generation to external solvers. Across model-specific challenging subsets of BW-PO, this raises plan success from 1% to 97% for Gemma-4-31B, 0% to 95% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 3% to 84% for Gemini-3.1-Pro. Isolating perception in this way separates two bottlenecks that are otherwise entangled: reconciliation under depth ambiguity, and completeness of visual extraction under scene density.

AI.tldr: 提出 BW-PO 基准（基于 Blocksworld，引入遮挡导致的局部可观测与深度歧义），并给出 VLM-as-perceiver 范式：VLM 只做局部感知，跨视角证据协调与规划交给外部求解器，成功率从 1%/0%/3% 提升到 97%/95%/84%。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在视觉规划基准上趋于饱和，但在遮挡引起的部分可观测（PO）下无法解决深度歧义，且随问题规模增大性能急剧下降；现有评测也把"跨视角证据协调"与"视觉提取完整性"两类瓶颈混在一起。
AI.method: 构建 BW-PO 受控基准（Blocksworld + 遮挡/深度歧义/规模扩展）；提出 VLM-as-perceiver：将 VLM 角色收窄为局部观测感知，把跨视角证据协调与规划生成外包给外部符号/搜索求解器；在模型特定困难子集上做消融以分离两类瓶颈。
AI.result: Gemma-4-31B 从 1%→97%，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 从 0%→95%，Gemini-3.1-Pro 从 3%→84%；表明解耦感知后，深度歧义下的证据协调与高密度场景的提取完整性可被分别诊断。
AI.conclusion: VLM 作为端到端规划器的失败主要源于跨视角证据协调与深度歧义，而非纯感知能力；将 VLM 降级为局部感知器 + 外部求解器的组合式架构在该类任务上显著更可靠。

title: WA-JEPA: Goal-Aware Predictive Feedback Action Refinement for a World-Action Model
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, including supplementary material. Code available at this https URL
summary: JEPA-based world models predict action consequences in latent space, but representative planning approaches rely on candidate-action search, requiring repeated evaluation of action sequences and incurring substantial online computational cost. Direct action generation avoids this search, yet how to leverage latent predictions to guide action generation given task goals remains a key challenge in translating learned physical dynamics into effective decisions. We introduce WA-JEPA, a world-action model that couples action generation, action-conditioned latent prediction, and goal-aware feedback. The model first generates an action proposal and predicts the resulting future scenes and proprioceptive states, then refines the proposal through two complementary feedback paths, using the task goal as a reference. Goal-discrepancy residual feedback (GDRF) uses differences between the latent representations of predicted scenes and the task goal to guide chunk-wise action refinement. Future-scene context feedback (FSCF) preserves fine-grained predicted scene representations to guide subsequent action refinement. Jointly learned from offline demonstrations, this process iteratively updates the same plan before execution, making future predictions directly participate in action generation without candidate-action search. We evaluate short-horizon goal reaching, long-horizon tasks, and full-task execution. The results show that goal-aware predictive feedback supports competitive task performance while maintaining a compact model and low online computational cost. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: WA-JEPA：将动作生成、动作条件的潜空间预测与目标感知反馈耦合的世界-动作模型，用GDRF与FSCF两条反馈路径迭代精化动作块，避免候选动作搜索。
AI.motivation: JEPA式世界模型虽能在潜空间预测动作后果，但主流规划依赖候选动作序列搜索，需反复评估动作序列，在线计算开销大；而直接生成动作虽免去搜索，却缺乏如何利用潜空间预测在给定任务目标下引导动作生成的机制。
AI.method: 先由模型生成初始动作提案，并预测对应未来场景与本体状态潜表示；再以任务目标为参考，通过两条互补反馈路径精化提案：(1) 目标差异残差反馈（GDRF）利用预测场景潜表示与目标潜表示的差异，进行块级（chunk-wise）动作精化；(2) 未来场景上下文反馈（FSCF）保留细粒度预测场景表示以引导后续动作精化。整体从离线示范联合学习，执行前对同一计划迭代更新。
AI.result: 在短时域目标到达、长时域任务与完整任务执行三类设定上，目标感知预测反馈取得有竞争力的任务表现，同时模型紧凑、在线计算成本低。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间预测可直接参与动作生成而无需候选动作搜索，目标差异与场景上下文反馈是衔接世界模型与决策的有效接口；但摘要未给出具体成功率数字与实机验证细节。

title: Do VLMs Really Look at the Road? A Diagnostic Evaluation for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for autonomous driving through question-answering benchmarks, yet high benchmark accuracy does not necessarily reflect visually grounded reasoning. We present a diagnostic evaluation framework that systematically probes whether VLMs base safety-critical driving decisions on visual evidence or instead rely on language priors, answer biases, and dataset regularities. Our benchmark comprises two task categories, Adverse Weather and Junctions \& Intersections, with a nuScenes spatial reasoning extension, and evaluates open-source (general, driving, and spatial-reasoning) VLMs along four diagnostic protocols: image versus no-image evaluation, counterfactual weather sensitivity, linguistic robustness under paraphrasing and negation, and spatial reasoning. All ground-truth labels are derived programmatically from BDD100K and DriveLM annotations, enabling reproducible evaluation without manual labeling. Across all models, we find that competitive overall accuracy conceals systematic failure modes, including strong affirmation bias, limited sensitivity to counterfactual scene changes, near-chance performance on negated questions despite high paraphrase consistency, and confident driving decisions even without visual input. These results demonstrate that current open-source VLMs remain insufficiently grounded for safety-critical autonomous driving and underscore the need for diagnostic evaluation beyond aggregate accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断式评测框架，从四个协议（有无图像、反事实天气、改写/否定语言鲁棒性、空间推理）检验开源VLM在自动驾驶中是否真正基于视觉证据推理，发现总体精度掩盖了肯定偏置、缺乏反事实敏感性和无语义入力下的自信决策。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶VLM的QA基准高分未必代表视觉grounded推理，可能是依赖语言先验、答案偏置与数据集规律，需诊断性评测揭示安全隐患。
AI.method: 构建Adverse Weather与Junctions/Intersections两类任务，并加nuScenes空间推理扩展；评测通用、驾驶与空间推理类开源VLM；采用四种诊断协议：有图vs无图、反事实天气敏感性、同义改写与否定下的语言鲁棒性、空间推理；真值由BDD100K与DriveLM标注程序化生成以保证可复现。
AI.result: 所有模型呈现系统性失效：强肯定偏置、对反事实场景变化不敏感、否定问句接近随机水平（尽管改写一致性高）、无视觉输入仍给出高置信驾驶决策；总体精度与真实视觉grounding脱节。
AI.conclusion: 当前开源VLM对安全攸关自动驾驶仍grounding不足，需超越聚合精度的诊断式评测。

title: Calibrating the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth without Labels
summary: Self-supervised monocular depth networks can predict a per-pixel uncertainty, which is mainly evaluated by how well it ranks pixels according to their error. Such metrics are insensitive to the magnitude of the uncertainty, so an uncertainty half as large as the actual error obtains the same score. In this paper, we investigate whether the predicted uncertainty is as large as the depth error, both on average (scale) and across confident and uncertain, near and far pixels (shape). On KITTI, the scale is miscalibrated for every uncertainty estimate we evaluate, and the error of MonoProb is nearly twice its predicted uncertainty. We propose MonoCal, which corrects both the scale and the shape without ground-truth depth. Scale calibration multiplies the uncertainty by a single constant measured from stereo pairs, requiring no retraining, and this constant closely matches the one fitted with ground truth. Since a constant cannot change the shape, we further retrain the uncertainty to predict where the depth of the network disagrees with that of a second self-supervised network. Experiments on KITTI show that MonoCal achieves better calibration across uncertainty levels and depth ranges than rescaling with ground truth, while still using a single image at inference. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: MonoCal: 用双目对估计的单一常数校正自监督单目深度不确定性尺度，并用第二个自监督网络的不一致重训练不确定性形状，无需真值深度。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督单目深度不确定性评估只看排序质量（如 sparsification 曲线），对量级不敏感——误差减半的不确定性可获同分。作者因此考察不确定性与深度误差在均值（尺度 scale）与在不同置信度/远近像素分布（形状 shape）上的一致性，发现 KITTI 上所有估计均尺度失准，MonoProb 误差约为预测不确定性的两倍。
AI.method: 1) 尺度校准：用双目立体匹配得到的不确定性估计中位数/统计量，计算一个全局常数乘到不确定性上，无需重训练，且该常数与用真值深度拟合的常数高度吻合。2) 形状校准：因全局常数无法改变形状，进一步重训练不确定性分支，使其预测第一网络与第二个自监督网络深度不一致之处（disagreement 作为监督信号）。推理时仍只用单张图像。
AI.result: KITTI 实验中，MonoCal 在不同不确定性层级与不同深度范围上的校准效果优于用真值深度做 rescaling；推理阶段仅需单张图像。
AI.conclusion: 自监督单目深度的不确定性普遍存在尺度失准，仅靠排序指标会掩盖问题；将尺度校准（双目单常数）与形状校准（第二网络不一致重训练）结合，可在无真值深度条件下获得跨不确定性层级与深度区间的更好校准，且不增加推理成本。局限在于校准常数与训练监督依赖特定数据集/立体基线，跨域泛化与下游（如 SLAM、避障阈值化）的实际收益未验证。

title: Distilling Safety Filters for Filter-free Multi-agent RL
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can teach robot teams to navigate shared spaces, but trial and error causes collisions that real robots cannot afford. Control barrier function (CBF) safety filters prevent these collisions by correcting unsafe actions, yet in a team the filter becomes a centralized optimization whose number of constraints grows quadratically with the team size. We propose an approach that builds the filter's safety into the RL policy and examine how such a system behaves during filter-free deployment. However, the filter that keeps training safe also hides what the policy must learn: it masks the cost of unsafe actions, which actor-critic methods then overvalue, and it keeps near-collision states out of the training data. Our approach therefore learns only from executed safe actions with implicit Q-learning and distills the filter into the policy at synthetic near-collision states. We prove that filter distillation loss bounds the policy's constraint violation and hence how far agents can cross their safety margin, so errors never accumulate. When distillation states cover deployed states, the loss also bounds the collision probability at every step. Without a filter and acting only on local observations, our policies have no collisions in 1,800 test episodes with multiple agents. A policy trained with three agents transfers zero-shot to teams of twenty at constant per-agent computation and stays collision-free with up to eight agents. We test our policies on Crazyflie quadrotors with up to five flying at the same time.

AI.tldr: 提出将控制屏障函数(CBF)安全滤波器蒸馏进多机器人RL策略的方法：用隐式Q学习仅从已执行的安全动作学习，并在合成的近碰撞状态上蒸馏滤波器，理论证明蒸馏损失可界定约束违反与碰撞概率，实现无滤波器、仅局部观测的去中心化安全部署。
AI.motivation: 多机器人共享空间导航中RL需要试错，真实机器人无法承受碰撞；CBF安全滤波器可纠正不安全动作，但团队场景下集中式滤波器约束数随团队规模平方增长，难以扩展且部署成本高。
AI.method: (1) 将CBF安全滤波器的安全性内化到RL策略中；(2) 指出滤波器会掩盖不安全动作代价（actor-critic高估）并把近碰撞状态排除出训练数据；(3) 仅用已执行的安全动作配合隐式Q学习训练；(4) 在合成的近碰撞状态上做滤波器蒸馏；(5) 给出理论分析：蒸馏损失上界策略约束违反度，当蒸馏状态覆盖部署状态时亦上界每步碰撞概率。
AI.result: 无滤波器、仅局部观测下，多智能体1,800次测试回合零碰撞；3智能体训练的策略以恒定的单智能体计算量零样本迁移到20个智能体，且在最多8个智能体时保持无碰撞；在Crazyflie四旋翼上验证，最多5架同时飞行。
AI.conclusion: 通过安全滤波器蒸馏可在保持理论安全保障的同时，实现可扩展、去中心化、无滤波器的多机器人安全导航策略，并具备良好的规模泛化与真机可行性。

title: Ref-MIL: Plug-and-Play Posterior Refinement for Multiple Instance Learning in QSM-Based Brain Disease Classification
summary: Quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) is a novel quantitative MRI contrast for studying tissue susceptibility changes in brain disorders, including Parkinson's disease (PD) and multiple sclerosis (MS). However, small cohorts and the lack of local annotations make developing deep learning models for QSM-based diagnosis challenging. In this work, we propose PoRef-MIL, a weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) framework combining iterative slice relabeling and network retraining with a plug-and-play posterior refinement module (PRM). During training, a 2D dual-branch diagnosis network and a subject-level classifier were alternately trained for five rounds. The classifier was used to update slice pseudo-labels for retraining the diagnosis network. The PRM was applied during inference to refine slice probabilities through bidirectional posterior inference and calculate entropy-derived confidence from the refined probabilities, which was then used in sliding-window scoring to obtain subject-level predictions. PoRef-MIL was evaluated on an in-house PD cohort of 287 participants and a public MS cohort of 150 participants. Compared with eight classification methods, PoRef-MIL achieved the highest mean areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.942 and 0.872, and accuracies of 0.926 and 0.833, for PD and MS classification, respectively. Ablation experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness of iterative relabeling and PRM, and the plug-and-play feature of the proposed PRM was also evaluated using four state-of-the-art MIL models. Overall, PoRef-MIL offers a promising approach to QSM-based disease classification in small cohorts without manual slice annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出PoRef-MIL弱监督多实例学习框架，用迭代切片重标注+即插即用后验精化模块实现基于QSM图像的小样本帕金森病与多发性硬化症分类。
AI.motivation: QSM是研究PD、MS等脑部疾病组织磁化率变化的定量MRI对比，但队列规模小、缺乏切片级局部标注，使深度学习诊断建模困难。
AI.method: 2D双分支诊断网络与受试者级分类器交替训练五轮，用分类器更新切片伪标签重训诊断网络；推理阶段引入即插即用的后验精化模块PRM，通过双向后验推断细化切片概率，并由其熵推导置信度用于滑窗打分得到受试者级预测。
AI.result: 在287例自建PD队列与150例公开MS队列上，平均AUC达0.942与0.872，准确率0.926与0.833，优于八种对比方法；消融验证迭代重标注与PRM有效性，并在四种先进MIL模型上验证PRM的即插即用性。
AI.conclusion: PoRef-MIL为小样本、无切片级人工标注的QSM疾病分类提供了可行方案，可作为弱监督医学影像分类的通用后处理增强组件。

title: Ego2Sim2Humanoid: Agentic Real-to-Sim for Learning Loco-Manipulation VLAs without Robot Demonstrations
summary: Imitation learning for visuomotor policies typically relies on teleoperated robot demonstrations, which are costly because every episode requires a trained operator controlling a physical robot in real time through teleoperation interfaces and wearable body-tracking hardware.
