Egocentric glasses capture human demonstrations without a robot or handheld grippers, yet they track only the head and in-view human hands, and directly copying human motion to a robot with different stature, arm reach and hand morphology fails to produce feasible contacts. \method{} converts egocentric glasses recordings into physically verified robot training trajectories. An agentic real-to-sim stage reconstructs collision and textured visual assets from the recorded RGB-D and head streams, completes unseen surfaces when needed, and predicts target contact bands on the manipulated objects. During motion adaptation, a grasp planner turns each contact band into a feasible robot wrist pose and finger closure, bilevel stance optimization plans collision-free standing postures that keep hand targets reachable, and a whole-body motion generator synthesizes lower-body locomotion and out-of-view arm motion. Two-stage motion correction then blends visibility transitions kinematically and trains a reinforcement-learning tracking policy in physics simulation under agent-designed semantic rewards, completing manipulation phases even when the object leaves the camera view. Rendering the reconstructed scene through the robot's onboard camera along the optimized rollout yields synchronized robot-view images, proprioception and verified action labels. Fine-tuned exclusively on this converted dataset, without real-robot demonstrations, GR00T N1.7 performed loco-manipulation tasks autonomously on a Unitree G1. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出从自我中心眼镜视频到机器人训练轨迹的转换管线：agentic real-to-sim重建+接触带预测、抓取/站立姿态双层优化、全身运动生成与两阶段运动修正，生成同步机器视角图像与动作标签；仅用该数据微调GR00T N1.7即可在Unitree G1上自主完成locomanipulation。
AI.motivation: 遥操作采集机器人示教成本高（需操作员实时操控真机+可穿戴动捕）；自我中心眼镜免机器人采集但仅有头部与视野内手部信息，且人体与机器人身材、臂展、手型差异导致直接迁移产生不可行接触。需要把人类示教自动转为物理可行的机器人训练数据。
AI.method: (1) agentic real-to-sim：由RGB-D与头部流重建碰撞/纹理资产，补全未见表面，预测物体目标接触带；(2) 运动适配：抓取规划器将接触带转为可行腕部位姿与手指闭合，bilevel站立姿态优化保证手部目标可达且无碰撞，全身运动生成器合成下肢移动与视野外手臂运动；(3) 两阶段运动修正：可见性切换处做运动学混合，并在物理仿真中以agent设计的语义奖励训练RL跟踪策略，补全物体出视野后的操作阶段；(4) 沿优化rollout用机器人机载相机渲染重建场景，产出同步机器视角图像、本体感觉与验证动作标签。
AI.result: 仅用转换数据集、无任何真机示教微调GR00T N1.7，在Unitree G1上实现自主locomanipulation任务执行。
AI.conclusion: 自我中心人类视频可经agentic real-to-sim与物理验证的运动适配，转化为可直接训练VLA策略的高质量机器人数据，显著降低示教采集成本；但真机验证的任务范围与数据规模尚有限。

title: Self-Calibrating Vision-Agent-Action: Deploying Pick-and-Place to New Robot Cells without Demonstrations or Fine-Tuning
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables; supplementary video in ancillary files
summary: In simulation, Vision-Agent-Action (VAA) performs pick-and-place in robot cells with gripper or base-frame changes without robot demonstrations or fine-tuning. It uses pre-trained vision-language and language models for interpretation, measures the command map and camera geometry from its own motion and fingertips, estimates lens distortion, and plans grasps from measured object depth. A controlled study of eight public LIBERO-fine-tuned vision-language-action models (VLAs) varies robot hardware, camera geometry, appearance, and base frame. Gripper and frame changes dominate their losses in the tested fractional design. Across 18 cells with these changes, frozen VAA achieves 230/360 successes (64%), the refined VAA 268/360 (74%), and the strongest released VLA on this subset 76/360 (21%). Paired ablations support the self-calibration bundle, lens estimation under compounded changes, and the measured-depth pipeline. On a two-step LIBERO-Goal chain with object state carried between instructions, VAA completes 54/60 chains in changed cells, while four evaluated VLAs complete none.

AI.tldr: VAA（Vision-Agent-Action）无需机器人示范或微调，在仿真中通过自运动与指尖测量实现自标定，完成夹爪更换与基座坐标系变化下的抓放任务，在18个变化场景中达成230/360（精化后268/360），远超最强开源VLA的76/360。
AI.motivation: 现有微调VLA对机器人硬件（夹爪）与基座坐标系变化极度脆弱，而跨平台部署恰恰需要这类鲁棒性；作者希望不依赖机器人数据，仅靠预训练视觉语言模型与自标定即可完成操作。
AI.method: 采用预训练VLM/LLM进行指令与场景解读；通过自身运动与指尖观测测量指令映射与相机几何，估计镜头畸变，并由实测物体深度规划抓取。对8个已发布的LIBERO微调VLA在硬件、相机几何、外观、基座坐标系四因素上做受控分数析因研究，并进行配对消融实验。
AI.result: 夹爪与基座坐标系变化是VLA性能损失主因；18个变化场景下冻结VAA为230/360（64%），精化VAA为268/360（74%），最强开源VLA仅76/360（21%）。消融支持自标定组合、复合变化下镜头估计与实测深度流程。两步LIBERO-Goal链式任务中VAA完成54/60，四个VLA全部为0。
AI.conclusion: 无数据、免微调的自标定智能体式方案在硬件与坐标系变化下显著优于端到端VLA，提示跨形态泛化可更多依赖测量与工具化推理而非大规模机器人数据拟合。

title: LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search
summary: Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We show that LogT-SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms the state-of-the-art trained with both SFT and RL, despite using 3.1$\times$ less data and $>120\times$ fewer GPU hours. Furthermore, applying a simple RL recipe without tool-specific design on LogT-SFT yields a model that surpasses prior methods with complex RL setups by a substantial 9.59-point margin. In addition to strong performance gains, our model exhibits higher tool-use accuracy and efficiency, as well as more structured and logically consistent reasoning traces, directly validating the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出LogT——全自动SFT数据引擎，通过显式逻辑链引导生成高质量工具调用（Zoom-in）推理数据，无需复杂RL即可让VLM在细粒度视觉搜索中兼顾逻辑推理与精准高效工具使用。
AI.motivation: 现有"用图像思考"的VLM依赖SFT+RL及工具专用设计，但逻辑推理与准确高效的工具使用难以兼得；作者认为瓶颈不在RL复杂度而在于SFT数据质量。
AI.method: 构建全自动数据引擎LogT，生成具有挑战性、视觉接地的问题与类人逻辑的结构化工具使用轨迹（logic-chain-guided reasoning），构造SFT数据集；在Qwen2.5-VL-7B与InternVL3.5-8B上微调，并在7个基准测试集上评测，另用简单RL配方进一步训练。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-VL-7B上的LogT-SFT在数据量少3.1倍、GPU小时少120倍以上的情况下超越SOTA的SFT+RL方法；在其上施加无工具专用设计的简单RL后，较复杂RL方案提升9.59点；工具调用准确率与效率更高，推理轨迹更结构化、逻辑一致。
AI.conclusion: 高质量、逻辑链约束的SFT数据是解锁VLM工具化视觉推理的关键，可显著降低对复杂RL设计与算力的依赖，并在性能、效率与推理可解释性上同时获益。

title: Incremental Learning of Vision-Language Models via Task Subspace Projection and Dynamic LoRA
comment: Pre-peer-review version of an article accepted for publication in the International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV)
summary: Recent pre-trained vision-language models often encounter a Multi-Domain Task-Incremental Learning (MTIL) scenario in practice, where a set of classes of multi-modal tasks arrive incrementally. Due to privacy concerns and memory constraints, MTIL with pre-trained models encounters forgetting of knowledge from old tasks, degradation of zero-shot transfer capability, and underfitting of new-task knowledge. To overcome these challenges, previous MTIL methods attempt to learn a discriminative cross-task identification (CTI) module and an effective new-task adaptation (NTA) module. However, current CTI modules suffer from severe task confusion between seen and unseen tasks, and NTA modules cannot adaptively balance the performance and parameter cost while incorporating task-specific knowledge. To alleviate the above dilemmas, we propose an effective and efficient TSP-DLoRA method for MTIL, which consists of Task Subspace Projection (TSP) and Dynamic Low Rank Adapter (DLoRA) modules. Specifically, our TSP module includes a task identifier classifier based on task-specific subspaces and a feature projection strategy that can determine the identifier associated with samples from both seen and unseen tasks. Our DLoRA improves the knowledge adaptation from new tasks by dynamically assigning Low Rank Adapter (LoRA) across transformer layers based on the task distributions. Experimental evaluations across 11 datasets, using three performance metrics, demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TSP-DLoRA方法，用于预训练视觉-语言模型的多域任务增量学习（MTIL），包含任务子空间投影（TSP）与动态低秩适配器（DLoRA）两个模块，以缓解旧任务遗忘、零样本迁移能力退化与新任务欠拟合问题。
AI.motivation: 预训练VLM在实际中常面临多域任务增量学习场景，受隐私与内存限制无法重访旧数据，导致旧任务知识遗忘、零样本迁移能力下降及新任务欠拟合。已有MTIL方法的跨任务识别（CTI）模块存在严重任务混淆（已见/未见任务难以区分），新任务适配（NTA）模块难以在引入任务特定知识的同时自适应平衡性能与参数开销。
AI.method: 提出TSP-DLoRA框架：TSP模块由基于任务特定子空间的任务标识分类器与特征投影策略组成，可为已见与未见任务的样本判定对应标识，从而缓解跨任务混淆；DLoRA模块依据任务分布动态地在各Transformer层分配低秩适配器（LoRA），在控制参数成本的同时提升新任务知识适配能力。
AI.result: 在11个数据集上使用三项性能指标进行实验评估，验证了所提方法的有效性；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 任务子空间投影与动态LoRA分配相结合，可有效且高效地缓解MTIL中的任务混淆、遗忘与适配不足问题，兼顾性能与参数开销。

title: Beyond Alignment: Supervising the Generator for EEG-to-Image Reconstruction
summary: Visual brain decoding translates neural activity into human-interpretable images. While recent EEG-to-image reconstruction methods rely on aligning EEG signals with pretrained visual embeddings to condition an image generator, we empirically demonstrate that stronger cross-modal alignment do not translate into comparable gains in reconstruction quality. This indicates that improving the input condition alone is insufficient; the generative process itself requires explicit supervision. Although Representation Alignment (REPA) offers a solution by guiding diffusion transformers with pretrained vision encoder features, we find that EEG-conditioned generators struggle to follow these fixed targets. To address this mismatch, we introduce generation-derived supervision (GDS): an image-conditioned teacher that translates static image-encoder features into the internal representation space of a diffusion transformer. Our EEG-conditioned student generator closely tracks these dynamic targets during denoising, discarding the teacher at inference. Evaluated on THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG, our approach consistently outperforms conditioning-centric baselines, achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出generation-derived supervision (GDS)：用一个由图像编码器特征驱动、被训练成输出扩散Transformer内部表示空间的“图像条件教师”，为EEG条件生成器的去噪过程提供动态监督；更强的跨模态对齐并不能带来更好的重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG-to-image重建依赖将EEG与预训练视觉嵌入对齐以条件化生成器，但作者实证发现更强的跨模态对齐并不带来同等的重建质量提升，说明仅改进输入条件不足，生成过程本身需要显式监督。而直接沿用REPA式固定目标（预训练视觉编码器特征）时，EEG条件生成器难以跟随这些静态目标，存在目标-学生空间错配。
AI.method: GDS：图像条件教师网络将静态图像编码器特征映射到扩散Transformer的内部表示空间，为EEG条件学生生成器在去噪过程中提供动态、与生成过程匹配的监督目标；学生紧跟随这些动态目标，推理阶段丢弃教师。在THINGS-EEG与THINGS-MEG上评测。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG与THINGS-MEG上一致优于以条件对齐为中心的基线方法，取得state-of-the-art的重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 提升跨模态对齐并非充分条件，针对生成过程本身的监督更关键；将静态编码器特征转为生成过程内部空间的动态教师目标，可有效解决EEG条件生成器无法跟随固定REPA目标的问题，无需推理时额外开销。

title: Continuous Lower-Limb Joint-Angle Estimation from sEMG and IMU: The Conditional Value of Cross-Activity and Cross-Subject Data under Update-Matched Controls
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Intent-driven exoskeleton control needs a continuous, causal estimate of the wearer's joint kinematics and an answer to a second question: whose data should train the estimator for a new user? Borrowing the user's recordings of other activities, or other users' recordings of the same activity, is usually evaluated as "more data" versus "less data," which confounds the information a source carries with the optimizer updates it adds and hides negative transfer behind averages. We separate these effects for hip, knee, and ankle angle estimation from high-density sEMG and an IMU across six locomotion activities on all ten participants of a public dataset. A compact residual causal TCN-GRU decoder is frozen, and an update-matched replay control prices every added source against the same number of updates on the user's own data. A user's own other activities raise $R^2$ from 0.722 to 0.788, of which +0.048 is information beyond replay; stair descent is a reliably harmful donor and sit-stand-walk a reliably beneficial one. Other users' same-activity data help while the user has only the target activity ($G_\mathrm{T} = +0.053$) and half as much once own other-activity data exist ($G_\mathrm{W} = +0.028$); at full calibration, donor value collapses after one to two target records. Per-target gains from the two sources correlate, and leave-one-participant-out gates recover most of the cross-subject value only at low calibration. Data value is hierarchical, state-dependent, and directional; the bottleneck is deciding, without test labels, when to transfer.

AI.tldr: 该研究将外骨骼角度估计的数据迁移问题解耦为“信息价值”与“优化更新次数”两个因素，通过冻结残差因果TCN-GRU解码器并采用更新匹配的回放对照，系统量化了用户自身其他活动数据与其他用户同活动数据的层次化、状态依赖与方向性价值。
AI.motivation: 意图驱动外骨骼控制需要持续、因果的关节运动学估计，且新用户数据来源选择（自身其他活动 vs 他人同活动）常被简化为“多数据 vs 少数据”，混淆了源数据信息量与优化器更新次数，并以平均值掩盖负迁移。
AI.method: 在公开数据集全部10名受试者、6种运动模式上，用高密度sEMG+IMU估计髋/膝/踝角度；冻结紧凑残差因果TCN-GRU解码器，采用“更新匹配回放对照”将每新增数据源与等量用户自身数据更新进行对价；并用留一受试者门控评估跨被试价值、来源间相关性。
AI.result: 自身其他活动使R²从0.722升至0.788，其中+0.048为回放之外的信息；下楼梯为可靠有害源，坐-站-走为可靠有益源。他人同活动数据仅在仅有目标活动数据时增益显著（G_T=+0.053），拥有自身其他活动数据后减半（G_W=+0.028）；完整校准后供体价值在一到两条目标记录后崩塌。两类来源的逐目标增益相关，LOPO门控仅在低校准下恢复大部分跨被试价值。
AI.conclusion: 数据价值是层次化、状态依赖且有方向的；核心瓶颈是在无测试标签条件下判断“何时迁移”。

title: GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models
summary: For more than half a century, video games have pursued better graphics, more natural interaction, and more engaging gameplay. Generative video models (VMs) now bear on all three. Neural networks already draw most of the pixels in shipped games, and recent world models let a lightweight game engine keep the world state while a VM turns the engine's coarse proxy video into final frames. These systems, however, treat the VM as a renderer that only restyles motion the engine has already authored, which leaves most of its generative capacity unused and limits the diversity a game can offer. We present GameWM, a design for next-generation games built on a clear division of labor. The GameWM-engine keeps what must be exact: rules, state, camera, and the layout of the world, which also spares the video model from having to remember it. The GameWM-VM generates what is expensive to author by hand: the look of the world and the detail of the player's interactions. One game mechanic can then be realized in many visually and physically distinct ways, while its outcome stays exactly as the engine computed it. To realize this division of labor, we build GameWM as a complete system: a data engine centered on interactions rather than exploration, an interface through which authored character sheets, scene art, and skill descriptions enter the model, and a model family from 5B to 33B parameters with a real-time causal variant for play. Together they give every player a fresh version of the same game: each player's own character, world, and skills turn the same engine mechanics into a new experience, while every event keeps the timing and outcome the GameWM-engine computed.

AI.tldr: GameWM 提出"引擎管规则/状态/相机/布局、视频模型管外观与交互细节"的分工式游戏架构，并给出数据引擎、创作接口与 5B–33B（含实时因果变体）模型族。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏把视频模型仅当作渲染器，只重绘引擎已编排好的运动，生成能力大量闲置，游戏内容多样性受限。
AI.method: 清晰分工：GameWM-engine 保持精确的规则、状态、相机与世界布局，免去 VM 记忆世界状态；GameWM-VM 生成手工昂贵的世界外观与玩家交互细节。配套：以交互而非探索为中心的数据引擎、输入角色设定图/场景美术/技能描述的作者接口、5B–33B 模型族及实时因果推理变体。
AI.result: 摘要为设计/系统级描述，无定量指标；声称同一机制可呈现多种视觉与物理上不同的表现，同时事件时序与结果严格由引擎决定，实现"每人一份同一游戏的新版本"。
AI.conclusion: 定位为世界模型驱动的次世代游戏系统蓝图，强调引擎-生成模型职责解耦与实时因果生成；实际证据需看论文全文的实时性与可控性评测。

title: Size-Matched Nulls Reveal What Block Ablation Measures in MambaVision
summary: Hybrid vision backbones interleave Mamba state-space mixers with self-attention, and a block's role is usually probed by removing it and measuring the damage. We test what that measurement means in MambaVision. On all 50,000 ImageNet validation images and three model sizes, every block ablation is paired with a size-matched null, the same perturbation with its channels shuffled or their signs flipped. In top-1 accuracy and in true-class rank, real and null damage are nearly indistinguishable in absolute terms: pooled over the blocks of MambaVision-T, the content effect lies within [-0.044,+0.016] percentage points (90% interval). Two attention-only controls show that the test detects content, with real ablations worse than their nulls by up to 4.2 points in DeiT-Small and 1.0 point in Swin-T. Part of MambaVision's near-equivalence reflects how little damage its blocks do (0.11--0.34 points on average, against 1.7 and 2.1). Scaled by damage, its content share is comparable to Swin-T's in accuracy, lower in rank, and far below DeiT-Small's: single-block damage in MambaVision is small and mostly positional. Ablation also hides what blocks carry together: removing all blocks of one type compounds damage to 3.7--8.4 times the sum of single effects, far more than size-matched nulls, including nulls that keep the alignment between the blocks' perturbations; for adjacent pairs, aligned nulls reproduce most of it. Freezing input-dependent selection in all Mamba mixers shows that it accounts for 20--32% of the Mamba contribution, mainly through the B and C projections. We turn these results into a protocol for causal attribution in hybrid networks.

AI.tldr: 该文质疑“消融即因果”的解读，在 MambaVision 上将每个 block 消融与尺寸匹配的零假设（通道打乱/符号翻转）对比，发现单块消融的“内容效应”极小（约 ±0.04pp 区间），主要体现位置性；而整体消融存在强超加性（单块和的 3.7–8.4 倍），并给出混合网络因果归因协议。
AI.motivation: 混合视觉主干（Mamba SSM + 自注意力）中“移除某 block 看精度下降”被默认为该 block 的因果贡献，但该损伤可能来自参数规模扰动而非块的内容语义。作者希望检验这一测量在 MambaVision 中是否真的指示内容归因，并设计能区分内容效应与结构/容量效应的对照实验。
AI.method: 在 ImageNet 全量 50k 验证集、MambaVision 三个规模上，对每个 block 消融配对一个尺寸匹配的零对照（同扰动但通道打乱或符号翻转），用 top-1 与真类排名衡量损伤；引入 DeiT-Small 与 Swin-T 的纯注意力控制组验证检验灵敏度；再做跨类型全部块联合消融（含保持扰动向对齐的零对照）以探测交互效应；最后冻结 Mamba mixer 的输入依赖选择项，定位其贡献来源。
AI.result: MambaVision-T 上内容效应在 90% 区间为 [-0.044, +0.016] 个百分点，真实与零对照损伤几乎不可分；对照模型可检出内容（DeiT-Small 差 4.2pp，Swin-T 差 1.0pp）。MambaVision 单块平均损伤仅 0.11–0.34pp（对照为 1.7 与 2.1pp），按损伤归一化的内容份额在精度上与 Swin-T 相当、排名指标更低、远低于 DeiT-Small。联合消融损伤为单块和的 3.7–8.4 倍（超加性），相邻块对时对齐零对照可复现多数效应。冻结输入依赖选择项贡献了 Mamba 部分的 20–32%，主要来自 B、C 投影。
AI.conclusion: 单 block 消融在混合主干中主要度量的是容量/结构扰动而非内容归因，且会掩盖块间协同；需以尺寸匹配零对照、归一化内容份额与联合消融共同构成因果归因协议。

title: Physics-Informed Causal Reasoning for Nonstationary Robot Dynamics
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Reasoning about what an action will cause requires internalizing how a system behaves. As conditions seldom stay fixed, this must often happen within a few interactions. Yet systems that look identical in a snapshot can respond differently to the same action, depending on physical conditions the snapshot hides. Context-based models capture this separation by summarizing recent transitions into a latent context, but do not specify how that context should change the equations of motion. Physics-informed neural networks build those equations into the model, but describe only a single system and cannot recognize when it has changed. We present Physics-Informed Causal Reasoning (PICR), which bridges the two. Only a context, re-inferred from recent interactions, is updated; it conditions a fixed physics-informed network that determines the robot's inertia and potential energy, so the robot adapts to new physical conditions from its own experience without retraining or a hand-specified robot model. On a Franka Panda arm in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, PICR predicts motion under changing and unseen payloads, reducing error on the latter by 1.6-3.8x over baselines, and extends to counterfactual queries under alternative torques. Our analysis shows that the context, inferred solely from interaction, encodes payload physical properties, tracks their changes, and governs the arm's response. The gravity and inertia terms induced by the context further demonstrate its physical validity, each agreeing with the simulator at the level of individual Lagrangian components.

AI.tldr: PICR：用交互推断的潜在上下文去条件化一个固定的物理信息网络（输出惯量与势能），使机械臂无需重训练即可适应未知/变化的负载，并在Franka+Isaac Sim上实现1.6-3.8x误差降低与反事实力矩查询。
AI.motivation: 快照相同的系统在不同物理条件（如负载质量）下对同一动作的响应不同，这些条件被快照隐藏。上下文模型只把近期转移总结为潜变量却未规定它如何改变运动方程；PINN把方程写进模型但只描述单一系统、无法识别系统变化。作者希望桥接两者：物理结构固定，仅更新从交互推断的上下文。
AI.method: 提出Physics-Informed Causal Reasoning（PICR）。用一个固定的物理信息网络（Lagrangian形式，由上下文条件化生成惯性项与势能/重力项）表示动力学；仅将近期交互轨迹重新推断得到的潜上下文进行更新，从而在无重训练、无手工机器人模型的前提下适配新物理条件；并支持替代力矩下的反事实查询。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim的Franka Panda上，PICR在变化与未见负载下预测运动，未见负载误差较基线降低1.6-3.8x；分析显示仅由交互推断的上下文编码了负载物理属性、跟踪其变化并支配机械臂响应，其诱导的重力与惯性项在单个Lagrangian分量层面与仿真器一致。
AI.conclusion: 将“上下文自适应”与“物理信息先验”结合是可行且有效的：物理结构固定、上下文快速在线推断，即可实现少样本、可解释、物理一致的在线系统辨识与预测，并支撑反事实推理；但证据目前限于仿真器，尚缺真机验证与开源信息。

title: dit.xpu : Taming DiT Sparse Inference on Mobile SoCs
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) enable on-device image generation and editing but incur high attention costs at high resolutions. Existing sparse attention reduces computation, yet dynamic sparsity introduces preprocessing and irregular data accesses that poorly fit mobile NPUs. We present this http URL , a sparse DiT inference framework for heterogeneous mobile SoCs. this http URL combines tile-aligned sparse attention with anchor-based error compensation by exploiting slowly varying dense-sparse output residuals across denoising steps. Heterogeneous XPU collaboration overlaps NPU dense attention with GPU sparse calibration, while mask-guided dataflow reduces data transfers and layout conversion by overlapping data movement with computation. Across five DiT models on two Snapdragon smartphones, this http URL achieves up to 1.56x end-to-end denoising speedup over the Hexagon-NPU backend and 11.5x attention-kernel speedup over the fastest alternative, while preserving generation quality close to dense attention. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 面向异构移动SoC的稀疏DiT推理框架：瓦片对齐稀疏注意力+基于锚点的误差补偿，XPU异构协同与掩码引导数据流，在骁龙手机上实现最高1.56倍端到端去噪加速与11.5倍注意力核加速。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformer在移动端高分辨率图像生成/编辑时注意力开销过大；已有动态稀疏注意力带来预处理与不规则访存，难以适配移动NPU。
AI.method: 1) tile-aligned稀疏注意力，匹配NPU分块访存；2) anchor-based误差补偿，利用去噪步间稠密-稀疏输出残差缓慢变化的特性做校准；3) 异构XPU协同，NPU稠密注意力与GPU稀疏校准重叠执行；4) mask-guided数据流，将数据搬移与布局转换与计算重叠。
AI.result: 在两个骁龙平台的五个DiT模型上，端到端去噪较Hexagon-NPU后端最高1.56x加速，注意力核较最快基线11.5x加速，生成质量接近稠密注意力；代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过稀疏化与硬件协同设计可在移动SoC上显著加速DiT推理且保持生成质量，属于生成模型高效推理的系统级工作，与具身智能核心方向关联较弱。

title: Distributed Shaping of Robot Swarms Through Spatial Moments of Arbitrary Order
summary: This paper shapes a swarm into a target pattern, such as a figure taken from an image, by controlling its spatial moments. The image is sampled into a reference configuration whose centroid and covariance set the position and principal spreads of the formation, while its higher-order moments, expressed in covariance-normalized (whitened) coordinates, encode the remaining shape. In contrast with geometric formation control, which prescribes distances, bearings, or relative positions between specific agents, this specification concerns the swarm as a whole and assigns no agent to a particular place. The key mechanism is orthogonalization in the swarm's own empirical inner product: projecting negative-gradient velocities onto the complement of low-degree polynomials sampled at the agents makes every higher-order correction preserve all lower-order moments exactly. The resulting hierarchical controller has lower triangular error dynamics and converges locally exponentially for any positive gains, so orders can be added without undoing those already achieved. A joint alternative regulates the higher moments together through a regularized Gauss--Newton step while preserving the centroid and covariance dynamics. We give bounds on the number of agents and sufficient conditions for regularity. Both controllers admit a distributed implementation that uses only relative positions and neighbor communication and retains local exponential convergence when estimation is sufficiently fast. In a distributed simulation on a sparse graph, 350 agents form an airplane from an unstructured swarm through moments up to order ten; the hierarchy reaches the full specification, while the joint law approaches it with smaller velocities.

AI.tldr: 通过控制集群的空间矩（质心、协方差及白化坐标下的高阶矩）将无序机器人集群塑形为指定图案，并利用经验内积下的正交投影实现分层控制。
AI.motivation: 几何编队控制（距离、方位、相对位置）需指定具体智能体与具体位置的对应关系，难以从图像等整体形状描述生成编队。作者希望以“整体形状”为规格，使集群整体趋近目标图案而不指派个体位置。
AI.method: 将图像采样为参考构型，用质心与协方差设定位置与主轴展布，其余形状由协方差白化坐标下的高阶矩编码。核心机制是在集群自身经验内积中做正交化：将负梯度速度投影到低阶多项式采样空间的补空间，使高阶修正精确保持所有低阶矩，得到下三角误差动力学，对任意正增益局部指数收敛。另提出联合替代方案：用正则化Gauss–Newton步同时调节高阶矩，并保持质心与协方差动力学；给出智能体数量界与正则性充分条件。两种控制器均可分布式实现，仅用相对位置与邻居通信，估计足够快时保持局部指数收敛。
AI.result: 在稀疏图上的分布式仿真中，350个智能体从无序集群经至十阶矩生成飞机图案；分层控制器达到完整规格，联合法则以更小速度逼近。
AI.conclusion: 矩基形状规格与经验内积正交化提供了层级可叠加、无个体指派、可分布式执行的集群塑形框架，且收敛性质良好。

title: HospitalBench: Diagnosing Where and Why Embodied Agents Fail on Long Hospital Task Chains
summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks fail in ways that end-task success cannot see. HospitalBench is a diagnostic benchmark of ten hospital chores in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each two unscored warm-up steps followed by a causal chain of five scored sub-tasks in one continuous simulation: the state one step leaves (an object pose, a choice, a fact seen once) determines what the next step must do, unlike benchmarks that place sub-tasks side by side. Vision-language agents act through skill-level tools from camera images. A scripted robot that makes only the calls a model gets is the solvability check of a chore. From each trajectory the benchmark reads where a chain breaks, what the agent did after a failed call, and how far its own position estimate drifts from the true one. This version reports first results only: 15 of 60 planned runs (three models at high effort, one run each on chores T1 and T10 from both start states and T3 from one), with scripted-robot proofs on three of the ten chores. Of the 15 runs, 2 passed all five sub-tasks. Runs still going after sub-tasks 1 to 5 were 15, 8, 4, 2, 2. Of 189 failed calls, 168 were followed by a different call and 111 by a call that did not fail. These are first results and not a full benchmark. We will release the scenes, task chains, scripted robot, evaluation harness and trajectories.

AI.tldr: HospitalBench：在 Isaac Sim 中构建 10 个医院家务长程任务，每个任务由 2 步不计分预热 + 5 个因果链式计分子任务组成，用于诊断 VLM 智能体链条断裂位置、失败后纠错行为与自身位姿估计漂移。当前仅报告 15/60 次试跑的初步结果。
AI.motivation: 端到端任务成功率无法暴露长程具身任务失败的细节；现有基准把子任务并列摆放，缺乏前一步状态（物体位姿、选择、一次见过的事实）决定后一步动作的因果依赖，因而无法定位链条在哪一环断裂、失败后智能体能否自恢复。
AI.method: 基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 搭建 10 项医院家务，每项含 2 步不计分预热与 5 步因果链式子任务，单次连续仿真；视觉语言智能体仅通过技能级工具接口从相机图像动作。以"只调用模型可用接口的脚本机器人"作为任务可解性验证。逐轨迹记录：链条断裂位置、失败调用后的后续行为、智能体自位姿估计相对真值的漂移。
AI.result: 仅报告 15/60 计划的初步结果（3 个高推理投入模型，T1、T10 从两个初始状态各一次，T3 一个初始状态；脚本可解性证明覆盖 10 个任务中的 3 个）。15 次中 2 次通过全部 5 个子任务；完成子任务 1–5 的存活运行数依次为 15、8、4、2、2；189 次失败调用中 168 次后接不同调用，111 次后接未失败调用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是"首次结果"而非完整基准，样本量小（每模型每任务仅 1 次），可解性证明仅覆盖部分任务，尚不足以支撑横向模型排名；其价值在于诊断性度量框架（因果链 + 失败后行为 + 位姿漂移），作者承诺开源场景、任务链、脚本机器人、评估框架与轨迹。

title: LC-ISP Benchmark: Learning Advanced ISP with Live and Capture Streams
summary: High-quality paired RAW-to-sRGB datasets are essential for data-driven ISP, yet existing datasets often rely on cross-device collection, causing misalignment and failing to faithfully reflect real capture conditions. We therefore introduce LC-ISP, a large-scale benchmark built from the intrinsic gap between a camera's live preview and offline capture streams. LC-ISP contains 53.9k spatially aligned groups, each comprising live RAW/live sRGB and multi-frame fused RGB/capture sRGB, and covers day, night, indoor, outdoor, and HDR scenes. It also provides capture-stream intermediates for modular supervision. We further develop a compact two-stage baseline that uses these intermediates as auxiliary targets. Under a 2.5-GFLOP budget for 448$\times$448 RAW inputs, it outperforms the strongest single-frame baseline by over 2 dB PSNR while improving texture, denoising, and color reproduction. LC-ISP supports realistic benchmarking, the design of supervision strategies, and the development of lightweight ISP models.

AI.tldr: LC-ISP：利用相机“实时预览流 vs 离线拍照流”的内在差异，构建了包含 53.9k 空间对齐组（live RAW/live sRGB + 多帧融合 RGB/拍照 sRGB）的大规模 RAW-to-sRGB ISP 基准数据集，并提供拍照流中间结果用于模块化监督；配套一个两阶段轻量 ISP 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有配对 RAW-to-sRGB 数据集多依赖跨设备采集，导致空间错位，且无法真实反映实际成像条件；缺乏高质量、天然对齐、覆盖多场景的真实配对数据。
AI.method: 从同一相机的预览流与拍照流的固有时序/处理差异构造配对：同一曝光下取 live RAW 与 live sRGB、多帧融合 RGB 与 capture sRGB，形成空间对齐组；覆盖白天、夜间、室内、室外、HDR 场景；额外提供拍照流中间结果（如去噪、融合阶段输出）作为模块化监督目标。基线采用紧凑两阶段网络，以中间结果作辅助监督。
AI.result: 在 448×448 RAW 输入、2.5-GFLOP 计算预算下，所提两阶段基线比最强单帧基线 PSNR 提升超过 2 dB，并在纹理、降噪与色彩还原上有改善。
AI.conclusion: LC-ISP 提供了真实成像条件下天然对齐的大规模 ISP 基准，可用于现实评测、监督策略设计以及轻量 ISP 模型研发；但作为数据集/基准类工作，方法创新有限。

title: Generate, Align, and Restore: MLLM-Empowered Diffusion for Generalizable Low-light Image Enhancement
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is essential to numerous vision applications operating under adverse illumination. Despite substantial advances, real-world nighttime enhancement remains challenging due to the scarcity of strictly aligned day-night pairs and complex degradations involving extreme darkness and heterogeneous artificial light sources, leading to fragile generalization. To overcome these challenges, we propose MrLIE (MLLM-empowered reference Low-light Image Enhancement), a novel reference-based unsupervised LLIE framework that synergizes the generative and reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with conditional diffusion. MrLIE employs the MLLM as a high-fidelity reference synthesizer and diagnostic critic, iteratively generating, diagnosing, and correcting normal-light references directly from degraded nighttime observations. Based on this, our method governs the enhancement process through two complementary mechanisms, in which a confidence offset module rectifies spatial-geometric inconsistencies for reference reliability and a structure-anchored injection scheme harmonizes aligned reference cues, low-light structural constraints, and ControlNet additive anchoring during the denoising process. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that MrLIE achieves superior perceptual quality, natural appearance, and robust generalization.

AI.tldr: MrLIE：利用多模态大模型作为参考合成器与诊断批评家，结合条件扩散实现无监督参考式暗光图像增强。
AI.motivation: 真实夜间增强缺乏严格对齐的日夜配对数据，且存在极暗区域与异构人工光源导致的复杂退化，泛化性脆弱。
AI.method: 以 MLLM 从退化夜间图像迭代生成、诊断并修正正常光照参考图；引入置信度偏移模块校正参考图的空间-几何不一致，并用结构锚定注入方案在去噪过程中融合对齐参考线索、低光结构约束与 ControlNet 加性锚定。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得更优感知质量与自然观感，并展现稳健的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MLLM 生成式参考 + 条件扩散的无监督框架可有效缓解暗光增强的数据对齐与泛化瓶颈。

title: VLN-Flash: Parallel Action Decoding with Adaptive Execution for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: When a vision-and-language navigation policy generates an action sequence autoregressively, the robot waits for a chain of dependent predictions. A small discrete action vocabulary makes it possible to score all short-horizon plans in parallel. We introduce VLN-Flash, a training-free decoder that evaluates the complete action-prefix tree in a single forward pass. Branch-specific attention and matched token positions preserve the original policy's conditional action distribution for each prefix in exact arithmetic. We use the score margin between the stepwise-greedy prefix and its strongest alternative at each depth to decide how many actions to execute. The robot then executes the plan with the highest joint score at the chosen depth before observing again. On matched inputs, VLN-Flash achieves a nearly $3\times$ speedup in action decoding over native autoregression on Uni-NaVid and StreamVLN. Compared with the native autoregressive decoders, it improves success rate and success weighted by path length (SPL) on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, with success gains up to 2.7 percentage points. On a Unitree GO2, VLN-Flash improves navigation success and cuts the mean wait between actions by about 160 ms after subtracting network transmission time.

AI.tldr: VLN-Flash：一种免训练的解码器，用单次前向传播并行评估完整动作前缀树，并以分数边际自适应决定执行步数，实现约3倍解码加速并提升导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 自回归VLN策略需串行生成依赖链式预测，推理延迟高；而离散动作词表较小，使并行评估短时域规划成为可能。
AI.method: 构造完整动作前缀树，在一次前向中并行打分；采用分支专属注意力（branch-specific attention）与对齐的token位置，在精确算术下保持各前缀的条件动作分布不变。用每深度上逐步贪心前缀与其最强备选之间的分数边际决定执行步数，执行联合分数最高的深度对应计划后再重新观测。
AI.result: 在Uni-NaVid与StreamVLN上，匹配输入下动作解码较原生自回归近3倍加速；在R2R-CE与RxR-CE上SR与SPL均提升，成功率最高提升2.7个百分点；Unitree GO2真机上成功率提升，去除网络传输后动作间平均等待减少约160 ms。
AI.conclusion: 表明无需重训练即可将VLN策略的串行解码转为并行树搜索式解码，同时改善效率与导航性能，并具备真实机器人部署可行性。

title: SAR-TopoGuard: Training-Free, Speckle-Aware Topological Verification for Structure-Preserving SAR-to-Optical Translation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Accepted manuscript of the article published in IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters (2026). \c{opyright} 2026 IEEE. Code: this https URL
summary: SAR-to-optical translators often synthesize detail that the radar measurement does not support, and pixel metrics alone cannot reveal it. We propose SAR-TopoGuard, a training-free inference-time layer for frozen generators: a stochastic sampler draws K candidates (Monte Carlo dropout for GANs, seed variance for diffusion), a speckle-aware verifier ranks them by gradient-magnitude correlation with the SAR input and a hallucination-frequency index, and a SAR-guided frequency gate admits high-frequency detail only where SAR edges support it. With all five hyperparameters frozen and three training seeds, we evaluate on 500 scene-disjoint SEN1-2 test patches, 500 patches of a held-out summer scene, and 200 cross-dataset SEN12MS winter pairs. The layer improves Pix2Pix by +0.060, +0.012, and +0.077 dB PSNR and by +0.0034, +0.0057, and +0.0135 SSIM, respectively (Wilcoxon p < 1e-6), and it improves CycleGAN and CUT on all three sets (+0.013 to +0.076 dB). It raises edge precision at the cost of edge recall (edge F1 -1.3% on the test set). On the latent diffusion model COP-GEN, it adds +0.33 dB (base) and +0.16 dB (Beta) on the winter set, the only set with dual-polarization SAR. An ablation shows that the gate produces the gain for MC-dropout GANs, whose candidates are nearly identical, whereas verifier selection contributes up to +0.26 dB for diffusion, whose samples differ. The layer has zero trainable parameters and adds 0.4 ms per patch beyond the K=5 generator passes.

AI.tldr: SAR-TopoGuard：为冻结的SAR→光学图像生成器提供免训练推理层，用随机采样K个候选+斑点噪声感知验证器（梯度幅值相关性+幻觉频率指数）筛选，并用SAR引导频域门控仅在有SAR边缘支撑处放行高频细节。Pix2Pix在三个数据集上PSNR提升+0.012~+0.077 dB，SSIM提升+0.003~+0.014；扩散模型验证器选择增益达+0.26 dB。
AI.motivation: SAR→光学转换模型常合成雷达观测并不支持的细节（幻觉），而纯像素指标（PSNR/SSIM）无法揭示这类虚构内容，需要一种能在推理时抑制幻觉、且不依赖重新训练的机制。
AI.method: 免训练推理时层：蒙特卡洛dropout（GAN）或种子方差（扩散）采样K个候选；斑点噪声感知验证器按与SAR输入的梯度幅值相关性和幻觉频率指数排序；SAR引导频域门控仅在SAR边缘支持处放行高频分量。零可训练参数，5个超参数全程冻结。
AI.result: 在500个场景不相交SEN1-2测试块、500个留出夏季场景块、200对SEN12MS冬季跨数据集对上，Pix2Pix分别提升PSNR +0.060/+0.012/+0.077 dB、SSIM +0.0034/+0.0057/+0.0135（Wilcoxon p<1e-6）；CycleGAN与CUT在三集全面提升（+0.013~+0.076 dB）；COP-GEN扩散模型冬季集+0.33/+0.16 dB。边缘精度上升但召回下降（edge F1 −1.3%）。消融显示门控对候选近乎相同的MC-dropout GAN贡献主要增益，验证器选择对样本多样的扩散模型贡献可达+0.26 dB。单块开销仅0.4 ms（K=5次生成之外）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明推理时"采样—验证—频域门控"流程可在零训练成本下缓解SAR-to-optical幻觉、稳定提升像素与结构指标，且增益幅度随生成器多样性不同而转移（GAN看门控、扩散看选择），为遥感跨模态生成的可信部署提供了轻量方案。

title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Visual Servo Control with Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer
comment: This manuscript is currently under review in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: We address tracking a moving object on a conveyor with a Franka Emika Panda robot arm, despite an imprecise digital twin, measurement errors, and noise. Our novel approach augments a loop-shaped inverse-Jacobian PI controller with a residual policy learned via Soft Actor-Critic in the digital twin. A delay-compensated Kalman filter fuses out-of-sequence camera measurements to provide latency-aware moving target position estimates. We compare the achieved performance to a performance bound for a class of model-based controllers derived from a frequency-domain sensitivity analysis, quantifying the minimum achievable error imposed by uncertain kinematic model mismatch. Simulation and hardware experiments indicate that our residual policy drives tracking error below the bound. Across conveyor speeds (27.9-41.8 mm/s), our method reduces mean tracking errors from 1.1-1.4 mm (baseline inverse-Jacobian PI) to 0.3-0.7 mm. These results show that learning residual corrections in a limited-fidelity simulator, combined with delay compensation, can substantially improve model-based control under modeling and measurement uncertainties while maintaining reliable sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: Franka机械臂在传送带上追蹤运动物体：用延迟补偿Kalman滤波融合乱序相机测量，并在数字孪生中以SAC学习残差策略增强环状逆雅可比PI控制器；给出基于频域灵敏度分析的性能下界，实机将平均误差从1.1–1.4mm降到0.3–0.7mm并低于该界。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生不精确、测量有误差与噪声，纯模型基控制器存在由运动学模型失配决定的最小误差下限，需在保证sim-to-real可靠性的前提下突破该下限。
AI.method: 在数字孪生中用SAC学习残差策略，叠加在环形逆雅可比PI控制器上；用延迟补偿Kalman滤波融合乱序相机测量以给出含时延感知的目标位姿估计；并通过频域灵敏度分析推导一族模型基控制器可达到的误差性能界作为对照。
AI.result: 仿真与真机实验表明残差策略使跟踪误差低于理论下界；传送带速度27.9–41.8 mm/s范围内，平均跟踪误差由1.1–1.4 mm（逆雅可比PI基线）降至0.3–0.7 mm，sim-to-real迁移稳定。
AI.conclusion: 在有限保真度仿真器中学习残差修正并结合时延补偿，可在建模与测量不确定性下显著改善模型基控制，并给出可量化的性能界用以评估学习残差的价值。

title: MARS: Dynamic Routing of Reinforcement-Learned Atomic Skills for Multi-Stage Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in multi-task robotic manipulation. However, they still face limitations in control precision and execution stability during critical manipulation stages, such as object grasping, alignment and insertion. To combine general-purpose manipulation capabilities with task-specific fine-grained control, while enabling effective coordination between generalist and specialized policies throughout multi-stage manipulation tasks, this paper proposes MARS (Modular Atomic-skill Routing System), a dynamic routing framework for reinforcement learning-based atomic skills. MARS integrates a frozen generalist VLA policy with multiple independently trained atomic skill policies. Using a shared RL Token state representation and the reference action of VLA, specialized control policies are optimized through reinforcement learning for different cr`itical manipulation stages. For high-level policy selection, we develop a dynamic router that integrates temporal context and skill semantics. The router employs Mamba-based recurrent encoding and a historical feature window to capture state evolution during manipulation. Skill descriptions of candidate policies are encoded into semantic queries, and attention mechanisms are used to establish correspondences between skill semantics and temporal state features. Experimental results show that MARS achieves an average Macro-F1 score of 90.47% across four LIBERO task suites under fixed-trajectory evaluation, outperforming an MLP-based router by 7.08 percentage points. In the simulated Tube Transport task, the full-task success rate increases from 20.04% to 85.67%. These results demonstrate that stage-specific reinforcement learning and temporal state-aware dynamic policy routing can improve multi-policy coordination and overall task execution performance in multi-stage robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: MARS 将冻结的通用 VLA 策略与多个独立训练的原子技能 RL 策略结合，通过共享 RL Token 表示、基于 Mamba 的时序编码与技能语义注意力路由，实现多阶段操作中的动态技能选择，在 LIBERO 上取得 90.47% Macro-F1，Tube Transport 全任务成功率从 20.04% 提升至 85.67%。
AI.motivation: 通用 VLA 模型在多任务抓取、对齐、插入等关键阶段的控制精度与执行稳定性不足；而专用 RL 技能策略泛化性差。需要一种机制在多阶段任务中协调通用策略与专用技能策略。
AI.method: 冻结的通用 VLA 策略 + 多个独立训练的原子技能 RL 策略；以共享 RL Token 状态表示和 VLA 参考动作作为条件训练专用控制策略；高层路由采用 Mamba 循环编码与历史特征窗口捕捉状态演化，并将候选技能的文本描述编码为语义查询，通过注意力在技能语义与时序状态特征间建立对应，实现动态策略选择。
AI.result: 固定轨迹评估下 LIBERO 四个任务套件平均 Macro-F1 达 90.47%，比 MLP 路由器高 7.08 个百分点；仿真 Tube Transport 全任务成功率由 20.04% 提升至 85.67%。
AI.conclusion: 阶段化强化学习 + 时序状态感知的动态策略路由可有效改善多策略协调与多阶段操作的整体执行性能。局限在于缺少真机验证，且仅在仿真环境评估控制精度收益。

title: Unlocking Fine-Grained Cell Representations via Soft-Interior Rim Dense-Grid Pooling in Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Fine-grained cell representations are essential for characterizing cellular heterogeneity and tissue organization in computational pathology. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide powerful pretrained features for transferable tissue analysis. HoVer-Net uses task-trained segmentation and typing, whereas CellViT++ averages native-grid tokens assigned to detected nuclei. However, the former requires cell-specific training; the latter ignores fractional nuclear coverage and can mix nuclear content with neighbouring tissue. Therefore, we propose SRDP, short for Soft-interior Rim Dense-grid Pooling, a training-free geometry-aware readout. We apply the frozen patch projection at half stride, interleave four offset lattices, map the cell mask to fractional coverage weights, and concatenate whole-cell pooling with two inner boundary pools. Across four datasets and six frozen encoders, SRDP improves mean balanced accuracy by 5.68 percentage points over native token averaging across 24 settings, including 11.22 points on average for CoNIC and Lizard. SRDP converts a coarse frozen PFM lattice into a mask-aligned, fine-grained cell representation without updating the encoder.

AI.tldr: SRDP：一种免训练、几何感知的细胞读取方法，将冻结的病理基础模型粗粒度网格token转换为掩码对齐的细粒度细胞表示。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型（PFM）提供可迁移的预训练特征，但细粒度细胞表示仍存在缺陷：HoVer-Net 依赖任务特定的分割与分型训练；CellViT++ 对检测细胞核所分配的原生网格token取平均，忽略了细胞核的分数覆盖（部分占据），并可能将核内容与邻近组织混合。
AI.method: 提出 SRDP（Soft-interior Rim Dense-grid Pooling），一种免训练的几何感知读出。具体做法：以半步长（half stride）应用冻结的patch投影，交错四组偏移点阵，将细胞掩码映射为分数覆盖权重，并把全细胞池化与两个内边界池化特征拼接。
AI.result: 在4个数据集、6个冻结编码器的24种设置下，SRDP 相比原生token平均使平均平衡准确率提升5.68个百分点；其中 CoNIC 与 Lizard 平均提升11.22个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SRDP 无需更新编码器，即可把冻结PFM的粗网格表示转换为掩码对齐的细粒度细胞表示。

title: A Think Block Is Conditioning, Not a Plan
summary: Generative models increasingly write a chain of thought before drawing, and report large gains from doing so. We ask what that text contributes, by substitution rather than ablation: holding the generator, sampler and seeds fixed, we replace the think block with controlled alternatives and measure the image. Across a unified model with a think mode, a reinforcement-learned reasoning generator, and a planner driving a frozen diffusion model, the same picture emerges. Content-free prose of matched length is worth nothing or less ($-0.05$ to $-0.15$). One sentence from an unrelated 8B model, naming the subject and a few identifying details, matches the generator's own plan in three to six times fewer conditioning tokens. The value sits where the referent is in doubt: writing down a name is worth $+0.33$ when it is right and $+0.05$ when it is wrong, and where the generator already succeeds the whole effect is $-0.07 \pm 0.07$. Cutting a plan at the text encoder's window leaves 272 of 286 images byte-identical, and a plan rewritten to fit that window ties a bare identification ($+0.003 \pm 0.044$), so a plan contains nothing the identification does not already supply. Field-level interventions find only colour executed reliably, and a control writing the same sentences into the user prompt shows that limit belongs to the generator rather than to the planning channel. Two judges and two annotators replicate the central contrasts. A think block earns its keep as a specification of what to draw, not as a plan that is carried out.

AI.tldr: 用"替换"而非"消融"的方式检验生成模型中think block的作用：无内容文字无价值甚至有害（-0.05~-0.15）；一句来自无关8B模型的单句识别（命名主体+若干辨识细节）在3-6倍更少token下即可匹配模型自身plan；价值集中在指代不确定处，且plan内容可被单纯识别完全替代。
AI.motivation: 生成式模型在绘图前写chain of thought并报告大幅收益，但这类文本究竟贡献了什么并不清楚；作者希望区分"文本作为计划被执行"与"文本作为要画内容的规格说明"两种解释。
AI.method: 固定生成器、采样器与随机种子，对think block做受控替换（而非消融）：在统一模型（含think模式）、RL训练的推理生成器、以及驱动冻结扩散模型的planner三类系统上重复；对比等长无内容散文、无关8B模型的一句话识别、自身plan被文本编码器窗口截断、改写适配窗口的plan、以及把同样句子写入user prompt的对照；并做字段级干预与双评判者、双标注者复现。
AI.result: 无内容散文价值为-0.05~-0.15；一句识别文本在3-6倍更少条件token下匹配原plan；写下正确名称+0.33、错误名称+0.05，生成器本已成功处效果为-0.07±0.07；plan在文本编码器窗口截断后286张中272张逐字节一致，改写适配版与裸识别持平（+0.003±0.044）；字段级干预中仅颜色被可靠执行；写入user prompt的对照表明该局限属于生成器而非planning通道；双评判者与双标注者复现核心对比。
AI.conclusion: think block的收益来自它是"要画什么"的规格说明（尤其是指代消歧），而非一份被逐步执行的计划；plan中不含识别文本之外的额外信息，长链式推理文本本身并非必要条件。

title: Attention U-Net Cellular Automata for Multi-Class Land Use and Land Cover Change Simulation in Lucknow, India: Evaluation Against Null and Classical Baselines
summary: Convolutional networks are often used to learn the transition rules of land-use cellular automata (CA), yet their predictions are seldom compared with a null model that predicts no change. We built AttentionUNet-CA, which reads a 32 x 32 neighbourhood of land-cover states with four drivers (elevation, distance to major roads, distance to the central business district (CBD) and population density) and predicts the state of each cell ten years later. We tested it on Lucknow, India, with GLC_FCS30D land cover for 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020, a 30 m series mapped consistently over time, and compared its built-up class with GHSL and ESA WorldCover. AttentionUNet-CA was trained on 1990-2010, selected on held-out spatial blocks and evaluated once on 2010-2020, with three seeds. Baselines were the null model, a random-forest CA (RF-CA) and a U-Net CA without attention; each network was trained with and without class weights. Only 8.1% of the study area changed in the test decade, so no model matched the overall agreement of the null model (91.9%). On change, measured by the figure of merit, the class-weighted networks scored highest (U-Net CA 22.0 +/- 1.2%, AttentionUNet-CA 21.0 +/- 1.4%), ahead of RF-CA (20.3%), but by margins comparable to seed-to-seed variation; the networks estimated the amount of change better than RF-CA. The attention gates did not improve accuracy. Population density and distance to the CBD were the most useful drivers. Projected to 2030, built-up land grows by 22-35%, mostly at the city edge.

AI.tldr: 该文构建 AttentionUNet-CA，以32×32邻域+4个驱动因子预测10年后土地利用状态，在印度勒克瑙1990–2020 GLC_FCS30D数据上训练与单次测试，并与零模型、RF-CA、无注意力U-Net对比；变化区仅8.1%，所有模型总体一致性均不及零模型，FOM上带类权重网络略优但与种子波动相当，注意力未带来增益。
AI.motivation: 土地利用元胞自动机（CA）常用卷积网络学习转换规则，但预测结果极少与"预测不变"的零模型对比，导致精度被高估、增益来源不清；同时注意力机制与类权重在CA中的实际作用缺乏受控评估。
AI.method: AttentionUNet-CA：输入32×32邻域土地覆盖状态及高程、距主干道距离、距CBD距离、人口密度4个驱动层，输出10年后各元胞状态。数据为GLC_FCS30D 1990/2000/2010/2020（30 m一致时序），建成区类与GHSL、ESA WorldCover交叉核对。1990–2010训练，空间分块留出选择，2010–2020单次测试，3个随机种子。基线：零模型、随机森林CA（RF-CA）、无注意力U-Net CA；各网络均做有/无类权重两版。评价用总体一致性、figure of merit（FOM）及变化量估计，并做2030年情景投影。
AI.result: 测试十年仅8.1%区域发生变化，故无模型在总体一致性上超过零模型（91.9%）。变化区FOM：带类权重U-Net CA 22.0±1.2%、AttentionUNet-CA 21.0±1.4%，RF-CA 20.3%，差距与种子间波动相当；网络对变化总量的估计优于RF-CA；注意力门未提升精度。最重要驱动因子为人口密度与距CBD距离。2030年投影建成区增长22–35%，主要位于城市边缘。
AI.conclusion: 在变化稀疏的土地利用预测中，零模型是必要基线，常规OA易产生误导；注意力机制与网络深度未带来实质增益，类权重对变化类识别更关键。该工作属遥感/地理模拟领域的方法学对照研究，对物理AI、VLA、三维重建与机器人系统无直接方法可迁移性。

title: HongguoTrending: A Longitudinal, Multimodal Archive of Trending Videos and Topics on a Leading Micro-Drama Platform
summary: Micro-dramas (duanju) are reshaping digital production and consumption, yet a lack of longitudinal data connecting series to their platform visibility persists, limiting our understanding of the emerging medium. We introduce HongguoTrending, a longitudinal, multimodal dataset of hourly snapshots from seven trending lists of Hongguo, China's largest micro-drama platform. Collected through a two-stage asynchronous pipeline, the archive links 63,200 ranking entries across 632 web list-hours and 157 client hours (889 distinct series) to metadata, cover images, sampled episode videos, and audience engagement metrics. Exploratory analyses show distinct turnover rates between web and mobile trending lists, production-driven mainstream values alongside kinship-centered synopses, genre-specific cover palettes, and strong associations between user sharing and next-day rank gains. Accessible via a RESTful API, this dataset supports empirical research on algorithmic gatekeeping, popularity dynamics, and multimodal digital culture.

AI.tldr: HongguoTrending：红果短剧平台7个热榜的逐小时纵向多模态数据集，含6.32万条榜单记录、889部剧的元数据/封面/剧集视频/互动指标，并附RESTful API。
AI.motivation: 微短剧正重塑数字生产与消费，但缺少将剧集与平台曝光（榜单可见性）联系起来的纵向数据，限制了对这一新兴媒介的理解。
AI.method: 采用两阶段异步采集流水线，对红果Web端7个热榜进行逐小时快照，覆盖632个Web榜单小时与157个客户端小时，链接排名条目至元数据、封面图像、抽样剧集视频与受众互动指标。
AI.result: 探索性分析发现：Web与移动榜单更替率存在差异；主流价值由生产驱动、梗概以亲缘关系为中心；封面配色具有类型特异性；用户分享量与次日排名上升强相关。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集通过RESTful API开放，可支撑算法把关、流行度动力学与多模态数字文化等实证研究。

title: RETR: A Structure-Preserving RGB-Event Transformer for Robust 3D Lane Detection
summary: Robust 3D lane detection requires accurate metric road geometry recovery from visual inputs, yet conventional RGB-based approaches suffer from fragile lane evidence under adverse illumination, motion blur, and long-range perspective compression. Event cameras offer complementary high-temporal-resolution, high dynamic-range structural cues that are robust to these challenges, but their sparse, motion-dependent responses cannot be directly fused into consistent 3D geometry. In this paper, we present the first attempt to introduce event cameras into 3D lane detection. To enable systematic research, we first build two multimodal benchmarks with metric 3D lane annotations: DSEC-3DLD (real-world sequences) and Ev-OpenLane (large-scale simulated sequences). We further propose RETR, a structure preserving transformer that converts complementary RGB and event observations into coherent 3D lane geometry. RETR first aligns modality consistent evidence through Reciprocal Context Flow Fusion, then preserves thin and uncertain lane structures with Uncertainty Aware Structural Consolidation, and finally decodes ordered lane hypotheses using a Geometry State Decoder with proposal conditioned initialization, reference conditioned query evolution, and diversified geometric inquiry. Extensive experiments show that RETR achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks, especially showing strong improvements in challenging lighting and complex road geometry scenarios. Code and dataset will be available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 首次将事件相机引入3D车道检测，构建DSEC-3DLD与Ev-OpenLane两个多模态基准，并提出结构保持Transformer（RETR）融合RGB与事件证据以恢复一致的3D车道几何，在两个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统基于RGB的3D车道检测在逆光、运动模糊和远距离透视压缩下证据脆弱；事件相机具备高时间分辨率与高动态范围的结构线索，但响应稀疏且依赖运动，难以直接融合为一致的3D几何。因此需系统性研究其可行性与融合方法。
AI.method: RETR结构保持Transformer：①互惠上下文流融合（Reciprocal Context Flow Fusion）实现模态一致证据对齐；②不确定性感知结构整合（Uncertainty Aware Structural Consolidation）保持细薄与不确定车道结构；③几何状态解码器（Geometry State Decoder），含提案条件初始化、参考条件查询演化与多样化几何查询，解码有序车道假设。
AI.result: 在两个自建基准上取得SOTA，尤其在挑战性光照与复杂道路几何场景提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机可作为3D车道检测的互补模态，配套基准与结构保持融合框架有效提升鲁棒性，代码与数据将开源。

title: XLSAR-Bench: Towards Extremely Large SAR Imagery Understanding of MLLMs
summary: The rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has highlighted the need for comprehensive benchmarks to assess their capabilities and limitations in remote sensing (RS). However, evaluating MLLMs in large-size synthetic aperture radar (SAR) scenarios remains challenging, as understanding complete scenes requires both global semantic interpretation and fine-grained target perception. Existing SAR benchmarks predominantly rely on small image patches, limiting their ability to assess these capabilities jointly. To address these limitations, we present XLSAR-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the perception and reasoning capabilities of MLLMs in large-scene SAR imagery. XLSAR-Bench comprises 405 images with an average size of 7153$\times$7153 pixels, ten tasks spanning visual question answering, visual grounding, and detailed image captioning, with all evaluation samples meticulously annotated manually, assisted by a semi-automatic captioner. Experimental results from general-purpose and domain-specific MLLMs reveal persistent challenges in understanding large SAR scenes and accurately perceiving small targets. We have open-sourced XLSAR-Bench to support further research in developing more powerful MLLMs for complete large SAR scenes.

AI.tldr: XLSAR-Bench：面向大场景SAR影像的多模态大模型感知与推理基准，405张平均7153×7153像素图像、10项任务，覆盖VQA、视觉定位与详细图像描述，人工精标+半自动captioner辅助。
AI.motivation: 现有SAR基准多基于小尺寸图像块，无法同时评估大场景所需的全局语义理解与细粒度小目标感知能力，限制了对MLLM在完整大场景SAR中能力边界的刻画。
AI.method: 构建包含405幅超大尺寸SAR图像（平均约7153×7153）的基准，设计10项任务（VQA、visual grounding、详细图像captioning）；所有评测样本经人工标注，并以半自动captioner辅助生成，随后对通用与领域专用MLLM进行系统性评测。
AI.result: 通用与领域专用MLLM在大场景SAR理解及小目标精确感知上均存在持续性的明显短板，暴露出全局-局部联合建模能力的不足。
AI.conclusion: XLSAR-Bench为MLLM在完整大场景SAR上的感知与推理提供了首个系统性评测平台，并已开源，但其本身为基准/数据集类工作，未提出新的模型方法。

title: AcousticBEV: Acoustic BEV Object Localization for Intelligent Vehicles
comment: Ziang Liu and Shiming Wang have equal contributions. Shiming Wang is the project lead
summary: Modern autonomous driving and driver assistance systems rely predominantly on cameras, radars and LiDARs for environmental perception. However, these modalities face different environmental limitations, including poor illumination for cameras and adverse weather for LiDAR. Acoustic sensing, particularly using microphone arrays, could provide complementary perception capabilities for autonomous driving, but has remained largely underexplored. In this work, we design a horizontally arranged microphone array that functions as the "ears" of a vehicle, enabling localization of nearby moving vehicles in a bird's-eye view (BEV) representation that captures both their relative direction and distance. Using this array, we collect a real-world driving dataset, AcousticScenes, which contains 2,117 static and 2,863 dynamic samples with synchronized spatial acoustic signals, LiDAR point clouds and 3D bounding box annotations. Building on this dataset, we propose AcousticBEV, a learning-based method for acoustic BEV object localization, which estimates the center locations of moving traffic participants in BEV from the microphone-array signals, conditioned on the ego vehicle's own speed. Experimental results demonstrate that AcousticBEV outperforms both classical signal-processing baselines and other learning-based methods, achieving F1 scores of $47.7 \pm 1.2$% on "Easy" scenarios and $45.1 \pm 1.4$% on "Difficult" cases. Our findings demonstrate that acoustic signals from a low-cost, vehicle-mounted microphone array can localize nearby moving vehicles in both azimuth and distance.

AI.tldr: 设计车载水平麦克风阵列作为车辆"耳朵"，构建 AcousticScenes 数据集（含同步空间声信号、LiDAR 点云与 3D 框标注），并提出 AcousticBEV，从阵列信号与自车速度条件估计近邻运动车辆的 BEV 中心位置。
AI.motivation: 相机受光照限制、LiDAR 受恶劣天气影响，模态各有局限；声学感知（麦克风阵列）成本低、可提供互补感知能力，但在自动驾驶中研究不足，缺乏数据与方法。
AI.method: 硬件：水平排布的麦克风阵列安装于车体，实现方位+距离联合估计。数据：实车采集 AcousticScenes，2,117 静态 + 2,863 动态样本，声信号与 LiDAR 点云、3D 框同步。算法：AcousticBEV，学习式声学 BEV 目标定位，以麦克风阵列信号为输入、自车速度为先验条件，回归运动交通参与者的 BEV 中心位置；与经典信号处理基线（如 GCC/波束形成类）及其他学习方法对比。
AI.result: AcousticBEV 优于经典信号处理基线与其它学习方法，Easy 场景 F1 = 47.7 ± 1.2%，Difficult 场景 F1 = 45.1 ± 1.4%。验证了低成本车载麦克风阵列可在方位与距离上定位近邻运动车辆。
AI.conclusion: 声学可作为一种低成本互补模态用于 BEV 目标定位，但仍属早期探索：绝对精度有限（F1 约 45–48%），主要针对近邻运动车辆，宜作为相机/LiDAR 的补充而非替代。

title: Long-Horizon Causal Inertial Odometry in Multistory Buildings
summary: In indoor 3D localization inside multistory buildings, an elevator or an escalator accelerates for a few seconds and then cruises at constant velocity for tens of seconds. Gait excitation disappears, the specific force degenerates into a constant gravity reaction, and instantaneous velocity becomes unobservable within a 1-2 s window. The output of short-window learned inertial odometry consequently degrades toward the conditional mean of the training set, and vertical displacement is systematically underestimated. We propose Local-Token Causal Attention (LTCA), a long-horizon architecture that compresses each 1 s inertial window into a 1 Hz motion token and sustains, over a bounded 60 s causal cache, the motion state established at the onset event. We further introduce a pluggable barometer branch that, when online, supplies a direct elevation constraint to the vertical channel through local differential height observations, and we train it with paired online/fallback conditional training so that the barometer also regularizes the representation shared by the two modes during training. On MSIO, our benchmark of nine buildings, the RoNIN and TLIO instances reach 3D trajectory errors (ATE-3D) of 2.83/4.18 m and 2.44/5.12 m on the Seen and Unseen splits, respectively, with the barometer online. With the barometer disabled at inference, the same weights fall back to pure inertial inference and reach 3.24/4.28 m and 2.64/5.23 m, still below every native short-window baseline. We further validate the framework on the public RoNIN and TLIO benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Local-Token Causal Attention (LTCA) 长时序学习式惯性里程计架构，将每 1 秒惯性窗压缩为 1 Hz 运动 token，并在 60 秒因果缓存内维持电梯/扶梯匀速段建立的运动状态；另加可插拔气压计分支及在线/回退条件训练，在 MSIO 九栋楼基准上将 ATE-3D 降至 2.44–2.83 m（Seen）/ 5.12 m（Unseen），无气压计时仍优于全部短窗基线。
AI.motivation: 多楼层室内定位中，电梯/扶梯会先加速数秒再匀速数十秒，步态激励消失、比力退化为恒定重力反作用力，1–2 s 窗口内瞬时速度不可观测；短窗学习式惯性里程计因此退化到训练集条件均值，系统性低估垂直位移。需要长时程、能维持起始事件所建立运动状态的架构。
AI.method: 1) LTCA：局部 token 化的因果注意力，将 1 s 惯性窗编码为 1 Hz 运动 token，在 60 s 有界因果缓存上跨窗传递运动状态；2) 可插拔气压计分支，用局部差分高度观测量为垂直通道提供直接高程约束；3) 在线/回退配对条件训练，使气压计在训练期同时正则化两模式共享表征，推理期缺失气压计时同一权重退化为纯惯性推理。在 MSIO（9 栋建筑）及公开 RoNIN、TLIO 基准上以 RoNIN/TLIO 为骨干评测。
AI.result: MSIO 上气压计在线时，RoNIN 与 TLIO 实例 ATE-3D 分别为 Seen 2.83/2.44 m、Unseen 4.18/5.12 m；推理时关闭气压计，同权重退化为纯惯性推理，分别达 3.24/2.64 m 与 4.28/5.23 m，仍低于所有原生短窗基线；并在公开 RoNIN、TLIO 基准上完成验证。
AI.conclusion: 长时程因果 token 化注意力可有效保持低速/匀速段的运动可观测性，缓解垂直位移低估；可插拔传感器分支配合条件训练兼顾性能与部署鲁棒性，为多楼层室内惯性定位提供可直接替换骨干的通用增强方案。

title: Pixel-KWS: Rendered-Glyph Representations for Orthographically Robust Open-Vocabulary Keyword Spotting
summary: Open-vocabulary keyword spotting (KWS) allows users to enroll arbitrary keywords at inference time. However, character and phoneme-based text encoders rely on fixed symbol vocabularies learned during training, limiting their ability to handle unseen or visually similar symbols such as homoglyphs, l33tspeak substitutions, and accented characters. We propose PIXEL-KWS, an open-vocabulary KWS framework that represents characters through rendered glyphs rather than learned embedding lookups. We render each character as a grayscale image and encode it with a lightweight CNN, enabling the text encoder to generalize from visual form rather than a fixed vocabulary. On LibriPhrase, PIXEL-KWS and its matched character-based counterpart achieve 9.57% and 9.55% EER on LibriPhrase-hard, 0.43% and 0.41% EER on LibriPhrase-easy, outperforming all published baselines without pre-training or synthetic data. PIXEL-KWS provides substantially greater robustness to both homoglyph and l33tspeak symbol-level perturbations. These results highlight glyph-based representations as a simple and effective approach for robust open-vocabulary KWS in practical settings.

AI.tldr: PIXEL-KWS 用渲染字形图像（灰阶字符图 + 轻量 CNN）替代固定符号词表的嵌入查表，实现字符/音素无关的开集关键词检测，并在同形字与 l33tspeak 扰动下显著更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有开集 KWS 的文本编码器依赖训练期固定的字符/音素符号表，无法处理未见符号及其视觉变体（同形字、l33tspeak、带重音符），限制实际场景部署。
AI.method: 提出 PIXEL-KWS：将每个字符渲染为灰阶图像，用轻量 CNN 编码得到字符表示，替代 embedding lookup，使文本侧从视觉形态而非固定词表泛化；与字符级基线保持对照匹配。
AI.result: LibriPhrase-hard 上 PIXEL-KWS 与匹配字符基线 EER 为 9.57% 与 9.55%，LibriPhrase-easy 上为 0.43% 与 0.41%，在无预训练、无合成数据条件下优于所有已发表基线；对同形字与 l33tspeak 扰动鲁棒性明显更强。
AI.conclusion: 字形表示是提升开集 KWS 符号级鲁棒性的简单有效手段；但其在常规指标上并未超越等价字符基线，收益主要体现在扰动鲁棒性，且属于语音关键词检测而非物理 AI 核心方向。

title: Detecting Small Space Objects for Space Situational Awareness with Collaborative Edge AI
summary: With the rapid growth of space activities, near-Earth space is becoming increasingly congested, leading to a higher risk of spacecraft collisions and space debris generation. Recent close-proximity encounters and collision incidents necessitate efficient and cost-effective onboard systems for space object detection (SOD) and collision avoidance. While deep learning (DL) enabled Edge AI using low-cost vision sensors on single or multiple satellites has shown promises for SOD, significant challenges remain, including limited datasets, small SOD, and the lack of comprehensive performance assessments. This paper presents a collaborative Edge AI framework for multiview SOD and systematically benchmarks DL models and fusion strategies. Results show that higher image resolution significantly improves small SOD. For multiple views, image-level fusion reduces the combined communication and inference latency by 30.13% and 32.80% on average compared with feature-level and attention-based fusion across the evaluated inter-satellite link (ISL) bandwidth. For larger view sets, feature-level and attention-based fusion achieve better detection accuracy at the cost of analysis in the sensing-communication pipeline, revealing that multiview collaboration introduces minimal latency overhead under ISL constraints when reception capacity is not exceeded. Our work provides valuable design insights for future collaborative satellite network design, supporting the emerging space situational awareness and space traffic management requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出面向多卫星协同边缘AI的空间目标检测(SOD)框架，系统评测多种深度学习模型与多视角融合策略在星间链路(ISL)带宽约束下的精度与时延权衡。
AI.motivation: 近地轨道空间日益拥挤，碰撞与碎片风险上升，需要低成本、高效率的星载检测与避碰系统；现有单/多星视觉+边缘AI方案受限于数据稀缺、小目标检测困难及缺乏系统性性能评估。
AI.method: 构建协同式多视角SOD边缘AI框架，对比图像级、特征级与注意力级三种融合策略，并在不同图像分辨率与ISL带宽条件下联合测量检测精度、通信与推理时延。
AI.result: 更高分辨率显著提升小目标检测；多视角下图像级融合相比特征级与注意力级融合平均降低30.13%与32.80%的通信+推理时延；视角数较多时特征级/注意力级融合精度更优但感知-通信流水线开销增大。
AI.conclusion: 在ISL接收容量未饱和时多视角协同时延开销很小；为未来协同卫星网络与空间态势感知、空间交通管理系统设计提供了工程权衡依据。

title: SplatFlow3D: Learning Scene Flow via 3D Motion Feature Splatting
summary: Considering the motion continuity and stability of 3D objects over short inter-frame intervals, introducing multi-frame settings in scene flow estimation can potentially address occlusion. In this paper, we propose a two-frame backbone, SimpleFlow3D, which integrates dense information from the image plane and sparse information from the depth dimension in a decoupling-followed-by-coupling manner by hierarchically constructing the 3D motion feature. SimpleFlow3D achieves SOTA results with minimal parameters. We also propose a weight-sharing multi-frame framework to splat the previous 3D motion feature to the current estimation process. The framework unifies the first and non-first frame inference by constructing pseudo inputs. After combining the proposed framework and backbone, the newly born multi-frame method SplatFlow3D further advances the state of the art. It achieves lower errors than the two-frame backbone, with fewer parameters than current methods. On both KITTI and Spring, SplatFlow3D ranked 1st over all published and submitted methods. Experiments show that SplatFlow3D improves occlusion handling, non-rigid motion estimation, and generalization to real-world scenes. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出两帧骨干 SimpleFlow3D（解耦再耦合的分层3D运动特征）与权重共享多帧框架 SplatFlow3D（将前一帧3D运动特征splat到当前估计），在KITTI/Spring上排名第一。
AI.motivation: 短间隔内3D物体运动具有连续性与稳定性，引入多帧设置可缓解遮挡问题；同时希望在极小参数量下达到SOTA。
AI.method: SimpleFlow3D：分层构建3D运动特征，采用“先解耦后耦合”方式融合图像平面的稠密信息与深度维度的稀疏信息。SplatFlow3D：权重共享多帧框架，通过构造伪输入统一首帧与非首帧推理，并将上一帧3D运动特征splat到当前估计过程。
AI.result: SimpleFlow3D以极少参数取得SOTA；SplatFlow3D误差低于两帧骨干且参数少于现有方法，在KITTI与Spring的所有公开/提交方法中排名第1；实验显示其改善遮挡处理、非刚性运动估计与真实场景泛化。
AI.conclusion: 多帧特征传播结合解耦-耦合的3D运动表示，是低成本、高效率提升场景流估计的有效范式，代码已开源。

title: Memorization Lives in a Few Attention Heads: Mitigating Memorization in Diffusion Models via Projection-Based Suppression
summary: Diffusion models can memorize and reproduce training samples during inference, raising serious privacy and copyright concerns. Existing inference-time mitigation methods often suppress conditional information globally, which may reduce memorization but can also harm semantic alignment and image quality. In this paper, we revisit memorization from the perspective of cross-attention heads. Through systematic analysis and targeted ablation, we find that memorization is mainly driven by a small subset of shallow-layer attention heads with abnormally strong semantic control, rather than by the entire cross-attention mechanism. Motivated by this finding, we propose Projection-based Top-k Attention Head Suppression, a targeted inference-time mitigation method. Our method first identifies the top-k attention heads most related to memorization using a semantic-control score, and then removes their condition-specific components through directional projection between conditional and unconditional representations. This design selectively weakens memorization-related features while preserving useful semantic information. Extensive experiments on different diffusion models and datasets show that our method effectively reduces memorization and achieves a better trade-off between memorization mitigation and image quality than existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文从交叉注意力头的角度重新审视扩散模型的记忆现象，发现记忆主要由浅层少数具异常强语义控制力的注意力头驱动，并提出基于投影的Top-k注意力头抑制方法以在推理时减弱记忆同时保持语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在推理阶段会记忆并复现训练样本，带来隐私与版权风险。现有推理时缓解方法往往全局抑制条件信息，虽可减少记忆，但会损害语义对齐与图像质量，因此需要更精细、有的放矢的抑制机制。
AI.method: 通过系统分析与针对性消融，定位记忆由少量浅层、语义控制异常强的交叉注意力头主导；据此提出Projection-based Top-k Attention Head Suppression：先用语义控制分数识别与记忆最相关的top-k注意力头，再通过条件与无条件表示间的方向投影去除其条件特化分量。
AI.result: 在多种扩散模型与数据集上的实验表明，该方法能有效降低记忆复现，并在记忆缓解与图像质量之间取得优于现有方法的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 记忆是交叉注意力机制中局部化（少数浅层头）的现象而非全局效应，针对性的头级投影抑制是实现隐私保护与生成质量兼顾的有效推理时干预手段。

title: Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D understanding aims to localize and segment arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. However, existing approaches based on Gaussian Splatting often rely on expensive preprocessing and lengthy training, limiting their applicability when fast and lightweight solutions are desired. We propose a lightweight, training-free framework for query-driven 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting. Instead of conventional mask-wise CLIP embeddings, we use dense pixel-level CLIP features to preserve fine-grained semantic information and enable flexible text-driven localization without relying on predefined instance proposals. Given a text query, we identify a high-quality target region in a carefully selected pivot view and propagate it across views using a video segmentor, providing consistent and comprehensive coverage of the target instance. We then lift the resulting 2D tracklets to 3D Gaussians through a novel visibility voting strategy, yielding accurate 3D segmentation masks with clean object boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on LERF-OVS, ScanNet, and ScanNet++, competitive results on 3D-OVS, and significant speedups over existing open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods. These results highlight the effectiveness of our framework for efficient open-vocabulary 3D understanding without per-scene training.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的轻量框架，在3D高斯（Gaussian Splatting）表示上做文本查询驱动的开放词汇3D实例分割：用稠密像素级CLIP特征定位，借助视频分割器跨视角传播，再通过可见性投票将2D tracklet 提升为3D高斯掩码。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯泼溅的开放词汇3D理解方法依赖昂贵预处理与冗长训练，难以满足快速、轻量需求；同时基于mask级CLIP嵌入的做法丢失细粒度语义并依赖预定义实例proposal。
AI.method: 1) 放弃mask-wise CLIP嵌入，改用稠密像素级CLIP特征以保留细粒度语义并支持灵活文本驱动定位；2) 给定文本查询，在精心选择的pivot视角中确定高质量目标区域，用视频分割器跨视角传播，得到一致且完整的2D tracklets；3) 通过新颖的可见性投票策略将2D tracklets 提升到3D高斯，生成边界干净的3D掩码。全过程无需逐场景训练。
AI.result: 在LERF-OVS、ScanNet、ScanNet++ 上取得SOTA，在3D-OVS 上具竞争力，并相对现有开放词汇3D分割方法有显著加速。
AI.conclusion: 验证了无需逐场景训练的高效开放词汇3D理解框架的有效性，可兼顾精度与推理速度。

title: Few-Shot Visual Concept Extraction for Steering Diffusion Transformers
summary: Image steering aims to provide fine-grained control over concepts in generated images, enabling targeted and continuous manipulation without broadly altering the generation process. Recent steering methods for diffusion models primarily focus on the text-conditioning space or rely on costly auxiliary training. Deviating from that, we here propose a novel steering approach that extracts visual concept directions directly from the image-side activations of Diffusion Transformers. Specifically, we showcase few-shot concept extraction in the activation space using a simple difference-of-means estimator over intermediate residuals. We observe (a) scene-level concepts such as lighting, weather, and style are distributed across image tokens, as well as (b) local concepts such as object colors, textures, materials, and facial attributes are concentrated in specific regions. Towards controlling both concepts, we introduce a new unified training-free framework that uses global difference-of-means for (a) distributed concepts and masked difference-of-means for (b) local concepts, preventing local signals from being diluted by global averaging. Notably, using only a handful of positive and negative prompt pairs, our method identifies and extracts reusable concept directions that can be injected at inference for continuous steering. Quantitatively, our method outperforms text-encoder steering and training-free activation-editing baselines, as well as is competitive with specialized editing models. Our results suggest that as concept directions can be applied at patch level, our method enables precise targeted and compositional steering, manipulating multiple concepts in the same image.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的扩散Transformer图像操控方法：从DiT图像侧激活中用差值均值估计器提取概念方向，对分布式场景概念用全局差值均值、对局部概念用掩码差值均值，推理时注入实现连续、可组合的操控。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型概念操控方法主要作用于文本条件空间或依赖昂贵的辅助训练，难以在细粒度层面精准控制图像概念且不改变整体生成过程。
AI.method: 仅用少量正负提示对，在DiT中间残差激活空间用difference-of-means提取视觉概念方向；观察到场景级概念（光照、天气、风格）分布于全局图像token，局部概念（物体颜色、纹理、材质、人脸属性）集中在特定区域，因此提出统一的无训练框架：全局差值均值处理分布式概念，掩码差值均值处理局部概念以避免局部信号被全局平均稀释；方向可在推理时注入，并支持patch级应用以组合多个概念。
AI.result: 定量上优于文本编码器操控与无训练激活编辑基线，并与专用编辑模型相当；patch级方向可同时精确操控同一图像中的多个概念。
AI.conclusion: DiT图像侧激活蕴含可复用的概念方向，结合全局/局部两种估计器可实现免训练、细粒度、连续且可组合的图像操控，为扩散模型可控生成提供了轻量新范式。

title: Semantics First, Pixels Later: Mission-Driven Event Streams for Drone Video over Bandwidth-Starved Links
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures; includes the supplementary material as an appendix; a demonstration video is attached as an ancillary file
summary: A surveillance drone on a bandwidth-starved link cannot send the video its operator would need, yet the operator's questions are often not about pixels: did three people converge, when, and where? We study what should cross a link of 1 Mbps down to 1 kbps instead, and in what order. BPS, a behavior-primitive stream, sends semantics first and pixels later: it runs a detector and a tracker onboard and sends short records (25 bytes on average) of multi-frame events selected by a mission card of 16-125 bytes, ahead of positions and pictures. We measure it by what a ground-side language model answers from it, under a preregistered protocol with a held-out set, against H.265 read by the vision fine-tune of the same model, H.265 on which the ground runs our own perception, a stream of quantized tracks, and onboard captions. On the development set (84% of questions about convergence, mostly one location) the event stream answers 74.3% of questions at 0.13 kbps. A reader that receives nothing answers 57.4%, and the video reader 59.6% at 100 kbps and 64.7% on the source frames. When the ground instead runs our perception on the video, video matches the stream at 100 kbps, about 800 times the stream's rate, and falls behind at 64 kbps and below. A track stream matches it at 96 times the bytes and loses 0.03 at 17 times. On held-out data the result is weaker: with events taken from annotated tracks, an oracle, the stream beats H.265 at 100 kbps (+0.13), but with onboard perception it does not (+0.01 [-0.04, +0.06]) and is no better than receiving nothing. Sent alone through emulated links the event records answer 0.739 at 1 Mbps and still 0.724 at 0.3 kbps; an every-frame track stream holds down to 1 kbps and video with ground-side perception down to about 100 kbps. On a Jetson Orin Nano the unchanged pipeline runs at 4.5 fps and misses most events.

AI.tldr: 提出BPS（行为原语流）：在机载端跑检测与跟踪，将多帧事件压缩为约25字节的记录，按任务卡筛选后优先于位置与图像传回；以地面语言模型的答题准确率评估，在极低带宽下显著优于H.265视频、量化轨迹流与机载描述。
AI.motivation: 带宽受限链路（1 Mbps～1 kbps）下无人机无法传输视频，而操作者的提问往往是语义性事件（如"三人是否在某时某地汇聚"）而非像素内容，因此需要研究"什么该过链路、以何种顺序过"。
AI.method: 机载检测+跟踪生成短事件记录（均值25 B），由16–125 B任务卡选择多帧事件，语义优先、像素后置。预注册协议、留出集，以地面VLM问答准确率评估；对比H.265（VLM直接读）、H.265+地面自研感知、量化轨迹流、机载字幕；并在模拟链路与Jetson Orin Nano上测速率与延迟。
AI.result: 开发集上事件流0.13 kbps达74.3%，空输入57.4%，视频读取59.6%（100 kbps）/64.7%（源帧）；轨迹流需96倍字节才持平，17倍字节时低0.03。留出集效果变弱：标注轨迹（oracle）+0.13，机载感知仅+0.01[-0.04,+0.06]，与空输入无差异。事件记录在1 Mbps答0.739、0.3 kbps仍0.724；逐帧轨迹流可降至1 kbps，地面感知视频约需100 kbps。Orin Nano上4.5 fps，漏检多数事件。
AI.conclusion: 语义优先的极低带宽通信在开发集与模拟链路下远超视频/轨迹基线，但依赖高质量机载感知；实际部署受限（4.5 fps、留出集无增益），作者以预注册与oracle对照诚实揭示瓶颈在机载跟踪而非通信范式本身。

title: Successive Convexification in Learned World Models for Safe Offline Planning
comment: 28 pages, 13 figures. Under review at L4DC 2027
summary: World models learned from offline data allow an agent to plan without further interaction with the environment, but the sampling-based planners used with them handle safety constraints only by scoring or rejecting sampled action sequences. We instead pose safe planning in the latent space of a learned world model as a successive convex program (SCP), in which a learned discrete-time control barrier function is imposed as a constraint at every step of the horizon. SCP requires smooth dynamics, so we build the networks from smoothed MaxMin activations and spectrally normalised layers, and bound the resulting linearisation error in terms of the Lipschitz bound and the smoothing width. As SCP is a local method, we start it from a sampled plan. On two Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks with offline data, this planner has fewer violations than MPPI and CEM drawing 128 times as many samples at equal wall-clock time in our main comparison, though not significantly, and earns greater return at longer horizons, and is much safer than SCP without a sampled start. SCP converged more often on Lipschitz-bounded models. Unlike sampling, it also reports at each step whether its plan is a feasible, first-order optimal KKT point of the planning problem in the model, or that no feasible plan was found nearby. Our implementation is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 在学到的世界模型潜空间中将安全规划表述为逐时域施加学习型离散时间控制屏障函数约束的序列凸规划(SCP),配合平滑MaxMin激活与谱归一化保证动力学光滑性并给出线性化误差界,性能超越MPPI/CEM且可给出KKT可行性判定。
AI.motivation: 基于采样的规划器(MPPI、CEM)在世界模型中只能通过打分或拒绝采样来处理安全约束,缺乏可行性保证;作者希望在潜空间中求解带约束的优化问题,使安全性成为硬约束并获得可验证的最优性/可行性证书。
AI.method: 1) 以序列凸规划(SCP)在学到的潜空间世界模型中规划,将学习得到的离散时间控制屏障函数(CBF)作为每一步horizon内的约束;2) 为保证SCP所需的光滑性,网络采用平滑MaxMin激活函数与谱归一化层,并将线性化误差以Lipschitz界和平滑宽度为上界进行理论界定;3) 因SCP为局部方法,以采样得到的计划作为初始解;4) 每步输出是否为模型内规划问题的可行一阶最优KKT点,或报告附近无可行解。
AI.result: 在两个Safety-Gymnasium导航任务(离线数据)上,主对比中该方法在相同wall-clock时间下违规次数少于采样数为其128倍的MPPI和CEM(但差异不显著);更长horizon下回报更高;显著优于无采样初始化的SCP;在Lipschitz有界模型上SCP收敛更频繁。
AI.conclusion: 将安全规划转化为带CBF约束的SCP是可用的替代采样方案,额外提供可行性/最优性的显式报告;但相对大样本采样器优势不显著,且依赖采样初始化与光滑化网络的误差界,实际安全性提升尚有限。

title: Representing Differential Inclusions as Monads: A Framework for Compositional Controller Synthesis
summary: Sequential composition of safety-certified controllers for hybrid and non-smooth robotic systems is well studied piecewise. Yet no existing framework reduces this question to a single algebraic condition. We construct a \emph{trajectory monad} for Filippov-regular differential inclusions. Its Kleisli category treats controllers as morphisms and sequential execution as trajectory concatenation. Control Barrier Function (CBF) certification, a guarantee of forward invariance, corresponds to a sub-monad of this category. Joint safety of composed controllers then follows from one algebraic condition. All controllers must land in a common sub-monad, which is closed under the monad multiplication. The sub-monad condition recasts recasts existing CBF composition practice categorically. It explains why a smooth intersection of multiple barriers supports safe composition, while enforcing barriers phase by phase does not. For the phase-by-phase case, we derive a closed-form Bernoulli model of the failure rate. We validate it over a randomized sweep of 3{,}000 instances. The same sweep shows that the standard baseline degrades under constraint conflict as the barrier count grows. This baseline enforces all barriers simultaneously as constraints in a single quadratic program (QP). We instantiate the framework on a four-mode piecewise-affine system and on a unicycle reduced-order model over heterogeneous terrain.

AI.tldr: 该文为Filippov正则微分包含构造"轨迹单子"，将控制器视为态射、顺序执行为轨迹拼接，用子单子条件统一刻画CBF安全组合。
AI.motivation: 混合与非光滑机器人系统的安全认证控制器顺序组合问题此前只被分情形研究，缺乏统一判据。
AI.method: 构造轨迹单子及其Kleisli范畴；CBF前向不变性认证对应子单子；组合安全性归结为所有控制器落入乘法封闭的公共子单子；对有相位切换的情形推导闭式Bernoulli失效模型，并在3000随机实例上验证，同时与单一QP同时施加全部约束的基线对比。
AI.result: 子单子条件解释了光滑屏障交集可安全组合而逐相位强制不可；基线在约束冲突下随屏障数增加而退化；框架应用于四模态分段仿射系统与异质地形容尼车降阶模型。
AI.conclusion: 给出单一代数判据统一CBF组合理论，并提供可验证的失效率模型。

title: InvarOrd: Self-Supervised Ordinal Knowledge Distillation with Rank-Invariant Alignment for Label-Efficient Cross-Species Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Assessment
summary: Hyperspectral models of fish freshness rarely transfer between species, and labelling a new species is slow and destructive. Freshness is also ordinal, and standard domain alignment can erase that order. We present InvarOrd, which adapts to a new species from 30 labelled cubes (5 per rank) in three stages: self-supervised spectral pretraining on unlabelled source cubes, cross-species alignment by a shrinkage covariance discrepancy computed only within matched ranks, and ordinal distillation into a compact student. The alignment term is provably invariant to the rank means, so it gives no incentive to collapse the ordinal axis. On paired salmon and cod data (800 cubes each, 16 days), a source-trained teacher reaches 1.6 to 1.9 days mean absolute error (MAE) on the other species, with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) below zero. The 423K-parameter student, 2.54 times smaller than its teacher, attains the lowest MAE (1.476 days) and highest within 1-day accuracy (56.1%) among 14 configurations, matching the best of six ImageNet-pretrained backbones (ConvNeXt-T, 1.503 days) at 66 times fewer parameters, 1.44ms per cube on a GPU and 5s re-adaptation. InvarOrd beats target-only training by 0.29 days (p = 0.031). Among alignment objectives, rank-invariant alignment retains the most ordinal structure (embedding rank correlation 0.183, QWK 0.112), whereas global discrepancy lowers the rank correlation to 0.049 and QWK to zero at only 0.014 days higher MAE.

AI.tldr: InvarOrd: 三阶段跨物种高光谱鱼新鲜度序数域适应（每等级5个标注立方体），秩内收缩协方差对齐保持序数结构，蒸馏出423K学生模型，MAE 1.476天。
AI.motivation: 高光谱鱼类新鲜度模型跨物种迁移能力差，新物种标注慢且具破坏性；新鲜度本身是序数变量，常规域对齐会抹平等级顺序。
AI.method: 三阶段：无标注源立方体自监督光谱预训练 → 仅在同等级内部计算收缩协方差差异的跨物种对齐（对秩均值可证不变，避免序数轴塌缩）→ 序数知识蒸馏得到紧凑学生模型；仅需30个标注立方体（每等级5个）。
AI.result: 三文鱼/鳕鱼各800立方体、16天数据；源训练教师在异种上MAE 1.6–1.9天且QWK<0；423K参数学生MAE 1.476天、±1天准确率56.1%，14种配置最优，媲美ConvNeXt-T（1.503天）但参数少66倍，GPU 1.44ms/立方体、5秒重适应；较仅目标域训练优0.29天（p=0.031）；秩不变量对齐的嵌入秩相关0.183、QWK 0.112，显著优于全局差异对齐（0.049/0）。
AI.conclusion: 在序数标签稀缺的跨域适应中，秩内不变对齐可同时保住序数结构与预测精度，是轻量高效的新物种快速适配方案。

title: StyleJudge: A Human-Validated, In-Context-Learning Vision-Language Evaluator for Artistic Style Transfer
summary: Automatic evaluation of artistic style transfer remains an open problem: existing metrics score an image pair in isolation, without seeing an example of the intended style transformation, and correlate poorly with human judgment. We introduce StyleJudge, a compact vision-language evaluator conditioned on a small set of reference source-to-stylized pairs before scoring a query pair, mirroring how a human rater calibrates to a style before judging a candidate. On a human-annotated benchmark of 878 rated pairs across 12 artistic styles (728 from 10 training/validation styles, 150 from 2 unseen styles), our efficient 0.8B-parameter StyleJudge reaches a Pearson correlation of 0.291 (Spearman 0.325) with human ratings on seen styles and 0.381 on unseen ones. On seen styles, it achieves the highest positive correlation among tested metrics: Gram-matrix style loss and CLIP similarity correlate weakly ($r=0.041$, $r=0.168$), while LPIPS (scored higher when closer to the source) correlates negatively ($r=-0.404$). We achieve this by distilling evaluation knowledge from a 72B-parameter vision-language teacher used only during training, which reaches $r=0.327$, confirming that most of its human alignment survives compact distillation.
