summary: Does an AUROC comparison survive a change in the proportions of tasks, populations, or image corruptions? A pooled-AUROC ranking of failure detectors or uncertainty scores describes one particular mix of groups. We study two fixed scores for a common binary target under mixtures of fixed group-conditional laws. Using the cross-group AUC decomposition, we prove that every rational symmetric quadratic comparison geometry is realizable by finite scalar-score distributions. Universal dominance is thus coNP-hard, and even exhaustive checks of every mixture on fewer than $K$ groups can miss a $K$-group reversal. A grid bound gives a dimension-uniform approximation certificate with sharp $1/m$ order. Common score marginals across groups make the comparison numerator linear, with an error envelope for imperfect alignment. These results yield exact finite-bank audits, explicit reversal mixtures and distances, and simultaneous population statements. For failure detection with a frozen ResNet-50 on ImageNet-C, 15 of 18 confidence-score comparisons win in every corruption family on a discovery split, and all 15 are finite-bank certified over all family mixtures on a held-out split; over all 15 corruption types, of 14 discovery winners the corrected grid certifies 10, leaves 3 unresolved, and finds one confirmation reversal of at least 0.05 AUROC. An audit of all 11,019 released Stable LM 2 12B outputs and 35 uncertainty methods finds 66 confirmation-set comparisons that win within all four tasks yet reverse under mixing. Discovery-fitted marginal rank alignment removes all 66; an alignment-error envelope certifies 83 comparisons. Label checks also change several selected reversals. The findings distinguish robustness of frozen scores from robustness after calibration; they do not establish human-error detection, robustness to unseen corruptions, or generalization beyond the evaluated banks.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在分组比例（任务、人群、图像损坏类型）混合变化下，AUROC 比较结论是否稳健；证明对称二次比较几何均可由有限标量分数实现，因此"通用占优"判定是 coNP-hard，少于 K 组下的穷举混合检验也可能漏掉 K 组反转；给出维度一致的网格近似证书（误差阶 1/m），并在 ImageNet-C 上的 ResNet-50 失效检测与 Stable LM 2 12B 不确定性审计中给出精确有限样本证据。
AI.motivation: 失效检测器与不确定性分数的排名通常基于某个固定混合的数据（特定任务、人群、损坏类型比例）的 pooled AUROC，但这一排名是否在混合比例变化后依然成立缺乏理论保证，实践中也可能因混合结构被误读为方法优劣。
AI.method: 采用跨组 AUC 分解，将 pooled 比较量写成组条件分布的对称二次型；证明任意有理对称二次比较几何都可由有限标量分数分布实现；构造显式反转混合与距离，给出 <K 组穷举检验的漏检反例；提出网格化近似证书与统一维度误差界（sharp 1/m）；在分数跨组边缘分布一致时推导比较分子的线性形式及对齐误差包络；进行有限样本库（finite-bank）精确审计与发现/确认划分验证。
AI.result: 理论上：通用占优判定的 coNP-hard 性、网格证书的 sharp 1/m 近似界、完美对齐时的线性化与误差包络。实验上：ImageNet-C/ResNet-50 中 18 个置信度比较的 15 个在发现集上于所有损坏族获胜并被有限库证书确认；跨 15 种损坏类型时，14 个发现集胜者中网格证书确认 10 个、3 个未决、发现 1 个 ≥0.05 AUROC 的确认反转；Stable LM 2 12B 共 11,019 条输出、35 种不确定性方法审计出 66 个在四个任务内均胜但在混合下反转的比较，边缘秩对齐消除全部 66 个，误差包络可确认 83 个比较。
AI.conclusion: pooled-AUROC 比较对组混合比例不具天然稳健性，需以显式混合审计与证书代替单点排名；研究区分了冻结分数的稳健性与校准后的稳健性，但未建立人类错误检测能力、未观测损坏的稳健性或超出所评估数据库的泛化。

title: M-CROSS: A Multisensor Simulation Dataset for SLAM across Water--Land Transitions
summary: Water--land cross-domain robots require continuous localization across land, transition and underwater phases, where sensor characteristics and availability change abruptly. Existing datasets and conventional metrics are not designed to capture transition-induced degradation and failures. We present \textbf{M-CROSS}, to the best of our knowledge, the first multisensor simulation dataset and benchmark for SLAM across continuous water--land transitions. It provides synchronized LiDAR, sonar, stereo camera, IMU, DVL, and depth measurements; 6DoF pose ground truth; sensor-wise medium-state annotations; and medium-dependent sensor degradation models. We establish a transition-aware protocol comprising the Trajectory Completion Rate (TCR), Piecewise Absolute Pose Error (PW-APE), Transition End Error (TEE), and Transition Survival Period (TSP), which measure trajectory completion, single-domain accuracy, transition-induced error, and localization survival under prolonged partial immersion, respectively. Experiments with 6 representative SLAM systems show that existing methods fail to maintain both localization accuracy and trajectory continuity across the full set of water--land transitions, exhibiting transition-induced drift, trajectory discontinuities, and tracking failures. M-CROSS is publicly available this https URL

AI.tldr: M-CROSS是首个面向水陆连续过渡场景的多传感器SLAM仿真数据集与基准，提供LiDAR/声呐/双目/IMU/DVL/深度同步数据、6DoF真值、介质状态标注与介质相关退化模型，并提出过渡感知评测协议（TCR、PW-APE、TEE、TSP）。
AI.motivation: 水陆跨域机器人需在陆地、过渡、水下阶段连续定位，但传感器特性与可用性会在介质切换时突变；现有数据集与传统指标无法刻画过渡导致的性能退化与失效。
AI.method: 构建多传感器仿真数据集：同步LiDAR、声呐、双目相机、IMU、DVL与深度测量，含6DoF位姿真值与传感器级介质状态标注，并引入介质相关传感器退化模型；设计过渡感知评测协议，包含轨迹完成率TCR、分段绝对位姿误差PW-APE、过渡终点误差TEE与过渡存活时长TSP；在6个代表性SLAM系统上做基准测试。
AI.result: 6种现有SLAM方法在全水陆过渡中均无法同时保持定位精度与轨迹连续性，表现出过渡诱导漂移、轨迹断裂与跟踪失效；TCR、PW-APE、TEE、TSP可分别度量轨迹完成度、单域精度、过渡误差与长时间部分浸没下的定位存活能力。
AI.conclusion: M-CROSS公开可用，为跨介质SLAM提供了标准化数据与过渡敏感评价体系，揭示现有方法在介质切换下的系统性缺陷，指向多模态退化自适应与鲁棒状态估计的后续研究方向。

title: JEPA4R: Embodied JEPA World Models with 4D Point Planning
comment: Code: this https URL , Website: this https URL
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models predict future embeddings instead of pixels and plan in latent space. Two challenges remain: 2D images leave the metric geometry that manipulation acts on implicit and entangled with appearance, and what these models imagine stays hidden, as they are mostly judged in simulation by short-horizon latent planning. We present JEPA4R, a JEPA world model that observes single-depth-camera point clouds, predicts and plans in their latent space, and acts through a policy head on its frozen latents; we call this 4D point planning. A decoder on the frozen world model shows what it imagines as 4D point clouds, with a mean point error within 1.1 cm over 200 steps. Under the policy-learning protocols of OGBench and CortexBench, JEPA4R leads pixel JEPA models on OGBench Cube-Single, Cube-Double, Cube-Triple and Scene, and ranks first on MetaWorld and Adroit Relocate with 98.4% and 88.0%, above the runner-up, R3M, at 96.0% and 65.3%. Trained only in a digital twin, JEPA4R and its policy heads run zero-shot on the real arm with both a gripper and a dexterous hand.

AI.tldr: JEPA4R：以单目深度相机点云为输入的JEPA世界模型，在4D点云潜空间做预测与规划，冻结潜空间上接策略头，并用解码器可视化想象的4D点云。
AI.motivation: 现有JEPA世界模型两大问题：2D图像的度量几何被外观纠缠、隐含不显式；模型"想象"的内容不可见，评价多局限于仿真中的短程潜空间规划。
AI.method: 输入单目深度相机点云，构建JEPA世界模型在点云潜空间中预测与规划（"4D点规划"）；在冻结潜特征上训练策略头执行动作；在冻结世界模型上训练解码器，将潜预测还原为4D点云。
AI.result: 解码器200步预测平均点误差≤1.1 cm；OGBench Cube-Single/Double/Triple/Scene上优于像素JEPA；MetaWorld 98.4%、Adroit Relocate 88.0%（次优R3M为96.0%/65.3%）；仅数字孪生训练即在真实机械臂（夹爪与灵巧手）零样本运行。
AI.conclusion: 以显式4D点云潜空间替代2D像素JEPA，兼顾几何可解释性与规划性能，并具备仿真到真实臂的零样本迁移能力。

title: SemLite-GS: Semantic-Selective Parallel Gaussian Splatting for Lightweight Building Reconstruction from UAV Oblique Imagery
summary: Lightweight 3D building models support urban spatial analysis, but their production often requires dense scene reconstruction, building extraction, and mesh simplification. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is more efficient than conventional multi-view stereo, existing large-scale methods lack semantic selection and parallel instance-level training. We present SemLite-GS, a building-centric framework that reconstructs lightweight building meshes from large-scale UAV oblique imagery. First, an orthographic reference map establishes globally consistent building identities, which are propagated to oblique views to form camera-instance pairs and regions of interest. Second, semantic-selective parallel PGSR training jointly processes multiple pairs within relevant image regions while updating only target Gaussians; contextual Gaussians remain fixed to preserve visibility. Third, architectural planes extracted from rendered depth, opacity, and normal maps guide signed distance field optimization, producing meshes with adaptive polygon allocation and well-defined structural boundaries. Experiments on multiple large-scale UAV datasets demonstrate that our SemLite-GS substantially reduces building reconstruction time compared with representative full-scene 3DGS methods. With comparable polygon budgets, SemLite-GS achieves superior preservation of dominant planar structures and sharp architectural transitions compared with conventional dense reconstruction followed by mesh decimation. The source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SemLite-GS：面向大规模无人机倾斜影像的建筑级轻量化重建框架，结合正交参考图建立的建筑实例身份传播、语义选择性并行PGSR训练（仅更新目标高斯）以及由渲染深度/不透明度/法线导出的建筑平面先验引导SDF优化，产出多边形自适应分配、结构边界清晰的轻量建筑网格。
AI.motivation: 轻量3D建筑模型支撑城市空间分析，但传统流程依赖稠密重建+建筑提取+网格简化，成本高；3DGS虽比MVS高效，但现有大规模方法缺乏语义选择能力，且无法按实例并行训练，难以高效生成单体建筑轻量网格。
AI.method: （1）用正射参考图建立全局一致的建筑实例身份，并传播到倾斜视图，形成相机-实例对与感兴趣区域；（2）语义选择性并行PGSR训练，在多对相机-实例上并行处理相关图像区域，仅更新目标高斯，上下文高斯保持固定以维持可见性；（3）从渲染的深度、不透明度、法线图提取建筑平面，引导SDF优化，实现多边形自适应分配与清晰结构边界。
AI.result: 在多个大规模无人机数据集上，相比代表性全场景3DGS方法显著缩短建筑重建时间；在相当多边形预算下，相较"稠密重建+网格简化"流程，对主导平面结构的保持与建筑锐利过渡的还原更优。
AI.conclusion: 语义选择性实例级并行训练+平面先验SDF优化为大规模建筑的轻量化网格重建提供了高效可行的方案，兼具效率与几何质量优势；代码已开源。

title: When Backdoors Can Be Switched Off: Suppression-Aware Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations, robot states, and natural-language instructions to robotic actions, but their multimodal interfaces introduce new security risks. Existing VLA backdoor attacks primarily study trigger-based activation and stealthy action manipulation, leaving conditional suppression of malicious behavior underexplored. We investigate suppression-aware backdoors, which combine conjunctive trigger activation with instruction-conditioned suppression. We instantiate this design through three variants: Cross-Modal Trigger, combining robot-state and spatially separated visual triggers; Self-Suppressing Trigger, requiring a state trigger and a [DISRUPT] instruction token for activation, with [RESTORE] token suppressing the attack; and Multi-Trigger, additionally requiring a visual trigger while retaining suppression even when physical triggers persist. We evaluate these attacks using SmolVLA on two SO-100 manipulation datasets against four baselines: State Backdoor, BadVLA, TabVLA, and SilentDrift. Self-Suppressing and Multi-Trigger reduce Isolation Forest detection from 96--98% to 1--18% and action-space l divergence by 10--14X, achieving 63--71% attack success rates with perfect clean-task performance. Experiments with OpenVLA on LIBERO further show that the attacks transfer to a 7B-parameter policy, evading STRIP and action-distribution-shift detection. Our findings establish conditional suppression as an important dimension for evaluating backdoor threats in VLA policies.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究VLA模型中的"抑制感知后门"，提出三种结合合取触发与指令条件抑制的后门变体（Cross-Modal Trigger、Self-Suppressing Trigger、Multi-Trigger），在SmolVLA/SO-100与OpenVLA/LIBERO上评估，证明可显著规避异常检测同时保持干净任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA后门攻击主要关注基于触发的激活与隐蔽动作篡改，对"恶意行为的条件性抑制"这一维度研究不足；多模态接口引入了新的安全风险，需要更系统的威胁建模。
AI.method: 提出抑制感知后门设计，将合取触发激活与指令条件抑制结合，实例化为三种变体：跨模态触发（机器人状态+空间分离视觉触发）、自抑制触发（状态触发+[DISRUPT]指令标记激活，[RESTORE]抑制）、多触发（额外加入视觉触发，物理触发持续时仍可抑制）。在SmolVLA上于两个SO-100操作数据集对比State Backdoor、BadVLA、TabVLA、SilentDrift四个基线。
AI.result: Self-Suppressing与Multi-Trigger将Isolation Forest检测率从96–98%降至1–18%，动作空间l1散度降低10–14倍，攻击成功率达63–71%且干净任务性能完美；在OpenVLA（7B）与LIBERO上可迁移，并规避STRIP与动作分布漂移检测。
AI.conclusion: 条件抑制应被视为评估VLA策略后门威胁的重要维度，现有防御对该类攻击有效性不足。

title: Recovery-Guided Model-Based Diffusion for Safety-Critical Legged Locomotion
summary: Safety-critical high-speed legged locomotion requires motion planners to balance safety foresight with online computational efficiency. Although short prediction horizons reduce rollout costs, they provide limited safety foresight, and strict safety constraints severely restrict the feasible trajectory space. We propose a recovery-guided model-based diffusion (MBD) framework for safety-critical legged locomotion. It incorporates a learned terminal recovery critic into short-horizon trajectory optimization. Specifically, the critic approximates the worst-case future clearance margin along rollouts of a designated recovery policy. We introduce a feasibility-guided refinement strategy that combines within-horizon constraints and terminal recoverability at each sampling stage, while retaining feasible elites to mitigate sampling-support loss. Across 50 paired randomized Unitree Go2 obstacle-avoidance trials, our approach achieves zero collisions and 98% strict-clearance success, while requiring substantially less computation than long-horizon MBD baselines. A project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出恢复引导的基于模型扩散(MBD)框架,将学习到的终点恢复评价器嵌入短视野轨迹优化,在50组随机Go2避障试验中实现零碰撞、98%严格间隙成功率,且计算量显著低于长视野MBD。
AI.motivation: 安全关键高速足式运动中,短预测视野降低采样成本但安全前瞻不足,严格安全约束又极度压缩可行轨迹空间;长视野MBD虽前瞻好但在线计算代价过高。
AI.method: 在短视野轨迹优化中引入学习式终点恢复critic,近似指定恢复策略rollout下的最坏情形未来间隙余量;并提出可行性引导的精化策略,在每个采样阶段联合视野内约束与终点可恢复性,同时保留可行精英样本以缓解采样支撑损失。
AI.result: 50组配对随机Unitree Go2避障试验中零碰撞、98%严格间隙成功,计算量显著低于长视野MBD基线。
AI.conclusion: 以学习式终点可恢复性替代长视野前瞻,可在短视野下兼顾安全约束与在线效率,为安全关键足式运动规划提供可行范式。

title: A Threshold-Free Visual-Semantic Matching Metric for Evaluating Consistency in Subject-Driven Image Generation
summary: In subject-driven text-to-image generation, quantitatively evaluating localized visual consistency across varying poses and environments remains a major challenge. Existing metrics either rely on global image embeddings (CLIP, DINO) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that pool spatial representations and miss fine-grained textural artifacts, or depend on scalar threshold-gated dense metrics such as Visual-Semantic Matching (VSM) that suffer from point-alignment dropouts, severe threshold sensitivity, and score instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose TF-VSM, a fully continuous, threshold-free visual-consistency metric paired with an extended feature-disentanglement retraining schedule for dual-branch ResNet feature-aggregation networks. Rather than enforcing rigid binary cutoffs $(T_s,T_v)$, TF-VSM weights every object point by a non-linear semantic match confidence $w_j=ReLU(\hat{s}_j)^2$ and continuously integrates visual similarity over all consistency levels $r\in[0,1]$, yielding a closed-form confidence-weighted score without any hand-tuned hyperparameters. On a controlled 100-pair benchmark with ground-truth inpainting oracles, TF-VSM attains Pearson $0.638$ and Spearman $0.674$ oracle correlation, improving over the pretrained VSM baseline ($0.454/0.589$) by $+0.171/+0.116$ after retraining, and drastically outperforming CLIP ($-0.052/-0.004$), DINO ($0.087/0.121$), and VLMs ($0.096/0.003$). Six diagnostic ablations confirm that smooth confidence weighting is the right mechanism, that hard semantic gating is brittle (dropping to $0.533$ Pearson at $T_s{=}0.8$), and that the threshold-free metric is essentially invariant to the training-time loss balance $\alpha$ that the thresholded metric still depends on.

AI.tldr: 提出TF-VSM：一种全连续、无阈值的主题驱动生成视觉一致性度量，用置信度权重ReLU(ŝ_j)^2替代硬阈值门控，并在[0,1]上连续积分视觉相似度，得到闭式评分。
AI.motivation: 现有主题驱动文生图评估指标存在缺陷：CLIP/DINO/VLM依赖全局池化嵌入，丢失细粒度纹理伪影；VSM等稠密度量依赖标量阈值门控，导致点对齐丢失、阈值敏感、分数不稳定。
AI.method: 将每个物体点的语义匹配置信度作非线性加权 w_j=ReLU(ŝ_j)^2，对所有一致性等级 r∈[0,1] 连续积分视觉相似度，得到无手工超参的闭式置信加权分数；同时对双分支ResNet特征聚合网络采用扩展的特征解耦重训练策略。并在100对带真值inpainting oracle的受控基准上做六组诊断消融。
AI.result: 重训练后TF-VSM的Pearson 0.638、Spearman 0.674，较预训练VSM基线(0.454/0.589)提升+0.171/+0.116，显著优于CLIP(-0.052/-0.004)、DINO(0.087/0.121)与VLM(0.096/0.003)；消融显示硬语义门控在T_s=0.8时Pearson降至0.533，且无阈值度量对训练时损失权重α基本不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 平滑置信加权是正确机制，硬阈值门控脆弱；TF-VSM提供了无超参、稳定且与人类/ oracle 判断更一致的局部视觉一致性度量，可作为主题驱动生成与个性化编辑的评估工具。

title: DynLimit: A Simulation Benchmark for Dynamics-Critical Planning and Control
summary: Experiments near vehicle handling limits must keep three questions apart: what a maneuver requests, what the closed-loop system executes, and whether the task is completed. We present DynLimit, a simulation platform that organizes this process end to end. Scenarios are composed from road, friction, obstacle, and reference objects; planners and controllers attach through a shared observation and control interface; a vehicle adapter runs either a license-free four-wheel model or an external dynamics solver; and synchronized records feed task evaluation, replay, and response inspection. The platform carries a task-oriented evaluation method that pairs a prescribed reference demand with a sampled passing set and event-aligned diagnosis. Across eight task families, three friction environments, and three reference-assisted baseline chains we executed 450 runs: 360 nominal, 18 locally refined, and 72 with prescribed initial offsets. Method differences depend on the task family, equal aggregate pass counts arise from different passing cells, and local refinement narrows two sampled transitions without locating a continuous boundary. Two case comparisons show why sideslip or tire-utilization peaks cannot replace task constraints. The three views therefore stay distinct in every reported run: an outcome can be traced from the prescribed demand, through the executed response, to the task rule that decided it. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DynLimit：面向车辆操控极限实验的仿真平台，将"请求的机动—闭环执行响应—任务完成判定"三视角分离，并提供任务导向评估与事件对齐诊断。
AI.motivation: 接近操控极限的实验常混淆三个问题：机动请求了什么、闭环系统实际执行了什么、任务是否完成。现有仿真/评估流程缺乏统一的端到端组织与任务级判据。
AI.method: 场景由道路、摩擦、障碍与参考对象组合；规划器/控制器经共享观测与控制接口接入；车辆适配器支持免授权四轮模型或外部动力学求解器；同步记录用于任务评估、回放与响应检查。评估方法将给定参考需求与采样通过集配对，并做事件对齐诊断。共450次运行（8类任务家族×3种摩擦环境×3条参考辅助基线：360标称、18局部细化、72预设初始偏移）。
AI.result: 方法差异依赖任务家族；相同聚合通过数来自不同通过单元；局部细化收窄两处采样过渡但未找到连续边界；两例对比表明侧偏角或轮胎利用率峰值不能替代任务约束，三视角在每次运行中均可追溯。
AI.conclusion: 平台提供了可追溯、任务导向的极限操控实验组织与评估范式，但边界刻画仍为采样式而非精确判定，属于仿真评估工具性贡献。

title: Fine-Grained RLAIF for Visual Safety: Learning to Zoom into Hazards for Multimodal Safety Alignment
summary: Recent multimodal safety alignment heavily relies on a text-centric paradigm, assuming risks are explicit in language or globally prominent in images. However, real-world hazards are often visually subtle or peripheral, causing existing models to fail due to their reliance on coarse, global visual representations. In this work, we study fine-grained visual safety alignment and introduce a challenging 1,200-sample benchmark across four domains, where hazards necessitate localized inspection. To address this, we propose Fine-Grained RLAIF (FGR), a reinforcement learning framework that casts image zoom-in as a learnable perception policy. FGR employs a decomposed reward design to jointly align three core safety behaviors: (i) where to look via a visual evidence reward, (ii) when to act via a tool-formatting constraint, and (iii) how to reason via visually grounded safety explanations. FGR achieves accuracy ranging from 86.71% to 93.00%, consistently outperforming strong multimodal and agent-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出细粒度视觉安全对齐问题与1,200样本基准，并提出Fine-Grained RLAIF（FGR）强化学习框架，将图像放大作为可学习的感知策略，通过分解奖励同时对齐"看哪里/何时行动/如何推理"三种安全行为。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态安全对齐依赖文本中心范式，假设风险在语言中显式表达或在图像中全局显著；而真实风险常视觉细微或处于边缘区域，模型依赖粗略全局视觉表征因而失效。
AI.method: 构建含四个领域、需局部审视的1,200样本细粒度安全基准；提出FGR强化学习框架，把图像放大（zoom-in）建模为可学习感知策略，并设计分解奖励：视觉证据奖励（决定看哪里）、工具调用格式约束（决定何时行动）、视觉接地安全解释（决定如何推理）。
AI.result: 准确率86.71%–93.00%，稳定优于强多模态与基于智能体的基线。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉工具调用（局部放大）纳入RL感知策略并用分解奖励对齐，可有效处理视觉细微/边缘风险，为多模态安全对齐提供细粒度范式。

title: Pros4D: Modeling Evolving 4D Worlds in Latent Space for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
summary: Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand how 3D environments evolve over time, supporting physical world understanding and embodied intelligence. Existing efforts primarily address observed-dynamics understanding, whereas agents in dynamic environments also require future-dynamics prediction beyond the observation boundary. Moreover, external geometric processing and textual descriptions can increase inference complexity or lose information when representing continuous dynamics. These limitations motivate a shared internal state that preserves observed dynamics and remains predictive beyond the input video. Accordingly, we present Pros4D, a framework for modeling evolving 4D worlds in latent space that unifies retrospective understanding of observed-dynamics with prospective reasoning for future-dynamics prediction. Specifically, Pros4D-Engine derives geometry-grounded supervision and constructs paired examples for both tasks, while Pros4D-Bench evaluates them across eight spatial task categories spanning dynamic cameras, objects, and scenes. At the model level, Pros4D compresses observed dynamics into latent observed states and autoregressively rolls them forward into latent future states. 4D Latent Alignment (4DLA) grounds these states through complementary visual-semantic and geometric supervision, while joint language supervision connects them to task reasoning. Experiments across benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines in both capabilities.

AI.tldr: Pros4D 在潜空间中建模动态 4D 世界，统一"观测动态理解"与"未来动态预测"两类任务，并配套 Engine（构造几何监督与配对数据）与 Bench（八类空间任务）以及 4D 潜对齐（4DLA）训练目标。
AI.motivation: 现有单目视频空间推理工作多只处理已观测动态，缺乏对观测边界之外的未来动态预测；同时依赖外部几何处理或文本描述会提升推理复杂度或丢失连续动态信息，因此需要一个既保留观测动态又可外推预测的共享内部状态。
AI.method: Pros4D-Engine 生成几何接地的监督信号并构建两类任务的配对样本；Pros4D-Bench 覆盖动态相机、动态物体、动态场景共八类空间任务评测；模型将观测动态压缩为潜观测状态，自回归滚动为潜未来状态；4D Latent Alignment 以视觉-语义与几何互补监督对齐状态，并用联合语言监督将其连接到任务推理。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，两类能力（回溯性理解与前瞻性预测）相对强基线均取得一致提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 以连续潜空间状态替代显式几何管线与文本描述是可行且有效的路线，为 VLM 提供兼顾观测理解与未来预测的统一 4D 世界建模范式；后续需关注定量增益与真实泛化证据。

title: Drone Navigation for Fast, Safe Emergency Response
comment: Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: In 2025, there was a total of 358 weather-related disasters worldwide affecting millions of people. For unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to autonomously aid these people, they need to be able to navigate around complex obstacles and reach their destinations to deliver supplies or quickly locate survivors in disaster-stricken areas. Our research addresses this need by providing a method to compute minimum-time trajectories in real time while providing guarantees of obstacle avoidance along the trajectory. Previous approaches treat the problem of computing time-optimal trajectories without considering obstacle avoidance. Our work not only includes obstacle avoidance constraints, but also improves overall mission time for navigation. We define mission time as the sum of planning time and traversal time. In time-sensitive emergencies, rapid trajectory planning is essential to ensure the prompt delivery of critical medical aid. As such, we consider the combined planning and traversal time as the key metric for how quickly the vehicle can reach a survivor. We show a sample mission in Fig. 1 where the quadrotor navigates through multiple canyon-like obstacles to deliver aid; during most of this trajectory, it is applying the near-maximum thrust.

AI.tldr: 提出一种实时计算最小时间无人机轨迹的方法，在保证避障的前提下将规划时间与飞行时间之和（总任务时间）作为核心指标进行优化。
AI.motivation: 灾害场景下UAV需自主避障并尽快抵达受灾者处以投送物资或搜救；已有时间最优轨迹工作多忽略避障约束，且较少关注"规划时间+飞行时间"的整体任务时延。
AI.method: 摘要未给出具体算法细节，仅说明在轨迹优化中显式引入避障约束，并针对最小时间目标做实时求解（推测为带约束的轨迹优化/TOPP类方法），使得轨迹大部分时段接近最大推力。
AI.result: 给出穿越多重峡谷状障碍的示例任务，飞行器沿轨迹大部分时间接近最大推力，据称在保证避障的同时降低了整体任务时间；摘要未见定量指标或实机统计。
AI.conclusion: 将避障纳入时间最优轨迹规划并以规划+执行总时延为优化目标，是实现应急场景快速自主导航的可行方向；但摘要缺乏算法细节与充分实验证据。

title: The Flip Test: Video World Models Fail to Learn the World State
summary: Video world models promise to predict the future of a scene from its present. Do current models keep this promise? We probe this question counterfactually. When a small change to the present flips the future, such as a box resting a few millimeters before or past a table edge, a model that tracks the state of the world must flip its prediction too. We build FlipTest, a three-level hierarchy of increasingly strict tests over 1,680 initial frames from 10 simulated and 15 real-world tasks. At the base, visual minimal pairs, two nearly identical frames whose true futures differ, test whether predictions change across the boundary; matched controls go further and test whether they change only where the future does; and dense sweeps, the strictest level, locate exactly where they change. All 11 video world models we evaluate fall short. The best averages 18.3% pair accuracy over real and simulated scenes, below the 25% of random guessing. Models flip as often on steps that leave the future unchanged as on steps that change it, and their response stays flat across the sweeps. On the same frames, a vision-language model is selective and traces a near S-shaped curve near the boundary, and a coding agent that measures the image comes close to the true boundary. This implies that the deciding information is in the frame, and video models just miss it. We therefore urge the community to rethink world modeling as pure video prediction. Next-frame prediction must do more than draw plausible pixels; it must also identify the causal states that control future dynamics.

AI.tldr: FlipTest提出反事实三级测试框架（视觉最小对、匹配对照、密集扫描），在1680个初始帧（10仿真+15真实任务）上评估11个视频世界模型，最好仅18.3%配对准确率，低于随机猜测的25%，揭示视频世界模型未真正追踪世界状态。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型声称能从当前状态预测场景未来，但其是否真正建模因果状态而非仅生成合理像素尚不明确。需用反事实探针检验模型预测是否随未来真实变化而翻转。
AI.method: 构建FlipTest：基于10个仿真任务与15个真实任务共1680帧，设计三级递进的严格测试——(1)视觉最小对：两张近乎相同但真实未来不同的帧，检验预测是否跨越边界变化；(2)匹配对照：检验预测是否仅在应变化处变化；(3)密集扫描：精确定位变化边界。对比11个视频世界模型，并以VLM与测量图像的coding agent作为参照。
AI.result: 所有11个视频世界模型均未通过。最佳模型在真实与仿真场景上平均配对准确率18.3%，低于25%的随机猜测。模型在未改变未来的步长与改变未来的步长上翻转频率相同，且对密集扫描响应平坦。同一批帧上，VLM表现出选择性并在边界附近呈现近S形曲线，测量图像的coding agent接近真实边界。
AI.conclusion: 决定性信息已在帧中存在，视频模型只是未能捕获。作者呼吁社区反思将世界建模等同于纯视频预测，下一帧预测必须识别控制未来动力学的因果状态，而非仅生成合理像素。

title: When Does Reusing Layers Help Multimodal Embeddings?
summary: We ask whether a compact universal multimodal embedding models can produce better search embeddings by running the same layers again. Looped transformers add computation with nearly unchanged model size, making them an appealing alternative to a larger encoder. Their success in language-model reasoning and recent use for retrieval motivate the idea, but higher retrieval scores alone do not reveal what an extra pass contributes. We study eleven loop designs and training variants on three checkpoints of one vision-language architecture. Our protocol distinguishes whether a model uses its extra pass, whether its image states respond to the query, and whether those updates improve retrieval. We prove that an image placed before the query remains query-independent through repeated layers when information only travels forward. We then open a query-to-image path in three ways, including order-alternating recurrence, which places the query first on the next pass. Each path produces query-sensitive image states. For bidirectional attention and order alternation, freezing later visual updates does not lower accuracy. On all 78 datasets of the Massive Multimodal Embedding Benchmark version 2 (MMEB-V2), a standard added loop loses 0.46 points against its trained control; an intermediate generative stage changes the effect to +0.36. A model pretrained with recurrence gains +4.23 points over its own loop-removed control and benefits from query-conditioned image updates when answering visual questions or locating objects from text.

AI.tldr: 研究循环Transformer（同一层重复执行）能否为紧凑多模态嵌入模型带来更好的检索嵌入；作者给出一条可证的信息流结论，并用11种循环设计在3个检查点、MMEB-V2全部78个数据集上做机制+效果分析。
AI.motivation: 循环层可在几乎不增加模型尺寸的前提下增加计算，被视为大编码器的低成本替代；但其在检索上的收益来源不明，单纯的高检索分数无法说明"多跑一遍"究竟贡献了什么。
AI.method: 以同一视觉-语言架构的3个检查点为基础，比较11种循环设计与训练变体；协议区分三件事：模型是否真正使用了额外一遍、图像状态是否对查询产生响应、这些更新是否提升检索。理论证明前向信息流下"图像置于查询之前"时图像表示在重复层中保持查询无关，并给出三种打开查询→图像通路的方案（含顺序交替循环，下一遍将查询前置）；在MMEB-V2全部78个数据集上评估。
AI.result: 三种通路均能产生查询敏感的图像状态；对双向注意力和顺序交替，冻结后续视觉层更新不降低精度（说明增益不来自更深的视觉特征）。标准附加循环相对训练对照组在MMEB-V2上-0.46分，插入中间生成阶段变为+0.36；以循环方式预训练的模型相对其去循环对照提升+4.23分，且在视觉问答与文本定位物体任务中受益于查询条件化的图像更新。
AI.conclusion: 循环的检索收益取决于是否建立查询→图像的反馈通路，而非单纯叠加层数；因果/对照控制+冻结实验给出可解释的机制证据，可作为多模态嵌入中循环计算的设计准则。

title: PRISM: Primitive-Integrated Separable Modulation with Priority Visual Memory Queue for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
summary: Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL) recognizes unseen attribute--object pairs by recombining primitives from seen compositions. Existing methods stop sharing evidence at deployment: fixed prototypes cannot exploit unlabeled test streams, while composition-wise refinement cannot propagate corrections across pairs sharing a primitive. We introduce PRISM, an online CZSL framework that extends primitive sharing to test-time adaptation. Its Hierarchical Knowledge Accumulation Module (HiKAM) factorizes prototype migration into composition-, attribute-, and object-level residual banks. A Priority Visual Memory Queue (PVMQ), initialized by Prototype Queue Initialization (PQI), grounds text updates with bounded visual evidence. The same adaptive core supports exhaustive Full PRISM and recall-calibrated Adaptive PRISM-Lite, which selects candidate budgets from held-out ranks. Comprehensive closed- and open-world experiments on UT-Zappos, MIT-States, and C-GQA demonstrate the state of the art, with Full PRISM achieving the best open-world AUC and harmonic mean on all three benchmarks and the best closed-world results on UT-Zappos and C-GQA. Fine-grained long-tail and non-stationary primitive-block evaluations reveal gains on under-supported concepts and stable adaptation under prolonged skew. Adaptive PRISM-Lite further delivers substantial efficiency gains in the full open-world space with only a small accuracy cost. PRISM thus combines primitive-shared online adaptation, multimodal grounding, and candidate-aware inference.

AI.tldr: PRISM提出在线组合零样本学习框架，将原语级知识共享延伸到测试时自适应：HiKAM把原型迁移分解为组合/属性/物体三级残差库，PVMQ用有界视觉证据锚定文本更新，并给出Full与Lite两种推理模式。
AI.motivation: 现有CZSL方法在部署阶段停止共享证据：固定原型无法利用无标注测试流，组合级精化也无法把修正传播到共享同一原语的配对。
AI.method: PRISM在线CZSL框架。HiKAM将原型迁移分解为组合级、属性级、物体级残差库；Priority Visual Memory Queue（PVMQ）经Prototype Queue Initialization（PQI）初始化，以有界视觉证据接地文本更新；同一自适应核心支持穷举式Full PRISM与按留出排名校准候选预算的Adaptive PRISM-Lite。
AI.result: 在UT-Zappos、MIT-States、C-GQA的闭世界与开世界实验中达到SOTA：Full PRISM在三项基准上取得最佳开世界AUC与调和平均，在UT-Zappos与C-GQA上取得最佳闭世界结果；长尾与非平稳原语块评测显示欠支持概念提升与持续偏移下的稳定自适应；PRISM-Lite在完整开世界空间大幅提效且精度损失很小。
AI.conclusion: PRISM将原语共享的在线自适应、多模态接地与候选感知推理统一起来，验证了测试时原语级证据传播对组合泛化的价值。

title: Beyond Vehicle-Centric Data: Scaling Autonomous Driving through Roadside-to-Vehicle Generation
summary: Training autonomous driving models requires large and diverse datasets, collected primarily by vehicles. Scaling them entails investment in fleet operation, data processing and annotation. Road infrastructure records traffic and multi-vehicle interactions, yet the viewpoint gap between roadside and onboard sensors limits its direct use for training. Here we introduce AnyR2V, a framework that transforms multimodal roadside observations into seven-camera surround-view videos for different vehicle perspectives. It aggregates sequential observations into a shared scene representation of geometry and road-user motion, then renders appearance, depth and layout conditions along target-vehicle trajectories. Supervised by spatiotemporally aligned roadside-vehicle pairs, AnyR2V generates surround-view videos guided by scene structure and road-user motion. Existing roadside 3D bounding boxes are transformed into target-vehicle coordinates and paired with generated images, allowing one traffic recording and its annotations to yield training data from multiple vehicle perspectives. We construct R2V360, a dataset of 89 real traffic sequences at an urban intersection, with aligned multimodal roadside data and onboard surround-view videos. AnyR2V outperforms six scene reconstruction methods in image fidelity and in depth and semantic agreement between generated and real onboard images. We further evaluate generated videos along other vehicles' trajectories by adding them to real training data. Adding generated frames equal to 50% of the original real training frame count improves mean average precision (mAP) by 3.3-3.4 AP-points across three 3D object detectors on the real onboard test set, relative to real-data-only baselines. These results demonstrate that roadside traffic records can provide training data from multiple vehicle perspectives, offering a new data source for autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: AnyR2V 将路侧多模态观测转化为目标车辆视角的七相机环视视频，用于扩充自动驾驶训练数据。
AI.motivation: 车端数据采集成本高（车队运营、标注、处理），而路侧基础设施已有大量交通与多车交互记录，但路侧视角与车端视角存在视点鸿沟，难以直接用于训练。
AI.method: 先聚合序列观测为共享场景表示（几何+道路使用者运动），沿目标车辆轨迹渲染外观、深度、布局条件；以时空对齐的路侧-车端配对数据监督，生成受场景结构与交通参与者运动引导的环视视频；将路侧3D框变换至目标车坐标并与生成图像配对，实现单次记录多视角复用。构建 R2V360（城市路口89段真实交通序列，含对齐多模态路侧数据与车端环视视频）。
AI.result: 图像保真度及生成-真实图像的深度与语义一致性优于6种场景重建方法；将生成帧按真实训练帧数50%加入真实数据，在真实车端测试集上使三种3D检测器的mAP提升3.3–3.4 AP。
AI.conclusion: 路侧交通记录可提供多车辆视角的训练数据，构成自动驾驶的新数据来源；但同时本路线依赖高质量路侧标定与定位对齐，跨路口泛化与生成伪影对下游任务的影响仍需进一步验证。

title: AGPF: Dynamic Source Selection for Feature Pyramid Fusion
summary: Feature pyramids provide dense predictors with features at several spatial resolutions. However, it remains largely unexplored which pyramid levels each output location should aggregate information from. We investigate this question by allowing each output location to attend to features from every pyramid level and measuring how attention is distributed across scales. Surprisingly, locations on the finest output grid allocate approximately 75\% of their attention to features two levels coarser, rather than to the current or adjacent levels. Even on the same output grid, the balance shifts toward coarser features as object size increases. These observations motivate Asymmetric Global Pyramid Fusion (AGPF), a neck that preserves the original output grids while allowing each location to dynamically select its contextual sources across scales. Each location interacts with a multiscale memory whose features are aligned in image coordinates, enabling flexible cross-scale aggregation without altering prediction resolutions. Compared with FPN, AGPF improves all 19 object detection and all seven instance segmentation configurations evaluated on COCO. A single fusion block improves Cascade Mask R-CNN by 1.7 box AP and 2.3 mask AP, and the gains consistently transfer to semantic and panoptic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出非对称全局金字塔融合(AGPF)：让每个输出位置通过多尺度记忆在图像坐标对齐下动态选择跨尺度上下文，发现细网格位置约75%注意力分配给粗两级特征。
AI.motivation: 特征金字塔各输出位置该从哪些层级聚合信息尚缺乏系统研究；作者想量化跨尺度注意力分布以指导neck设计。
AI.method: 先做观测实验：允许每个输出位置对全部金字塔层级做注意力并统计分布；再提出AGPF neck，保持原输出网格分辨率不变，每个位置与图像坐标对齐的多尺度记忆交互，实现灵活的跨尺度聚合，单融合块即可插入FPN式结构。
AI.result: COCO上19种目标检测与7种实例分割配置全部优于FPN；单个融合块使Cascade Mask R-CNN提升1.7 box AP与2.3 mask AP，并在语义分割与全景分割上迁移有效。
AI.conclusion: 跨尺度注意力呈现非对称偏向粗层级的规律；按此设计的AGPF作为通用neck替换FPN可稳定提升密集预测任务，且不改变预测分辨率。

title: Passable for Whom? Few-Shot Personal Calibration of Sidewalk Accessibility Perception
summary: Whether a sidewalk is passable depends on who is trying to pass: people who use the same mobility aid disagree about the same image, so one label per scene, or per aid, is wrong for many of them. We introduce few-shot personal accessibility perception: from K answers of a person never seen before, predict their judgment of sidewalk scenes never seen before. PassCal separates a shared description of the scene from the person's interpretation of it. The description comes from the internal state of a frozen vision-language model (VLM) and from barrier type, severity and context properties predicted by a detector trained on 14.9k public audits; the interpretation, a calibration of the person's response style and a weighting of the properties, is fit from their answers. On 8,883 judgments in which each of 135 verified mobility-aid users rated the same 50 sidewalk scenes, with people and scenes both held out, eight answers lower the Brier score from 0.550 to 0.479. The same VLM prompted with those answers reaches 0.562, and the same calibration without the scene 0.521. Conformal risk control turns predictions into passable, blocked or "depends on you" statements with a bounded expected rate of wrong statements over people; at 5%, eight answers raise the share of decisive scenes from 27% to 42%. Audit-supervised properties improve all sixteen vision and VLM encoders we test and outperform attributes from a sidewalk navigation VLM.

AI.tldr: 提出 few-shot personal accessibility perception 任务与 PassCal 方法：将人行道场景的共享描述（冻结 VLM 内部状态 + 审计数据训练的障碍类型/严重度/情境检测器）与个人解释（响应风格校准 + 属性加权）解耦，用少量个人回答拟合个性化判定，并用 conformal risk control 给出 person-level 风险受控的三分类输出。
AI.motivation: 同一无障碍辅助具（如轮椅、助行器）使用者对同张人行道图像的可通行判断并不一致，单场景或单辅助具标签对许多人都是错的，需要建模个体差异的个性化可通行性感知。
AI.method: 任务设定为 few-shot personal accessibility perception：用未见过的用户 K 个回答预测其对未见场景的判断。PassCal 将判断分解为共享场景描述（冻结 VLM 内部特征 + 在 14.9k 公开审计数据上训练的检测器预测的障碍类型、严重度、上下文属性）与个人解释（响应风格校准与属性权重，由个人回答拟合）。最后用 conformal risk control 将预测转为 passable/blocked/"depends on you" 三态，控制跨人群错误陈述的期望比例。
AI.result: 在 135 名经核验的移动辅助具使用者对相同 50 个场景的 8,883 条判断上（人与场景双留出），8 个回答将 Brier 分数由 0.550 降至 0.479；直接用同样回答提示同一 VLM 为 0.562，去掉场景的同类校准为 0.521。5% 风险水平下，8 个回答将可判定场景占比从 27% 提升至 42%。审计监督的属性使测试的全部 16 种视觉/VLM 编码器均有提升，并优于人行道导航 VLM 的属性。
AI.conclusion: 个性化可通行性可通过"共享描述 + 个体解释"的解耦实现高效少样本建模，配合保形风险控制可给出可信三态输出；审计监督属性具通用增益。

title: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
comment: Code: this https URL , Website: this https URL
summary: Driving world models usually generate videos from six pinhole cameras with separate optical centres and small overlaps, and must learn to keep these views consistent. We present PanDWM, which stitches them into one $360^\circ$ panoramic band. Camera boundaries then fall inside one image, so keeping the views consistent means keeping the image continuous, and each pixel still records its camera ray. Conditioned on layouts, a causal student generates the band window by window in four steps; it is distilled from a causal teacher and trained on its own rollouts. A feed-forward decoder lifts each frame along these rays into 3D Gaussians, and static Gaussians from neighbouring frames complete them into 4D scenes. On nuScenes, scored in one stitched $360^\circ$ view, PanDWM has lower FID and FVD than the multi-camera baselines at $8$-$46\times$ their speed, and keeps its 50-step teacher's FID while lowering FVD by 22-25%.

AI.tldr: PanDWM将六路环视相机拼接为单条360°全景带，把跨视角一致性转化为单图连续性，用因果蒸馏学生模型四步逐窗生成，经前馈解码器沿相机射线提升为3D高斯并补全为4D场景。
AI.motivation: 驾驶世界模型通常基于六个光心独立、重叠很小的针孔相机生成视频，需额外学习跨视角一致性，建模困难且推理慢。
AI.method: 将六相机拼接为360°全景带，使相机边界落在同一图像内；条件于layout，因果学生模型以四步逐窗生成该带，由因果教师蒸馏并在自身rollout上训练；前馈解码器将每帧沿像素相机射线提升为3D高斯，并利用相邻帧静态高斯补全为4D场景。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上以单一拼接360°视角评测，PanDWM的FID与FVD均优于多相机基线，速度为其8–46倍；保持50步教师的FID水平，同时FVD降低22–25%。
AI.conclusion: 全景带表示把多视角一致性问题简化为图像连续性，配合因果蒸馏与前馈高斯解码，实现高保真、高速度的驾驶世界模型与4D场景生成。

title: Illusion of Explainability: A Sanity Check for Spectral Band Attribution in Satellite Time-Series Crop Classification
comment: Accepted at the 4th Computer Vision for Earth Observation (CV4EO) Workshop at WACV 2027
summary: Attribution methods are commonly validated through convergence across methods and consistency with domain knowledge, yet neither criterion establishes whether identified features are necessary for a task. This limitation is particularly relevant in multispectral remote sensing, where overlapping spectral information makes individual bands potentially substitutable. We investigate this gap in crop-type classification using GradientSHAP, Shapley sampling, and Occlusion on a U-TAE segmentation model trained on Sentinel-2 time series from the PASTIS benchmark. All three methods identify vegetation-sensitive spectral regions consistent with domain knowledge, while Shapley and Occlusion exhibit strong ordering sensitivity in deletion and insertion tests. However, these properties do not reliably predict retraining performance. Aggregate attribution consensus masks substantial per-class disagreement, with pairwise mean Spearman correlations ranging from 0.09 to 0.79. Models retrained from scratch using the five lowest-ranked bands perform comparably to or better than those using the five highest-ranked bands. Furthermore, attribution rankings from an independently trained model with identical configuration and seed identify a different top-five subset that yields better retraining performance. Analysis of all 252 five-band subsets reveals consistently low effective dimensionality (1.35 to 2.62), suggesting substantial spectral redundancy. These findings demonstrate that plausible and apparently faithful attribution rankings do not necessarily identify task-relevant bands for improved retrained performance, highlighting the limitations of band-level feature attribution in spectrally redundant input spaces.

AI.tldr: 该文检验多光谱遥感作物分类任务中各波段级归因方法能否识别真正必要的波段，发现三类归因虽符合领域知识与保真度测试，却无法预测重训练性能。
AI.motivation: 归因方法通常仅通过跨方法收敛性与领域知识一致性来验证，二者都无法证明被识别特征对任务是否必要；多光谱遥感中波段间信息重叠、可替代性强，使这一问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 在 PASTIS 基准的 Sentinel-2 时序数据上训练 U-TAE 分割模型，使用 GradientSHAP、Shapley 采样与 Occlusion 三种归因方法，并做删除/插入保真度测试、按归因排序选取前五/后五波段从头重训练、以及全部 252 个五波段子集的有效维度分析。
AI.result: 三种方法均定位出植被敏感谱段且与领域知识一致，Shapley 与 Occlusion 在删除/插入测试中表现出强排序敏感性；但逐类归因分歧显著（两两平均 Spearman 相关 0.09–0.79）。使用归因排名最低的五个波段重训练的模型，表现不逊于甚至优于使用最高五波段者；同配置同种子的独立模型给出不同的前五波段子集且重训练效果更好。252 个五波段子集的有效维度仅 1.35–2.62。
AI.conclusion: 看似合理且"忠实"的归因排序并不必然指向对重训练性能有效的任务相关波段，揭示了在光谱冗余输入空间中波段级特征归因的根本局限。

title: EasyNav: A Modular Architecture for Real-Time Navigation Across Heterogeneous Robot Environments
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Most robot navigation stacks implicitly bind mapping, localization, planning, and control to specific representations and data flows, yielding architectures hard to extend, compare experimentally, or reason about end-to-end timing. This is critical in heterogeneous scenarios, where multiple spatial representations, sensing modalities, and coordinate frames coexist and evolve at different rates. This paper presents a navigation architecture centered on an explicit, shared navigation state that serves as the sole interaction interface between modular components. Constraining mapping, localization, planning, and control to operate over this shared state enables interchangeable, representation-agnostic pipelines under explicit compatibility and timing contracts. We realize this architecture as EasyNav, an open source ROS 2 framework, and validate it through real-robot experiments, including indoor navigation with laser sensing and large-scale indoor-outdoor navigation with GPS and 3D LiDAR across multi-level routes. Compared with Nav2 under matched conditions, EasyNav reduces reaction latency from 377 to 33 ms indoors and from 71 to 8 ms outdoors, while also using less CPU and memory.

AI.tldr: 提出以显式共享导航状态为唯一交互接口的模块化导航架构,并实现为开源 ROS 2 框架 EasyNav,在真实机器人室内(激光)与大范围室内外(GPS+3D LiDAR,多层路线)实验中验证,较 Nav2 显著降低反应延迟与计算资源占用。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人导航栈将建图、定位、规划、控制隐式绑定到特定表示与数据流,导致架构难以扩展、难以实验对比、难以端到端推理时序;在异构场景(多空间表示、多传感模态、多坐标系共存且速率各异)下尤为关键。
AI.method: 设计以显式共享导航状态为中心的架构,将建图/定位/规划/控制统一约束在该共享状态上,使管线可互换且与表示无关,并通过显式的兼容性与时序契约约束模块间协作;将其实现为开源 ROS 2 框架 EasyNav,在真实机器人上开展室内激光导航与 GPS+3D LiDAR 的大规模室内外多层路线导航实验。
AI.result: 与 Nav2 在匹配条件下对比,室内反应延迟由 377 ms 降至 33 ms,室外由 71 ms 降至 8 ms,同时 CPU 与内存占用更低。
AI.conclusion: 以共享导航状态为唯一交互界面的模块化架构能够有效解耦表示与数据流,提升可扩展性与时序可控性,并在真实异构场景中取得更好的实时性与资源效率;框架开源,便于复现与对比研究。

title: HIVE-ECIA: Identity-Aware Historical Evidence Acquisition for Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Panoramic multi-object tracking (MOT) requires reliable identity association across a 360° field of view, yet bandwidth-constrained operation forces a trade-off between low-resolution (LR) identity ambiguity and costly high-resolution (HR) transmission. We propose HIVE-ECIA, an identity-aware framework that selectively retrieves historical HR evidence to recover fragmented identities without modifying detection boxes or the underlying tracker. An ECIA Base-Guided query policy determines when additional HR evidence is warranted; HIVE ranks historical LR observations to select an informative retrieval timestamp; and ECIA Full integrates the retrieved HR crop through learned gated fusion and conservative identity safeguards. We further introduce DualPano-MOT, a real-world dual-fisheye panoramic evaluation dataset featuring controlled pedestrian interactions, panorama-seam challenges, and occlusions, with model-assisted, manually verified tracking annotations. On held-out QuadTrack sequences and zero-shot DualPano-MOT, HIVE-ECIA improves identity association across four MOT trackers without tracker-specific retraining. Across these trackers, identity switches decrease by up to 21.8% and 23.4%, while the largest IDF1 gains reach 3.81 and 6.74 percentage points, respectively. Under an offline JPEG-based acquisition model, our framework reduces encoded data volume by 89.2% and 79.3% relative to continuous Full-HR acquisition.

AI.tldr: HIVE-ECIA是先验驱动的全景多目标跟踪身份恢复框架：通过ECIA Base-Guided查询策略判断何时需要高分辨率证据，HIVE对历史低分辨率观测排序选取检索时刻，ECIA Full以门控融合+保守身份保护机制整合HR裁剪；并提出双鱼眼全景数据集DualPano-MOT。
AI.motivation: 全景MOT中，带宽受限使低分辨率观测存在身份歧义，而持续传输高分辨率代价高昂，因此需在"LR身份模糊"与"HR带宽开销"间折中；目标是恢复因低分辨率导致的身份碎片化，且不改动检测框或底层跟踪器。
AI.method: (1) ECIA Base-Guided查询策略决定何时触发额外HR证据检索；(2) HIVE对历史LR观测排序选择信息量最大的检索时间戳，实现历史HR证据选择性回取；(3) ECIA Full用学习式门控融合整合HR裁剪，并加入保守身份保护机制；(4) 增广DualPano-MOT数据集，含受控行人交互、全景接缝挑战与遮挡，标注为模型辅助+人工校验。
AI.result: 在留出QuadTrack序列与零样本DualPano-MOT上，无需针对跟踪器重训练即可在4种MOT跟踪器上提升身份关联：ID switches最多下降21.8%与23.4%，最大IDF1提升3.81与6.74个百分点；离线JPEG采集模型下编码数据量相较连续Full-HR采集降低89.2%与79.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以"条件触发+历史排序检索+门控融合"的方式实现按需HR证据获取，可在不修改检测/跟踪主体的前提下即插即用地降低身份切换并显著节省带宽，为带宽受限全景MOT提供实用范式；局限在于评估以离线JPEG模型近似带宽，未涉及闭环实时部署与多相机规模化。

title: Remember, Replay, Adapt: Learning from Past Experience in Online Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Existing feedback-based methods for online vision-and-language navigation (VLN) primarily learn from current episode outcomes, leaving previously acquired feedback underutilized. Inspired by human episodic memory, we propose R2A, an online VLN adaptation framework that continually reuses successful and failed navigation experiences for policy learning. Specifically, Success-Failure Memory (SFM) retains successful and failed navigation episodes with acquired feedback and retrieves task-relevant experiences based on incoming instructions, enabling historical feedback to guide subsequent navigation. Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA) learns from these experiences by reinforcing successful trajectories and suppressing failed ones relative to a frozen pretrained policy, while regularizing behavioral drift. Together, these modules enable continual feedback reuse and stable policy adaptation without source-domain data or expert supervision. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks, REVERIE, R2R, and R2R-CE, and five navigation backbones demonstrate consistent performance gains. On the REVERIE validation unseen split, R2A improves DUET's SR from 46.98% to 69.84% and SPL from 33.73% to 50.98%.

AI.tldr: 提出R2A在线VLN自适应框架：用成功-失败记忆(SFM)存储并检索历史导航经验，用先验锚定自适应(PAA)相对冻结预训练策略强化成功轨迹、抑制失败轨迹并约束行为漂移，实现无需源域数据与专家监督的持续反馈复用。
AI.motivation: 现有基于反馈的在线VLN方法仅从当前episode结果学习，已获得的历史反馈被大量浪费；受人类情景记忆启发，希望像人一样反复调用过去成功与失败的经验来改进策略。
AI.method: R2A包含两模块：(1) Success-Failure Memory (SFM) 保留带反馈的成功/失败导航片段，并依据当前指令检索任务相关经验；(2) Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA) 以冻结的预训练策略为锚，对检索到的成功轨迹施加强化、对失败轨迹施加抑制，并加入行为漂移正则，从而在无源域数据、无专家监督下稳定地持续自适应。
AI.result: 在REVERIE、R2R、R2R-CE三个基准和五种导航backbone上均取得一致提升；REVERIE val unseen上使DUET的SR由46.98%提升至69.84%，SPL由33.73%提升至50.98%。
AI.conclusion: 经验回放式记忆+锚定式自适应的组合能有效复用历史反馈，带来稳定的在线VLN性能提升，且方法通用性较好（跨基准、跨backbone）、部署约束低（不需源域数据与专家标注）。

title: DiffWAM: Learning World Action Model from Consecutive Visual Difference
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as an important paradigm in robot learning, jointly predicting future scene states and robot actions from current observations and instructions. However, future states entangle task-related changes with large amounts of task-irrelevant content, such as static backgrounds, which weakens the model's ability to capture changes relevant to task execution. To address this, we propose Difference World Action Model (DiffWAM), a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that enhances world representations by jointly learning future-state prediction and consecutive visual difference prediction. We define consecutive visual differences as differences between the latent representations of consecutive observations, providing an explicit learning signal for temporal variation. The framework comprises a World Expert for future frame prediction, an Action Expert for action generation, and a Diff Expert for predicting these latent differences along the trajectory. A structured unidirectional attention mask conditions the Diff, World, and Action Experts solely on the current-frame representation while blocking attention between experts. This design allows both the World and Diff Experts to be removed during inference, introducing no additional inference overhead. DiffWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks and substantially improves over FastWAM on real-world manipulation tasks. Specifically, it attains average success rates of 98.8%, 92.65%, and 88.3%, outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline (i.e., FastWAM) by 1.75, 1.55, and 15.0 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: DiffWAM 提出一个 MoE 框架，联合学习未来帧预测与连续视觉差分（相邻观测隐表示的差）预测，用结构化单向注意力掩码让 Diff/World/Action 三个专家仅以当前帧表示为条件，推理时可删掉 World 与 Diff 专家而零额外开销。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Model 预测的未来状态混杂大量任务无关内容（如静态背景），削弱了对任务执行相关变化的建模能力；作者希望引入显式的时间变化学习信号来强化世界表示。
AI.method: 定义"连续视觉差分"为相邻观测隐表示之差，作为时间变化的显式监督。框架由 World Expert（未来帧预测）、Action Expert（动作生成）、Diff Expert（轨迹上隐差分预测）组成，采用结构化单向注意力掩码：三者仅关注当前帧表示，专家之间互相屏蔽。推理阶段可移除 World 和 Diff 专家。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得 SOTA；真实世界操作任务上较 FastWAM 提升 15.0 个百分点。平均成功率分别为 98.8%、92.65%、88.3%，比 FastWAM 高 1.75、1.55、15.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以隐空间差分预测作为辅助专家、配合单向注意力隔离，可在不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升世界动作模型的表示质量与真实机器人操作成功率，是 WAM 方向有效且易部署的改进。

title: HEmIF-Bench: Benchmarking H&E-to-mIF Models BeyondVirtual-StainFidelity
summary: Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-to-multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) generators predict spatial protein expression from routine histology, yet pixel-level marker reconstruction does not establish downstream utility. We present HEmIF-Bench, evaluating five frozen generators across eight datasets spanning molecular, cellular, tissue, and patient scales. HEmIF-Bench decouples internal encoder features from generated outputs, benchmarking both against the pathology foundation reference UNI2. Mirroring the clinical workflow where pathologists rely on mIF to define cell phenotypes, delineate tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) and germinal centers (GCs), and stratify patient risk, we evaluate external CD3 recovery, single-cell classification, dense nuclear segmentation, TLS/GC segmentation, and patient survival prediction. Across the benchmark, foundation-model-based MIPHEI-ViT leads among the generators, while non-foundation models show task-specific strengths. Comparing the two routes reveals that internal encoder features generally outperform generated outputs, and larger output marker panels do not guarantee stronger downstream utility across datasets. Moreover, neither internal encoder features nor generated outputs consistently surpass frozen UNI2. These findings show that pixel-level stain fidelity does not equate to downstream utility, and that generators trained at current paired-data scales have yet to surpass large-scale pure-H&E foundation models. With the expansion of paired translation cohorts and the advancement of foundation-based generative architectures, HEmIF-Bench establishes a definitive benchmark for tracking when H&E-to-mIF generation crosses the threshold to deliver genuine value beyond routine histology for tumor microenvironment analysis and precision oncology.

AI.tldr: HEmIF-Bench 提出一个从 H&E 到多重免疫荧光(mIF)生成的评测基准：在 8 个数据集、分子/细胞/组织/患者四个尺度上评测 5 个冻结生成器，并将内部编码器特征与生成输出解耦，分别与病理基础模型 UNI2 对照，覆盖 CD3 恢复、单细胞分类、核分割、TLS/GC 分割、生存预测等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 现有 H&E→mIF 生成器只追求像素级标记重建，但像素级染色保真并不能证明下游临床/生物学效用；缺乏统一基准来回答"生成输出是否真的优于常规 H&E 表征"这一关键问题。
AI.method: 构建 HEmIF-Bench：冻结 5 个生成器，跨 8 个数据集，在分子、细胞、组织、患者四个层级评测；将生成器内部编码器特征与生成图像解耦评测，并以病理基础模型 UNI2 作为参照；下游任务包括外部 CD3 恢复、单细胞表型分类、稠密核分割、TLS/生发中心(GC)分割与患者生存预测。
AI.result: 基于基础模型的 MIPHEI-ViT 在生成器中整体最优，非基础模型展现任务特定优势；内部编码器特征普遍优于生成输出；更大的输出标记面板并不保证更强下游效用；内部特征与生成输出均未能稳定超越冻结的 UNI2。
AI.conclusion: 像素级染色保真 ≠ 下游效用；在当前配对数据规模下训练的生成器尚未超过大规模纯 H&E 基础模型。该基准为追踪 H&E→mIF 生成何时真正超越常规组织学、服务肿瘤微环境分析与精准肿瘤学提供统一评测框架。

title: AgenticJevNav: Agentic Object Search and Navigation via Event-Driven Verification
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: this http URL
summary: Agentic navigation must maintain goals and adapt actions from incomplete evidence despite execution failures and delayed inference. We present AgenticJevNav, which links goal-directed planning, evidence memory, event-triggered verification, and bounded execution. The Agent plans from RGB, odometry, memory, and feedback, retaining goal ownership while authorizing a bounded action set. Jev reviews structured evidence after blocked/failed execution or two consecutive low-progress segments. Version, freshness, and once-only checks govern decision application. A single executor and independent RGB reflex constrain motion. Goal revisions revoke obsolete requests and actions before replanning. Across six simulated task families, AgenticJevNav achieves 73.33% SR over 60 trials, 21.67 percentage points above the next-best Agent-only aggregate control under differing historical protocols. A real-world GENISOM L1 quadruped deployment achieves 70.0% success over 30 trials, including bounded search reporting. Together, the simulation and physical-robot results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed architecture, while remaining failures highlight opportunities to improve grounding, approach planning, and runtime.

AI.tldr: AgenticJevNav：由Agent负责目标规划、独立Jev证据评审器在执行受阻/失败或连续两段低进展时触发验证，结合版本/新鲜度/一次性检查、单执行器+RGB反射与目标修订撤销机制；仿真6类任务60次试验SR 73.33%，真实GENISOM L1四足30次试验70.0%。
AI.motivation: 具身导航需在证据不完整、执行失败与推理延迟条件下保持目标一致性并自适应行动，需要把目标主导权、证据记忆与有界执行耦合为可控架构。
AI.method: 分层Agentic架构：Agent基于RGB、里程计、记忆与反馈规划并授权有界动作集，保留目标所有权；Jev评审器在阻塞/失败或连续两段低进展时审查结构化证据；用版本号、新鲜度与once-only校验保证决策只应用一次、过期请求与动作在重规划前被撤销；单一执行器加独立RGB反射约束运动。
AI.result: 仿真六类任务族60试验平均成功率73.33%，较次优「仅Agent」聚合对照高21.67个百分点（历史协议有差异）；真实GENISOM L1四足机器人30次试验成功率70.0%，含有界搜索报告。
AI.conclusion: 仿真与实机结果共同验证架构有效性；剩余失败指向grounding、接近规划与运行时长方面的改进空间。基线协议不一致使提升幅度需谨慎解读。

title: Lao Siji: Adapting openpilot to Closed-Loop End-to-End Driving in Neural Reconstruction
summary: We present Lao Siji, an end-to-end driving policy that ranks third in the 2026 NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Driving Challenge, ahead of most entries built on foundation models. Instead of training from scratch on a general-purpose vision backbone, we adapt openpilot, an open-source L2 production model. We freeze its vision encoder and fine-tune the policy layers with an ego-state adapter and a route memory. On closed-loop rollouts in neural-reconstructed scenes, we supervise the policy with a privileged map teacher for lateral self-correction and a body-extent loss for road and obstacle clearance, while distilling the base model's remaining outputs to retain car following. Ablations show that self-correction samples carry the gain, while the clearance loss substitutes for them where no teacher exists. Longitudinal safety instead rests on the base model's lead-vehicle estimate behind a rule-based speed layer. Longer training, imitating human logs, and human-log speed targets yield either no measurable gain or adverse effects. Without further training, Lao Siji also places among the leaders on HUGSIM and Odyssey. The final training takes only one GPU-hour and shifts the weights by 3.9% from the shipped model. Code will be released after review.

AI.tldr: Lao Siji adapts openpilot (frozen vision encoder + fine-tuned policy layers, ego-state adapter, route memory) with a privileged map teacher, body-extent clearance loss, and distillation to rank 3rd in a 2026 NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E driving challenge; training costs 1 GPU-hour with only 3.9% weight shift.
AI.motivation: Most challenge entries train end-to-end driving policies from scratch on general-purpose vision backbones; the authors instead ask whether a strong open-source L2 production model (openpilot) can be efficiently adapted to closed-loop neural-reconstructed simulation with minimal compute.
AI.method: Freeze openpilot's vision encoder, fine-tune policy layers with an ego-state adapter and route memory. In closed-loop rollouts in neural-reconstructed scenes, supervise with (1) a privileged map teacher for lateral self-correction, (2) a body-extent loss for road/obstacle clearance, (3) distillation of remaining base-model outputs for car following. Longitudinal safety relies on the base model's lead-vehicle estimate behind a rule-based speed layer.
AI.result: Third place in the 2026 NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Driving Challenge, ahead of most foundation-model entries; ablations show self-correction samples drive the gain and the clearance loss substitutes where no teacher exists; longer training, human-log imitation, and human-log speed targets give no gain or harm; transfers to HUGSIM and Odyssey leaderboards without extra training.
AI.conclusion: Strong pretrained driving models can be adapted with minimal compute (1 GPU-hour, 3.9% weight change), and the key signal is privileged-teacher self-correction plus geometric clearance losses rather than scale or human-log imitation.

title: Does synthetic pre-training pay off on a microcontroller? Accuracy, latency and energy across two MCUs
comment: 43 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables; supplementary tables, figures and notes as ancillary files. Analysis plan registered on OSF (doi: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/BPQGA ). Under review
summary: Rendered images are cheap to label, but a microcontroller classifier must survive 8-bit integer (INT8) quantisation and compute correctly on the chip. Five models, from MobileNetV2 at 224 px to a 61K-parameter convolutional neural network (CNN), were fine-tuned on a six-class scene dataset with and without a synthetic stage, against thresholds fixed in advance, and deployed on an ESP32-S3 and an RP2040. With full real data the stage gave no detectable gain. For the main deployable model the INT8 difference was +0.312 percentage points (pp), its interval below the +1.6 pp gain recomputed from the source study; quantisation did not detectably change it, nor did model size. With 10% of the real data the stage paid off for the CNN, by +3.438 pp on one seed and +2.715 pp over three; its cause is open. On the ESP32-S3 the main model took 152.7 ms and 16.3 mJ above idle per inference, and adding the stage changed neither beyond preset bounds. The model's INT8 outputs matched TensorFlow Lite's reference kernels exactly, but only after a memory overrun in a vendor kernel was patched. On the RP2040 the same model took 1.80 s and 27.3 mJ above idle, about twelve times slower, and the largest 96 px model exceeded the board's flash-capacity limit. Neither the RP2040 nor the host interpreter used for scoring reproduced the reference arithmetic. A synthetic stage is worth adding only when real data are scarce, and on-device INT8 outputs should be checked against reference kernels, not inferred from host scores.

AI.tldr: An ESP32-S3 and RP2040 deployment study: a synthetic rendering stage helps a small CNN only when real data are scarce (≈10%: +2.7–3.4 pp), INT8 quantisation produced no detectable change, and on-device INT8 outputs matched TFLite reference kernels only after patching a vendor kernel memory overrun.
AI.motivation: Rendered/synthetic images are cheap to label, but microcontroller classifiers must survive INT8 quantisation and actually run correctly on-chip; the claim that synthetic augmentation helps (reported ≈+1.6 pp in the source study) needs independent verification plus real on-device evidence rather than host-side accuracy scores.
AI.method: Five models (MobileNetV2 @224 px down to a 61K-parameter CNN) fine-tuned on a six-class scene dataset with/without a synthetic stage, evaluated against pre-registered thresholds; deployed on ESP32-S3 and RP2040; INT8 host scores (TFLite interpreter) compared with on-device outputs and reference kernels; latency/energy measured above idle.
AI.result: Full real data: no detectable ST gain. Main model INT8 delta +0.312 pp, interval below the +1.6 pp recomputed gain; quantisation and model size had no detectable effect. 10% real data: CNN gained +3.438 pp (one seed), +2.715 pp (three seeds). ESP32-S3: 152.7 ms, 16.3 mJ above idle; RP2040: 1.80 s, 27.3 mJ (~12×), 96 px largest model exceeded flash. RP2040 and host interpreter did not reproduce reference arithmetic.
AI.conclusion: Add a synthetic stage only when real data are scarce; verify on-device INT8 outputs against reference kernels instead of inferring correctness from host scores; vendor kernels require patching (memory overrun) before exact match.

title: From Companion to Guardian: Designing an Emergency Support System Using a Quadruped Robot for Older Adults
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA 2026)
summary: As older adults increasingly live alone, emergency support becomes an important function for home companion robots. In Australia, demand for the care and support workforce is projected to nearly double between 2020-21 and 2049-50. Service robots such as robot dogs may support older adults by combining everyday companionship with assistance when human support is not immediately available. We present the design and implementation of a domestic companion-robot system on a Unitree Go1 quadruped platform that combines companionship with emergency awareness and response. The system uses a three-stage interaction model consisting of companion, danger-awareness, and emergency modes. A rule-based escalation policy combines signs detected from visual and speech input to determine the current risk level and adjust how long the robot waits for the user to confirm safety before entering emergency mode. Additional detected signs can shorten this waiting time. Users can confirm safety, request immediate help, stop robot motion, or reset the system. We verified the implemented decision rules and escalation timing through 105 automated trials and 25 staged physical trials. Additional visual evidence shortened the waiting time, and the system entered emergency mode when the waiting time ended without confirmation.

AI.tldr: 在Unitree Go1四足平台上实现家庭陪伴机器人系统，采用"陪伴—危险感知—紧急"三阶段交互模型和基于规则的风险升级策略，视觉与语音线索可缩短安全确认等待时间。
AI.motivation: 独居老年人增多，护理人力需求预计到2049-50年近乎翻倍；机器人宠物有望兼顾日常陪伴与人类无法即时到场时的紧急支援。
AI.method: Unitree Go1四足平台上的陪伴机器人系统；三阶段交互模式（陪伴/危险感知/紧急）；规则式升级策略融合视觉与语音检测到的危险标志，动态调整进入紧急模式前的安全确认等待时长，额外线索可缩短等待；用户可确认安全、立即呼救、急停或复位。
AI.result: 105次自动化试验与25次分阶段实体试验验证了决策规则与升级时序；额外视觉证据确实缩短等待时间，等待超时未确认即进入紧急模式。
AI.conclusion: 规则化多模态风险升级机制在真实四足平台上可行，可作为陪伴与紧急响应的集成原型；但风险判定仍为人工规则，缺乏学习式感知与大样本、长期真实居家评估。

title: SAGE-VQA: A Training-Free, Self-Evolving Agentic Framework with Grounded Evidence for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) aims to combine visual information with external knowledge to answer user questions. Existing methods face two main bottlenecks: visual perception errors can propagate into hallucinations, and generalization across scenarios remains limited. To address these issues, we propose SAGE-VQA (Self-evolving Agent framework with Grounded Evidence), a training-free agentic framework that combines evidence verification with experience evolution. Our key insight is to explore an Evidence-Driven Adaptive Reasoning (EDAR) strategy. It accurately acquires and verifies question-relevant fine-grained visual information. It also extracts and refines reusable experience to support robust reasoning across tasks. Specifically, we design a Co-verified Visual Grounding module that verifies question-relevant visual information and provides grounded evidence for subsequent reasoning. We further introduce a Self-evolving Hierarchical Memory (SHM) mechanism. SHM organizes experiences into declarative and procedural memories based on their nature. These memories can be reused in subsequent reasoning and continually refined through feedback, without updating model parameters. Experimental results show that our method outperforms competing methods based on lightweight open-source vision-language models (VLMs) as well as those based on closed-source VLMs. Moreover, our method can serve as a plug-and-play reasoning framework for existing VLMs without modifying their architectures.

AI.tldr: SAGE-VQA：免训练的自进化智能体框架，通过证据驱动自适应推理（EDAR）、共验证视觉定位模块与自进化分层记忆（SHM），提升KB-VQA的视觉证据可靠性与跨任务泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有KB-VQA方法存在两大瓶颈：视觉感知误差会传导并引发幻觉；跨场景泛化能力有限。作者希望在冻结模型参数的前提下同时缓解感知错误传播与经验不可复用的问题。
AI.method: 提出SAGE-VQA，一个免训练的agentic框架。核心是证据驱动自适应推理（EDAR）策略：一方面用Co-verified Visual Grounding模块对问题相关的细粒度视觉信息进行定位与交叉验证，为后续推理提供有依据的证据；另一方面引入自进化分层记忆（SHM），将经验按性质分为陈述性记忆与程序性记忆，在后续任务中复用并通过反馈持续精炼，且无需更新模型参数。整体可作为即插即用推理框架挂载到现有VLM上。
AI.result: 在实验中优于基于轻量开源VLM以及基于闭源VLM的对比方法；且该框架可即插即用地增强现有VLM，无需修改其架构。
AI.conclusion: 以证据验证加经验进化的免训练智能体范式，能有效抑制视觉误检导致的幻觉并提升跨场景泛化，为VLM上的知识型视觉问答提供了可迁移的通用推理外挂方案。

title: Two-Stage Prompt Learning: A Unified Framework for Person ReID without Clothing Hypothesis
summary: Person re-identification (ReID) in real-world scenarios involves three clothes conditions: the same clothes (SC), changed clothes (CC), and the unknown (GEN) scenario where clothes changes are not specified. Existing methods typically train separate SC- or CC-specific models, which limits generalization across all conditions. Meanwhile, pre-trained visual-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP have shown strong generalization ability in various vision tasks, motivating recent ReID methods to incorporate textual prompts. However, to distinguish SC and CC, prior approaches rely on fixed predefined instructions, which lack learnable context embeddings in prompts and cannot effectively handle the GEN scenario. To overcome these limitations, we propose Two-Stage Prompt Learning (TSPL), a unified framework that integrates clothes-identity decoupling and scenario-aware task prompts within VLMs. In Stage 1, appearance-decomposed prompt learning disentangles clothes and identity information under frozen encoders, producing stable embeddings where clothes cues can be selectively preserved or suppressed. In Stage 2, task-aware prompt learning trains the image encoder with learnable context embeddings guided by Stage-1 representations, enabling robust adaptation across SC, CC, and GEN conditions. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks show that TSPL achieves state-of-the-art performance under all scenarios, improving mAP by up to 9.2% on LTCC (SC) and by 6.4% on VC-Clothes (GEN), respectively. The code will be released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TSPL：面向换衣行人重识别的两阶段提示学习统一框架，先在冻结编码器下做外观分解提示学习解耦衣服与身份，再用可学习上下文提示训练图像编码器，统一处理同衣(SC)、换衣(CC)与未知(GEN)场景。
AI.motivation: 现有ReID方法通常分别训练SC专用或CC专用模型，跨场景泛化差；引入CLIP等VLM的提示方法又依赖固定的预定义指令，缺乏可学习上下文嵌入，且难以覆盖未指定换衣情况的GEN场景。
AI.method: 两阶段提示学习：(1) 冻结编码器下的外观分解提示学习，将衣服线索与身份信息分离，得到可选择性保留或抑制衣服线索的稳定嵌入；(2) 任务感知提示学习，以第一阶段表示引导、用可学习上下文嵌入训练图像编码器，实现SC/CC/GEN统一适配。
AI.result: 在五个基准上全场景达到SOTA；LTCC(SC)上mAP提升最高9.2%，VC-Clothes(GEN)上提升6.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将服装-身份解耦与场景感知任务提示整合进VLM，单一统一框架可替代多模型方案，在SC、CC、GEN三种服装条件下均取得领先性能，具备较强通用性。

title: CRAFT: A Robot-Agent Harness with Scope-Aware Adaptation
summary: A robot may know how to move an object yet still need to learn where it belongs. When a person rejects a placement, the robot must decide whether the correction applies only to that situation or expresses a broader rule. We study this problem in CRAFT (Contextual Requirement Adaptation with Frozen Tools), a framework for learning local requirements without retraining robot skills. It records physical success separately from whether an action meets the requirement. Our scope ladder uses memory when an action has already been judged in a nearly identical situation. Elsewhere, it combines memory, explicit rules and a learner for requirements beyond those rules, weighting their predictions by how well they predicted earlier feedback. Controlled studies show gains over correction memory alone in utility, which rewards acceptable actions and charges for mistakes and questions. In camera-grounded robot simulations, the ladder asks fewer questions than language-model agents with persistent memory, but some of those agents take fewer wrong actions and succeed more often after requirements change. All execution failures and timeouts remain in the evaluation. These results support combining specific memories with broader rules, while leaving reliable adaptation to changing requirements unresolved. All evidence comes from simulation with generated requirements and simulated feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出 CRAFT 框架：机器人冻结技能下，通过“记忆/显式规则/学习器”三层 scope ladder 结合，学习局部放置需求，并以历史反馈预测准确度加权融合；模拟实验中在效用上优于纯纠正记忆，提问少于带持久记忆的 LLM 智能体，但部分 LLM 智能体错误动作更少、需求变化后成功率更高。
AI.motivation: 机器人会移动物体但不知其应放置何处；人类拒绝一次放置时，机器人需判断该纠正是仅适用于当前情形，还是表达了一条更普遍的规则。现有方法缺乏在不重训技能的前提下学习此类“局部需求”并处理纠正泛化范围的机制。
AI.method: CRAFT（Contextual Requirement Adaptation with Frozen Tools）框架：将物理成功与“是否满足需求”分别记录；采用 scope ladder，在近乎相同情境下优先使用记忆，否则融合记忆、显式规则与针对规则之外需求的学习器，并按各模块对既往反馈的预测表现加权；以效用指标评估（奖励可接受动作，对错误和提问计惩罚），全部执行失败与超时计入评测。
AI.result: 受控研究中效用优于仅用纠正记忆的基线；在相机输入的机器人模拟中，提问次数少于具持久记忆的语言模型智能体，但部分此类智能体错误动作更少、需求改变后成功率更高。所有证据均来自生成需求与模拟反馈的仿真。
AI.conclusion: 支持“具体记忆 + 更广规则”的组合思路，但面向需求变化的可靠自适应仍未解决；主要局限为仅在仿真中用合成需求与模拟反馈验证，缺真实机器人证据。

title: FinVision: Multimodal AI for Visualizing Financial Narratives
summary: Financial narratives contain rich information about firms' performance and business conditions. Conventional text analysis often summarizes this information into numerical representations, which may not fully preserve the dynamic structure described in the narrative. In this study, we develop FinVision, a domain-specific multimodal generative model that translates financial narratives into visual representations of contemporaneous market dynamics. Using 87,940 paired observations of Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) disclosures and stock price charts, FinVision learns the average relationship between a firm's narrative account of a fiscal year and its stock-price dynamics over the same period. Given an MD&A alone, the trained model generates a text-implied stock chart, extending financial text analysis beyond numerical representations toward text-to-visual generation. We validate FinVision in two ways. First, held-out tests show that the model generates stock-chart representations that closely resemble observed charts and outperform direct LLM prompting, general-purpose text-to-image models, and the same architecture without financial-domain adaptation. Second, we examine the economic validity of the generated representations by comparing text-implied and observed stock charts. The resulting discrepancy is systematically associated with weaker investor responses around subsequent 10-K filings and with worse subsequent market and operating outcomes. Overall, our findings show how domain-adapted multimodal generative AI can create a new visual representation of financial text and provide an additional modality for studying business communication.

AI.tldr: FinVision：将MD&A财务叙述翻译为"文本隐含股价走势图"的领域适配多模态生成模型，并检验生成图与实际图的偏差的经济含义。
AI.motivation: 传统财务文本分析将叙述压缩为数值表示，可能丢失叙述中蕴含的动态结构信息；作者希望把财务文本分析从数值化推进到"文本到视觉"生成。
AI.method: 构建87,940对MD&A披露与同期股价图表的配对数据，训练领域特定的多模态生成模型FinVision，学习"财年叙述—同期股价动态"的平均映射；推理时仅输入MD&A即生成文本隐含的股价图，并与直接LLM提示、通用文生图模型、无金融领域适配的同架构模型对比。
AI.result: 留出集上生成图与真实图高度相似，优于三类基线；文本隐含图与真实图的偏差与后续10-K披露前后投资者反应更弱、以及更差的市场与经营表现系统性相关。
AI.conclusion: 领域适配的多模态生成AI可为财务文本提供一种新的视觉表示，为商业沟通研究增加一个额外模态；偏差本身构成有经济意义的信号。

title: Multimodal AI in Healthcare: Review of Vision-Language Foundation Models for Real-World Medical Applications
summary: The emergence of foundation models has marked a transformative shift in AI, enabling robust generalization across diverse downstream tasks through putative zero-shot learning. Large Language Models and Vision Language Models have demonstrated strong capabilities in tasks such as image interpretation, report generation, and question answering by effectively learning from multimodal data-images paired with associated text often with minimal supervision. In the healthcare domain, this ability to align visual and textual information reduces the reliance on extensive manual annotations, as models can leverage existing clinical reports and imaging data to learn meaningful representations. This integration holds promise for improving diagnostic support, treatment planning, and overall patient care, even in data constrained settings. In this review, we provide a definitive taxonomy of the medical VLM landscape, tracing the evolution from early Contrastive Alignment and Generative MLLMs to the cutting edge frontiers of Dense Pixel Grounding, Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and Reasoning Incentivized (RL) architectures. We critically examine the "medical bottleneck" identifying the persistent challenges of data scarcity, the "hallucination" risks in generative diagnostics, the computational strain of 3D volumetric processing, and the lack of standardized, clinically grounded evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 一篇医学视觉语言模型(VLM)综述：提出从对比对齐、生成式MLLM到密集像素定位、稀疏MoE、推理强化学习架构的演进分类体系，并批判性分析数据稀缺、生成诊断中的"幻觉"、3D体数据处理算力与缺乏标准化临床评测等"医学瓶颈"。
AI.motivation: 基础模型与VLM在图像解读、报告生成、问答等任务上展现出强泛化能力，多模态对齐可减少对人工标注的依赖，能利用既有临床报告与影像数据学习表征，在数据受限场景下提升诊断支持与治疗规划；但该领域快速发展缺乏系统性梳理，关键瓶颈也未被统一审视。
AI.method: 综述性工作：构建医学VLM领域分类学(taxonomy)，按技术代际梳理从早期对比对齐、生成式多模态大模型，到密集像素定位(grounding)、稀疏专家混合(MoE)、推理激励型(RL)架构的演进路线，并按数据、幻觉、算力、评测四个维度做批判性分析。
AI.result: 无原创实验或定量结果；产出为分类框架与瓶颈清单，指出数据稀缺、生成诊断幻觉风险、3D体数据计算负担、缺乏标准化且具临床依据的评测指标四项持续挑战。
AI.conclusion: 医学VLM已形成清晰的技术演进谱系，但落地仍受数据、可信度、算力与评测制约，需建立临床对齐的标准化评估体系。

title: Value and Policy Calibration from Execution Feedback for Socially Compatible Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicle (AV) decisions at intersections affect the delay, braking, and motion smoothness of surrounding human-driven vehicles (HDVs). Learning socially compatible behavior requires connecting imagined interaction outcomes with feedback from executed actions. We propose a world-model reinforcement learning framework combines imagined policy improvement with direct value and policy calibration from finalized interactions, balancing AV progress with HDV interaction burden. An interaction-aware latent model supports imagination, while off-policy correction and replay updates enable observed rewards and transitions to supervise both the critic and actor. Simulation experiments at an unsignalized intersection achieve a 100% success and reductions in following-HDV acceleration variation of 65.5% and 44.0% relative to PIWM and DreamerV3, respectively. Ablations identify complementary roles for value calibration in reducing HDV burden and policy calibration in improving passage efficiency. Tests under out-of-distribution traffic shifts further show lower ego jerk and HDV acceleration variation than PIWM at comparable passage times.

AI.tldr: 提出融合"想象式策略改进"与"真实交互价值/策略校准"的世界模型强化学习框架，用交互感知潜变量模型支撑想象，并用off-policy校正与回放让实执行奖励同时监督critic与actor，实现兼顾自车通行效率与周边人类驾驶车辆（HDV）负担的交叉口决策。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆在交叉口的决策直接影响周边HDV的延迟、制动与平顺性，社会兼容行为需要把"想象交互结果"与实际执行反馈建立联系；纯想象式世界模型RL易出现模型偏差，导致对社会性指标（HDV加速度变化等）优化不足。
AI.method: 世界模型RL框架：交互感知的潜变量动力学模型用于rollout想象；值校准（value calibration）与策略校准（policy calibration）利用已结束交互的观测奖励/转移，通过off-policy correction与replay更新监督critic和actor，将想象改进与真实信号结合。
AI.result: 无信号交叉口仿真：成功率100%；跟驰HDV加速度变化相对PIWM、DreamerV3分别降低65.5%和44.0%。消融显示值校准主要降低HDV负担、策略校准主要提升通行效率。OOD交通流偏移下，在相近通行时间下自车jerk与HDV加速度变化低于PIWM。
AI.conclusion: 想象与真实校准互补的混合世界模型RL可同时提升AV通行效率与HDV交互平顺性，并对分布外交通变化具备一定鲁棒性；证据限于仿真，缺乏实车/高保真闭环部署验证。

title: CreaTrace: Video Creative Plagiarism Detection and Evidence Tracing
summary: Video creative plagiarism refers to the unauthorized reproduction of creative ideas across videos despite substantial differences in visual appearance, posing a new challenge to video copyright protection. However, existing video copy detection methods primarily focus on visual content similarity, struggling to capture abstract creative that are entangled with specific visual realizations. To address this issue, we introduce a novel task, named Video Creative Plagiarism Detection (VCPD), and propose an iterative creative evidence tracing framework, termed CreaTrace, to verify creative similarity and accurately localize the corresponding evidence segments. Specifically, we design a Multimodal Semantic Event Segmentation strategy to divide similar long videos into coherent narrative events, facilitating event-level dataset construction and retrieving similar segments. Based on these events, CreaTrace employs Coarse Creative Matching to identify candidate event pairs through narrative semantics and camera language. Then CreaTrace presents Creative Decoupling to disentangle abstract creative patterns from specific visual realizations. Meanwhile, Creative Swap Contrastive Learning is devised to enhance creative consistency through cross-realization feature swapping. Benefiting from the above designs, our CreaTrace enables accurate creative similarity detection and temporal localization, while providing interpretable evidence report. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of CreaTrace across diverse creative plagiarism scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出新任务"视频创意抄袭检测"(VCPD),并给出迭代式创意证据溯源框架 CreaTrace:多模态语义事件分割、粗粒度创意匹配、创意解耦与创意交换对比学习,实现创意相似度判定、时序证据定位与可解释报告。
AI.motivation: 视频创意抄袭指在视觉表观差异明显的情况下跨视频复现创意思路,现有视频拷贝检测只关注视觉内容相似度,难以捕捉与具体视觉实现纠缠的抽象创意。
AI.method: ①多模态语义事件分割将长视频切分为连贯叙事事件,支持事件级数据集构建与相似片段检索;②粗匹配:基于叙事语义与镜头语言选出候选事件对;③创意解耦:将抽象创意模式与具体视觉实现分离;④创意交换对比学习:跨"实现"特征交换增强创意一致性。整体为迭代式证据溯源流程。
AI.result: 在多类创意抄袭场景下的大量实验表明,框架在创意相似度检测与时序定位上有效且鲁棒,并能输出可解释的证据报告。
AI.conclusion: 面向版权保护引入创意层面的抄袭检测范式,验证了"语义事件+解耦表征"思路可提升抽象创意判别的泛化性,并可扩展到更多多模态内容审核场景。

title: Practice Is Not Free: Measuring the Embodied Cost of Reset-Free Robot Practice
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures. Code, data, logs and videos: this https URL
summary: When a robot practices without human resets, every attempt still costs wall-clock time, actuator wear, and sometimes a person's attention, yet the schedulers that decide what to practice next treat attempts as free. We present an open, low-cost testbed for measuring these costs: a self-built SO-101 arm runs two demonstration-trained ACT policies that reset each other, with a vision-based success detector and a ledger that records the time, joint travel, and human interventions of every attempt. We formulate cost-aware practice scheduling, in which task selection is rewarded by measured competence gain net of embodied cost, and specify in advance the comparison that will test it. Its first two conditions, run on hardware for 51 minutes of robot time, show that a fixed retry limit did not reduce the share of execution time lost to failures (36%, against 27% for a feasibility rule; not significant) and saved no robot time. The logs suggest why: failures showed no sign of clustering, so a retry right after a failure was as likely to succeed as any other attempt. The ledger also shows that most of the retry rule's extra human time came from cubes knocked out of reach rather than from the rule itself, and a cost-aware rule replayed on the logs recovers the sensible choice without a hand-set limit. We also report lessons from building the system, including a coverage effect in which concentrating demonstrations in a smaller workspace raised success there from 8/20 to 10/10.

AI.tldr: 自建SO-101双臂互重置测试台，量化每次自主练习的时间、关节磨损与人工干预成本，提出"净能力增益/具身成本"的成本感知练习调度，并在硬件日志上验证重试规则无效的原因。
AI.motivation: 机器人在无人重置条件下的自主练习中，每次尝试都消耗墙钟时间、执行器磨损与人力，而现有练习调度器把尝试视为零成本，缺乏可测量这些成本的开放低成本平台与评估协议。
AI.method: 搭建低成本SO-101机械臂测试台，运行两个由示教训练的ACT策略相互重置；配视觉成功检测器与"账本"记录每次尝试的耗时、关节行程与人工干预。形式化成本感知练习调度（以扣除具身成本后的能力增益为奖励），并预先规定对比实验；先跑前两个条件共51分钟机器人时间。
AI.result: 固定重试上限未降低失败占执行时间比例（36% vs 可行性规则27%，不显著），也未节省机器人时间；日志显示失败无聚集性，故失败后立即重试成功率无优势；重试规则额外人工时间主要来自方块被推出可达范围；成本感知规则在日志回放中无需人工设定上限即恢复合理选择；并报告"覆盖效应"——示教集中于更小工作区使该区成功率由8/20提升至10/10。
AI.conclusion: 将自主练习视为有成本序贯决策问题的初步实证；主要贡献是可测量的开放测试台、成本账本与预注册评估协议，而非性能突破；覆盖效应提示示教空间覆盖对成功率影响显著。
