title: Morphology-Decoupled Segmentation for Multiple Tunnel Defects Under Complex Environments
summary: Automated tunnel-lining inspection must segment different defect geometries: cracks are thin, elongated, and connectivity-sensitive, whereas leakage, lining falling off, and segment damage are spatially extensive and context-dependent. Existing approaches generally apply a common decoder across defect classes or introduce boundary, topology, and directional mechanisms as isolated enhancements. This paper introduces Morphology-Decoupled Segmentation (MDS), in which defect morphology becomes the organising principle for feature routing, decoding, and interaction. A supervised routing module partitions multiscale encoder features into complementary linear and areal streams. The linear stream employs Deformable Strip Attention with image-conditioned direction hypotheses to preserve crack continuity without assuming fixed horizontal or vertical orientations, while the areal stream combines Pyramid Pooling with feature-pyramid fusion to capture diffuse boundaries and regional context. The representations are coupled through gated cross-morphology attention, allowing complementary information exchange while retaining morphology-specific features. A resolution-adaptive tiling and probability-blending pipeline preserves fine defects across variable-resolution imagery. MDS achieves 81.17% mIoU on the internal validation set and improves foreground image-level recognition over a backbone-matched SegDINO model, primarily for areal defects. Controlled ablations demonstrate the complementary contributions of routing supervision and cross-stream interaction while revealing a trade-off between areal-class performance and crack specialisation. The submitted model achieved 67.55% mIoU on an organiser-controlled hidden test, and the team placed second. Selective dynamic INT8 quantisation reduced model storage by 2.83 times with negligible accuracy loss.

AI.tldr: MDS将缺陷形态学作为分割任务的组织原则：监督式路由把多尺度特征分为线性（裂缝）与面状（渗漏、剥落、管片损伤）两路，线性路用可变形条带注意力+图像条件方向假设保持裂缝连续性，面状路用金字塔池化+FPN融合捕捉弥散边界，二者经门控跨形态注意力耦合；配合分辨率自适应切片与概率融合，内部验证81.17% mIoU，隐藏测试67.55% mIoU（赛事第二），INT8量化压缩2.83倍几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 隧道衬砌缺陷几何形态差异极大：裂缝细长、方向不定、对连通性敏感；渗漏、剥落、管片损伤则空间弥散、依赖上下文。现有方法要么全类别共用同一解码器，要么把边界、拓扑、方向等机制作为孤立增强，缺乏按形态组织特征流的统一设计。
AI.method: (1) 监督式路由模块，将多尺度编码器特征划分为线性流与面状流；(2) 线性流：Deformable Strip Attention，以图像条件的方向假设替代固定水平/垂直先验，保持裂缝连续性；(3) 面状流：金字塔池化（PPM）与特征金字塔融合，捕捉弥散边界与区域上下文；(4) 门控跨形态注意力实现两流互补交互且保留各自专长特征；(5) 分辨率自适应切片+概率混合推理管线；(6) 选择性动态INT8量化用于部署。
AI.result: 内部验证集81.17% mIoU；前景图像级识别优于同骨干的SegDINO，提升主要来自面状缺陷；消融显示路由监督与跨流交互各自有互补贡献，同时揭示面状类别性能与裂缝专精之间存在权衡；官方隐藏测试67.55% mIoU，团队排名第二；选择性动态INT8量化将存储压缩2.83倍，精度损失可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 按缺陷形态解耦特征路由与解码是有效的结构化设计范式，可在一个模型中兼顾细长线状目标与弥散面状区域；跨形态交互带来增益但也存在类型间性能权衡。属工程落地导向的领域CV工作，方法可迁移性有限，但"按形态分流+门控交互+自适应切片"的思路对高分辨率细长/大面积混合目标分割有借鉴价值。

title: KneeFS-Net: A Lightweight Deep Learning Model for Knee Osteoarthritis Severity Assessment with Cross-Domain External Validation
summary: Knee osteoarthritis (OA) grading from radiographs using the Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) scale requires expertise that may be scarce. We present KneeFS-Net, a lightweight ordinal grader (0.8 million parameters; 0.33 GFLOPs) combining spatial, Fourier and state-space features with landmark-guided attention. On the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) test set, KneeFS-Net achieved a quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) of 0.863, mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.325 and 97.2% within-one-grade accuracy, comparable to models with 9-35-fold more parameters. We evaluated cross-population generalization on two Bangladeshi cohorts, a single-center hospital cohort and a multi-center teleradiology cohort. Without further training or adaptation, the OAI-trained model achieved QWK 0.803, MAE 0.339 and 98.2% within-one-grade accuracy on its hospital cohort, declining to QWK 0.656 and MAE 0.522 on multi-center teleradiology images. Self-supervised pretraining on 6,092 unlabeled radiographs followed by joint fine-tuning achieved QWK 0.823, MAE 0.329 and 99.7% within-one-grade accuracy in cross-validation. These findings demonstrate accurate, efficient KL grading and potential adaptation to new populations with limited annotation.

AI.tldr: KneeFS-Net：融合空间、傅里叶、状态空间特征与关键点引导注意力的轻量有序回归器（0.8M参数/0.33 GFLOPs），用于Kellgren-Lawrence膝骨关节炎分级。
AI.motivation: KL分级需专家阅片，而专业放射科医师在资源匮乏地区稀缺；现有高精度模型参数量大（本文模型的9–35倍），不利于部署，且跨人群泛化性未知。
AI.method: 构建轻量有序回归网络，混合空间域、傅里叶频域与状态空间（SSM）特征分支，并以解剖关键点引导的注意力进行特征加权；在OAI数据集训练，并在两个孟加拉国队列（单中心医院队列、多中心远程放射队列）上零样本评估；进一步用6,092张无标注X光片做自监督预训练后联合微调。
AI.result: OAI测试集QWK 0.863、MAE 0.325、一级内准确率97.2%，与参数量大9–35倍模型相当。零样本跨人群：医院队列QWK 0.803/MAE 0.339/98.2%；多中心远程放射队列降至QWK 0.656/MAE 0.522，显示明显域偏移。自监督预训练+联合微调后交叉验证QWK 0.823、MAE 0.329、99.7%一级内准确率。
AI.conclusion: 证明了极轻量模型即可实现准确的KL有序分级，且借助无标注影像自监督预训练可在新人群中以少量标注完成适配；但多中心真实场景下域泛化仍是主要瓶颈。

title: MoViC: Real-Time Humanoid Whole-Body Control from Monocular Video Streams
summary: Real-time whole-body imitation from monocular video requires both a robust universal tracker and high-quality real-time reconstruction. We present MoViC, a framework that uses live RGB video as a control signal for humanoid robots without wearable tracking devices. The framework combines monocular human motion reconstruction, robot retargeting, and a transformer-based behavior foundation model. The policy receives proprioceptive history, a single explicit next-step reference, and a compact frequency-domain motion representation that supplies temporal context without explicitly stacking future reference frames, which reduces the input dimension and network size. During deployment, our extrapolation method bridges the 10-Hz visual estimation with 50-Hz controller, enabling asynchronous visual processing and policy execution. Hardware experiments further demonstrate highly dynamic motion tracking and device-free teleoperation of bimanual and single-arm manipulation tasks from live monocular RGB input. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: MoViC 利用单目 RGB 视频实时驱动人形机器人全身模仿：单目人体运动重建 + 机器人重定向 + Transformer 行为基础模型策略；策略输入本体感知历史、单步显式参考与频域紧凑运动表征，并用外推法桥接 10Hz 视觉与 50Hz 控制。
AI.motivation: 现有全身模仿通常依赖可穿戴动捕设备，而单目视频实时模仿需要同时具备鲁棒的通用跟踪器与高质量实时重建；直接堆叠未来参考帧会使输入维度与网络规模过大、难以实时。
AI.method: 框架由三部分组成：单目人体运动重建、机器人重定向、基于 Transformer 的行为基础模型策略。策略以本体感知历史、单个显式下一步参考、以及频域紧凑运动表征（提供时序上下文而不堆叠未来帧）为输入；部署时采用外推方法将 10Hz 视觉估计与 50Hz 控制器对齐，实现异步视觉处理与策略执行。
AI.result: 硬件实验展示了高动态动作跟踪，以及从实时单目 RGB 输入对双臂与单臂操作任务的无设备遥操作。
AI.conclusion: 用频域运动表征替代参考帧堆叠、配合频率外推，可在无需可穿戴设备的情况下实现实时全身模仿与无设备遥操作，说明紧凑时序表征对人形机器人实时遥操作是有效路径。

title: What Matters for Cross-Modal Alignment
summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that models trained on different modalities converge toward a shared representation. Related work aligns frozen image and text encoders on natural images without paired data. We test zero-pair alignment on five datasets across four modalities: natural images, environmental audio, chest radiographs, and 3D computed tomography (CT). It succeeds only on COCO and fails on the other four. We analyze the failures and find that alignment must first locate the subspace where the modalities co-vary and then orient the mapping within it. Consistent with previous studies, medical imaging is the hardest case: its shared subspace carries the smallest fraction of the variance. When this fraction is small, alignment needs image-text pairs, and random-matrix theory predicts how many pairs are needed. These findings motivate LightAlign: a few pairs let a ridge regression between two frozen encoders locate and orient the mapping simultaneously, and a classifier fitted only on report text then predicts findings from the mapped images. On 3D CT, LightAlign surpasses models trained end to end on image-report pairs without finding-level labels: with only 200 pairs, LightAlign outperforms CT-CLIP on CT-RATE (0.754 vs. 0.733 AUROC), and with only 100 CT-RATE pairs, it does so on RAD-ChestCT, an out-of-distribution dataset from a different hospital. On CheXpert, it reaches 0.862 mean AUROC with only about 5% as many pairs as models trained on MIMIC-CXR.

AI.tldr: 本文检验"零配对"跨模态对齐（冻结编码器）在4模态5数据集上的可行性，发现仅在COCO成功；分析表明对齐需先定位共变子空间再定向映射，医学影像子空间方差占比最小故最难。据此提出LightAlign：少量配对做岭回归同时完成定位+定向，再用报告文本训练分类器。3D CT上200对即超CT-CLIP（0.754 vs 0.733 AUROC），OOD跨院数据100对即可迁移，CheXpert以约5%配对数达0.862。
AI.motivation: Platonic表示假说认为不同模态训练会收敛到共享表示，已有工作在不使用配对数据的自然图像上对齐冻结图文编码器。作者希望系统检验这一"零配对对齐"假设是否跨模态普适，并解释失败原因，从而给出何时必须用少量配对的理论判据与实用方法。
AI.method: 在自然图像、环境音频、胸片、3D CT四模态五数据集上做零配对对齐实验并对比失败模式；提出"定位共变子空间+在其内定向映射"的两步分解，并用随机矩阵理论预测所需配对数。据此设计LightAlign：用少量配对在冻结编码器间拟合岭回归，同时完成子空间定位与映射定向，再仅用报告文本训练分类器，把映射后的图像特征接入预测。
AI.result: 零配对对齐仅在COCO成功，其余四个数据集均失败；医学影像共享子空间方差占比最小、最难。LightAlign在3D CT上：200对时CT-RATE AUROC 0.754 优于端到端CT-CLIP的0.733；仅用100个CT-RATE配对即跨院OOD数据集RAD-ChestCT超越CT-CLIP；CheXpert上以约5%配对数达0.862平均AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态对齐的可行性取决于共享子空间方差占比；占比低时（尤其医学影像）零配对不可行，但其所需配对量可由随机矩阵理论刻画，少量配对+岭回归即足够，且无需发现级标签与端到端训练。

title: Glance, then Select: Evidence-Tempered Visual Token Selection for Extremely Compressed Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode a high-resolution image into thousands of visual tokens, which dominate the cost of the prefill stage. Visual token reduction removes most of these tokens, but two problems remain at extreme budgets. The vision encoder still processes every patch of the image, and the few surviving tokens often miss the small regions that hold the answer. In this paper, we propose Glance-ETD, a two-stage token reduction framework guided by a lightweight question-conditioned scorer. In the first stage, a glance encoder views the image at low resolution and re-encodes only the question-relevant regions at native resolution. In the second stage, Evidence-Tempered Diversity (ETD) selects the final tokens by combining diversity with the evidence predicted by the scorer, so that the kept tokens cover the scene and retain the answer. A single-rollout self-distillation recipe trains the MLLM with the glance encoder. With only 5% of the visual tokens, Glance-ETD retains 91.6% of the full-token performance of Qwen3.5-4B across fourteen benchmarks and outperforms the strongest prior method, LT-OPD, by 17.3 points and the same training recipe with DivPrune by 6.0. It also speeds up the time to first token on 4K images by 3.1x and generalizes to three other MLLMs and to high-resolution document benchmarks, with the largest gains on text-rich tasks.

AI.tldr: Glance-ETD：两阶段视觉token削减框架，用轻量问题条件打分器引导"低分辨率通览编码+原生分辨率相关区域重编码"，再以Evidence-Tempered Diversity选择最终token；仅5%视觉token即保留91.6%全token性能。
AI.motivation: MLLM将高分辨率图像编码为数千视觉token，主导prefill开销。极端token预算下存在两个问题：视觉编码器仍需处理全部图像块；保留下来的少量token常遗漏包含答案的小区域。
AI.method: 两阶段、由轻量问题条件打分器（question-conditioned scorer）引导的token削减：第一阶段glance encoder以低分辨率通览图像，仅将问题相关区域以原生分辨率重编码；第二阶段Evidence-Tempered Diversity（ETD）结合多样性与打分器预测的证据进行最终token选择，使保留token既覆盖场景又保留答案。配以单次 rollout 自蒸馏配方训练MLLM。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B上仅用5%视觉token，于14个基准保留91.6%全token性能；比最强先前方法LT-OPD高17.3点，比同训练配方的DivPrune高6.0点；4K图像首token时延加速3.1倍；可泛化到另外三个MLLM及高分辨率文档基准，文本密集任务收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 问题条件的两阶段token削减（粗通览定位+细重编码+证据-多样性选择）能有效突破极端预算下的视觉token瓶颈，兼顾效率与精度，具备跨模型与文档场景的泛化性。

title: PlanDiv: Test-Time Scaling with Latent Plans for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Test-time scaling improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies by drawing several action candidates and executing the best one. We find that its returns diminish quickly when the candidates are resampled from one decoder: they differ by noise rather than by plan, and for each of three resampling sources, going from four to eight candidates adds only 0.06-0.07 to the average number of completed tasks on CALVIN. We introduce PlanDiv, an action head that makes the candidates differ by plan: a lightweight planner proposes K latent plan hypotheses, a shared masked-diffusion executor decodes one action chunk per plan from a single backbone pass, and the policy executes the chunk that its own likelihood ranks highest. The plans are learned from demonstrations alone, without plan labels or rewards. With the backbone, data and training recipe held fixed, eight plan-conditioned candidates raise five-task chain success on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D from 56.9% to 69.9%, while eight candidates from autoregressive, plan-free or same-plan resampling reach at most 64.9%. The same-plan baseline is PlanDiv's own checkpoint with the plan held fixed, so this gap comes from the plans, not from drawing more samples. On LIBERO-Long, four plans remove 40% of single-candidate failures, against at most 21% for matched resampling. On a real Franka arm the gain appears where a task admits more than one solution: PlanDiv is on par with a single-output OpenVLA-OFT+ baseline on a one-solution task and succeeds in 51 of 54 trials against 40 of 54 on two tasks with two solutions.

AI.tldr: PlanDiv通过潜规划器产生K个潜计划假设、共享掩码扩散执行器一次前向解码每个计划的动作块，并用策略自身似然挑选最优块，使测试时扩展的多候选"按计划"而非"按噪声"区分。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA测试时扩展从同一解码器重复采样多个候选，仅靠噪声差异区分，收益快速饱和（4→8候选仅提升0.06–0.07个任务）。
AI.method: 轻量规划器从演示中无监督地提出K个潜计划假设；共享掩码扩散执行器在单次骨干前向中为每个计划解码一个动作块；策略以自身似然排序并执行最高分动作块。无需计划标签或奖励。
AI.result: CALVIN ABC→D五任务链成功率56.9%→69.9%，优于自回归/无计划/同计划重采样的≤64.9%；同计划对照用同权重固定计划，证明增益来自计划多样性。LIBERO-Long四计划消除40%单候选失败（匹配重采样≤21%）。真机Franka上单解任务与OpenVLA-OFT+持平，双解任务54次中成功51次（基线40次）。
AI.conclusion: 候选多样性应由结构化潜计划而非采样噪声提供，且可从演示中无监督习得；差异在解空间多模态任务上最显著。

title: ReactBench-AD: Do Driving VLAs and World-Action Models React to Imminent Hazards in Their Path?
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged in autonomous driving with the promise of strong generalization to long-tail scenarios. Although these models achieve state-of-the-art results on autonomous driving benchmarks, most existing benchmarks are dominated by nominal scenarios and therefore cannot test this promise. To test one such long-tail capability that is critical for safety, we introduce ReactBench-AD, a benchmark that measures how driving models react to objects that appear in the ego vehicle's path. Built on real NAVSIM and PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles scenes, ReactBench-AD composites a crossing pedestrian, a standing pedestrian, or a stationary car consistently across all camera views and history frames. Each edited scene thus forms an exact, pixel-level counterfactual pair with its original, which allows us to isolate the causal effect of the inserted object on the predicted trajectory. Evaluating four VLAs and two WAMs, we find that they react weakly, often barely at all. Finally, we test how easily one of the evaluated VLAs, ReCogDrive, can be taught to brake hard for imminent hazards: a short fine-tuning stage on edited scenes substantially improves its reactions, with the learned behavior generalizing to unseen objects and fully real scenes, at minimal cost to nominal driving. These results call into question the out-of-the-box long-tail capabilities of these models, but suggest that they can be a strong foundation for acquiring them with little additional training, highlighting the value of real or synthetic data that demonstrates the long-tail behaviors nominal datasets rarely contain. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReactBench-AD 基准，在 NAVSIM/PhysicalAI-AV 真实场景上以像素级反事实方式插入横穿行人、站立行人或静止车辆，用于因果化地度量自动驾驶 VLA/WAM 对路径障碍的避让反应；发现 4 个 VLA 与 2 个 WAM 反应普遍微弱；并对 ReCogDrive 做短时微调，显著提升紧急制动并泛化到未见物体与真实场景，名义驾驶性能损失极小。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶基准以常规（nominal）场景为主，无法检验 VLA/WAM 所宣称的长尾泛化能力；而"对突然出现在自车路径上的物体是否做出反应"是安全关键的长尾能力，缺少可控、可归因的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 ReactBench-AD：基于真实 NAVSIM 与 PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles 场景，将横穿行人、站立行人、静止车辆在所有相机视角与历史帧中一致地合成，使每个编辑场景与原场景构成精确的像素级反事实配对，从而隔离插入物体对预测轨迹的因果影响。评测 4 个 VLA 与 2 个 WAM；并对 ReCogDrive 在编辑场景上做短时微调以学习紧急制动。
AI.result: 现有 VLA/WAM 对插入障碍物反应微弱、多数近乎无反应；短时微调后 ReCogDrive 的紧急制动反应显著增强，且该行为泛化到未见过的物体类别与完全真实场景，名义驾驶性能成本极小。
AI.conclusion: 这些模型的"开箱即用"长尾能力存疑，但可作为低成本习得长尾行为的基础；凸显了展示长尾行为（真实或合成）数据的价值。

title: D'BEAST: Logged Bad Experiences as Explanation for Autonomous Driving Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning agents learn from mistakes, yet their decisions can be difficult to trace back to those experiences. We investigate whether a tabular agent's decisions can be explained by its bad experiences, defined as the training transitions associated with safety or task events. A fixed training log is replayed from the same initial Q-table under three conditions. FULL retains all updates, SKIP omits bad-experience updates, and NEUTRALIZE retains those updates without their event penalties. We illustrate the method on six classic Markov decision processes and evaluate it in closed-loop driving in CARLA. On the full driving task, FULL reached the goal from 33 of 40 test starts, whereas SKIP and NEUTRALIZE reached it from none, indicating that the bad experiences carry decision-relevant information. At the local level, for 47 decisions shortly before a failure of SKIP or NEUTRALIZE, removing or neutralizing a small group of bad experiences, with a median size of one, caused the trained agent to select the failing policy's action in 46 cases. For this agent, the results indicate that its decisions can be explained by its bad experiences.

AI.tldr: 提出经验消融解释法：回放固定训练日志、剔除或中性化"坏经验"（安全/任务事件相关的transition），检验表格型RL智能体决策是否依赖这些经验，并在CARLA闭环驾驶中验证。
AI.motivation: RL智能体的决策难以追溯到具体训练经验，作者希望检验"坏经验"（与安全或任务事件相关的训练转移）是否承载决策相关信息，从而提供一种可操作的决策解释途径。
AI.method: 在相同初始Q表下重放固定训练日志，设置三种条件：FULL保留全部更新；SKIP剔除坏经验对应的更新；NEUTRALIZE保留这些更新但去掉事件惩罚项。比较三者在经典MDP与CARLA闭环驾驶中的行为差异；再在局部层面针对SKIP/NEUTRALIZE失败前的决策做小规模坏经验组的移除/中性化消融。
AI.result: 完整驾驶任务中FULL在40个测试起点中33个到达目标，SKIP与NEUTRALIZE为0；局部层面针对47个失败前决策，移除/中性化中位规模为1的少量坏经验后，46次智能体选择了失败策略的动作。
AI.conclusion: 对该表格型智能体而言，决策可由其坏经验解释，坏经验携带决策相关信息；方法作为经验级解释工具有效，但证据限于表格RL与单一驾驶场景。

title: FastGRN: Few-Step Generative Refinement Networks
summary: Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) generate an image by repeatedly re-predicting and refining every token of a discrete latent. They reach high fidelity, but need dozens of Markov steps. We therefore train few-step GRNs on the distribution of their own samples. We use its own uniform-state corruption to perform distribution matching on discrete tokens, which lets a discrete generator learn by backpropagation, and we pair noise with samples in the manner of rectified flow. We find that the steps of a few-step GRN do not carry the same amount of information or the same repair load. We therefore exploit its discrete refinement during training and build few-step GRNs in three parts. Oversampling samples the student with more steps than it was trained for and refines its judge on these samples. Non-uniform sampling trains only the last step and hands it most of the information at sampling time. Refinement confidence keeping holds on to the tokens the student is already sure of. We train a fast class-conditional generator on ImageNet 256 and, with the same method, a 2B text-to-image model. On ImageNet 256, the 3-step FastGRN beats the FID of GRN. On a 2B binary-token text-to-image GRN, a 4-step student also nearly matches the GenEval of GRN-T2I 2B.

AI.tldr: 提出FastGRN：利用GRN自身的离散状态破坏过程做分布匹配，结合rectified flow式噪声-样本配对训练少步生成器；并以过采样、非均匀采样、refinement confidence keeping三种训练策略构造3步/4步学生模型。
AI.motivation: GRN（生成式精炼网络）虽保真度高，但需数十步马尔可夫式迭代精炼每个离散token，推理开销大；需在保持质量的前提下压缩到少步。
AI.method: 在自身采样分布上训练少步GRN：用GRN固有的uniform-state corruption实现离散token上的分布匹配（使离散生成器可反向传播学习），并以rectified flow方式配对噪声与样本；发现各步信息量与修复负荷不均，故设计三部分训练机制——(1) oversampling：用超出训练步数的步数采样学生并更新其判别器；(2) non-uniform sampling：只训练最后一步并在采样时把大部分信息交给该步；(3) refinement confidence keeping：保留学生已有高置信度token。
AI.result: ImageNet 256上3步FastGRN的FID优于原始GRN；同方法训练的2B二值token文生图模型，4步学生GenEval几乎追平GRN-T2I 2B。
AI.conclusion: 少步离散精炼生成可通过自采样分布匹配与非均匀步分配实现大幅步数压缩，且方法可扩展至2B级文生图模型，为高效离散token生成提供可行路径。

title: acuSimNet: Multi-View Self-Occlusion-Awared Visibility Learning for Cranio-Cervical Acupuncture Points
summary: The localization of acupuncture points (acupoints) in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) presents unique challenges since they are defined by abstract principles rather than distinct anatomical landmarks. Existing approaches are typically constrained to single view or rely on indirect calculations of relative positions with respect to other landmarks, thereby overlooking human anatomical variations. Furthermore, acupoint visibility assessment, which determins whether points are occluded by human itself, hair, clothing, or other objects, has received limited attention in practical applications. Acupoint localization itself does not require 3D reconstruction, but inferring their occlusion relationships with anatomical surfaces does, which adds computational cost and limits real-time inference. In this work, we introduce acuSimNet, an efficient hierarchical multi-task learning architecture for multi-view, self-occlusion-aware visibility prediction of acupoints, achieving 99.97% accuracy on the validation set. Our approach also addresses the challenges of high-dimensional classification (174 acupoints in cervicocranial region), negative convergence issues for visible acupoints, and inter-task scheduling optimization, resulting in substantially accelerated convergence. We improved the training efficiency from the exisiting methods of 3000 epochs to achieve 99% validation accuracy, to our optimized framework achieving 90% accuracy in 39 epochs and 99% accuracy in 86 epochs. This architecture overcomes the limitations of existing methods, could enable practical applications in acupoints detection and visualization, advancing the automation of TCM.

AI.tldr: 提出 acuSimNet——分层多任务学习架构，实现多视角、自遮挡感知的穴位可见性预测，验证集准确率 99.97%，并大幅加速收敛（39 epoch 达 90%、86 epoch 达 99%）。
AI.motivation: 穴位由抽象原则而非明确解剖标志定义，现有方法局限于单视角或依赖相对其他标志的间接位置计算，忽略人体解剖差异；同时穴位可见性（被身体、毛发、衣物遮挡）评估长期被忽视。若通过 3D 重建推断遮挡关系则计算开销大、难实时。
AI.method: 分层多任务学习架构：多视角输入 + 自遮挡感知的可见性预测头；针对 174 类颈颅区穴位的高维分类、可见穴位的负样本收敛问题，以及任务间调度优化进行设计。
AI.result: 验证集准确率 99.97%；训练效率由原方法 3000 epoch 达 99% 提升至 39 epoch 达 90%、86 epoch 达 99%。
AI.conclusion: 规避了显式 3D 重建与间接相对位置计算的局限，为穴位检测与可视化提供可行的实时方案，推动中医自动化。

title: Machine Learning for Near Real-Time Identification of Wildfire Burned Areas
summary: In this article, we present a near real-time method that estimates burned probability anywhere in the world using satellite images. Our approach takes advantage of the state-of-the-art pix2pix model to translate a preprocessed index calculated from Landsat 8/9 images into an approximate of USGS Burn Probability indicating per pixel burn probability. Since this is a machine learning-based approach, it can be automated with a minimum amount of human intervention with significantly less time delays and geographic restrictions compared to other contemporary methods. We include results from our experiments and compare our approximation with the USGS Burn Probability using RMSE score.

AI.tldr: 用pix2pix将Landsat 8/9指数影像翻译为近似USGS燃烧概率图，实现全球近实时逐像元燃烧概率估计。
AI.motivation: 现有燃烧概率制图依赖人工干预、时延大且受地理限制，难以在全球范围内快速获得逐像元燃烧概率。
AI.method: 基于pix2pix的图像到图像翻译模型，将Landsat 8/9影像预处理得到的指数转换为USGS燃烧概率的近似输出；流程可自动化、人工干预需求极低。
AI.result: 给出实验结果，并以RMSE指标将估计结果与USGS Burn Probability进行定量对比；相比同类方法时延更短、地理限制更少。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可作为一种近实时、低人工成本的全球燃烧概率估计方案。

title: MARLIN: Multiscale And Directional Sparse Representation Learning for Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification
summary: Despite recent progress in SAR maritime monitoring, ship classification remains challenging due to limited labeled data, class imbalance, large intra-class variability, fine-grained inter-class similarity, and variations in target scale, orientation, and backscattering structure. To address these challenges, this paper proposes MARLIN, a class-frequency-aware framework with directional sparse and hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction for ship type classification in SAR images. The proposed architecture first constructs two complementary representations of each input image, where each views are processed by parallel encoder branches. Each branch begins with a directional sparse convolutional stem designed to capture elongated and orientation-dependent ship scattering patterns, followed by customized hierarchical multiscale feature extraction blocks. To improve learning under imbalanced class distributions, we introduce a class-frequency aware objective. The proposed objective combines margin-based classification with class-frequency-weighted prototype compactness and class-pair frequency weighted margin separation. This formulation shapes the embedding space by encouraging samples from the same class to form compact clusters while enforcing stronger separation for class pairs involving underrepresented ship categories. Extensive experiments on three complementary datasets demonstrate that in addition to being lightweight and parameter efficient, MARLIN improves both overall accuracy and class-balanced metrics, confirming its effectiveness for robust SAR ship-type classification under limited and imbalanced training conditions. The codes are available at this http URL .

AI.tldr: MARLIN: 面向SAR图像舰船类型分类的类别频率感知框架，采用方向稀疏卷积stem与分层多尺度特征提取的双分支编码器，并设计类别频率加权目标函数以应对样本不均衡。
AI.motivation: SAR海事监测中舰船分类受限于标注数据稀缺、类别不均衡、类内差异大、类间细粒度相似以及目标尺度/朝向/散射结构变化等难题，需要针对性的表征与损失设计。
AI.method: 构建每个输入图像的两种互补表示，经并行编码分支处理；各分支以方向稀疏卷积stem捕捉细长且依赖朝向的舰船散射模式，再接定制分层多尺度特征提取块；训练目标为margin分类损失 + 类别频率加权原型紧致项 + 类对频率加权margin分离项。
AI.result: 在三个互补数据集上，模型轻量、参数高效，同时提升总体精度与类别均衡指标。
AI.conclusion: 针对受限且不均衡训练条件下的SAR舰船类型分类，方向稀疏表征结合频率感知的嵌入空间塑形是一种有效且轻量的方案。

title: Prompt Re-Specification and Target-Mask Availability in Mask-Conditioned Visual Reinforcement Learning for Moving-Platform Landing
summary: Visual reinforcement learning (RL) policies that land a drone on a moving platform can fail when the landing pad looks different from the one used in training. Using binary target masks as the visual input removes most pixel-level appearance information while preserving the spatial representation of the target, and lets a text prompt specify the target. In simulation, we test whether a frozen (fixed-weight) mask-based DrQ-v2 policy can handle a new pad when only the prompt of its fine-tuned SAM 3 detector changes. A banana-themed pad lowered landing success from 75.6% to 12.0%, and SAM 3 rarely detected it under the original prompt. A revised prompt, chosen after testing several candidates, restored success to 68.4% with no weight updates. In a separate experiment with a policy trained on ground-truth masks, filling in masks that were missing while the pad was visible helped landing far more than the tested mask-centroid and area corrections. Tracking the pad over time supplied masks more often and also kept producing them after the pad was confirmed absent from the rendered image, but it did not establish a reliable improvement in landing success. Whether a usable mask reaches the policy at all thus appears to be an important limiting factor for this approach.

AI.tldr: 用二值目标掩码替代原始像素作为视觉输入，配合可替换文本提示的冻结SAM 3检测器，测试DrQ-v2无人机降落策略对更换着陆板的泛化性
AI.motivation: 视觉强化学习训练的无人机着陆策略在着陆板外观变化时会失效；作者希望借助二值掩码去除像素级外观信息、保留目标空间表征，并通过文本提示切换目标，从而在不动策略权重的情况下适应新着陆板
AI.method: 仿真环境中使用掩码输入的冻结DrQ-v2策略；仅改动其微调SAM 3检测器的文本提示，比较原提示与多个候选提示下的降落成功率；另设实验：对策略使用真值掩码，比较"补全可见期缺失掩码"与掩码质心/面积修正的效果，并测试基于时间跟踪生成掩码的影响
AI.result: 香蕉纹理着陆板使成功率从75.6%降至12.0%，SAM 3在原提示下几乎检测不到；改写提示后无权重更新即恢复至68.4%。掩码补全带来的提升远大于质心/面积修正；时间跟踪能更频繁供给掩码（甚至在画面中已确认目标消失后仍输出），但未带来可靠的降落成功率提升
AI.conclusion: 掩码可用性（掩码能否真正送达策略）是该掩码化视觉输入方案的关键瓶颈，提示工程可在零权重更新下部分恢复泛化能力

title: SGIP: Learning Scene-Grounded Interaction Priors for Scene-Aware Human Motion Prediction
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Human motion prediction (HMP) aims to forecast future movement from an observed motion sequence, and recent methods have incorporated 3D scene geometry and object semantics to improve long-term plausibility. However, the destination of future motion remains ambiguous in cluttered scenes: the same observed motion can lead to different interaction targets or navigation modes. Existing methods either handle this ambiguity implicitly or rely on auxiliary signals like gaze that are hard to obtain in practice. To address this, we propose SGIP, which explicitly predicts where in the scene future motion will be grounded across both objects and open navigation regions, and uses it to condition future trajectory and full-body pose prediction. This scene-grounded interaction prior is learned via intent distillation: at training time only, a teacher model scores candidate scene regions by combining an LLM prompted with a textual description of the person's intent with geometric motion-scene features. A student model learns to reproduce these scores from only the observed motion and 3D scene, making intent and LLM unnecessary at test time. Across multiple benchmark datasets, SGIP outperforms prior scene-aware baselines on both trajectory and pose accuracy in a realistic deployment setting where neither gaze nor intent is available at inference, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SGIP 显式预测场景中未来运动落点（物体或可导航区域），并用该"场景接地交互先验"条件化轨迹与全身姿态预测；先验通过教师-学生蒸馏学习，推理时无需 gaze、intent 或 LLM。
AI.motivation: 现有 HMP 方法对"未来运动目的地"的歧义（同一观测可指向不同交互目标或导航模式）处理隐含，或依赖目光等难以获取的辅助信号，部署受限。
AI.method: 教师模型：LLM 接收人物意图文本描述 + 几何运动-场景特征，对候选场景区域打分；学生模型仅由观测运动与 3D 场景回归这些分数，实现意图蒸馏；再以预测的 scene-grounding 作为条件，联合预测未来轨迹与全身姿态。
AI.result: 在多个人体运动预测基准上，于无 gaze、无 intent 的推理设定下，轨迹与姿态精度均优于先前 scene-aware 基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模场景接地目的地并蒸馏为可部署先验，是缓解 HMP 歧义的有效框架。

title: See the Lives of Stars in a Handful of Light
summary: Galaxies evolve over hundreds of millions of years, and no telescope has ever watched one move. Cosmological simulations make this evolution visible as a sequence of multi-view images, inviting the question of whether a galaxy can be recovered in four dimensions from its images. This setting defeats existing dynamic scene methods, since millions of stars span only a few pixels each, faint populations blend into diffuse light, and free deformations reproduce the images without obeying gravity. We present Cosmos4D, which rests on two components. Gravitational 4D Gaussian Splatting represents each star as a self-luminous Gaussian whose motion is integrated through a gravitational potential and a low-dimensional force field shared by all stars. Luminosity-stratified dynamics give bright stars individual orbits supervised across image scales and carry faint populations with a velocity field estimated from optical flow. We further build a 4D dataset of eight galaxies from four cosmological simulations, on which Cosmos4D outperforms dynamic Gaussian baselines in both photometric quality and physical accuracy. With these advancements, we glimpse eight hundred million years of a galaxy's life in ninety-six frames.

AI.tldr: Cosmos4D：用重力约束的4D高斯溅射（Gaussian轨迹经引力势+共享低维力场积分）加重力分层动力学（亮星个体轨道跨尺度监督、暗弱星用光流速度场）从星系多视角图像序列中重建4D星系演化，并发布来自4个宇宙学模拟的8个星系数据集，在光度质量与物理精度上优于动态高斯基线。
AI.motivation: 星系演化时标长达数亿年，望远镜无法直接观测其运动；宇宙学模拟可生成多视角时序图像，从而提出"能否从图像中恢复四维星系"的问题。现有动态场景重建方法失效：数百万恒星各仅占几像素、暗弱星族混入弥散光、自由形变能拟合图像却不遵守引力物理。
AI.method: 1) Gravitational 4D Gaussian Splatting：每颗恒星建模为自发光高斯，其运动由引力势与所有恒星共享的低维力场积分得到，实现物理一致的形变而非自由变形；2) Luminosity-stratified dynamics：亮星赋予个体轨道并在多图像尺度上监督，暗弱星族由光流估计的速度场驱动；3) 构建含8个星系（来自4个宇宙学模拟）的4D数据集用于评测。
AI.result: 在自建4D星系数据集上，Cosmos4D在光度重建质量与物理精度（运动符合引力规律）两方面均优于动态高斯类基线；用96帧呈现星系约8亿年的演化过程。
AI.conclusion: 将物理先验（引力势+共享力场）引入动态高斯溅射，可把纯图像拟合转化为受物理约束的4D重建，为科学可视化与模拟对齐提供了可行路径；但评测限于合成宇宙学模拟数据，缺乏真实观测验证，属于科学可视化/科学机器学习方向的领域应用。

title: Latent World Modeling for Point-Cloud Video Pretraining
summary: Masked modeling is the dominant self-supervised paradigm for point-cloud videos. However, it leaks the information it is meant to predict, whether it reconstructs masked points as in MAE-style methods or predicts their latent features. Because point-cloud tokens are anchored at points sampled from each frame, querying a target at its own position reveals where its geometry has moved, in reconstruction and latent prediction alike. For latent predictors, random spatio-temporal masks introduce a further shortcut, as visible frames on both sides of each target allow interpolation rather than forecasting. The pretext task thus reduces to completion. Once the target positions are withheld, a masked latent predictor performs only slightly better than copying the last frame. To remove this leakage, we propose PointWM, a latent world model that turns completion into forecasting by predicting the features and geometry of future frames from strictly earlier context. Each target is queried only with its last-seen position and timestamp, while a latent action learned without annotations is meant to capture the part of the future that the past leaves undetermined. On HOI4D action segmentation with a P4Transformer backbone, PointWM improves F1@50 over training from scratch by 24.9 offline and 29.1 under strictly causal inference. These results show the promise of latent world models as a leakage-free pretraining paradigm for point-cloud this http URL code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PointWM 指出点云视频掩码建模存在目标位置泄漏（重建与潜变量预测均然），改为严格因果的潜空间世界模型，仅以目标最后出现的位置与时间戳查询特征/几何，并用无标注潜动作建模未来不确定部分，在 HOI4D 动作分割上 F1@50 提升 24.9（离线）/29.1（严格因果）。
AI.motivation: MAE 式重建和潜特征预测都因"在目标自身位置查询"而泄漏其运动后几何；随机时空掩码使目标两侧帧可见，任务退化为插值/补全。剥去位置信息后，掩码潜预测器仅略优于复制上一帧，说明现有预训练范式的自监督信号在很大程度上是虚假的。
AI.method: 将掩码补全改造成预测式潜世界模型：仅用严格更早的上下文，以目标最后被观测到的位置与时间戳作为查询，预测未来帧的潜特征与几何；同时学习一个无标注的潜动作变量，用于解释过去无法决定的那部分未来。
AI.result: 在 HOI4D 动作分割任务、P4Transformer 主干上，F1@50 相较从头训练提升 24.9（离线）与 29.1（严格因果推理）；消融显示去除位置泄漏后掩码潜预测收益大幅崩塌。
AI.conclusion: 提出无泄漏的"预测而非补全"点云视频预训练范式，验证潜世界模型作为 4D 表征预训练框架的有效性，并给出公开代码。

title: Geo2Gcode: From 3D Geometry to CNC Programs through Structured Machining Primitives
summary: Turning a 3D shape into a Computer Numerical Control (CNC) program is still largely manual. For every part, a machinist chooses setups, tools, step-downs, and toolpath patterns. We present Geo2Gcode, which converts a target mesh directly into standard G-code through structured machining primitives. Each primitive couples an indexed machining direction, a closed per-view reconstruction of the target, and explicit tool-radius, layer-height, and clearing-pattern parameters, and compiles deterministically into layerwise toolpaths via signed-distance queries. Most of the fidelity comes from this compiler. A lightweight selector trained with a voxel stock simulator fills in primitive parameters without per-part manual settings, approaching the finest fixed setting at about a quarter of its toolpath length. In simulation on ABC parts, Geo2Gcode reaches roughing fidelity comparable to an expert-tuned commercial CAM setup with a moderately longer toolpath, and clearly improves on a default CAM configuration. Generated programs run in a commercial G-code simulator, and one part is machined on a physical CNC mill. These results demonstrate that roughing programs can be generated directly from geometry without per-part CAM tuning.

AI.tldr: Geo2Gcode 通过结构化的加工基元将网格直接编译为标准 G-code，用体素毛坯模拟器训练的轻量选择器自动填充参数，实现免逐件调参的粗加工刀路生成。
AI.motivation: 将 3D 形状转化为 CNC 程序目前基本依赖人工：每件零件都需机加工人手动选择装夹方向、刀具、步降量与刀路模式，缺乏自动化途径。
AI.method: 定义"加工基元"：每个基元耦合索引化加工方向、针对该视角的闭合重建、显式刀具半径/层高/清腔模式参数，并基于符号距离场查询确定性地编译为逐层刀路；用一个体素毛坯仿真器训练的轻量选择器预测基元参数，无需逐件手动设定。
AI.result: 在 ABC 数据集上仿真，粗加工保真度接近专家调优的商业 CAM 配置（刀路长度中等偏长），明显优于默认 CAM 配置；刀路约为最精细固定设定的四分之一长度却接近其保真度；生成程序可在商业 G-code 仿真器中运行，并在一台实体 CNC 铣床上完成一件加工。
AI.conclusion: 粗加工程序可以直接由几何生成，无需逐件 CAM 调参；保真度主要来自确定性编译器而非学习选择器，为几何到制造代码提供了可复现范式。

title: A Geometric Observer for Visual-Inertial Odometry using Optical-Flow Constraints
summary: This paper presents a geometric observer for monocular visual-inertial odometry driven by individual optical-flow constraints. For each tracked point, the bearing and its rotationally compensated derivative give a depth-free homogeneous constraint on the body-frame velocity. These constraints enter the innovation of an observer on the gravity-augmented group $\mathbb{SE}_3(3)$ through a Riccati gain, without estimating depths or reconstructing the direction of motion. The auxiliary gravity state makes the six-dimensional body-frame velocity-gravity error dynamics independent of the attitude correction, and their uniform observability is shown to be equivalent to persistent excitation of a matrix formed from the inertial bearings and their derivatives. Under this condition, the body-frame velocity and gravity errors converge globally and uniformly exponentially, and a gravity-based attitude correction renders the combined velocity, gravity, and reduced-attitude error almost globally asymptotically stable and locally uniformly exponentially stable. Simulations illustrate the excitation condition, recovery from initial errors, and sensitivity to perturbed measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅由单目光流约束驱动的几何观测器：每个特征点的方位向量及其旋转补偿导数给出无深度的齐次速度约束，经Riccati增益注入 SE_3(3)（含重力增广）观测器的新息项，无需估计深度；在惯性方位矩阵持续激励条件下证明速度-重力误差全局一致指数收敛，并给出近全局渐近+局部一致指数的组合位姿误差稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统单目VIO需要估计特征深度或重建运动方向，引入尺度不可观、初始化敏感与耦合误差问题；作者希望以纯几何、无深度估计的方式直接在重力增广群上构建可证明稳定的视觉-惯性观测器。
AI.method: 对每个跟踪点构造bearing及其旋转补偿导数，形成机体坐标系速度的无深度齐次线性约束；将约束写入 SE_3(3)（SE(3)⋉重力）观测器的新息项，用Riccati型增益加权，不估深度；利用重力辅助状态解耦出六维机体速度-重力误差动力学，使其与姿态修正无关，并将一致可观性等价于惯性bearing及其导数构成矩阵的持续激励条件；再用重力对齐的attitude correction构成级联/组合Lyapunov分析。
AI.result: 在该持续激励条件下，机体速度与重力误差全局一致指数收敛；组合速度-重力-约化姿态误差达到近全局渐近稳定与局部一致指数稳定；仿真验证激励条件成立性、大初值误差恢复以及测量扰动敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 给出了一类无需深度估计、具备严格收敛性保证的单目VIO几何观测器框架，把可观性刻画为光流bearing矩阵的持续激励；但目前验证局限于仿真，缺乏真实数据/真实机器人实验与计算复杂度分析。

title: EgoSwarm: Learning Decentralized Robot Swarm Intelligence from Human Swarm Demonstrations
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Includes supplementary materials. Project page: this https URL
summary: Advancing from individual embodied intelligence to swarm embodied intelligence is a key step toward scalable, general-purpose embodied intelligence. Complex tasks often require multiple agents to divide responsibilities, coordinate handovers, and manipulate shared objects collaboratively. However, existing robot learning methods rely primarily on individual demonstrations, which provide limited supervision for modeling dependencies among agent actions, while collecting multi-robot demonstrations at scale remains difficult. Human egocentric demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, yet distributed observations from multiple participants cannot directly supervise decentralized policies. We introduce EgoSwarm, the first robot learning framework for learning decentralized multi-robot collaboration from human swarm demonstrations. EgoSwarm collects more than 50 hours of collaborative experience using a robot-free multi-person egocentric system. We introduce the Swarm Interaction Packet (SIP) and Swarm Interaction Token (SIT) to recover cross-agent interaction relations from distributed observations and transform this experience into local supervision consistent with deployment-time information constraints. We further propose SwarmVLA, which transfers knowledge of swarm behavior to decentralized policies conditioned on local observations, local history, and limited neighbor messages. SwarmVLA achieves a mean success rate of 72.2% across three categories of multi-robot collaborative tasks. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: EgoSwarm通过多人第一视角系统采集50+小时人类群体协作演示，提出SIP/SIT从分布式观测中恢复跨智能体交互关系并转为局部监督，训练去中心化策略SwarmVLA，在多机器人协作任务上达72.2%平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 个体具身智能走向群体具身智能需要多智能体分工、交接与共享物体协同操作，但个体演示难以监督跨智能体动作依赖，而规模化多机器人演示采集困难；人类第一视角演示可扩展，却与去中心化策略的局部信息约束不匹配。
AI.method: 构建无机器人的多人第一视角采集系统（50+小时协作经验）；提出Swarm Interaction Packet（SIP）与Swarm Interaction Token（SIT）从分布式观测中重建跨智能体交互关系，并转换为符合部署时信息约束的局部监督；提出SwarmVLA，将群体行为知识迁移至以局部观测、局部历史和有限邻居消息为条件的去中心化策略。
AI.result: 在三个类别的多机器人协作任务上，SwarmVLA取得72.2%的平均成功率。
AI.conclusion: 人类群体第一视角演示可作为可扩展的多机器人协作学习监督源，关键在于显式恢复跨智能体交互关系并施加与部署一致的局部信息约束；该框架为群体具身智能提供了数据与策略学习路径。

title: Trading Parameters for Accuracy in MambaVision for Chest Radiograph Classification
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to an IEEE journal
summary: MambaVision, a hybrid state-space and attention backbone, places most of its parameters in its widest, fourth stage. We quantified what that stage contributes to multi-label chest radiograph classification. The fourth stage was replaced with lighter single-scan state-space blocks adapted from Spatial-Mamba, with multi-scale dilated depthwise convolutions applied to the scan output; the first three stages were retained. Tiny, Small, and Base models were evaluated across nine dataset-scale combinations drawn from two source cohorts: the National Institutes of Health ChestX-ray14 archive (full ChestMNIST and a high-resolution subset) and Indiana University Open-i. At the Tiny scale, replacement reduced parameter count by 35.7% and increased graphics processing unit throughput by 19.3%; the savings came from the stage's dense projections, not from removing quadratic attention. Without distillation, the mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve on ChestMNIST was 0.004 lower than the baseline (95% bootstrap confidence interval, 0.002 to 0.006), and 0.003 to 0.006 lower across all nine combinations. Knowledge distillation from an unreplaced teacher narrowed the gap to the undistilled baseline to 0.001-0.002 and met the equivalence criterion on ChestMNIST, but distilling the baseline with the same recipe improved it by 0.001-0.003, so a gap of 0.002-0.005 persisted under symmetric training. At the Base scale, the unreplaced Small model was both smaller and more accurate. Fourth-stage replacement is a useful trade-off only for Tiny and Small models. These measurements let developers of chest radiograph screening tools weigh model size and speed against a quantified loss of diagnostic discrimination.

AI.tldr: 将MambaVision第四阶段替换为轻量single-scan状态空间块并加多尺度空洞深度可分离卷积，在胸片多标签分类上仅Tiny/Small规模是有效折中，Base规模不划算。
AI.motivation: MambaVision参数量集中在其最宽的第4阶段，作者量化该阶段对多标签胸片分类的贡献，以判断能否用更轻的结构替换以换取参数与吞吐收益。
AI.method: 保留前三个阶段，将第4阶段替换为改编自Spatial-Mamba的轻量single-scan SSB，并在scan输出上施加多尺度空洞depthwise卷积；在Tiny/Small/Base三档、来自ChestX-ray14（全量ChestMNIST及高分辨率子集）与Indiana Open-i的9种数据-规模组合上评估，并做无蒸馏与教师蒸馏两种设置对比。
AI.result: Tiny档参数量降35.7%、GPU吞吐升19.3%（收益来自该阶段稠密投影而非去除二次注意力）；无蒸馏时ChestMNIST均值AUROC低0.004（95% bootstrap CI 0.002–0.006），9种组合低0.003–0.006；蒸馏将差距收窄至0.001–0.002并在ChestMNIST满足等价判据，但对称训练下仍有0.002–0.005差距；Base档下未替换的Small模型更小且更准。
AI.conclusion: 第4阶段替换仅在Tiny/Small规模是可接受的精度-效率折中，且收益主要来自参数压缩而非架构优势；为胸片筛查工具开发者提供了可量化的精度损失权衡依据。

title: SAFER: Navigating the Exploration-Exploitation Dilemma in World-Model-Based Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: An autonomous vehicle must foresee the consequences of its actions, especially in the rare, time-critical situations where crashes happen. A world model offers this foresight, but only within the coverage of its training data, which poses an exploration-exploitation dilemma. Within this coverage a planner can hardly improve on the data, and beyond it the model's errors mislead it. Logs of competent driving rarely contain the failures that would widen the coverage, and agents that learn from interaction gain them only by failing themselves, without being shown what to do instead. We propose SAFER, a framework that learns offline from failures that others make, judged by an expert, and keeps learning online from its own driving. Offline, partially trained agents and scripted, recoverable perturbations Stage failures in simulation, and an expert Annotates every visited state with its action and value, so that much of what the planner explores is covered before it drives. In planning, a chunked latent world model Foresees the consequences fast enough for real-time use, and a risk-aware sampling-based planner Evaluates candidate maneuvers by their return minus a bounded collision penalty. Online, a loop continuously Refines the model wherever this driving leaves the coverage of the offline data. In closed-loop evaluation against the compared methods, SAFER reaches the highest route completion and reward per step on the CARLA Leaderboard routes, 0.95 and 0.77 from a privileged bird's-eye view, and the highest episode reward in MetaDrive, 53.4 in regular and 49.0 in safety-critical traffic. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: SAFER：离线学习他人失败的专家标注知识 + 在线持续修正的分块潜空间世界模型，配合风险感知采样规划器实现实时安全自动驾驶。
AI.motivation: 世界模型的预判仅在其训练数据覆盖范围内可靠，形成探索-利用两难：覆盖内规划器难超越数据，覆盖外模型误差会误导规划器；而常规驾驶日志缺少失效样本，交互式智能体只能靠自身失败获取经验且无正确示范。
AI.method: 离线阶段用部分训练的智能体与脚本化可恢复扰动在仿真中"制造失败"（Stage），由专家对每个访问状态标注动作与价值（Annotate），把探索区提前纳入覆盖；规划阶段用分块（chunked）潜空间世界模型快速预测后果，风险感知采样规划器以"回报减有界碰撞惩罚"评估候选机动；在线阶段持续在离线数据覆盖之外精化模型。
AI.result: 闭环评测中，CARLA Leaderboard 路线取得最高路线完成率与单步奖励（特权鸟瞰视角下 0.95 与 0.77），MetaDrive 中取得最高回合奖励：常规场景 53.4，安全关键场景 49.0。
AI.conclusion: 当模型可复制的失败方式被显式引入训练，且探索结果由专家标注担保，世界模型驱动的规划器能在覆盖内外都保持性能，验证了"先覆盖后行驶"的离线-在线联合范式。

title: Sequential Semantic-Non-Semantic Watermarking: Robustness Against UnMarker Attacks
comment: 13 pages, 16 figures. Preprint based on this http URL . thesis research
summary: Advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) have accelerated digital content generation and intensified concerns around fraud, misuse, counterfeiting, and content provenance. Defensive image watermarking provides a practical mechanism for identifying and tracing digital content, but recent watermark-removal attacks challenge its robustness. This study investigates Sequential Semantic Non-Semantic Watermarking (SSNSW), which combines HiDDeN and StegaStamp as complementary non-semantic and semantic watermarking schemes. Using 50 images from MS-COCO and CelebA-HQ, both embedding orders are evaluated, followed by UnMarker's non-semantic and semantic attacks applied individually and sequentially. Results show that both watermarks remain highly decodable after dual embedding, with only limited embedding-order effects. Under individual attacks, one watermark generally remains strongly decodable: StegaStamp under the non-semantic attack and HiDDeN under the semantic attack. Sequential attacks are therefore required to substantially reduce both watermark signals, while attack order has a limited and configuration-dependent effect. The semantic attack also shows a broader effect across the two watermark types than the non-semantic attack. LPIPS remains relatively low in several settings, although qualitative inspection reveals noticeable distortions, particularly in selected facial images, indicating that LPIPS should not be used alone to assess visual quality. Overall, the findings show that combining complementary watermark types can increase robustness against single-stage removal attacks and motivate broader multi-layer watermarking, stronger perceptual evaluation, and further study of sequential watermark-removal strategies.

AI.tldr: 该文研究顺序语义/非语义水印（SSNSW），将HiDDeN与StegaStamp组合嵌入，评估双嵌入顺序及UnMarker单次/顺序去除攻击的鲁棒性与视觉质量。
AI.motivation: AI生成内容加速扩散，带来伪造、滥用与溯源问题；防御性图像水印虽实用，但近期水印去除攻击严重削弱其鲁棒性，单一水印方案难以抵御。
AI.method: 在MS-COCO与CelebA-HQ共50张图像上，将HiDDeN（非语义）与StegaStamp（语义）以两种嵌入顺序叠加，随后施加UnMarker的非语义攻击与语义攻击（单独及顺序组合），以可解码性与LPIPS评估，并辅以定性检查。
AI.result: 双嵌入后两种水印均可高可解码，嵌入顺序影响有限；单独攻击下总有一种水印保持强可解码（非语义攻击下StegaStamp、语义攻击下HiDDeN）；需顺序攻击才能显著削弱两者。语义攻击对两类水印的破坏更广。LPIPS在多种设置下偏低，但人脸图像出现明显失真，说明LPIPS不宜单独衡量视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 组合互补水印类型可提升对单阶段去除攻击的鲁棒性，支持多层水印设计、更强的感知质量评价及对顺序去除策略的进一步研究。

title: Aerial Person Detection under Edge Constraints: Held-Out Evaluation and Edge-Ground Verification
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Code, truth registers and result files: this https URL
summary: A search drone sees a missing person as a few pixels, carries a small computer, and shares a narrow radio link. We study person detection under those limits; the primary evaluations were declared before they ran, and later analyses are marked exploratory. In an exploratory comparison, holding out recording blocks inferred from thermal frame identifiers cut recall at a fixed false-alarm target from 32.7% to 12.3%. With nothing tuned on test blocks, a 46,000-parameter detector gated by a contrast cue finds 10.4% of people against 5.7% for the same network applied everywhere. A standard detector, YOLO11n, trained under the same folds finds 54.5% at a similar false-alarm rate for about eleven times the arithmetic, and on our 4K field footage at 117 m has a walking person among its top 16 detections in up to 92% of frames against 74% for our board. Run alone, YOLO11n's thresholds set at one location overshot their false-alarm target 1.7 to 3.4 times at new locations, and its best configuration at altitude cost 4 to 24 standard passes per frame. Re-scoring its 16 best crops (154 KB per frame) with an 842,000-parameter ground model, thresholds frozen on a validation location, raised recall from 44.9% to 53.7% against the same 16 crops with YOLO's own scores; in a post hoc paired analysis over 15 test locations the gain was +8.8 points [+2.4, +12.5]. Pooled false detections fell from 0.86 to 0.64 per frame, but that paired change was not distinguishable from zero. Coverage of a still person in earth tones was very low for both detectors in the clips we flew.

AI.tldr: Pre-registered evaluation of tiny onboard person detection for search drones: block-wise splits reveal recall collapse (32.7%→12.3%); a 46k-param contrast-gated detector beats its always-on version (10.4% vs 5.7%), while YOLO11n reaches 54.5% at ~11× compute but generalizes poorly across locations until re-scored by a ground model (+8.8 pts).
AI.motivation: Search-and-rescue drones face three coupled constraints—targets are only a few pixels, onboard compute is tiny, and the radio link is narrow. The authors want evaluation protocols that reflect true generalization (location/block-wise splits) rather than leaky frame-level splits, and want to know whether an ultra-small detector plus a gating cue or a crop re-scoring stage can realistically deliver usable recall at fixed false-alarm rates.
AI.method: Pre-declared primary evaluations with post hoc analyses flagged exploratory. Grouped/block-wise folds inferred from thermal frame identifiers for honest test separation. Benchmarks: (1) 46,000-parameter detector gated by a contrast cue vs. dense application; (2) YOLO11n baseline under identical folds with compute accounting; (3) a two-stage pipeline where YOLO's top-16 crops (154 KB/frame) are re-scored by an 842,000-parameter ground model with thresholds frozen on a validation location; (4) field tests on 4K footage at 117 m. Recall measured at a fixed false-alarm target, with pooled and paired false-positive accounting.
AI.result: Block-wise holding out cut recall from 32.7% to 12.3% at fixed false-alarm target—the headline evidence that frame-level splits inflate results. The 46k-param gated detector finds 10.4% vs 5.7% ungated. YOLO11n: 54.5% recall at ~11× arithmetic; on 4K field footage at 117 m, a walking person is in the top-16 in up to 92% of frames (74% for the small board). YOLO's location-tuned thresholds overshot false-alarm targets by 1.7–3.4× at new sites; its altitude-best config cost 4–24 standard passes per frame. Re-scoring raised recall 44.9%→53.7% on identical crops; paired post hoc gain +8.8 pts [+2.4, +12.5] over 15 test locations; pooled false detections 0.86→0.64 per frame but paired change not distinguishable from zero. Still persons in earth tones were poorly covered by both detectors.
AI.conclusion: Three takeaways: (i) block-wise/location-wise splitting is mandatory—frame-level evaluation overstates recall by ~2.6×; (ii) fixed thresholds do not transfer across locations, so either re-calibrate per site or use a second-stage scorer with location-frozen thresholds; (iii) a crop re-scoring head on a narrow link is a cheap, statistically supported recall gain, whereas absolute recall (~54%) remains far from operational, and camouflaged/still targets remain a hard failure mode. The contrast-gating cue is a low-cost pre-filter but its absolute recall is very low.

authors: José Arce y de la Borbolla
title: Cleanly-DINO: Efficiently Learning Visual Task Spaces for Robotics
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, accepted at COMPOGEN Workshop CoRL 2026, Austin, USA
summary: Learning manipulation tasks from few demonstrations requires abstractions that capture the changes relevant to task completion, such as object poses in rigid-body manipulation. However, tasks such as cleaning are defined by changes in visual state rather than object pose, making the choice of task representation less clear. In this work, we propose Cleanly-DINO to learn visual task spaces from few demonstrations. Given a mask of a task-relevant region and frozen ViT features, Cleanly-DINO fits a projection to isolate a task space and fit a progression metric to it. We train the model on diverse cleaning examples and evaluate its ability to localize incomplete task regions and transfer across visual domains. We also study its utility for robot learning by using it as an observation encoder and reward signal in a reinforcement learning setting. Finally, we deploy our fitted model within a real-world robotic wiping pipeline to evaluate its use in guiding task execution.

AI.tldr: Cleanly-DINO 利用少量演示，从冻结 ViT 特征和任务区域掩码中拟合一个投影以分离出"视觉任务空间"，并在其上拟合任务完成度度量，用于清洁（擦除）类视觉状态变化型任务。
AI.motivation: 清洁等任务的目标由视觉状态变化定义而非物体位姿，传统基于位姿的任务表示不适用；少样本条件下需要可迁移、可解释的任务抽象。
AI.method: 以冻结 ViT 特征为输入，给定任务相关区域掩码，学习线性/浅层投影将特征映射到低维任务空间，并拟合标量进度度量（progression metric）以衡量任务完成程度；用多样清洁样本训练，可作 RL 观测编码器与奖励信号，并嵌入真实机器人擦拭流水线。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量数据；声称能定位未完成区域并跨视觉域迁移，在 RL 中作为观测编码器/奖励有效，且在真实机器人擦拭系统中可用。
AI.conclusion: 视觉任务空间是位姿抽象之外处理状态变化型操作任务的一种可行表示，具有域迁移与实机部署潜力；但结论主要依赖定性描述，需原始论文数据支撑。

title: GeoReVis: Learning Selective Revision and Evidence Consolidation for Remote Sensing Segmentation
summary: Recent methods try to inspect and revise masks to mitigate referential ambiguity and localization errors caused by complex spatial relations in language-guided remote sensing segmentation. However, these solutions often lead to Revision Degradation: revising missing regions may introduce errors into previously correct ones. Even a globally better mask can omit correct regions found in inferior masks. We term this Evidence Fragmentation: correct target evidence is scattered across imperfect masks. All masks generated by the model at this time are suboptimal. We propose GeoReVis, which unifies revision guided by execution feedback, Candidate Selection, and Cross-Mask Evidence Consolidation. It learns fine-grained revision from real actions that improve segmentation when executed and learns to select a better mask through quality comparisons between actual candidates, reducing the risk of degradation during revision. The selected whole mask can still discard useful regions. GeoReVis therefore retains all candidates across rounds, partitions their spatial disagreements into composable regions, and jointly reconstructs regions conditioned on the full instruction and context. This makes complementary and fragmentary evidence reusable regardless of its source candidate's overall quality, yielding improved segmentation. We further build a data pipeline to generate fine-grained multi-round segmentation trajectories and derive supervision for revision actions, candidate selection, and region composition from the model's own outputs, extending training beyond whole-mask IoU supervision. We also propose ReVis-Eval, a benchmark protocol evaluating multi-round revision and cross-round evidence consolidation accuracy. Experiments on ReVis-Eval and 5 benchmarks for remote sensing reasoning and referring segmentation demonstrate the effectiveness of GeoReVis.

AI.tldr: GeoReVis：针对语言引导遥感分割中的“修订退化”与“证据碎片化”，统一执行反馈驱动的修订、候选选择与跨掩码证据整合，并构建多轮轨迹数据流水线与 ReVis-Eval 评测协议。
AI.motivation: 语言引导遥感分割中，复杂空间关系导致指代歧义与定位错误。现有掩码修订方法易出现“修订退化”（修正缺失区域时破坏原本正确区域）；且局部正确证据分散在不同残次掩码中（证据碎片化），全局更优的掩码仍可能丢失劣质掩码中的正确区域。
AI.method: GeoReVis 三部分：（1）以执行反馈引导修订，从真实能提升分割的动作中学习细粒度修订；（2）候选选择，通过实际候选间质量比较学习选取更优掩码以降低退化风险；（3）跨掩码证据整合：保留多轮全部候选，将其空间分歧切分为可组合区域，在完整指令与上下文条件下联合重建区域。另构建数据流水线，从模型自身输出生成细粒度多轮分割轨迹，并导出修订动作、候选选择、区域组合的监督信号，超越整掩码 IoU 监督。
AI.result: 提出 ReVis-Eval 基准协议，评测多轮修订与跨轮证据整合精度；在 ReVis-Eval 及 5 个遥感推理与指代分割基准上验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将分割从单次整掩码优化转向多候选、区域级证据复用，并可用自产轨迹监督训练，为遥感指代分割中的多轮自我修订提供了可复用范式与评测协议。

title: RoboKit: Accelerating Parallel Differentiable Optimization for Robot Learning
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: We present RoboKit, a high-performance, general-purpose toolkit for parallel differentiable optimization in robotics, built on three principles: (i) Performance and flexibility: GPU-parallel multi-seed solvers pair sampling with versatile optimizers, running 2-60$\times$ faster than task-specific baselines across seven tasks; (ii) Geometry, rendering and physics: hybrid and coarse-to-fine representations accelerate collision, differentiable rendering and simulation, optimizing 4096 grasps in 2.97 s; (iii) Integration with learning: costs are differentiable and simulation is parallel, so RoboKit both distills optimization into policies and trains RL; distilled policies run 9-240$\times$ faster at comparable accuracy, and RL reaches a GPU baseline's scores up to 2.1$\times$ sooner on the same simulator.

AI.tldr: RoboKit：GPU并行可微优化的通用机器人工具包，融合多种子采样求解、可微几何/渲染/物理与策略蒸馏及RL训练，速度提升2-60倍。
AI.motivation: 机器人中的优化（抓取、轨迹、接触）计算昂贵且任务专用实现割裂，难以与学习流水线（策略蒸馏、RL）统一；需要兼顾性能、灵活性与可微性的通用优化底座。
AI.method: 基于三条设计原则构建：(i) GPU并行多种子求解器，将采样与多种优化器组合；(ii) 混合与由粗到细的几何/碰撞/可微渲染/物理仿真表示；(iii) 代价函数可微且仿真并行，从而支持将优化蒸馏为策略及在同一仿真器中训练RL。
AI.result: 七项任务上比任务专用基线快2–60倍；2.97秒完成4096个抓取优化；蒸馏策略在精度相当下快9–240倍；RL达到GPU基线同等分数所需时间最多缩短2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: RoboKit以统一的可微并行优化框架在速度与集成性上取得显著收益，为优化与学习融合提供了通用基础设施；但工作以工具包与速度基准为主，尚缺真实机器人部署验证。

title: GlyphAtlas: Disentangling Stroke Detail from Layout for Scene Text Synthesis
summary: Scene text synthesis requires stroke-accurate characters rendered in a specified layout, as well as visual coherence with the surrounding scene. To achieve this, existing methods commonly pre-render the target text at its intended locations to form a glyph image that jointly specifies layout and glyph structure. However, this representation ties the resolution of each glyph to its target region, limiting fine-grained stroke guidance for small, densely packed, or structurally complex text. To tackle this, we propose GlyphAtlas, a scene text synthesis framework that retains the glyph image as a spatial anchor and supplies fine-grained stroke references through a dedicated glyph atlas. The atlas renders and encodes each character or word in a separate cell, decoupling reference resolution from target-region size. We further introduce atlas-anchored attention, which lets each text region retrieve stroke detail only from its corresponding atlas cells to refine the coarse glyph structure provided by the glyph image. This coarse-to-fine conditioning simplifies stroke rendering while preserving explicit layout correspondence. We optimize GlyphAtlas with a mask-weighted flow matching objective and a timestep-weighted text perceptual loss for writing accuracy and background consistency. Random resolution augmentation of atlas cells supports adjustable atlas budgets at inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GlyphAtlas achieves stroke-accurate synthesis of small, dense, and structurally complex text, zero-shot transfer to languages unseen during task-specific training, and leading performance in scenes with many text regions. project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: GlyphAtlas提出场景文本合成框架：保留glyph image作为空间布局锚点，同时用独立的glyph atlas逐字符/词渲染编码精细笔画参考，并通过atlas-anchored attention按区域检索对应cell细节，实现粗到细的笔画控制。
AI.motivation: 现有方法把目标文本预渲染成glyph image，使每个字形的分辨率与其目标区域尺寸绑定，导致小尺寸、密集排布或结构复杂的文字缺乏细粒度笔画引导。
AI.method: 将每个字符/词在atlas独立cell中渲染并编码，解耦参考分辨率与目标区域大小；引入atlas-anchored attention，使每个文本区域仅从对应atlas cell检索笔画细节以细化glyph image提供的粗结构；采用mask加权flow matching目标与timestep加权文本感知损失；推理时通过atlas cell随机分辨率增强调节atlas预算。
AI.result: 实验表明GlyphAtlas在小、密集、结构复杂文本上实现笔画精确合成，可零样本迁移到任务训练中未见语言，在多文本区域场景中取得领先性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦字形参考分辨率与目标区域尺寸并对齐显式布局的粗到细条件化，有效提升复杂文本合成质量，且具语言泛化性与可控推理开销。

title: DoF-Query Transformer for Adaptive Fusion of Egocentric Vision and Forearm HD-sEMG in Continuous Hand Kinematics
summary: Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. To account for the varying informativeness of visual and EMG cues across joint DoFs and input conditions, the decoder assigns a separate learnable query to each DoF, enabling DoF-specific and context-adaptive fusion of the two modalities. The framework was evaluated on synchronized multimodal data from 10 participants. Averaged across participants, the proposed fusion model achieved a mean coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of $0.88$ and a mean absolute error (MAE) of $2.80^\circ$, compared with $0.82$ and $3.21^\circ$ for the vision-only model and $0.68$ and $5.13^\circ$ for the EMG-only model. It also outperformed the evaluated representative unimodal baselines and alternative fusion designs. DoF-wise analyses showed larger fusion gains for visually ambiguous joints and viewing conditions, while synthetic visual occlusion demonstrated greater robustness than vision-only estimation. These results highlight the complementary value of egocentric vision and forearm HD-sEMG for capturing fine-grained human hand kinematics, with potential applications in human demonstration acquisition and dexterous robot learning.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉+前臂HD-sEMG的多模态框架，用DoF查询Transformer融合，从第一人称RGB与128通道肌电连续回归20个手部关节角，R²=0.88、MAE=2.80°，优于单模态与替代融合设计。
AI.motivation: 单手部运动学估计对自然人机交互和获取细粒度人手操作示范（可作具身智能数据集与灵巧机器人学习的动作监督）很重要，但单一感知模态在多变工况下不可靠：视觉受遮挡与视角歧义影响，肌电受电极位移与个体差异影响，因此需要互补的多模态融合。
AI.method: 免指部佩戴的多模态连续回归框架：ViT视觉编码器处理第一人称RGB，Transformer编码128通道前臂高密度表面肌电，再由自由度查询Transformer融合解码器为每个关节DoF分配独立可学习query，实现DoF特定且上下文自适应的视觉-肌电融合以应对不同DoF上两种线索信息量差异。在10名受试者的同步多模态数据上评测，并做DoF级分析、与单模态基线及替代融合设计比较、合成视觉遮挡鲁棒性实验。
AI.result: 融合模型平均R²=0.88、MAE=2.80°；纯视觉0.82/3.21°，纯肌电0.68/5.13°。优于代表性单模态基线和替代融合设计；视觉歧义较大的关节与视角下融合增益更大，合成遮挡下比纯视觉更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 第一人称视觉与前臂HD-sEMG具有明确互补性，可精确捕捉细粒度手部运动学，适用于人类操作示范采集与灵巧机器人学习；主要局限是需前臂肌电设备、受试者规模较小、未在真实机器人闭环中验证。

title: DAPPT: Domain-Aware Policies from Procedural Trajectories for Sim-to-Real Dexterous Tool Use
summary: Sim-to-real RL has achieved impressive results in dexterous manipulation but remains limited to tasks with accurate rigid-body simulation. However, these methods cannot be applied to skills that involve deformable and particles, with which the simulation speed will become too slow for large-scale RL learning. We present DAPPT, a sim-to-real framework for end-to-end dexterous tool-use manipulation skills, e.g., sand scooping, play-dough rod-rolling, without simulating non-rigid materials. Our method learns a domain-aware RL policy by tracking procedural trajectories parameterized by domain parameters, and distills it into an end-to-end domain-aware sensorimotor policy. Furthermore, explicit domain represen-tation enables fast selection of domain parameters that can maximize downstream task performance. We evaluate DAPPT end-to-end on six dexterous manipulation tasks, including sand scooping, play-dough rod-rolling, sand scraping, mouse-wheel scrolling, dispenser pressing, and spray triggering. Our method achieves 1.5-3.8x in task metrics through the best domain parameter and transfers zero-shot to the real world.

AI.tldr: DAPPT：不仿真非刚体（沙、橡皮泥等）的sim-to-real灵巧工具使用框架，通过跟踪域参数化程序轨迹学习域感知RL策略，再蒸馏为端到端传感器运动策略，并利用显式域表示快速选择最优域参数。
AI.motivation: 现有sim-to-real RL在灵巧操作成功但依赖精确刚体仿真，涉及可变形体与颗粒物的任务仿真过慢，难以支撑大规模RL学习，因此需要绕开非刚体仿真。
AI.method: 用域参数（domain parameters）参数化程序化轨迹（procedural trajectories），RL策略通过轨迹跟踪学习，形成域感知策略；随后蒸馏为端到端域感知sensorimotor策略；显式域表示支持快速搜索使下游任务性能最优的域参数。
AI.result: 在六个灵巧操作任务（舀沙、橡皮泥擀棒、刮沙、鼠标滚轮、按压分配器、触发喷壶）上，通过最优域参数取得1.5–3.8倍任务指标提升，并零样本迁移到真实世界。
AI.conclusion: 显式域参数化的轨迹先验可替代非刚体仿真的作用，实现无需仿真可变形材料的灵巧工具使用sim-to-real零样本迁移。

title: Radar Panoptic Transformer: Semantic-Guided Mask Queries for Dynamic Scene Understanding
summary: Automotive radar provides long-range sensing and direct Doppler velocity measurements, but its sparse and non-uniformly sampled point clouds pose significant challenges for panoptic segmentation. Dynamic objects often yield only a few detections amid a dominant static background, providing limiting the geometric cues for separating object instances. We propose \emph{Radar Panoptic Transformer (RPT)}, an end-to-end point-based network that incorporates radar-adaptive feature extraction with semantic-guided mask prediction. Its backbone aggregates pose-aligned temporal context through grouped vector attention and learns per-point neighborhood radii conditioned on range, azimuth, and radar cross section (RCS). Point-wise semantic predictions initialize queries at likely foreground detections and guide masked cross-attention through query-point class agreement, producing instance masks without geometric clustering. An auxiliary RCS-consistency loss matches instance-level statistics between predicted and annotated instances. RPT achieves state-of-the-art performance on RadarScenes with $71.6\%$ mIoU and $82.2\%$ PQ. We further evaluate RPT on MAN TruckScenes, where it outperforms the evaluated baselines in a long-range, full-surround radar setting with sensing ranges up to $230\,\mathrm{m}$. RPT achieves real-time end-to-end inference at $31$\,Hz on RadarScenes, exceeding the sensor frame rate.

AI.tldr: Radar Panoptic Transformer (RPT): 端到端点云全景分割网络，用雷达自适应特征提取（分组向量注意力+按range/azimuth/RCS学习邻域半径）与语义引导的mask预测（语义初始化query、query-point类别一致性引导masked cross-attention、RCS一致性损失），在RadarScenes达71.6% mIoU/82.2% PQ，31Hz实时。
AI.motivation: 车载雷达点云稀疏且非均匀采样，动态目标仅产生少量检测点、被静态背景主导，几何线索不足以区分实例，传统基于几何聚类的方法难以胜任全景分割。
AI.method: 点级骨干用分组向量注意力聚合位姿对齐的时序上下文，并按距离、方位角与RCS预测每点邻域半径；语义分支初始化前景query并以其与点的类别一致性引导masked cross-attention，无需几何聚类直接生成实例mask；附加RCS一致性损失对齐预测与标注实例的统计量。
AI.result: RadarScenes上SOTA：71.6% mIoU、82.2% PQ，单帧推理31Hz（超过传感器帧率）；MAN TruckScenes长距（≤230 m）全周雷达场景优于所有对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 表明语义引导、几何聚类无关的mask范式可有效应对雷达点云稀疏性，并具备实时部署潜力；但仅为感知层分割任务，未有下游规划/控制或实车闭环验证。

title: AstroPIE-53: Towards Understanding Failure Modes of Human Pose Estimation in Space
comment: 4 pages + references, 4 figures. Published in the Proceedings of SPAICE 2026 and i-SAIRAS 2026
summary: Reliable monitoring of astronauts is essential for safety, situational awareness, and autonomous assistance in space missions. While modern computer vision enables accurate human detection and pose estimation on Earth, its robustness in space environments remains largely unquantified due to limited data availability. We present AstroPIE-53, a pilot dataset of 53 annotated astronaut videos collected from publicly available mission footage. To respect copyright restrictions, we release video identifiers, reconstruction scripts, and dense annotations rather than raw videos. The dataset includes bounding boxes, challenge classes, and human-annotated pose failure tags. We benchmark state-of-the-art person detection and pose estimation models under realistic zero-shot deployment conditions and perform the first systematic failure analysis for astronaut monitoring. Our results reveal substantial performance degradation caused by occlusions, unusual body orientations, low contrast, and microgravity motion patterns.

AI.tldr: AstroPIE-53：53 段公开任务影像构建的宇航员监测试点数据集，含检测框、挑战类别与位姿失败标签，并首次系统评估人体检测/位姿估计在太空环境下的零样本失效模式。
AI.motivation: 航天任务中宇航员可靠监测对安全与自主辅助至关重要，但现有计算机视觉模型在微重力、舱内复杂光照与非常规姿态下的鲁棒性缺乏量化数据，公开数据稀缺。
AI.method: 从公开任务影像中采集 53 段视频；因版权仅发布视频标识符、重建脚本与稠密标注（边界框、挑战类别、人工位姿失败标签）；在真实零样本部署条件下基准测试 SOTA 人体检测与位姿估计模型，并做系统性失效分析。
AI.result: 遮挡、非常规身体朝向、低对比度与微重力运动模式导致显著性能下降；首次给出宇航员监测的系统性失效分析。
AI.conclusion: 太空场景下现成人体检出/位姿模型零样本迁移不可靠，需针对性鲁棒性改进；该数据集为后续研究提供标注与评估协议基础。

title: Ocular Recognition: Interoperability, Multi-Resolution, and Spectrum Challenges
comment: Paper submitted to IEEE journal in revision process. Abstract reduces to 1920 characteres
summary: Ocular recognition is typically developed under controlled acquisition conditions, limiting its use in semi-controlled and on-the-move scenarios. A key obstacle is the lack of representative data spanning real-world capture conditions. At a border checkpoint, for example, images may range from low-resolution visible-light periocular crops (RGB) to high-resolution near-infrared iris images (NIR). Using this heterogeneous evidence raises three questions: whether resolution-specific processing improves recognition, how to compare templates from different processing routes, and how to allocate training data across resolution specialists. We investigate resolution-specific processing and parameter sharing using three AdaFace-based architecture families: fixed-resolution specialists; Independent Backbones with Shared Heads (IBSH); and models with resolution-specific front-ends for 40x40, 80x80, and 160x160 inputs, followed by a shared identity trunk and embedding projection. We evaluate each architecture with route-specific training subsets and with a full-pool strategy, in which every specialist uses the complete selected training set. Results reveal a trade-off among same-resolution specialization, cross-resolution interoperability, and common-route re-extraction. Route-specific training produces distinct performance profiles across routes, whereas full-pool training makes route performance more uniform and primarily benefits the 160x160 route. Thus, adding training data does not improve all resolution routes equally.

AI.tldr: 论文在非受控/移动场景的眼周与人眼识别中研究分辨率专用处理与参数共享，比较三种AdaFace架构（固定分辨率专家、独立主干共享头IBSH、分辨率专用前端+共享身份主干）与两种训练数据分配策略。
AI.motivation: 真实边检等半受控场景下图像分辨率差异极大（40x40 RGB眼周裁片到160x160 NIR虹膜），缺乏代表性异构数据；需回答分辨率专用处理是否有效、跨分辨率模板如何比较、训练数据如何在分辨率专家间分配。
AI.method: 基于AdaFace构建三类架构族：固定分辨率专家；Independent Backbones with Shared Heads (IBSH)；40x40/80x80/160x160分辨率专用前端+共享身份主干与嵌入投影。每组架构分别用路径专属训练子集与全池（full-pool）策略训练，并在同分辨率、跨分辨率及共同路径重提取场景下评估。
AI.result: 三种策略间存在权衡：同分辨率专精、跨分辨率互操作性与共同路径重提取性能相互制约。路径专属训练产生各路径差异明显的性能画像；全池训练使各路径性能更均匀，且主要提升160x160路径，说明增加训练数据并非对所有分辨率路径同等有效。
AI.conclusion: 分辨率专用前端+共享身份主干是兼顾跨分辨率互操作与专精的实用折中；数据分配需按路径权衡，均匀增益假设不成立。

title: Streaming across viewing conditions - The effect of viewing distance and display luminance on video quality
summary: The visibility of streamed video distortions is affected by the user's display and viewing conditions, such as their display's luminance or the viewing distance. Distortions become less visible at lower luminance levels or farther viewing distances. However, most image and video quality metrics assume fixed optimal display and viewing conditions, making them insensitive to the viewing conditions. In this work, we demonstrate how existing metrics can be adapted to account for both factors and compare such an adaptation with the metrics that natively model viewing conditions. First, we collected a new video quality dataset, HDR-VDC, which contains streaming distortions in 4K HDR videos. The dataset consists of 12 4K and 4 FHD HDR source video content, each distorted with AV1 encoding and Lanczos upscaling from a lower resolution. The quality loss due to the distortions was measured at two viewing distances, corresponding to 60 and 120 pixels per visual degree, and two display mean luminance levels, varying by a factor of 8 in terms of luminance. Next, we developed a pre-processing framework that lets us adapt many quality metrics so that they can evaluate content across the viewing distances and luminance levels. The framework employs a display model and perceptually uniform encoding, PU21, to account for the effect of display luminance, and perspective projection scaling (PPS) to account for the effect of viewing distance. We used the framework to compare the performance of 35 state-of-the-art metrics. This allowed us to identify a selection of existing quality metrics that can be effectively adapted to account for the viewing conditions.

AI.tldr: 构建HDR视频质量数据集HDR-VDC（4K HDR流媒体失真，2种观看距离×2种显示亮度），并提出一套预处理框架（显示模型+PU21感知均匀编码+PPS透视投影缩放），使35种现有质量指标能感知显示亮度与观看距离，筛选出可有效适配的单目质量指标。
AI.motivation: 主流图像/视频质量指标假设固定最优显示与观看条件，无法反映较低显示亮度或较远观看距离下失真可见度下降的现象，与实际流媒体观看场景不符。
AI.method: 采集HDR-VDC数据集：12段4K+4段FHD HDR源视频，失真为AV1编码与低分辨率Lanczos上采样；在60/120 ppd观看距离与相差8倍的显示平均亮度下测量质量损失。提出预处理框架：显示模型+PU21感知均匀编码建模亮度效应，透视投影缩放（PPS）建模观看距离效应，统一适配已有指标。
AI.result: 用该框架对35种SOTA质量指标进行跨观看条件性能对比，识别出一批能被有效适配至观看条件的现有指标，并与原生建模观看条件的指标进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: 现有质量指标可通过轻量预处理适配显示亮度与观看距离，适配后部分指标性能可与原生建模观看条件的指标相当或更优，为面向实际观看条件的视频质量评估提供了可复用方案。

title: EvoMem3D: Adaptive-Depth Temporal Representation Memory for Multi-Camera 3D Detection
summary: Modern multi-camera 3D detectors increasingly rely on large Vision Transformer (ViT) image encoders, making repeated full-depth encoding a dominant inference cost even though adjacent driving frames are highly redundant. We present EvoMem3D, an adaptive-depth temporal framework that caches the most recent full-depth detector-interface appearance representation as a read-only anchor and combines it with policy-selected partial features from the current frame. A lightweight pre-encoding controller chooses among semantic encoder exits before image processing, allocating shallow computation to stable frames and deeper computation when the visual state changes. To reuse appearance without carrying stale geometry, we decouple temporal appearance from geometric alignment: current-frame calibration defines the decoder geometry at every timestamp, while a motion-conditioned positional adapter accounts for anchor-to-current ego motion. On nuScenes, EvoMem3D achieves 61.50 NDS and 52.76 mAP while reducing end-to-end latency from 364.4 to 168.7 ms (x2.16) relative to standard dense DETR3D. With StreamPETR, it reaches 61.36 NDS and 52.55 mAP at a x1.92 speedup. Controlled studies isolate the effects of current evidence, temporal reuse, memory correction, and adaptive routing, while our audit confirms that the policy learns to distinguish semantic driving regimes.

AI.tldr: EvoMem3D：面向多相机3D检测的自适应深度时序框架，缓存上一帧全深度检测器接口外观表征作为只读锚点，结合当前帧按策略选择的部分特征，并用预编码控制器决定语义编码器出口深度，实现2倍以上推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现代多相机3D检测器依赖大型ViT图像编码器，重复的全深度编码成为推理主成本，而相邻驾驶帧高度冗余，需在保持精度的前提下削减冗余计算。
AI.method: 以最近一次全深度检测器接口外观表征为只读锚点，与当前帧策略选择的部分特征组合；轻量预编码控制器在图像处理前选择语义编码器出口，稳定帧走浅层、视觉状态变化时走深层；解耦时序外观与几何对齐——当前帧标定定义每个时刻的解码器几何，运动条件位置适配器补偿锚点到当前帧的自车运动。
AI.result: nuScenes上达61.50 NDS / 52.76 mAP，端到端时延由364.4 ms降至168.7 ms（×2.16），相对稠密DETR3D；用于StreamPETR达61.36 NDS / 52.55 mAP，×1.92加速。消融分离了当前证据、时序复用、记忆校正与自适应路由的贡献，审计显示策略可区分语义驾驶状态。
AI.conclusion: 通过外观缓存+自适应编码深度+几何解耦，可在多相机3D检测中实现约2倍加速且精度基本无损，为时序冗余的ViT编码提供实用加速范式。

title: Right Goal, Wrong Body: Re-grounding Frozen VLAs under Actuation Shift
comment: Accepted at the SPAIS Workshop at CoRL 2026
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are capable of producing desired robotic behaviors in ideal settings. However, they often fail when the robot's actuation changes at deployment. For example, remounting, mechanical wear, or command latency changes can lead to failed tasks and unsafe behaviors. To address the inevitable actuation shift, we propose ReGround, an inference-time method that keeps the VLA frozen and re-grounds its intended motion. ReGround learns the deployed robot's dynamics from task-agnostic motor babbling, and then tracks the policy's intended motion while staying close to the policy's own plan. ReGround activates only upon detecting a shift, and needs no rewards, demonstrations, or retraining. We show via two VLAs, eight LIBERO tasks, and five shift settings that ReGround can restore near-oracle success, such as raising $\pi_{0.5}$'s success from 0.16 to 0.90 under 400 ms latency, while remaining safer than a linear-calibration baseline. Project website and open-source code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: ReGround: 冻结VLA，在推理时通过无任务导向的电机扰动(motor babbling)在线学习部署机器人的动力学，并在检测到执行机构偏移(actuation shift)时跟踪策略的意图运动、同时贴近策略原计划，从而恢复任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在理想条件下能产生期望的机器人行为，但部署时执行机构发生变化（重新安装、机械磨损、指令延迟）会导致失败与不安全行为；这类执行偏移不可避免，而重训练或微调成本高且需奖励/示教。
AI.method: 推理时方法，VLA本体保持冻结。1) 通过任务无关的motor babbling采集数据，学习已部署机器人的实际动力学；2) 将策略输出的意图运动重新"落地"(re-ground)，即在跟踪策略预期轨迹的同时保持与策略自身计划的接近；3) 仅在检测到shift时激活，无需奖励、示教或重训练。
AI.result: 在两种VLA、8个LIBERO任务、5种偏移设置上验证；可将π0.5在400 ms延迟下的成功率从0.16恢复到0.90，接近oracle水平，且安全性优于线性标定基线。
AI.conclusion: 面向执行机构偏移的推理时重定位方法可有效恢复VLA部署鲁棒性，成本低（无需重训练/奖励/示教），并具备更好的安全性；提供了开源代码与项目网站。

title: Self-supervised learning for zebrafish embryo phenotype evaluation: Systematic comparison of algorithms, label-efficient classification, and transfer learning
summary: Zebrafish embryos are a prominent model organism for image-based phenotyping and especially suited for large-scale imaging studies, for which machine learning (ML) models can automate evaluation. However, training ML models usually requires large labeled datasets, and differences in imaging conditions often impede reuse across laboratories. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses both constraints by learning transferable representations from unlabeled images. Yet central aspects like the choice of algorithm remain underexplored for domain-specific applications. To close this gap, we benchmark popular SSL algorithms on the public EmbryoNet dataset, explore label-efficient learning, and test transfer to an unseen setting. Using representations from our strongest model, a ResNet50 network trained with SwAV, a simple linear classifier reaches 86.4% accuracy and a non-linear classifier 87.1%, rivaling the fully supervised EmbryoNet model (87.1%). The SwAV model decisively outperforms supervised training from scratch when labels are scarce (70.2% vs. 45.7% accuracy with 5% of labels). On a three-class problem (normal, dead, falsely cropped) with a small, previously unseen zebrafish toxicity dataset, recorded in a different setting, our model reaches 81.3% accuracy without retraining, while EmbryoNet achieves 75.9%. Overall, self-supervised models for zebrafish embryos seem to mostly facilitate label-efficiency and transfer to new settings rather than improving supervised results.

AI.tldr: 在EmbryoNet斑马鱼胚胎数据集上系统性基准了多种自监督学习(SSL)算法，发现SwAV+ResNet50表示配合线性分类器可达86.4%、非线性分类器87.1%，与全监督EmbryoNet持平；在仅5%标签时70.2%远超从零监督的45.7%，并在未见条件下的三分类毒性数据上零重训迁移达81.3%。
AI.motivation: 斑马鱼胚胎是图像表型分析的重要模式生物，适合大规模成像研究，但训练ML模型需大量标注数据，且成像条件差异阻碍跨实验室复用。SSL可从无标注图像学习可迁移表示以缓解这两点，但算法选择等关键因素在领域特定应用中缺乏探索。
AI.method: 在公开EmbryoNet数据集上基准多种主流SSL算法，评估标签高效学习(5%标签)与跨设置迁移；用最强模型(SwAV训练的ResNet50)提取特征，接线性与非线性分类器；并在一个小规模、不同成像设置、此前未见的斑马鱼毒性数据集上零重训评估三分类(normal/dead/falsely cropped)。
AI.result: 线性分类86.4%、非线性87.1%，追平全监督EmbryoNet的87.1%；5%标签下SwAV为70.2% vs 从零监督45.7%；跨设置零重训迁移81.3%，高于EmbryoNet的75.9%。
AI.conclusion: SSL在斑马鱼胚胎图像上的主要价值在于标签效率与跨设置迁移，而非提升全监督精度上限；研究属于领域专用视觉方法学基准。

title: DexFormer 2.0: Towards a Cross-Embodiment Foundation Policy for Dexterous Grasping
summary: Dexterous grasping policies are usually trained for one arm paired with one hand. Every new pairing then needs its own policy, and the number of policies grows with every arm and hand added. We ask whether a single policy can control many arm-hand combinations and transfer to pairings and hands it has never seen. This is hard because robots differ in the number, layout, and dynamics of their joints, so their observations and actions share no common interface. We present DexFormer 2.0, a single reinforcement learning policy for cross-embodiment dexterous grasping. It maps every robot to a canonical joint interface with validity masks, encodes each joint's morphology with attention biased by the kinematic tree, and uses a Transformer-XL memory to infer embodiment-dependent dynamics from recent interaction. Trained on 18 combinations of four arms and six hands, it reaches 89% stable success on seen combinations and 51% on six held-out arm-hand pairs, outperforming GRU and DexFormer 1.0 baselines. Without fine-tuning, it also grasps with four new hand types and, through retargeting, with parallel grippers.
