Ablations show that memory, the kinematic-tree bias, and broader pairing coverage each matter for transfer. On a physical Flexiv arm, distilled students transfer zero-shot from simulation with two hands, including a held-out pair. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: DexFormer 2.0: 单一强化学习策略通过规范化关节接口、运动树偏置注意力与 Transformer-XL 记忆，实现跨本体（4臂×6手共18组合）灵巧抓取，零微调泛化到未见手型与夹爪，并蒸馏上真机。
AI.motivation: 灵巧抓取策略通常为单一"臂+手"配对专门训练，臂与手数量增加时策略数量爆炸；不同机器人关节数量、布局与动力学差异导致观测与动作缺乏共同接口，难以共享一个策略。
AI.method: 将每个机器人映射到带有效性掩码的规范关节接口；用受运动学树偏置的注意力编码各关节形态；用 Transformer-XL 记忆从近期交互中推断本体相关动力学。在 4 臂×6 手共 18 种组合上训练单一 RL 策略，并做消融（记忆、树偏置、配对覆盖度）与策略蒸馏到实体 Flexiv 机械臂。
AI.result: 已见组合稳定成功率 89%，6 组留出臂-手对达 51%，优于 GRU 与 DexFormer 1.0；零微调下可用 4 种新手型抓取，并通过重定向用于平行夹爪；消融显示记忆、运动学树偏置和更广配对覆盖对迁移均有贡献。物理 Flexiv 机械臂上，蒸馏学生策略从仿真零样本迁移至两种手（含一对留出组合）。
AI.conclusion: 跨本体的统一关节表征 + 形态感知注意力 + 记忆机制可让单一策略覆盖多种臂手组合并具备一定零样本迁移能力，为通用灵巧操作策略提供了可行路径。

title: Beyond AUC: Do Mammography Risk Models Predict When Cancer Occurs?
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ISBI 2027
summary: Longitudinal deep learning models for mammography-based breast cancer risk prediction output either per-year cumulative risks or a discrete distribution over the year of diagnosis, from which cumulative risks F1,...,F5 are derived. These models are evaluated almost exclusively with year-wise AUCs and the concordance index. We show that these metrics are largely insensitive to when cancer occurs: they can be high even for a model that carries no information about the year of diagnosis. We re-evaluate two recent longitudinal models (OA-BreaCR, LMV-Net) on CSAW-CC with a 5-year horizon using timing metrics computed on cancer cases only. Despite C-indices up to 0.75, neither orders cancer cases by time to diagnosis significantly better than chance (c_time 0.51 and 0.55, both 95% CIs covering 0.5). Weighted absolute timing error favours a constant "year 3" prediction over both models, so we use c_time as the primary timing metric. For Mirai's additive-hazard head, also used by LMV-Net, we analyse how per-year increments passed through a ReLU can collapse under severe class imbalance. We also propose a breast-level, two-stage model that separates whether from when. It matches LMV-Net in discrimination (C-index 0.745 vs. 0.746) but orders cancer cases better (c_time 0.58 vs. 0.51, paired 95% CI of the difference 0.01-0.13), on par with Mirai's published weights (0.57).

AI.tldr: 该文指出乳腺X线纵向风险预测模型常用的逐年AUC与C-index对\"何时发病\"不敏感，提出仅在癌症病例上计算的时序指标c_time，并据此重评OA-BreaCR与LMV-Net，进而提出两级\"是否+何时\"模型。
AI.motivation: 现有纵向风险模型的评测几乎只用逐年AUC与C-index，即使模型不包含任何诊断年份信息也可能获得高分，缺乏对时间预测能力的检验；同时ReLU加性风险头在严重类别不平衡下可能出现逐年增量坍缩。
AI.method: 在CSAW-CC上以5年跨度重评OA-BreaCR与LMV-Net，使用仅在癌症病例上计算的时序指标（c_time、加权绝对时间误差）；分析Mirai加性风险头中ReLU后逐年增量的坍缩机制；提出乳腺级两阶段模型，将\"是否患病\"与\"何时患病\"解耦。
AI.result: 尽管C-index可达0.75，两模型对癌症病例的时间排序均未显著优于随机（c_time 0.51、0.55，95%CI均覆盖0.5）；加权绝对时间误差显示常数\"第3年\"预测优于两模型；两阶段模型判别力与LMV-Net相当（C-index 0.745 vs 0.746），时间排序更优（c_time 0.58 vs 0.51，配对95%CI 0.01–0.13），与Mirai公开权重（0.57）持平。
AI.conclusion: 逐年AUC/C-index不足以评价纵向风险模型的时间判别力，应引入癌症病例专属时序指标；显式解耦\"是否\"与\"何时\"的两阶段建模可在保持判别力的同时提升时间排序。

title: Visual Marking as a Native Reasoning Capability for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Visual reasoning often requires maintaining intermediate spatial states that are difficult to express in text. Existing approaches either rely on external drawing tools or image generators, or encode these states in latent tokens without explicit spatial correspondence to the input image. We introduce SelfMark, which enables MLLMs to construct and use visual marks directly in their native visual feature space. By treating the visual token grid as a canvas, SelfMark establishes explicit spatial correspondence between marks and images. This is achieved through a locate-mark-read procedure, where the model identifies relevant locations, constructs task-dependent mark features, and reads the resulting visual features to guide its reasoning. We jointly train a single model on spatial planning, dense counting, high-resolution VQA, and line tracing. Across six benchmarks, SelfMark outperforms state-of-the-art MLLM-based methods specialized for individual tasks. These improvements also persist with a stronger backbone, demonstrating the effectiveness of visual marking across different model capabilities. Overall, SelfMark provides a unified approach to visual reasoning by integrating spatially grounded marks directly into the visual feature space of MLLMs.

AI.tldr: SelfMark 让多模态大模型在自身视觉 token 网格（画布）上直接构造任务相关的视觉标记，通过 locate-mark-read 流程建立标记与图像的空间对应，统一支持空间规划、密集计数、高分辨率 VQA 和线条追踪。
AI.motivation: 视觉推理需要维护难以用文本表达的中间空间状态；现有方法依赖外部绘图工具/图像生成器，或把状态编码进缺乏显式空间对应的隐 token，导致标记与输入图像无法一一对齐。
AI.method: 以视觉 token 网格为画布，采用 locate（定位相关位置）—mark（构造任务相关标记特征注入视觉特征空间）—read（读取带标记的视觉特征用于推理）三步流程；单一模型在空间规划、密集计数、高分辨率 VQA、线条追踪四类任务上联合训练。
AI.result: 在六个基准上超过针对单项任务专门设计的最先进 MLLM 方法；换成更强主干后增益依然保持，说明视觉标记机制在不同能力模型上均有效。
AI.conclusion: SelfMark 通过把空间落地的标记直接整合进 MLLM 的视觉特征空间，提供了统一的视觉推理范式，避免了对外部工具或无空间对应隐 token 的依赖。

title: CiGS: Conduction in Gaussian Splats for Interior Temperature Field from Thermal Images
summary: We present a method for inferring the interior temperature distribution of a solid object from registered multi-view visible-spectrum and thermal images, even when the thermal views cover only part of its surface. We formulate steady-state heat conduction as a Laplace boundary value problem and solve it with a direct boundary integral equation discretized over a point cloud: a Gaussian reconstruction of the visible-spectrum images supplies the boundary geometry, and the thermal images supply the boundary data. We do not build surface or volume meshes at any stage in our method. Instead, we sample collocation points from rendered depth without the pixels at depth discontinuities, and use a density subtraction that keeps the interior evaluation accurate up to the surface. The whole chain is differentiable, and we use it to recover the pose and depth of heating pipes, insulation defects, and the shape of cracks from thermal images. We validate our method through experiments on boundary value problems with Dirichlet-only and mixed Dirichlet and Robin boundaries, using synthetic and real captured data on scenes with challenging topology. These experiments show that our method matches analytical solutions and has better accuracy than FEM solvers.

AI.tldr: 提出无需网格的边界积分方程方法，从多视角可见光与热成像推断固体内部温度场，并可微分化以反推管道位姿/深度、隔热缺陷与裂纹形状。
AI.motivation: 热视图常只覆盖部分表面，而传统有限元/边界元需要表面或体网格，网格生成困难且难以对不同iable方式嵌入逆问题求解管道识别、缺陷检测等任务。
AI.method: 将稳态热传导建模为Laplace边值问题，用点云离散的直接边界积分方程求解；可见光图像经高斯重建给出边界几何，热图像提供Dirichlet/Robin边界数据；从渲染深度中剔除深度不连续像素采样配点，采用密度扣除（density subtraction）保证贴近表面的内部解精度；全链路可微，用于反演加热管道位姿与深度、绝缘缺陷及裂纹形状。
AI.result: 在Dirichlet与混合Dirichlet-Robin边值问题上，用合成与真实采集数据、含复杂拓扑场景验证，结果与解析解一致，精度优于FEM求解器。
AI.conclusion: 无网格、可微的边界积分框架能有效从部分覆盖的热图像推断内部温度场，并支撑热成像逆问题的端到端几何参数恢复。

title: Ontology-Compiled Control Barrier Functions for Heterogeneous Robot Teams
summary: Safety filters for heterogeneous robot teams fail because of missing constraints, overestimated braking capabilities and conflicts between individually satisfiable constraints. We present OntoCBF, which compiles a domain ontology with a class taxonomy, typed relations, safety axioms and a dynamics profile per robot class into a control barrier function filter with one quadratic program per agent. Description-logic entailment supplies the constraints of any team online, including those that follow from chains of relations and from classes defined by what a robot carries, so the existing safety axioms cover new robot classes, payload classes and combinations. We prove that a subclass may reuse the braking capability of its parent whenever it can produce every velocity of the parent, a property separate from subsumption. For box-bounded double integrators this property is also necessary, and every loss of safety then begins with a conflict. Once three robots interact, the safe set of pairwise barriers contains states from which a collision is unavoidable, and such states persist in larger teams under any fixed capability reduction. In a simulated warehouse where humans ignore the robots, a filter written for the design classes violates safety in 89-100 % of the episodes with unseen classes. In all scenarios, including one with 32 robots, OntoCBF violates safety in 20-70 % of the episodes, each time after a conflict, with a median deepest intrusion of 10-17 % of the keep-out distance. A multi-agent PPO policy trained with the filter in the loop lowers the rate of infeasible quadratic programs, nearly all of them conflicts, by 18-41 %.

AI.tldr: OntoCBF 将领域本体（类分类、类型化关系、安全公理、各类别动力学画像）编译为每个智能体一个 QP 的 CBF 安全滤波器，用描述逻辑推理在线导出异构机器人团队的安全约束，并证明子类可复用父类刹车能力的一个充分（在箱体约束双积分器下亦为必要）条件。
AI.motivation: 异构机器人团队的安全滤波因三类问题失效：约束缺失、刹车能力被高估、以及各自可满足约束之间的冲突。现有方法无法在团队组成变化（新机型、新载荷、新组合）时自动、在线地生成与继承安全约束。
AI.method: 用本体描述机器人类别与"所携带载荷"定义的类别，类型化关系链经描述逻辑蕴含在线推出约束；安全公理 + 每类动力学画像编译成 CBF-QP（每智能体一个）；提出子类复用父类刹车能力的充分条件（"能产生父类所有速度"，独立于概念包含关系），并证明在箱体界双积分器下该条件必要；分析三体及以上交互时成对 CBF 安全集中的不可避免碰撞态；在人类不避让的仓储仿真（含 32 机器人场景）中评估，并用多智能体 PPO 将滤波器置于训练回路。
AI.result: 仅按设计类编写的滤波器在出现未见类别时 89–100% 回合违反安全；OntoCBF 在所有场景（含 32 机器人）20–70% 回合违反，且均发生在冲突之后，最深侵入中位数仅为禁入距离的 10–17%；在回路训练将不可行 QP 率降低 18–41%。
AI.conclusion: 本体的蕴含式约束供给能推广到新类别与组合，安全性能的失效阈值由"冲突"而非"约束缺失"决定；但方法本身并未在这些场景中消除冲突引起的安全违反，需结合策略学习（回路内 PPO）缓解。属于多机器人安全滤波的机制性工作，与 VLA/3D 重建等主线关联较弱。

title: PoCoAttn: Position-Content Collaborative Sparse Attention for Fast and High-Fidelity Video Generation
comment: 21 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Video diffusion transformers rely on 3D full attention over tens of thousands of spatiotemporal tokens, and its quadratic cost dominates inference latency. Sparse attention reduces this cost, but existing methods face a dilemma: static methods apply predefined masks and cannot capture input-dependent attention, whereas dynamic methods reconstruct the sparse mask repeatedly, paying online to rediscover positional structure that is largely stable across inputs. To this end, we propose PoCoAttn, a training-free sparse attention framework that separates input-stable from input-dependent attention and resolves the former offline and the latter online. PoCoAttn features: (1) A relative-offset analysis of 3D query-key pairs, which shows that video attention decomposes into an input-stable positional prior that carries most of the attention mass and a small content-dependent residual. (2) A position-content collaborative sparse attention mechanism, which retrieves positional keys from offline-calibrated tables, selects content keys online with a head-adaptive ratio between the two sources, and compensates for the discarded keys to approximate full attention. (3) A step-adaptive budget allocation algorithm, which models how early-step sparse attention errors are amplified along the denoising trajectory and derives the optimal sparsity budget per step. Extensive experiments across four video diffusion models and three tasks show that PoCoAttn consistently achieves a better speed-fidelity Pareto frontier than state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, improving PSNR by 1.9 to 5.0 dB over baselines and delivering up to 4.1$\times$ attention and 2.0$\times$ denoising speedups over dense FlashAttention-3 attention.

AI.tldr: PoCoAttn：免训练的稀疏注意力框架，将视频扩散Transformer的3D注意力分解为输入稳定的位置先验（离线校准表检索）与内容相关的残差（在线选取），并配合步自适应稀疏预算分配，实现最高4.1倍注意力加速与1.9-5.0 dB PSNR提升。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer的3D全注意力对数十万时空token呈二次复杂度，主导推理延迟。静态稀疏掩码无法适应输入，动态方法则每次重建掩码、重复付出在线代价；作者观察到位置结构在跨输入上基本稳定，因此希望把"稳定部分"离线化、"依赖输入部分"在线化。
AI.method: (1) 对3D query-key对做相对偏移分析，证明视频注意力可分解为承载大部分注意力质量的稳定位置先验与小的内容残差；(2) 位置-内容协同稀疏注意力：从离线校准表检索位置key，在线选择内容key，采用head自适应比例分配二者预算，并对丢弃key做补偿以逼近全注意力；(3) 步自适应预算分配，建模早期去噪步稀疏误差沿轨迹的放大效应，推导每步最优稀疏预算。全程无需训练。
AI.result: 在4个视频扩散模型、3类任务上，PoCoAttn 的速度-保真度帕累托前沿优于SOTA方法，PSNR较基线提升1.9-5.0 dB，相对稠密FlashAttention-3实现最高4.1倍注意力加速与2.0倍去噪加速。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种将输入稳定先验离线化、内容残差在线化的免训练稀疏注意力范式，为视频扩散模型推理加速提供了新思路；但其评测限于生成保真度指标，尚未涉及机器人策略、世界模型rollout或3D重建等具身应用验证。

title: NF-VLA: A Normalizing-Flow Baseline for Vision-Language-Action Learning
summary: Autoregressive normalizing flows (NFs) provide a tractable density for learning and sampling continuous robot actions. We show that a single maximum-likelihood objective can train vision--language--action (VLA) policies competitive with leading methods on manipulation benchmarks. We present NF-VLA, which combines conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with score-based action refinement. Its deep--shallow architecture concentrates visual, language, and proprioceptive prefix conditioning in a high-capacity deep block, while unconditioned shallow blocks provide a shared invertible action transformation. The vision--language backbone and flow are jointly trained by exact maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks. The same learned density supplies a single score-based correction at inference, refining generated actions to account for training-time smoothing without a separately trained denoiser. Trained on LIBERO from a pretrained vision--language backbone without robot pretraining, NF-VLA achieves 98.35\% success across the four standard suites and 72.6\% on LIBERO-Plus using the same checkpoint without further fine-tuning. Ablations show that deep-only prefix conditioning and score-based refinement both improve closed-loop success. Together, these results establish carefully structured autoregressive flows as a competitive approach to VLA control, with one learned density supporting policy training, action generation, and refinement.

AI.tldr: NF-VLA用条件自回归归一化流（NF）建模动作块密度，以单一精确极大似然目标联合训练VLA主干，并用学到的密度在推理时做一次score-based修正，在LIBERO上达98.35%。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流匹配等生成式VLA多依赖启发式目标或多阶段训练，能否用单一可处理的似然目标既训练策略又生成并精化动作，尚未被充分验证。
AI.method: 深-浅架构的自回归归一化流：深层块承载视觉-语言-本体感知前缀条件，浅层无条件块提供共享可逆动作变换；VLA主干与流以高斯平滑动作块上的精确极大似然联合训练；推理时复用同一密度做单步score-based校正，替代单独训练的去噪器。
AI.result: 在LIBERO四个标准套件上98.35%成功率，同一checkpoint在LIBERO-Plus上72.6%（无额外微调）；消融显示仅深层前缀条件与score精化均提升闭环成功率。
AI.conclusion: 结构化自回归流可作为有竞争力的VLA控制范式，单一人学习密度同时支持策略训练、动作生成与精化。

title: Course-Referenced Lateral Control of Trail-Following Convoys: String Stability and Adaptive Feedforward under Load Uncertainty
summary: Vehicles in a convoy can steer along the GNSS trails of the vehicles ahead when lane markings are unavailable, as on snow covered roads. Since each vehicle's tracking error enters the reference of the next, lateral errors can grow along the convoy. This paper presents a course referenced formulation of trail following in arc length, in which each follower takes the direction of its fitted trail as its heading reference. Error propagation then reduces to a single transfer function. We derive a condition under which combining the trails of the leader and the predecessor keeps the errors bounded for any convoy length, and show that following the predecessor alone lets the errors accumulate without bound, even without amplification, on roads that end turned or shifted sideways. Passenger and cargo loads and tire stiffness vary in practice, and we show that they enter the curvature feedforward through a single coefficient, whose mismatch leaves steady offsets on curves. We propose an adaptive law that estimates this coefficient on curves and removes the offsets. Simulations of an eleven vehicle convoy confirm the analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出弧长域"航向参考"式轨迹跟随建模，将车队横向误差传播化为单一传递函数；给出融合领航车与前车轨迹即有界跟随的条件，并设计自适应律在线估计载荷/轮胎刚度相关曲率前馈系数以消除弯道稳态偏移。
AI.motivation: 雪覆盖等无车道线场景下，车辆需沿前车GNSS轨迹行驶；但每辆车的跟踪误差会进入后车参考，导致横向误差沿车队累积甚至无界增长，且载荷与轮胎刚度变化带来弯道稳态偏移，缺乏可分析、可补偿的统一框架。
AI.method: 采用弧长参数化的course-referenced轨迹跟随表述，以拟合轨迹切向作为航向参考，使误差传播退化为单一传递函数；理论上推导领航车+前车轨迹组合的误差有界性条件，并证明仅跟随前车的误差累积性；识别载荷与胎侧刚度的单一曲率前馈系数，提出在线自适应估计律。
AI.result: 证明混合领航车与前车轨迹可使任意车队长度下误差有界；仅跟随前车则在"末端转向或侧移"道路上误差无界累积（即便无放大）；自适应律可在弯道估计系数并消除稳态偏移；11车仿真验证。
AI.conclusion: 给出可解析的车队轨迹跟随误差传播理论与保证有界性的轨迹融合准则，并提供可落地的参数自适应补偿方案；结论目前由仿真支撑，尚待实车验证。

title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables. Extended version of a paper at the Sim2Science workshop, NeurIPS 2026. Code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record: this https URL
summary: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Using a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator on SPEED+, the paper probes the synthetic-to-real gap in spacecraft pose estimation: calibration confidence collapses on real images (90% coverage → 9–38%), transfer is asymmetric (data/feature scaling helps synthetic domain but barely moves harshly lit sunlamp, while last-stage backbone adaptation transfers 63–83% of the gain), and photometric augmentation only helps in the lighting direction it models.
AI.motivation: Vision-based on-orbit navigation must train on simulated imagery because labelled real in-flight images are scarce; simulators are inherently misspecified (radiometric error: missing specular highlights, hard shadows, sensor saturation), so the synthetic-to-real gap is the central risk. The paper asks how that gap manifests—especially in calibration confidence—and which levers (backbone adaptation vs. photometric augmentation) actually close it.
AI.method: 2×2 pre-registered study (backbone adaptation × photometric augmentation) with a simple monocular pose estimator trained on SPEED+ synthetic data and tested on two real hardware-in-the-loop domains (sunlamp, lightbox). Analyses include conformal calibration coverage of rotation errors, seed variance-controlled comparisons, and stage-wise backbone adaptation isolation.
AI.result: (1) Severe mis-calibration on real domains: synthetic-90% conformal regions cover only 9–15% (sunlamp) and 21–38% (lightbox) of rotation errors. (2) Asymmetric transfer: scaling data/features cut synthetic rotation error 1.65→1.03 rad but only 0.05 rad on sunlamp (<2× seed s.d.); adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63–83% of the synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, photometric augmentation helped only the diffusely lit lightbox (1.17→0.99 rad consistently across seeds) and did not beat seed variance on sunlamp; frozen backbone helped sunlamp more.
AI.conclusion: Synthetic-to-real transfer for spacecraft pose estimation cannot be inferred from synthetic metrics; confidence is systematically over-optimistic on real imagery, and effective transfer requires backbone adaptation rather than data/feature scaling, with augmentation value conditional on lighting regime. Code, per-image predictions, and pre-registration record are released.

title: High-Speed Forward and Reverse Tractor-Trailer Driving with Learned Vehicle Dynamics
comment: The first three authors contributed equally to this work. Project page: this https URL
summary: Tractor-trailer systems are difficult to control, especially unstable during reverse motion, and their dynamics depend on difficult-to-measure factors, including road friction and suspension coefficients. We introduce a learned dynamics model for tractor-trailer control and compare it with a reduced-order dynamics model with Fiala tire forces as an analytic baseline. Specifically, we compare a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller that uses the learned dynamics model to an MPPI controller that uses the analytic model, as well as to three additional baseline controllers. In the main closed-loop tracking experiments across four simulated environments, MPPI with learned dynamics achieves mean speeds closer to the target magnitudes and lower root-mean-square (RMS) hitch angles than MPPI with the analytic model at every tested setpoint, with higher completion rates in seven of eight reverse configurations.

AI.tldr: Learned dynamics model for tractor-trailer control; MPPI with learned dynamics beats analytic Fiala-tire reduced-order model and three other baselines in closed-loop tracking.
AI.motivation: Tractor-trailer systems are hard to control, especially in reverse, and their dynamics depend on hard-to-measure parameters such as road friction and suspension coefficients; an analytic reduced-order model cannot capture these effects.
AI.method: Learn a dynamics model for the tractor-trailer and embed it in a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller. Compare against MPPI with a reduced-order analytic model using Fiala tire forces, plus three additional baseline controllers, in closed-loop tracking across four simulated environments (forward and reverse setpoints).
AI.result: Learned-dynamics MPPI achieves mean speeds closer to target magnitudes and lower RMS hitch angles than the analytic-model MPPI at every tested setpoint, with higher completion rates in seven of eight reverse configurations.
AI.conclusion: Learned dynamics + sampling-based MPC improves tractor-trailer tracking over reduced-order analytic models, particularly for the unstable reverse regime, suggesting data-driven models can compensate for unmodeled friction/suspension effects.

title: Sidewalk Stewards: A Visual Analytics Approach for Interactive Topology Repair of Sidewalk Networks
summary: Accurate pedestrian network data is foundational to urban accessibility, routing, and infrastructure planning, yet such data remains scarce and difficult to produce at scale. Automated extraction pipelines have made significant strides by leveraging computer vision to derive sidewalk networks from aerial imagery, and have seen real-world adoption by municipalities seeking cost-effective inventory solutions. Yet, these pipelines consistently produce topological errors (e.g., disconnected components, dangling edges, missed connections, malformed intersections) that undermine the utility of the extracted networks for routing and accessibility analysis. Correcting these errors requires situated human judgment that global automated repair strategies cannot replicate, yet practitioners currently lack dedicated tools to support this work efficiently. We present Sidewalk Stewards, a visual analytics system that bridges the gap between automated extraction and a deployment-ready pedestrian network. Sidewalk Stewards detects candidate topology errors, supports interactive user-guided correction through coordinated spatial views, and provides real-time quality feedback as edits are applied. We evaluate Sidewalk Stewards through a comparative user study, case studies across cities, and a quantitative evaluation. Compared with conventional workflows, the system facilitates error identification and enables faster and more complete correction. The case studies illustrate the workflow across different urban contexts, and the quantitative evaluation shows that a small number of user corrections can enhance multiple sidewalk quality metrics. Sidewalk Stewards is available at this http URL .

AI.tldr: Sidewalk Stewards：面向自动化提取人行道网络的可视分析纠错系统，检测拓扑错误、多视图交互式修正并提供实时质量反馈。
AI.motivation: CV 自动提取的通勤网络常用于路由与可达性分析，但普遍存在断开连通分量、悬挂边、漏连、畸形交叉等拓扑错误；这类错误依赖情境化人工判断，全局自动修复策略无法替代，而业界缺乏高效支持该工作的专用工具。
AI.method: 构建可视分析系统：自动检测候选拓扑错误；通过协调的空间视图支持用户引导式交互修正；编辑过程中实时反馈网络质量指标；并以比较型用户研究、多城市案例研究与定量评估进行验证。已开源（附 URL）。
AI.result: 对比传统流程，系统更快地识别错误、修正更完整；跨城市案例展示不同城市场景下的工作流适配性；定量结果显示少量人工修正即可提升多项人行道网络质量指标。
AI.conclusion: "自动提取 + 人在回路修正"是通往可部署人行道网络的可行范式；HCI/可视化工具层面即可显著提升下游路由与可达性分析的可用性，适合市政低成本入库场景。

title: Words Speak Louder? Exploring the Language Shortcut of LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Learning
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Is a face or a voice still heard once the words are known? Incomplete multimodal learning increasingly uses large language models (LLMs) as fusion engines: modality features enter as token blocks and missing modalities become placeholders. We find that LLM-driven fusion can override non-verbal evidence it can read. Contrasting its full-input prediction with counterfactual views, the same model shown one modality or no content, we identify language shortcuts. We build MR-Bench: MR-Bench-A types every test sample of four sentiment benchmarks; MR-Bench-H contains 900 human-validated clips (620 language-shortcut, LS; 280 non-verbal-shortcut, NS) from seven sources, and every model is scored on all of them. Zero-shot MLLMs solve at most 32.7% of the LS clips; adding the transcript to the muted video lowers vision-language accuracy by 46.1-53.1 points. Yet inverting a text-only model's answers solves 94.4%, so LS accuracy alone cannot establish use of non-verbal evidence. Inside the fusion LLM, fused states align increasingly with the text view late in the decoder. Counterfactual-View Reliability learning (CoVeR) trains views as unimodal judges and withholds fused supervision where they disagree. It achieves state-of-the-art results on five benchmarks without extra inference cost in accuracy mode. On MR-Bench-H, it reaches 61.7% LS and 93.6% NS accuracy; robust mode raises LS accuracy to 63.0% while lowering NS accuracy to 84.8%. Among LS clips solved without text, adding text causes errors on 30.1% with CoVeR versus 32.2% with LLM-Fusion. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 论文发现以LLM为融合引擎的多模态模型存在"语言捷径"：融合结果会压制模型本可读取的非语言（视觉/语音）证据；作者构建MR-Bench（文本转写版+900条人工校验片段）量化该问题，并提出反事实视角可靠性学习CoVeR，以单模态视角作"评委"、在视角不一致时撤销融合监督。
AI.motivation: 不完全多模态学习常用LLM作为融合引擎，缺失模态以占位符注入。作者质疑：当语言信息已知时，面部表情与声音语气是否仍被使用？即融合LLM可能覆盖其本可读取的非语言证据，形成语言捷径。
AI.method: 1) 构造MR-Bench：MR-Bench-A将四个情感基准的测试样本逐条转写为纯文本；MR-Bench-H含900条人工校验视频片段（620条语言捷径LS、280条非语言捷径NS），来自七个数据源，所有模型在同一集合上评分。2) 通过反事实视角（仅单模态、无内容）对比全输入预测以识别语言捷径。3) 分析融合LLM内部表征，发现解码器后期融合状态与文本视角对齐增强。4) 提出CoVeR：将各视角训练为单模态判别器，在视角不一致处撤销融合监督；另提供鲁棒模式。
AI.result: 零样本MLLM在LS片段上最高仅32.7%；在静音视频中加入转写使视觉-语言准确率下降46.1–53.1个百分点；但反转纯文本模型答案即可解出94.4%，说明LS准确率不足以证明使用了非语言证据。CoVeR在五个基准上达SOTA且精度模式无额外推理成本；MR-Bench-H上LS 61.7%、NS 93.6%；鲁棒模式LS升至63.0%、NS降至84.8%；对无文本即可解出的LS片段，加文本导致错误率为30.1%（LLM-Fusion为32.2%）。
AI.conclusion: LLM式融合会系统性偏向文本而抑制非语言线索，单看LS准确率会高估多模态能力。通过单模态视角互相校验并门控融合监督（CoVeR）可显著缓解，但仍未完全消除语言捷径，鲁棒模式存在LS-NS权衡。

title: BlockAlign: Preference Optimization for Trajectory-Distilled Video Generation
summary: Directly aligning trajectory-distilled video generators slashes rollout costs and optimizes the deployed few-step model without teacher fine-tuning or re-distillation. However, conventional flow-matching preference objectives assume single-head local velocity supervision, mismatching the finite-interval, block-average transition interface of trajectory-distilled generators such as Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) and Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD). Naively supervising only the primary initial-subinterval velocity sub-head rather than the fused block-average velocity at block starts (DirectAlign) induces a severe training--inference mismatch that degrades quality below the unaligned baseline. We introduce BlockAlign, an interface-consistent preference optimization framework that constructs states at valid block boundaries, queries the fused block-level velocity predictor, and supervises span-normalized transition residuals-seamlessly supporting DPO-, NFT-, and rollout-style objectives while preserving the native few-step sampler. We further build a unified post-training pipeline integrating offline pairs, reward-free semi-online continuations, and online rollouts with hierarchical preference selection and objective-aware block scheduling. Experiments on multi-reference video generation across MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA and an in-house model RefVid-V4 show that BlockAlign consistently outperforms unaligned distilled models and DirectAlign in structural plausibility, reference consistency, and visual quality. Notably, our approach unlocks PDD's 5x few-step rollout speedup for 3x faster end-to-end online training, achieving statistically significant human preference gains over PDD baselines (54.0% vs. 33.3% wins/losses, or 61.8% non-tie win rate on RefVid-V4; 51.3% vs. 34.7%, or 59.7% non-tie win rate on MiniMax-H3) and up to an 82.7% win rate against DirectAlign.

AI.tldr: 提出 BlockAlign：面向轨迹蒸馏少步视频生成器的接口一致偏好优化框架，在有效 block 边界采样、查询融合后的 block 级速度预测器、监督 span 归一化转移残差，兼容 DPO/NFT/rollout 类目标，保持原生少步采样器。
AI.motivation: 轨迹蒸馏生成器（如 PDD、PTD）采用有限区间、block 平均的转移接口，而传统 flow-matching 偏好优化假设单头局部速度监督；仅监督初始子区间速度子头（DirectAlign）会造成训练-推理失配，效果甚至低于未对齐基线。
AI.method: 在有效 block 边界构造状态；查询融合 block 级速度预测器；监督 span 归一化转移残差，可无缝支持 DPO、NFT 与 rollout 类目标并保留原生少步采样器；构建统一后训练流水线，整合离线偏好对、无奖励半在线续写与在线 rollout，并采用分层偏好选择和目标感知 block 调度。
AI.result: 在多参考视频生成的 MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA 与自研 RefVid-V4 上，BlockAlign 在结构合理性、参考一致性和视觉质量上稳定优于未对齐蒸馏模型与 DirectAlign；释放 PDD 5 倍少步 rollout 加速，端到端在线训练快 3 倍；人类偏好胜率 RefVid-V4 为 54.0%/33.3%（非平局 61.8%），MiniMax-H3 为 51.3%/34.7%（非平局 59.7%），对 DirectAlign 最高 82.7%。
AI.conclusion: 面向蒸馏少步生成器的偏好优化需与推理接口对齐；BlockAlign 以 block 级融合速度监督消除训练-推理失配，显著提升质量与训练效率，但对训练-推理接口匹配的洞察可迁移。

title: Structure-Guided Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer for Efficient Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Existing multi-granularity methods for monocular 3D human pose estimation emphasize spatial joint features while underusing skeletal structure, including global connectivity and temporal continuity. Moreover, modeling entire frame sequences incurs high computational costs. We propose a Structure-Aware Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer that integrates structural priors across spatial and temporal representations for accurate and efficient pose estimation. A three-level feature extractor captures human topology at the joint, bone, and limb levels. Gated Adaptive Spatial Attention (GASA) embeds structural constraints into spatial attention, while Multi-Granularity Feature Enhancement (MGFE) uses hierarchical pooling and fusion to strengthen local details and global semantics. Temporal Segment Fusion (TSF) aligns temporal contexts across granularities to capture both short- and long-range motion patterns. Hierarchical Cross-Attention (HCA) promotes spatiotemporal interaction between granularities, and Keyframe Attention (KFA) selects informative motion segments to reduce redundancy and computational cost. Experiments demonstrate improved accuracy and efficiency over conventional Transformer-based approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of structure-aware multi-granularity modeling for monocular 3D human pose estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知多粒度时空Transformer：三级拓扑特征提取+门控自适应空间注意力+多粒度特征增强+时序片段融合+分层交叉注意力+关键帧注意力，用于单目3D人体姿态估计，兼顾精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有多粒度单目3D人体姿态估计方法偏重空间关节特征，忽视骨架结构先验（全局连通性与时序连续性），且对整段帧序列建模计算开销大。
AI.method: 三级（关节/骨骼/肢体）特征提取器编码人体拓扑；GASA将结构约束注入空间注意力；MGFE用分层池化与融合强化局部细节与全局语义；TSF跨粒度对齐时序上下文；HCA促进粒度间时空交互；KFA选取信息量大的运动片段以降低冗余与算力。
AI.result: 实验表明相较常规Transformer方法在精度与效率上均有提升，验证结构感知多粒度建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构先验+多粒度时空建模可有效改进单目3D人体姿态估计，并通过关键帧选择实现效率优化。

title: VisDrone-ReID: A Unified Multi-Category Object Re-Identification Benchmark
summary: Object re-identification (Re-ID) benchmarks remain predominantly confined to single-category evaluations, limiting the development of unified systems capable of operating across diverse object types. This paper presents VisDrone-ReID, a unified multi-category Re-ID benchmark derived from the VisDrone2019-MOT dataset through a principled conversion pipeline. The pipeline resolves structural incompatibilities between multi-object tracking annotations and Re-ID evaluation requirements, addressing sequence-scoped identity collision, temporal redundancy, and the absence of a principled identity-level train/test split. The resulting benchmark comprises 9,516 identities and 150,016 images across ten object categories - pedestrian, people, bicycle, car, van, truck, tricycle, awning-tricycle, bus, and motor, sourced from 80 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sequences captured across urban environments. A leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation protocol is adopted to provide a comprehensive assessment. Baseline experiments across four representative Re-ID models spanning CNN and transformer architectures establish the first systematic performance reference on this benchmark. Results reveal a consistent Rank-1 to mAP gap across all models, suggesting that VisDrone-ReID presents a genuine retrieval challenge beyond nearest-neighbour matching. Per-category analysis identifies pedestrian as the most challenging category and reveals that vision-language pretraining provides a measurable advantage on semantically distinctive categories. VisDrone-ReID provides a consistent platform for studying multi-category object re-identification under the scale variation, viewpoint challenges, and category diversity characteristic of real-world surveillance scenarios.

AI.tldr: VisDrone-ReID：从 VisDrone2019-MOT 转换而来的十类别无人机统一多类别 Re-ID 基准，含 9,516 个身份、150,016 张图像，采用留一类别（LOO）评估协议，并给出 CNN/Transformer 四个基线模型的系统性能参考。
AI.motivation: 现有 Re-ID 基准几乎都局限于单类别评测，难以支撑跨多类目标的统一 Re-ID 系统研发；而 MOT 标注与 Re-ID 评测需求在结构上不兼容。
AI.method: 提出一套有原则的数据转换流水线，解决序列内身份冲突、时间冗余、缺少身份级训练/测试划分三类问题；构建十类别（行人、人群、自行车、汽车、厢式车、卡车、三轮车、遮阳三轮车、公交、摩托车）UAV 基准；采用 leave-one-out 类别协议，并以 CNN 与 Transformer 四类代表性模型进行基线评测。
AI.result: 所有模型均呈现稳定的 Rank-1 与 mAP 差距，说明任务并非简单最近邻匹配；按类别分析显示行人是最难类别，视觉-语言预训练在语义区分度高的类别上带来可量化增益。
AI.conclusion: VisDrone-ReID 为研究真实监控场景下尺度变化、视角挑战与类别多样性条件下的多类别物体 Re-ID 提供了一致平台，但贡献主要为基准与基线分析，未提出新的 Re-ID 方法。

title: Trait Collapse in Text-to-Image Generation: Evaluating and Mitigating Personality Inconsistency in Visual Storytelling
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main Conference Paper. 26 pages, 5 figures
summary: In visual storytelling, a believable character must not only look consistent across scenes but also \textit{behave} in ways that reflect their personality. Current text-to-image (T2I) models preserve visual appearance effectively, yet consistently fail to maintain personality-relevant behavior---a failure we term \textit{trait collapse}. We show that conventional metrics (CLIP Score, DINO similarity) are blind to this failure, and that abstract personality descriptors and scene-level emotion labels do not produce consistent improvements over neutral prompts across models. To systematically diagnose trait collapse, we introduce \textbf{ViStoryBench-Personality}, a story-level benchmark combining an expert-validated Visual Cues Lexicon (Fleiss' $\kappa = 0.757$) with a six-dimensional metric suite covering personality alignment, cross-scene stability, and behavioral coherence. Evaluating seven T2I systems, we confirm a persistent semantic gap between abstract trait labels and visual evidence, and find that visual identity consistency does not imply personality consistency. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{Trait-Behavior-Visual (TBV)}, a training-free prompting framework that decomposes personality traits into renderable visual constraints. TBV improves Personality Alignment Score by up to $+22.1\%$, with larger gains in models with stronger language-conditioning capacity.

AI.tldr: 提出"特质崩塌"问题：T2I模型能保持角色外观一致，却无法保持人格相关行为一致；构建ViStoryBench-Personality基准并给出免训练提示框架TBV。
AI.motivation: 视觉叙事需角色外观一致且行为符合人格设定，现有T2I模型在人格行为一致性上系统性失效，且CLIP/DINO等常规指标对此不可见，抽象人格标签提示也无稳定收益，缺乏诊断工具。
AI.method: 构建故事级基准ViStoryBench-Personality（专家校验的Visual Cues Lexicon，Fleiss κ=0.757，六维指标覆盖人格对齐、跨场景稳定性、行为连贯性），评测7个T2I系统；并提出免训练提示框架TBV，将人格特质分解为可渲染的视觉约束。
AI.result: 实证确认抽象特质标签与视觉证据间存在持续语义鸿沟，视觉身份一致不等于人格一致；TBV使Personality Alignment Score最高提升22.1%，语言条件能力更强的模型增益更大。
AI.conclusion: 人格一致性需通过可渲染视觉约束落地而非抽象标签；TBV为免训练、可迁移的提示方案，但其面向图像生成的叙事，未涉及具身智能或3D/物理世界建模。

title: Signs of Wear: Evaluating Intelligent Speed Assistance Under Synthetic Adverse Conditions
summary: Intelligent Speed Assistance (ISA) systems rely on cameras to recognize speed-limit signs, yet existing benchmarks underrepresent the weathered, dirty, and overgrown signs commonly encountered on rural roads. We use generative image editing to introduce different forms of wear into real street-level images of speed-limit signs. The resulting ISA-Wear dataset contains paired original and edited images. Guided by text instructions, a multimodal image-editing model adds snow, rust, vegetation, faded paint, or mud to the speed-limit sign in a street-level frame at three severity levels. Where appropriate, the surrounding scene is adapted as well, and the viewpoint is kept. Every edited frame has an unedited counterpart, and we only evaluate frames whose original is recognized correctly, so any failure can be attributed to the wear. Since the model alters the sign's geometry in 21\% of the edits, all edits are filtered by a geometric check and a manual review. Severity is measured as the LPIPS distance between the original and the edited sign plate. On 716 worn frames, we find that in detect-then-read pipelines, wear breaks detection before it breaks reading. The detector finds only 62\% of the worn signs, even though it finds every one of them in the original frames. Missed detections account for 78--87\% of failed reads, a pattern that a zero-shot detector shares. Given the annotated sign box, as in the crop-based benchmarks, a classifier still reads 78\% of the worn signs, but only 56\% when it has to rely on the detector

AI.tldr: 利用生成式图像编辑对真实限速牌图像注入雪、锈、植被、褪色、泥污等磨损，在保持视角的条件下构建成对ISA-Wear数据集，并用LPIPS度量损伤严重度，发现"检测先坏、读数后坏"的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有ISA速度标志识别基准难以代表乡村道路上风化、脏污、被植被遮挡的标志；需要一个可控、可归因的磨损基准，使失败可明确归因于磨损而非原图质量问题或几何变化。
AI.method: 以真实街景限速牌图像为基础，用文本指令驱动的多模态图像编辑模型在三个严重度等级上叠加磨损，并同步适配周边场景、保持视点；每帧保留未编辑对照；仅评估原图可正确识别的帧；对21%出现几何形变的编辑进行几何校验与人工复核过滤；用原图与编辑牌面的LPIPS距离量化严重度；在detect-then-read与crop-based两种协议下评测。
AI.result: 716张磨损帧上，检测器对磨损牌仅检出62%（原图100%）；漏检占读数失败原因的78–87%，零样本检测器呈同一模式；给定标注框时分类器仍能读取78%的磨损牌，而依赖检测器时仅56%。
AI.conclusion: ISA的瓶颈在检测环节而非识别环节，磨损导致的失效主要经由定位丢失传导；crop-based基准显著高估了系统鲁棒性，应报告端到端detect-then-read指标。

title: DominoBench: Evaluating Multi-Step Physical Reasoning from Still Images
comment: DominoBench dataset, evaluation harnesses, and benchmarks available at this https URL
summary: Can a vision-language model look at a picture of a chain reaction and tell what will happen? Recent multimodal models describe scenes fluently and solve textbook physics problems, which suggests they should also predict how a scene of ramps, ledges, pendulums, seesaws and dominoes plays out once a ball is pushed. We tested this claim on 30 models from 10 families and reached a clear conclusion: unaided, no model predicts the outcome reliably. We built DominoBench, a benchmark of still images of 2D rigid-body scenes whose outcome a physics simulator computes. It holds 854 items in 427 minimal pairs, in which a change of one to three grid steps in one quantity decides whether one person survives, and every item comes with a four-rung hint ladder ending in the exact calculation that decides the outcome. Unaided, frontier models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI are right about the person whose fate flips in at most 72% of items and answer both twins of a pair correctly in at most 34%. Pointing at the deciding step helps little, and exact geometry given as text barely helps, yet once the deciding calculation and the quantities it needs, including speeds that a still image cannot show, are written out, the same models reach 82-92% on the deciding person, while small open-weight models stay near chance. Physical prediction from a still image therefore fails at the quantitative step: the strongest models use the deciding quantity when they are given it, but do not produce it on their own. For models that plan or act in the physical world, a fluent account of a scene is thus no evidence of a correct prediction: such models must find and compute the deciding quantity unprompted, and DominoBench tests whether they do.

AI.tldr: DominoBench：854张刚性体连锁反应静帧（427最小对），测30个模型对"人是否存活"的预测；无辅助时前沿模型仅≤34%双胞胎全对，给出关键计算后升至82-92%，说明失败点在量化步骤。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型能流畅描述场景、解教科书物理题，易被误认为能预测静帧中坡道、杠杆、摆、多米诺的连锁动力学结果；作者要检验"流畅描述≠正确物理预测"。
AI.method: 构建DominoBench：2D刚体场景静帧，结果由物理仿真器计算；854题组成427个最小对（1-3格微扰即翻转结局）；每题配四级递进提示阶梯，末级给出决定结局的精确计算；在10族30个模型上做消融评估。
AI.result: 无辅助时Anthropic/Google/OpenAI前沿模型在"命运翻转者"上最高72%、成对全对≤34%；点出决定步骤或文本给出精确几何帮助很小；一旦写出决定量（含静帧不可见的初速度），同一批模型达82-92%；小型开源模型仍接近随机。
AI.conclusion: 静帧物理预测的瓶颈在定量环节：强模型能"用"正确量却不能自主"产生"该量；流畅场景叙述不构成预测能力的证据，物理世界中的规划/执行模型需无提示地定位并计算决定量。

title: Making Koopman Control Guarantees Hold on Robots
summary: A Koopman controller can stabilize its learned latent-space linear model yet fail to stabilize the nonlinear plant. The learned model propagates predictions in latent space, while the deployed controller repeatedly re-encodes the measured physical state. We show that nominal closed-loop stability transfers to the nonlinear plant when the learned and true closed-loop dynamics agree to first order on the embedding's tangent space at the target. We derive a robustness margin for approximate matching and show that a stable open-loop latent model cannot exactly match an unstable equilibrium. We introduce Tangent-Invariant Koopman (TIK), which estimates a local plant linearization from offline transitions and enforces first-order matching to this estimate. TIK recovers the fitted LQR gain at the target, while a bilinear predictor captures state-dependent actuation during large maneuvers. Across four simulated unstable benchmarks, all 40 Standard Koopman controllers have stable latent closed loops, but their deployed nonlinear systems are locally unstable. In contrast, all 40 TIK controllers locally stabilize their respective nonlinear plants. An offline stability test using empirical curvature estimates identifies stable TIK controllers on two cart-pole systems, but is inconclusive under high noise. Under explicit model-error and curvature bounds, an invariant terminal set guarantees constraint satisfaction after entry under local feedback. TIK achieves 88\% constrained cart-pole swing-up success with a 0.25 ms planning budget and controls simulated seven-joint arms within 1-5 ms per step.

AI.tldr: Point out that Koopman latent stability ≠ plant stability; derive first-order tangent-space matching condition + robustness margin; propose TIK enforcing matching to an offline-estimated local linearization; 40/40 TIK controllers stabilize unstable nonlinear plants vs 0/40 Standard Koopman.
AI.motivation: Koopman-based controllers can have provably stable latent closed loops yet fail on the true nonlinear plant, because prediction propagates in latent space while the deployed controller repeatedly re-encodes measured physical states. The paper asks when/why nominal latent stability transfers to the physical system.
AI.method: Theoretical: closed-loop stability transfers iff learned and true closed-loop dynamics agree to first order on the embedding's tangent space at the target; derive robustness margin for approximate matching; prove a stable open-loop latent model cannot exactly match an unstable equilibrium. Algorithm: Tangent-Invariant Koopman (TIK) estimates a local plant linearization from offline transitions and enforces first-order matching (recovering the fitted LQR gain at the target), with a bilinear predictor for state-dependent actuation in large maneuvers. Also an offline stability test via empirical curvature estimates and an invariant terminal set under explicit model-error/curvature bounds.
AI.result: Across four simulated unstable benchmarks, all 40 Standard Koopman controllers have stable latent closed loops but locally unstable deployed systems; all 40 TIK controllers locally stabilize their plants. Offline test identifies stable TIK controllers on two cart-pole systems but is inconclusive under high noise. TIK achieves 88% constrained cart-pole swing-up with 0.25 ms planning and controls simulated 7-joint arms at 1–5 ms/step.
AI.conclusion: Latent-space Koopman stability is insufficient; tangent-space first-order matching is the correct criterion for transfer, and TIK operationalizes it with simple offline estimation and fast inference, plus certified constraint satisfaction under bounded error.

title: Training-Free Anonymization of Driving Data with Promptable Segmentation and 3D Human Mesh Recovery
summary: Camera recordings for autonomous driving contain faces and license plates that should be anonymized before labeling, sharing, or training. Dedicated detectors can miss small plates and faces behind vehicle glass. We present FM-Anonymize, a training-free anonymization pipeline that combines promptable segmentation, 3D human mesh recovery, and generative replacement. SAM 3 locates people, faces, and vehicles and searches zoomed vehicle crops for plates, occupants, and windows. SAM 3D Body assesses face visibility from head orientation and projects head regions for blurring. Optional diffusion inpainting replaces eligible blurred heads with synthetic faces, guided by estimated pose and keypoints. On PP4AV, the blur pipeline protects 97.8% of faces and 95.5% of plates, the highest privacy recall of all compared methods at their default settings. On our recordings, where the localization thresholds were set, it protects 97.1% of faces and 93.4% of plates, compared with 93.7%/73.0% for UrbanAnonymizer, 42.7%/40.7% for EgoBlur, and 96.6% of faces for deface. Synthetic replacement raises full-body keypoint average precision over blurring from 54.1% to 79.6% on our recordings and from 39.9% to 68.3% on PP4AV. Code and configurations are available on this https URL

AI.tldr: FM-Anonymize 是一个免训练的车载影像匿名化流水线，联合可提示分割（SAM 3）、3D 人体网格恢复（SAM 3D Body）与可选扩散重建，以提升人脸/车牌隐私召回并改善下游关键点标注可用性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶相机数据在标注、共享与训练前必须匿名化人脸与车牌；专用检测器在小车牌和被车玻璃遮挡的车内人脸等场景易漏检，且常规模糊会破坏下游姿态/关键点标注质量。
AI.method: 免训练三阶段流水线：(1) SAM 3 定位人、脸、车辆，并在放大的车辆裁剪图中检索车牌、乘员与车窗；(2) SAM 3D Body 依据头部朝向判定人脸可见性并投影头部区域做模糊；(3) 可选扩散 inpainting，以估计的位姿与关键点引导，将可替换的模糊头部生成为合成人脸。
AI.result: PP4AV 上模糊方案保护 97.8% 人脸、95.5% 车牌，为各对比方法默认设置下最高隐私召回；自采数据上为 97.1%/93.4%，对比 UrbanAnonymizer 93.7%/73.0%、EgoBlur 42.7%/40.7%、deface 96.6%（仅人脸）；合成替换将全身关键点 AP 从 54.1% 提升至 79.6%（自采）与 39.9%→68.3%（PP4AV）。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的组合式基础模型流水线即可在隐私保护上超越专用匿名化方法，且生成式替换能显著缓解模糊对姿态标注的破坏，具备实用价值；但属数据前处理工具，对具身/3D 生成核心议题贡献有限。

title: InterRSGaussian: Interactive Multi-view Instance Segmentation for 3D Remote Sensing Scenes
summary: Remote sensing image segmentation plays a critical role in various applications. Interactive instance segmentation, a specialized task within image segmentation, aims to generate precise segmentation results for target objects based on user input prompts. However, previous studies on interactive instance segmentation primarily focus on single-view images, limiting their ability to comprehensively understand complex 3D remote sensing scenes. In this study, we extend interactive instance segmentation from a single-view to a multi-view framework, which can also be easily converted to a 3D segmentation format, thus achieving more accurate and comprehensive 3D remote sensing scene perception across multiple views. First, we construct a multi-view interactive instance segmentation dataset for remote sensing, comprising five distinct scenes, each captured from about one hundred different views. Second, we propose InterRSGaussian, a novel instance segmentation method based on 3D Gaussians. InterRSGaussian enables users to provide point clicks on target objects from any arbitrary view and generates view-consistent instance segmentation results across all input views without requiring manual annotations. The resulting multi-view segmentation can further be projected onto 3D point clouds for 3D segmentation. To improve training efficiency and segmentation performance, we introduce a prior distillation network for initialization. Overall, this study extends traditional 2D remote sensing scene perception into a 3D multi-view framework, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of target objects in complex environments with user interactivity.

AI.tldr: 提出多视角交互式实例分割数据集与基于3D Gaussian的InterRSGaussian方法，支持任意视角点点击提示，输出跨视角一致的实例分割，并可投影到3D点云实现3D分割；引入先验蒸馏网络加速初始化。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式实例分割主要面向单视图图像，难以完整理解复杂3D遥感场景；作者希望将交互式实例分割从单视图扩展到多视角，并自然衔接3D分割。
AI.method: 1) 构建遥感多视角交互式实例分割数据集（5个场景，每场景约100个视角）；2) 提出InterRSGaussian，基于3D Gaussian表示，接受任意视角上的目标点点击，无需人工标注即生成全视角一致的分割；3) 分割结果可投影到3D点云获得3D分割；4) 引入先验蒸馏网络提升初始化与训练效率。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标；定性上实现多视角视角一致实例分割并可直接转换为3D分割格式，降低标注需求。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将传统2D遥感场景感知扩展为具用户交互性的3D多视角框架，为复杂环境下目标理解提供更完整感知，可推广至其他多视角分割场景。

title: UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge 2026: Site-Calibrated Synthetic Data and Multi-Detector Fusion for Roadside 3D Detection
summary: This report summarizes the work submitted by team arnav007 (submission ID 1054222) for the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (V2X-Real track) at the IEEE BigData Cup 2026. The primary objective is to train 3D detectors for vehicles, pedestrians, and trucks using only synthetic roadside LiDAR data, and to generate synthetic scans that are realistic enough to be indistinguishable from real ones. A CARLA based pipeline is developed and calibrated to the fixed sensor site, accurately modeling the range image, including no-return beams, based on unlabelled real development scans. A combined inference detector, using multiple 3D detectors (VoxelNeXt, PV-RCNN, and SECOND) trained exclusively on synthetic data, is also proposed. Each scan is aligned to the synthetic ground plane and processed through the detectors at multiple ground heights. The resulting bounding boxes are fused using bird's-eye view (BEV) clustering, followed by class-specific post-processing to refine heading, box size, and filter low-confidence detections. The final submission achieved a combined score of 0.8947. The ablation study shows that per-scan ground leveling more than doubled the real-scan mAP, while fusing boxes across different heights and models further improved performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 CALIBRATED CARLA 合成雷达成像管线（含 no-return 光束建模）与纯合成数据训练的 VoxelNeXt/PV-RCNN/SECOND 多模型 + 多地面高度 + BEV 聚类融合检测器，UrbanTwin V2X-Real 挑战赛合计得分 0.8947。
AI.motivation: 路侧激光雷达标注昂贵，需验证"仅用合成数据"训练 3D 检测器并生成与真实扫描难以区分的合成点云，即 Sim2Real 可行性问题。
AI.method: 基于 CARLA 搭建并按固定传感器站点标定的 range-image 仿真管线（显式建模 no-return 光束，利用无标注真实扫描校准）；三个 3D 检测器仅用合成数据训练；推理时逐扫描对齐合成地平面、在多个地面高度分别推理，用 BEV 聚类融合包围盒，再做类别相关后处理（朝向、尺寸精修、低置信过滤）。
AI.result: 挑战赛合计得分 0.8947；消融显示逐扫描地平面归一化使真实扫描 mAP 提升一倍以上，跨高度与跨模型包围盒融合进一步带来增益。
AI.conclusion: 低成本仿真保真度校准 + 几何对齐对纯合成训练的路侧 LiDAR 检测 Sim2Real 迁移起关键作用，模型级与几何级融合可稳定累积收益。

title: ReScene: Incremental Scene Chronology from Sparse Revisits
summary: Scene chronology aims to reconstruct a scene across visits separated by hours or days, during which objects may change in position, presence or shape. Such reconstruction must retain every earlier state, yet each revisit often provides only a few images. Storing a complete model for each visit duplicates the unchanged scene, whereas updating a single shared model alters earlier states. We present ReScene, which stores each visit as an immutable compact update, so that any earlier visit can be recovered exactly by applying the stored updates in order, without retaining past images. To localise each update, ReScene attributes the disagreement between the preceding reconstruction and the new images to individual Gaussians through their compositing weights. This attribution guides the suppression of outdated Gaussians and the refinement of persistent ones, while newly visible surfaces are initialised from learned multi-view depth. We also introduce Multi-State, a benchmark of non-rigid deformation and partial material removal, including synthetic scenes with ground-truth geometry. ReScene achieves quality higher than sequential 3DGS checkpointing with 2.5--4.8$\times$ less uncompressed history storage. At comparable PSNR, it also reduces foreground depth error by 3.2$\times$ relative to sequential ChronoGS, showing that accurate rendering does not necessarily imply accurate geometry. Code and benchmark are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ReScene 将每次重访存成不可变的紧凑增量更新，按序回放即可精确恢复任意历史状态；通过合成权重归因将新旧重建的差异定位到单个 Gaussian，抑制过时高斯并细化持久高斯，新表面由学习型多视图深度初始化；同时提出 Multi-State 基准（非刚性形变+局部材质移除，含合成真值）。
AI.motivation: 场景时序重建需保留每次重访的历史状态，但"每个 visit 存整模型"会重复存储未变部分，"共享单一模型在线更新"又会篡改历史状态；且每次重访常只有少量图像。
AI.method: 基于 3DGS 的增量式场景编年史：每 visit 只保存不可变紧凑 update；利用合成权重（compositing weights）把前序重建与新图像的差异归因到单个 Gaussian，以此引导过时高斯抑制与持久高斯细化；新可见表面用学习型多视图深度初始化；构建 Multi-State 基准（非刚性形变、部分材料移除，含带 GT 几何的合成场景）。
AI.result: 相比顺序 3DGS checkpointing，同等质量下未压缩历史存储少 2.5--4.8×；PSNR 相当时前景深度误差比顺序 ChronoGS 降低 3.2×（说明高渲染质量不必然对应准确几何）。
AI.conclusion: 以"可回放的增量更新+高斯级差异归因"实现无历史图像的精确时序状态恢复，兼顾存储效率与几何精度，并提供含真值几何的动态场景基准。

title: LEDGE: Separating Critic and Editor Failures in Text-to-Image Self-Correction
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) self-correction combines a vision-language model (VLM) critic that diagnoses errors and proposes instructions with an image editor that executes them. End-to-end evaluation obscures whether failures arise from incorrect diagnoses or an editor unable to execute valid instructions. We introduce LEDGE (Learning Error Diagnosis in Generation and Editing), a framework that separates these bottlenecks. LEDGE compiles oracle edit instructions from GenEval while holding the generated images and the editor fixed, isolating the editor's correction capability from the critic's diagnostic accuracy. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, oracle instructions raise GenEval from 72.0% to 81.2%, versus 74.1% for the baseline VLM critic. Yet 435 of 644 failed images remain unrepaired, exposing a substantial editor gap. We also use oracle labels from disjoint training prompts to supervise the critic. Oracle supervision raises exact diagnosis from 33.3% (the same VLM with our structured output, untrained) to 70.8%. With the same editor, the resulting critic improves GenEval from 42.2% (uncorrected) to 59.4% on Stable Diffusion 1.5, against 50.9% for the baseline critic, and from 72.0% to 76.0% on Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, despite training only on Stable Diffusion 1.5. Improvements transfer to unseen object classes, a second editor, and independent T2I-CompBench judges and prompts. A small human evaluation confirms the ranking in estimated net corrections but suggests a smaller gain than detector-based evaluation. LEDGE thus distinguishes two limits of self-correction: knowing what to fix and being able to fix it.

AI.tldr: LEDGE 框架用 oracle 编辑指令将 T2I 自我纠错拆分为"诊断"与"执行"两个瓶颈，发现编辑器的执行能力是主要短板，并用 oracle 监督大幅提升 VLM critic 的诊断准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2I 自我纠错系统端到端评测，无法判断失败源于 VLM 批评者诊断错误，还是图像编辑器无力执行正确的编辑指令，因此需要解耦分析这两类瓶颈。
AI.method: 从 GenEval 编译 oracle 编辑指令并固定图像与编辑器，隔离编辑器纠错能力；再用来自不相交训练提示的 oracle 标签监督 critic（结构化输出），在 SD1.5 与 SD3.5-Large 上评测，并检验跨物体类别、跨编辑器及 T2I-CompBench 泛化。
AI.result: SD3.5-L 上 oracle 指令将 GenEval 从 72.0% 提升至 81.2%（基线 critic 仅 74.1%），但 644 张失败图中 435 张仍无法修复，暴露明显 editor gap；oracle 监督将精确诊断率从 33.3% 提至 70.8%，SD1.5 上 GenEval 由 42.2% 升至 59.4%（基线 critic 50.9%），SD3.5-L 由 72.0% 升至 76.0%，且可跨类别、跨编辑器与 T2I-CompBench 迁移；人工评估排序一致但增益小于检测器评测。
AI.conclusion: 自我纠错存在两个独立上限——"知道要改什么"与"能够改好"，二者须分别评估与优化；当前图像编辑器的执行能力是更受限的一环。

title: XMimic and XSoma: Learning Humanoid Motion Tracking and Locomotion in Under a Minute
summary: We present XMimic and XSoma, which learn humanoid motion tracking and locomotion on rough terrain in under a minute of training. Both follow SuperMimic, which learns a world model of the robot and optimizes the policy with analytic gradients through short rollouts imagined in this model. Existing implementations of this method do not make use of larger GPUs, as every training iteration is a long chain of small GPU operations that run one after another. XMimic and XSoma therefore shorten this chain and run the steps of every iteration at the same time on up to four GPUs. We compile the complete training loop with JAX, including the MuJoCo Warp simulator. For locomotion, XSoma leaves only the dynamics of the robot to the world model and computes everything else exactly, including the terrain height under the feet. It learns with a horizon of one second and without a critic. On four H100 GPUs, XMimic learns to track all 40 LAFAN1 clips with the Unitree G1 in 0.86 minutes, 3.7 times faster than BlinkMimic on one GPU. XSoma reaches the tracking target that Holosoma's tests set for FastSAC in 0.77 minutes, 12.3 times faster than FastSAC on one GPU, while needing only an eighth of its environment steps.

AI.tldr: XMimic/XSoma 用 JAX 编译整条训练循环（含 MuJoCo Warp），在多 GPU 上并行化 SuperMimic 的世界模型策略优化，1 分钟内完成人形运动跟踪与复杂地形行走。
AI.motivation: SuperMimic 类方法通过机器人世界模型 + 短rollout解析梯度训练策略，但每轮迭代是大量串行小 GPU 算子构成的超长计算链，无法利用大 GPU，训练慢。
AI.method: (1) 用 JAX 整体编译训练循环（含 MuJoCo Warp 仿真器），缩短算子链并将一轮内各步骤并行到最多 4 块 GPU；(2) XSoma 仅把机器人动力学交给世界模型，其余（含足下地形高度）精确计算，采用 1 秒预测视界且不使用 critic。
AI.result: 4×H100 上，XMimic 用 0.86 分钟学会 Unitree G1 跟踪全部 40 条 LAFAN1 片段，比单卡 BlinkMimic 快 3.7 倍；XSoma 在 0.77 分钟达到 Holosoma 为 FastSAC 设定的跟踪指标，比单卡 FastSAC 快 12.3 倍，环境步数仅为其 1/8。
AI.conclusion: 端到端编译 + 多 GPU 并行的世界模型解析梯度训练，可将人形运动跟踪与崎岖地形行走的训练压缩到分钟级，同时显著降低样本需求，为快速迭代的具身策略训练提供了高效系统方案。

title: VISTA: A Framework for Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, Accepted for publication in IEEE Internet of Things Magazine, 2026
summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming intelligent transportation systems by connecting roadside cameras, edge computing units, vehicles, and traffic infrastructure into a shared sensing and decision-making ecosystem. However, transmitting raw traffic video over vehicle-to-everything (V2X) links is bandwidth-intensive, while deploying large multimodal models directly on resource-constrained vehicles is often impractical. To address these limitations, this article proposes VISTA (Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness), a multimodal vision-language edge-intelligence framework that combines predictive video representation learning with lightweight language-based reasoning to provide communication-efficient traffic situational awareness. In the proposed architecture, roadside surveillance units employ the Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) and an attentive-pooler module to convert traffic video clips into compact future-scene embeddings. These embeddings are transmitted through V2X links to vehicle-mounted systems, where a TinyLlama small language model, enhanced with a custom visual adapter, interprets the embeddings alongside natural-language (NL) traffic queries. VISTA enables vehicles to obtain interpretable traffic information, reason about upcoming scene dynamics, and identify potential collision risks without receiving raw video streams. Experimental results in a digital-twin urban traffic environment show that VISTA achieves 97.77% accuracy and an 89% F1 score for future collision prediction while reducing the communication payload by several orders of magnitude compared with raw RGB video transmission. These results demonstrate the feasibility of embedding-based multimodal intelligence for low-latency, communication-efficient, and safety-oriented IoT-enabled transportation systems.

AI.tldr: VISTA：路侧用V-JEPA+attentive pooler将交通视频压缩为未来场景嵌入，经V2X传给车端，由TinyLlama+视觉适配器结合自然语言查询做交通态势理解与碰撞风险预测。
AI.motivation: 原始交通视频经V2X传输带宽开销大，而大模型直接部署在资源受限车端不现实；需要通信高效的语义级交通态势感知方案。
AI.method: 端边协同多模态框架：路侧监控单元用V-JEPA与attentive-pooler把视频片段编码为紧凑的未来场景嵌入，经V2X传至车端；车端TinyLlama小语言模型配自定义视觉适配器，将嵌入与自然语言交通查询对齐，实现可解释的交通推理与碰撞风险识别。实验在数字孪生城市交通环境中评估。
AI.result: 未来碰撞预测准确率97.77%、F1为89%；相较传输原始RGB视频，通信负载降低数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 证明了基于嵌入的多模态智能在车联网中实现低时延、通信高效、面向安全的态势感知是可行的。但验证仅在数字孪生仿真完成，缺少真实V2X链路与实车部署证据；对具身智能/机器人核心议题（VLA、世界模型、3D重建、操作）参考价值有限。

title: Stochastic Self-Distillation for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotics through imitation learning, yet fine-tuning them with on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is limited. In group-based RL methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), every rollout step requires multi-step ODE integration, and the sampler's limited stochasticity leads to rollout groups with low variance. We propose VLA-SSD, which addresses both high inference latency and limited stochasticity. In particular, our method self-distills a pretrained flow-matching action head into a stochastic one-step policy by conditioning a single-jump generator on a Brownian path. We derive a conditional action density via our stochastic one-step policy, enabling efficient post-training via likelihood-ratio RL algorithms. We show that distilling VLA-SSD from the $\pi_0$ VLA reduces the action head's forward-pass time by a factor of 7.7, at the cost of a 5.5% relative decrease in the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark. However, by leveraging the increased sample diversity of VLA-SSD during group generation, post-training a $\pi_{0.5}$ VLA using GRPO yields a 20.6% relative improvement.

AI.tldr: VLA-SSD通过将预训练flow-matching动作头自蒸馏为条件于布朗路径的单步随机策略，实现低延迟且高随机性的可采样动作策略，从而支持GRPO等似然比RL后训练。
AI.motivation: 基于flow的VLA在模仿学习中表现优异，但on-policy RL微调受限：GRPO类方法每步rollout需多步ODE积分，推理延迟高；且采样器随机性不足导致rollout组内方差低，组相对优势估计失效。
AI.method: 将预训练flow-matching动作头自蒸馏为单跳生成器，以布朗路径作为条件输入，一步采样出随机动作；由其噪声到动作的映射推导条件动作密度，从而支持似然比RL（GRPO）直接使用。从π0蒸馏得到VLA-SSD。
AI.result: 动作头前向时间降低7.7倍，LIBERO成功率相对下降5.5%；但利用组生成中更高的样本多样性，对π0.5 VLA进行GRPO后训练获得20.6%的相对成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: 单步随机蒸馏可同时解决VLA在RL后训练中的延迟与采样方差瓶颈，随机性带来的多样性收益可超过蒸馏精度损失。

title: LiveView: Real-Time Camera-Controlled Re-filming of Streaming Videos
summary: Real-time camera-controlled video re-filming aims to synthesize target views from a streaming source video under online user-specified camera trajectories. This task poses two key challenges: maintaining synchronization and content consistency across views, and achieving low-latency rendering with long-horizon stability. Existing approaches are predominantly designed for offline full-sequence processing and rely on bidirectional attention or costly depth-based geometric preprocessing, making them unsuitable for low-latency streaming scenarios. To address these limitations, we develop a teacher-to-student framework that distills a high-fidelity bidirectional re-filming teacher into a few-step causal autoregressive student. We introduce Cross-Frame Injection to interleave each incoming source frame with its synchronized target latent, thereby establishing direct cross-view correspondence and improving content consistency. To ensure stable long-horizon generation, we further propose Shared Relative RoPE, which bounds temporal indices within the pretrained range, and Cycle Streaming Tuning, which exposes the student to extended cyclic trajectories during streaming training. These designs enable low-latency online video re-filming with precise camera control and sustained spatiotemporal consistency over long streaming rollouts.

AI.tldr: 提出教师-学生蒸馏框架，将双向离线重拍模型蒸馏为少步因果自回归学生模型，实现低延迟、长时稳定的实时相机可控视频重拍，并用跨帧注入与共享相对RoPE保证跨视图一致性与时序稳定。
AI.motivation: 实时相机控制视频重拍需在流式源视频上按在线用户轨迹合成目标视图，但存在两大挑战：跨视图同步与内容一致性、低延迟渲染与长时程稳定性。现有方法多为离线全序列处理，依赖双向注意力或昂贵深度几何预处理，不适合低延迟流式场景。
AI.method: 1) 教师-学生框架：高保真双向重拍教师蒸馏为少步因果自回归学生；2) Cross-Frame Injection：将每个输入源帧与其同步目标隐变量交错排列，建立直接跨视图对应；3) Shared Relative RoPE：将时间索引约束在预训练范围内以保证长时程稳定；4) Cycle Streaming Tuning：流式训练中暴露于延长循环轨迹。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标；作者声称可实现低延迟在线视频重拍，具精确相机控制，并在长流式推演中保持持续的时空一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过因果少步蒸馏与跨视图注入、时序索引约束相结合，可为流式视频重拍提供低延迟且长时稳定的在线方案，思路对实时交互式视频/3D生成有借鉴价值。

title: ReRead: Wrong Predictions, Useful Representations - Correcting Frozen Robot Policies by Re-reading Their Own Representations
summary: When a pretrained robot policy fails on challenging tasks, common remedies include retraining the backbone, adding an external visual encoder, or introducing a memory module. We argue that wrong predictions do not imply wrong representations: a policy can retain the required information yet fail to read it out as the correct action. To test this view, we propose ReRead: with the backbone frozen, a corrector re-reads the current and two previous caches to predict an action residual. The corrector sees no images, is trained solely on offline demonstrations from all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, and adds only 4.17% latency. Ablations and interventions show that the correction relies on the backbone's own representations: none of four external visual encoders adds further gain, and swapping in past caches from other trajectories sharply increases action error. On the 11 hardest RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, ReRead improves the success rates of LingBot-VLA, $\pi_{0.5}$, and Fast-WAM by 23.45, 13.09, and 8.00 percentage points, respectively. In paired evaluation on all 50 tasks, it raises Fast-WAM's average success rate from 90.73% to 92.66%. On a Flexiv dual-arm robot, it raises success on a phase-ambiguous task from 0% to 36%.

AI.tldr: 冻结VLA主干，仅用无视觉输入的轻量"重读"模块从当前及前两帧缓存读出动作残差，在RoboTwin 2.0 50任务与真机双臂任务上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略失败时常用重训主干/加视觉编码器/加记忆模块等重手段，作者主张"预测错≠表征错"：策略可能已保留所需信息，只是未能正确读出为动作，因此应优先改善读出而非表征。
AI.method: ReRead在主干完全冻结的前提下，引入一个不含图像输入的corrector，重读主干当前及前两步的cache（隐状态）来预测动作残差；仅用50个RoboTwin 2.0任务的离线示教训练，额外延迟4.17%。通过消融与干预实验（替换四类外部视觉编码器、跨轨迹替换历史cache）验证校正依赖主干自有表征。
AI.result: 11个最难任务上LingBot-VLA/π0.5/Fast-WAM成功率分别+23.45/+13.09/+8.00个百分点；50任务配对评测中Fast-WAM均值90.73%→92.66%；Flexiv双臂真机相位歧义任务0%→36%。外部视觉编码器无额外增益，跨轨迹替换过去cache使动作误差显著上升。
AI.conclusion: "冻结表征+改进读出"是一种低成本、跨策略通用的VLA性能提升范式，且实证支持失败源于读出而非表征，对VLA后训练与部署具有可复用价值。

title: Improving X-Ray Baggage Instance Segmentation with Shared Point-Based Mask Refinement
summary: Overlapping projections and complex object contours make prohibited items difficult to delineate in X-ray baggage images. This study investigates shared point-based mask refinement to improve instance segmentation within Cascade Mask R-CNN. The framework combines a ResNet-101 backbone with an attention-based feature pyramid and progressively updates uncertain mask locations, increasing mask resolution from $28 \times 28$ to $112 \times 112$. A single refinement module is shared across cascade stages and refinement levels, with transformer and multilayer perceptron (MLP) variants used to examine the role of interactions among selected points. Ten configurations were evaluated on the official PIXray split across three training seeds using the original target-instance annotations for evaluation. The transformer and MLP refiners achieved mean mask average precision (AP) of 71.79 and 72.47, respectively, compared with 70.50 for the unrefined detector, yielding gains of 1.29 and 1.97 AP points. The MLP achieved the highest mean mask AP among the evaluated configurations. Both variants also improved boundary agreement on commonly detected objects, supporting improved mask delineation, while detection diagnostics did not establish a corresponding positive gain. These findings demonstrate that shared point-based refinement can improve segmentation quality in the tested cascade architecture using existing target-mask annotations, without additional occluder supervision. Evaluation on independent X-ray datasets is needed to determine how well these improvements generalize.

AI.tldr: 在Cascade Mask R-CNN中引入跨级共享的点基掩码细化模块（Transformer/MLP变体），将掩码分辨率由28×28提升至112×112，在PIXray X光行李数据上掩码AP由70.50提升至72.47。
AI.motivation: X光安检图像中违禁物品存在投影重叠与轮廓复杂问题，掩码边界难以精确刻画；同时希望在仅使用目标实例标注、不引入额外遮挡物监督的前提下提升级联检测器的实例分割质量。
AI.method: 以ResNet-101为骨干并配合注意力特征金字塔构建Cascade Mask R-CNN；设计单一共享的点基掩码细化模块，在所有级联阶段与细化层级间复用，逐步更新不确定掩码点并提升分辨率（28×28→112×112）；用Transformer与MLP两种变体比较所选点间交互的作用；共10种配置、3个训练随机种子，在官方PIXray划分上评估。
AI.result: Transformer与MLP细化器平均掩码AP分别为71.79与72.47，未细化基线为70.50，提升1.29与1.97个点；MLP为最优配置；两种变体在共同检出目标上改善边界一致性，但检测诊断指标未显示相应正向增益。
AI.conclusion: 共享点基掩码细化可在该级联架构中利用现有目标掩码标注提升分割质量，且无需额外遮挡监督；其泛化性需在独立X光数据集上进一步验证。

title: Beyond Seeing: Fine-Grained Preference Validation and Severity-Aware Alignment for Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Includes a 4-page supplementary appendix with experimental details, equations, prompt templates, and additional comparisons
summary: Large vision-language models can produce fluent responses containing objects, attributes, or relations unsupported by the image. We study an implemented alignment pipeline that normalizes released fine-grained hallucination supervision, validates chosen-rejected preference pairs with vision-language judges, repairs rejected chosen responses, and trains LLaVA adapters with standard or severity-aware direct preference optimization. The study uses 16,143 normalized feedback records and 8,386 released preference pairs, comparing direct training with zero-shot and two-shot judged severity-margin variants. The zero-shot variant reduces Object HalBench CHAIRs from 53.00 to 36.00 and CHAIRi from 15.72 to 10.41. Across aligned models, AMBER-Hal decreases from 35.90 to 25.10-26.90, accompanied by reduced visual coverage. In contrast, the base model retains the highest valid POPE adversarial F1, 84.18 versus 83.87-83.91 after alignment. These results support benchmark-dependent reductions in generative hallucination rather than uniform superiority of severity-aware alignment. We distinguish implemented pipeline components from the preference paths used in the reported experiments and discuss the limits of attributing gains to judging, repair, or the training objective individually.

AI.tldr: 研究LVLM细粒度幻觉对齐流程：归一化监督、VLM裁判校验与修复偏好对、严重度感知DPO训练LLaVA，报告基准相关的幻觉下降但视觉覆盖率与POPE对抗F1略有损失。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型常生成图像不支持的对象、属性或关系描述（细粒度幻觉），需要系统评估对齐流程中各组件（裁判、修复、训练目标）的实际贡献与边界。
AI.method: 构建已实现流程：归一化发布版细粒度幻觉监督数据（16,143条反馈记录、8,386个偏好对），用VL裁判校验chosen-rejected对并修复被拒回答，再以标准或严重度感知DPO训练LLaVA适配器；对比直接训练与零样本/两样本裁判严重度边际变体。
AI.result: 零样本变体将Object HalBench CHAIRs从53.00降至36.00、CHAIRi从15.72降至10.41；对齐模型AMBER-Hal由35.90降至25.10-26.90，但视觉覆盖率下降；基模型POPE对抗F1最高（84.18 vs 83.87-83.91）。
AI.conclusion: 对齐带来基准相关的生成式幻觉减少，而非严重度感知对齐的普遍优越性；需区分实现流程与实验所用偏好路径，且难以将增益单独归因于裁判、修复或训练目标。

title: Lift, See, Act: Hierarchical Robot Policy Pretraining with 3D Foundation Models
summary: Robot policy pretraining based on human videos is crucial for improving the policy's generalization ability. One main challenge for this task is the lack of explicit action-relevant representations in such unlabeled data. Recent works tend to estimate 3D hand motion trajectories from videos using 3D foundation models (3D FMs). However, they keep solely the sparse trajectories as supervision, ignoring the rich, fine-grained information produced during the trajectory extraction process. To address this issue, we propose LSA, a hierarchical robot policy pretraining framework that includes three phases: Lift, See, and Act. Specifically, the Lift phase elevates 2D video observations into dense 3D representations by adaptively aligning features in the policy's shallow layers with the intermediate representations extracted from multiple 3D FMs. Building upon these lifted representations, the See phase equips the policy with explicit geometric and interactive awareness through dual guidance. It introduces depth-map reconstruction to help the model comprehend 3D spatial layouts and utilizes hand region cues to explicitly supervise the encoder's attention toward task-relevant interaction hotspots. Empowered by the dense 3D representation learning and precise spatial guidance, our policy achieves robust and accurate robotic manipulation in the Act phase. Extensive experiments on diverse simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that LSA significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches. The project page is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 LSA 三阶段（Lift-See-Act）层级式机器人策略预训练框架，将人类视频中 3D 基础模型提取的稠密中间表征与手部区域线索用于策略监督，在仿真与真机任务上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 基于人类视频的机器人策略预训练缺乏显式动作相关表征；现有方法仅用 3D FM 估计的稀疏手部轨迹作为监督信号，丢弃了轨迹提取过程中产生的大量细粒度 3D 信息。
AI.method: 三阶段层级预训练：Lift 阶段把 2D 视频观测提升为稠密 3D 表征，在策略浅层自适应对齐多个 3D FM 的中间特征；See 阶段通过深度图重建与手部区域注意力监督提供几何与交互双引导；Act 阶段基于稠密 3D 表征执行操作策略。
AI.result: 在多样化仿真与真实世界任务上显著优于当前 SOTA 方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用 3D FM 稠密中间表征与显式空间/交互引导，可提升人类视频预训练策略的三维感知与泛化操作能力。

title: Pointillist Maize: 3D Reconstruction of Field-Grown Maize Using RGB UAV Imagery
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures, submitted to Frontiers in Plant Science
summary: Three-dimensional reconstruction can extend field phenotyping to individual maize organs, but thin, flexible, occluding structures and plant movement complicate reconstruction. We evaluated whether consumer-grade UAV RGB video processed with Structure from Motion and multi-view stereo could recover recognizable field-grown maize structures, and examined the effects of acquisition trajectories and frame sampling. COLMAP reconstructions preserved recognizable leaves, stems, tassel branches, ears, silks, and brace roots. For an equal-frame comparison, we reconstructed one plant from two sets of 295 frames from the same video: a single orbit sampled at 5 frames/second and three orbits at different altitudes (ribbon skirt) sampled at 2 frames/second. After ground removal, the reconstructions contained 520,601 and 375,318 points, respectively. The single orbit yielded greater point concentration within plant structures and fewer visible gaps, while the ribbon skirt yielded fewer scattered points and slightly lower proportions of isolated points. In densely planted nursery rows, visible voids occupied 17.57% of the rendered scene with one orbit at 1 frame/second, decreasing to 5.07% with additional serpentine passes and 2.68% when the original orbit was sampled at 3 frames/second. Additional observations also increased point dispersion associated with plant movement. A curlicue trajectory tested in a different field in 2024 produced distinguishable individual plants without visible duplicated structures, although substantial voids remained, mainly on the soil surface. These results demonstrate the feasibility of recovering recognizable maize organs from consumer UAV imagery and reveal trade-offs between acquisition strategies, reconstruction completeness, and point dispersion. Independent geometric validation is still needed before quantitative phenotyping.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估消费级无人机RGB视频经SfM与MVS重建田间玉米三维形态的可行性，比较不同飞行轨迹与帧采样策略对重建完整性与点云离散度的影响。
AI.motivation: 三维重建可将田间表型分析拓展到单器官尺度，但玉米叶片细薄易遮挡、植株随风摆动，加上田间密集种植，使重建困难；同时缺乏对航拍采集策略（轨迹、帧采样）如何影响重建质量的系统评估。
AI.method: 使用消费级无人机RGB视频，COLMAP做SfM与MVS重建。等帧数对比：同一植株、各295帧，来自单轨道5fps采样与三高度轨道（ribbon skirt）2fps采样；另在密植苗行中比较单轨道1fps、增加蛇形航线、以及3fps采样三种方案；2024年另一田块测试curlicue轨迹。指标包括去地面后的点数、结构内点聚集度、可见空洞占比、孤立点比例与点云离散度。
AI.result: 两种295帧方案分别得到520,601与375,318个点；单轨道方案点更集中于植株结构、可见空洞更少，ribbon skirt方案散点更少、孤立点比例略低。密植苗行中1fps单轨道空洞占17.57%，增加蛇形航线降至5.07%，原轨道3fps采样降至2.68%；增加观测也增大与植株运动相关的点云离散度。curlicue轨迹可区分单株且未见明显重复结构，但仍有较大空洞（主要在土表）。
AI.conclusion: 消费级无人机影像可恢复可辨识的玉米器官（叶、茎、雄穗分枝、果穗、花丝、气生根），揭示了采集策略在重建完整性与点云离散度之间的权衡；定量表型前仍需独立几何验证。

title: How Reliable Is Visual Token Selection? Rethinking Pruning in Multimodal LLMs
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027
summary: Visual token pruning improves the efficiency of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by removing redundant visual tokens, yet the reliability of existing selection signals has not been systematically examined. We analyze token selection under semantics-preserving perturbations and across representative pruning criteria, revealing two limitations. First, attention-based importance shifts non-uniformly under perturbations, so magnitude alone cannot distinguish stable evidence from unstable saliency (local instability). Second, attention- and diversity-based methods select substantially different subsets despite comparable performance, showing that useful evidence is not confined to a unique subset (global inconsistency). These findings motivate reliable token-set construction. We instantiate this perspective in CoRePruner, a training-free framework combining instruction-aware diversity with reliability-aware attention. Across image benchmarks, multiple MLLM architectures, and token budgets, CoRePruner improves performance, especially under aggressive pruning, and remains competitive on video benchmarks. Our results establish reliability as a central consideration in visual token selection.

AI.tldr: 分析视觉 token 剪枝中"选择信号可靠性"问题：语义保持扰动下注意力重要性不稳定（local instability）、注意力类与多样性类准则选出差异很大但性能相当的子集（global inconsistency），据此提出免训练框架 CoRePruner（指令感知多样性 + 可靠性感知注意力）构造可靠 token 集。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 视觉 token 剪枝方法的"重要性/选择信号"从未被系统检验；作者想证明单纯依赖注意力幅值既不能区分稳定证据与不稳定显著信号，也非唯一有效子集，因此应把"可靠性"作为 token 选择的核心设计考量。
AI.method: 先做诊断性分析：在语义保持扰动下比较多种剪枝准则的 token 排序稳定性（local instability），并比较注意力类与多样性类方法所选子集的差异与性能（global inconsistency）。据此提出免训练框架 CoRePruner：将指令感知的多样性选择与可靠性感知（扰动下稳定）的注意力打分结合，用于构造视觉 token 子集。
AI.result: 在多个图像基准、多种 MLLM 架构与不同 token 预算下性能提升，激进剪枝时增益更明显；在视频基准上保持竞争力；无需训练。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性应成为视觉 token 选择的核心指标；attention magnitude 单指标不足，需结合扰动稳定性与集合多样性。属 MLLM 推理效率优化，与 embodied/VLA/3D 主线相关性有限。

title: VoxSAOR: Semantic-Aware Occupancy Robustification via Aleatoric Uncertainty Modeling
comment: The source code will be made publicly available at this https URL
summary: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction provides a dense semantic representation of scenes for autonomous driving and embodied perception, yet remains vulnerable to occlusion, depth ambiguity, and projection errors that induce spatially varying reliability in voxel features. Existing methods typically map voxel representations to semantic predictions without explicitly modeling such observation-induced feature variations. To address this limitation, we propose VoxSAOR, a semantic-aware occupancy robustification framework that models aleatoric uncertainty through feature-space proxies. It first quantifies Local Semantic Consistency (LSC) to derive a voxel-wise structural stability prior and uses cross-view semantic consensus to filter unreliable semantic correspondences. Within each semantic category, spatially matched stable and ambiguous voxels form stable-to-ambiguous feature transitions, which are modeled by a class-conditional diagonal Gaussian distribution, capturing both feature displacement and dispersion. Guided by these proxy distributions, Aleatoric Regime Ensemble Learning (AREL) trains independently parameterized prediction heads using feature perturbations at progressively increasing scales, with perturbation strength modulated by structural reliability. At inference, proxy modeling and sampling are disabled, and all heads process the same observed features; their output probabilities are then averaged to produce a deterministic consensus prediction without requiring sampling. Experiments across multiple datasets and occupancy backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of VoxSAOR in improving semantic occupancy prediction, long-tail recognition, and predictive calibration. The source code will be made publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: VoxSAOR用特征空间代理建模偶然不确定性：先以局部语义一致性(LSC)生成体素稳定性先验并借跨视角语义共识过滤不可靠对应，再对每类"稳定→模糊"体素对的特征迁移拟合类条件对角高斯，据此用AREL训练多尺度扰动头，推理时取平均得确定性预测。
