AI.motivation: 视觉3D占据预测受遮挡、深度歧义与投影误差影响，体素特征可靠度空间不均匀；现有方法直接把体素表征映射为语义预测，未显式建模这种观测引起的特征变化，导致错误预测与校准不佳。
AI.method: 1) 局部语义一致性(LSC)计算体素级结构稳定性先验；2) 跨视角语义共识过滤不可靠语义对应；3) 类内匹配稳定-模糊体素对，用类条件对角高斯刻画特征位移与离散度作为代理分布；4) AREL：按扰动强度随结构可靠度调整，多尺度特征扰动训练独立参数预测头；5) 推理关闭采样，多头对同一观测特征取概率平均。
AI.result: 在多个数据集与多种占据主干网络上，语义占据预测精度、长尾类别识别与预测校准均获提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 以代理分布+多头集成的确定性鲁棒化，可低成本提升视觉占据预测的精度、长尾表现与校准；工程上即插即用于现有主干，代码将开源。

title: WTR-Drive: World-Task Decomposition with Structured Risk Supervision for End-to-End Driving
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV) 2027
summary: Proposal-conditioned scene predictions can lack a common object-level reference across candidate trajectories. Aggregate planning scores also leave the objects and times associated with violations implicit. We present WTR-Drive (World-Task-Risk Driving), a Drive-JEPA-based planner that separates shared scene estimation from proposal-conditioned reasoning. A proposal-independent World Memory estimates object states, map structure, and future motion by re-reading the original visual features at each refinement round. Proposal feedback updates a residual Task branch without writing back to World Memory. This branch guides refinement through candidate-specific retrieval and gated visual feedback. A final Task readout supplies candidate-conditioned features for scoring. We derive structured risk targets from existing candidate-scoring rollouts without additional simulator calls. For at-fault collision and time-to-collision violations, the targets encode event existence, association with shared object slots, and the first violation time bin. On the NAVSIM navtest split, WTR-Drive achieves 94.66 PDMS on v1 and 88.24 EPDMS on v2 (expert-frame sequential evaluation). These scores are 0.96 and 0.44 points above the published Drive-JEPA values, respectively. Candidate-level analysis shows that higher best-candidate scores can coexist with lower selected-trajectory scores, revealing a gap between candidate quality and selection effectiveness.

AI.tldr: WTR-Drive 将 Drive-JEPA 规划器拆为与 proposal 无关的世界记忆表征学习世界状态的 World Memory 与由候选反馈驱动的 Task 残差分支，并用结构化风险监督（事件存在性、共享 object slot 关联、首个违规时间 bin），在 NAVSIM 上小幅超越 Drive-JEPA。
AI.motivation: Proposal-conditioned 场景预测缺乏跨候选轨迹的公共 object-level 参照；聚合的规划分数使违规涉及的对象与时间信息隐式化，难以诊断与纠正。
AI.method: 基于 Drive-JEPA 分离共享场景估计与候选条件推理：World Memory 每轮细化时重读原始视觉特征，估计物体状态、地图结构与未来运动；proposal 反馈仅更新 Task 残差分支（候选特定检索+门控视觉反馈），不回写 World Memory；最终 Task readout 给出候选特征用于打分。直接从已有候选打分 rollout 构造结构化风险目标（事件存在、object slot 关联、首次违规时间 bin），无需额外仿真器调用。
AI.result: NAVSIM navtest（专家帧序贯评估）v1 94.66 PDMS、v2 88.24 EPDMS，分别比公开 Drive-JEPA 高 0.96 与 0.44。候选级分析显示最佳候选分数更高时选中轨迹分数可能更低，暴露候选质量与选择有效性之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 解耦共享世界估计与候选条件推理可带来稳定但幅度有限的自动驾驶规划增益；结构化风险目标与候选级诊断有复用价值，但差距主要来自候选选择而非表征能力。

title: What the Averages Hide: Monocular Metric Depth Models Still Fail in Everyday Scenes, Mostly on Scale
summary: Zero-shot monocular metric depth models are evaluated by averaging metric and scale-aligned scores across datasets. Averages cannot show how many images still have severely wrong metric depth, whether depth is under- or overestimated, or whether different models fail on the same images. We propose an evaluation built on per-image results: the failure rate (metric $\delta_1$ < 0.5); scale-aligned metrics for structure, and the bias, dispersion and absolute error of the alignment scale for scale; and a cross-model comparison that separates shared from model-specific failures. We apply it to 11 recent architectures with and without ground-truth intrinsics (18 model evaluations) on the 7 everyday-scene benchmarks (4,406 images) used by MoGe-2. Metric depth estimation is not solved in everyday scenes, and the remaining difficulty is mainly scale: the best of the 18 evaluations still has a failure rate of 7.7% (datasets weighted equally); pooled over all failures, 78.8% have intact structure, and after scale correction 98.3% no longer fail. Images failed by at least 6 architectures make up 7.3% of the data, concentrated on HAMMER and DIODE; even when selected only by architectures of other families, they hold 34% to 40% of the error of the top 6 models, against 14% to 18% for as many random images from the same datasets. Adding objects reduces the scale error of most models; ground-truth intrinsics and, in most families, larger models reduce the failures but do not remove them. We recommend reporting failure rates, structure and scale separately, and results stratified by how many models fail. We will release the code, the per-image results with shared-failure labels, and two diagnostic sets built from TUM RGB-D.

AI.tldr: 提出基于单图结果的零样本单目度量深度评测框架（失败率、结构与尺度分离的指标、跨模型共享/特化失败分析），在7个日常场景基准（4406图）、18组模型评测中发现难度主要在尺度：最佳评测失败率仍7.7%，78.8%失败图结构完好+尺度校正后98.3%不再失败。
AI.motivation: 现有评测对指标做数据集间平均，掩盖了三类关键信息：仍有多少图像度量深度严重错误、误差方向（高估/低估）、不同模型是否在同一批图像上失败。单一均值无法指导模型改进方向。
AI.method: 构建per-image评测体系：(1) 失败率 = 度量δ1<0.5的图像比例；(2) 结构用尺度对齐后的指标衡量；(3) 尺度用对齐系数的偏差(bias)、离散度(dispersion)与绝对误差；(4) 跨模型比较，将失败划分为多个架构共同失败(shared)与单模型特有(model-specific)失败。在11个近期架构、含/不含GT内参共18组评测、7个日常场景基准(4406图像)上执行，并分析物体存在、GT内参与模型规模的影响。
AI.result: 最佳评测失败率7.7%（等权数据集）；所有失败样本中78.8%结构完好，尺度校正后98.3%不再失败，说明剩余难度主要在尺度。至少6个架构同时失败的图像占7.3%，集中于HAMMER与DIODE；仅用其他家族架构筛选出的共享失败图像，对top-6模型贡献34%–40%误差，而随机采样同数量图像仅14%–18%。加入物体可降低多数模型的尺度误差；GT内参和（多数家族的）更大模型降低但不消除失败。
AI.conclusion: 建议报告规范：分别报告失败率、结构与尺度指标，并按"多少模型失败"分层报告结果。将开源代码、带共享失败标签的逐图结果，以及两个基于TUM RGB-D构建的诊断集。

title: AFRNet: Adaptive Frequency Redistribution Network for Image Deraining
summary: Image deraining aims to recover rain-free images from rain-degraded observations. Recent frequency-aware deraining methods have demonstrated promising performance by removing rain artifacts in the spectral domain. However, since rain artifacts and background textures often appear in several correlated subbands, prior frequency-domain deraining models still enhance frequency subbands separately. Such band-wise processing limits information exchange across subbands. Without context from other subbands, rain and clean content that appear together in one subband cannot be separated. This leads to either residual rain streaks or over-smoothing of fine details. To address this limitation, we propose AFRNet, an Adaptive Frequency Redistribution Network for image deraining. First, we introduce an Adaptive Frequency Recombination Module (AFRM) that performs cross-band modulation among wavelet subbands, enabling information interaction and adaptive recombination of degraded frequency components. We then develop a Subband Compensation Block (SCB) that compensates for decoder subband degradation by leveraging encoder subband features through inter-subband attention in the wavelet domain, alleviating detail loss during reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AFRNet achieves competitive performance and consistent results across diverse deraining benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 AFRNet，通过小波域跨子带调制与子带补偿，解决频率域去雨中逐子带独立处理导致信息不互通的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有频率感知去雨方法在频谱域逐子带独立增强，缺乏跨子带信息交互；当雨纹与干净纹理共存于同一子带时无法区分，导致雨痕残留或细节过度平滑。
AI.method: 1) 自适应频率重组模块（AFRM）：在小波子带间做跨频带调制，实现退化频率分量的自适应交互与重组；2) 子带补偿块（SCB）：利用编码器子带特征，通过小波域跨子带注意力补偿解码器子带退化，缓解重建细节损失。
AI.result: 在多个去雨基准上取得有竞争力的性能，且结果一致性较好（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
AI.conclusion: 跨子带信息交互是频率域去雨的关键改进方向，AFRM+SCB 组合可同时抑制残雨与保细节。

title: SmoothShift: Disrupting Visual Adversarial Attacks on LVLMs at Test Time
summary: Visual adversarial perturbations can substantially impair large vision-language models (LVLMs) despite introducing only subtle input changes. To understand how these small changes cause substantial errors, we investigate their optimization and propagation through the model, revealing two key findings. First, stronger attacks rely on finer iterative optimization, while subtle input perturbations induce representation discrepancies that are amplified layer by layer through the vision encoder and persist in the language model. Second, disrupting the alignment between within-patch input patterns and the model's computation reduces clean-adversarial representation discrepancies and substantially weakens attacks. Together, these findings suggest that adversarial effectiveness depends on both fine-grained perturbation patterns and their coupling with the model's computation. Motivated by these findings, we propose SmoothShift, a lightweight, training-free defense that combines local smoothing and spatial transformations. Smoothing weakens fine-grained perturbation patterns, while spatial transformations disrupt their alignment with the encoder's patch grid. SmoothShift requires no model updates, auxiliary networks, or additional model inference. Experiments cover three LVLM families on four datasets and robustly fine-tuned Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models on eight classification datasets. Evaluations across eight attack methods and multiple perturbation budgets demonstrate improved robustness while largely preserving clean performance. SmoothShift also provides robustness gains under defense-aware attacks using mixed-gradient BPDA with EOT.

AI.tldr: 该文分析视觉对抗扰动如何逐层传播并放大LVLM表示差异，据此提出免训练防御SmoothShift（局部平滑+空间变换），在多种LVLM与CLIP模型上提升鲁棒性且基本保持干净性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉对抗扰动虽细微却能显著破坏大视觉语言模型（LVLM），作者希望弄清其优化方式与在模型内部的传播机制，并据此设计轻量防御。
AI.method: 机制分析发现：(1) 强攻击依赖更细粒度的迭代优化，细微扰动造成表示差异并在视觉编码器与语言模型中逐层放大、持续存在；(2) 破坏patch内输入模式与模型计算的对齐可降低干净-对抗表示差异并弱化攻击。基于此提出SmoothShift：结合局部平滑（削弱细粒度扰动模式）与空间变换（打乱其与编码器patch网格的对齐），无需模型更新、辅助网络或额外推理。
AI.result: 在3个LVLM家族、4个数据集，以及8个分类数据集上鲁棒微调的CLIP模型上，对8种攻击方法及多扰动预算评测，鲁棒性提升且基本保持干净性能；在基于混合梯度BPDA与EOT的防御感知攻击下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 对抗有效性取决于细粒度扰动模式及其与模型计算的耦合；简单的平滑+空间变换即可构成无训练、无额外推理开销的有效防御。属对抗鲁棒性/安全方向，与具身智能核心议题关联较弱。

title: A Gaussian Primitive Data Management Framework for Efficient 3DGS Trajectory Rendering
summary: Trajectory rendering, which renders novel views of a reconstructed 3D scene along a camera path, is a core operation in digital twins and autonomous inspection. Structured 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders a single view in real time by decoding sparse anchors into Gaussians on demand, but it renders a trajectory view by view: every view projects all anchors to select them, re-decodes anchors already requested by neighboring views, and runs all steps on the GPU while the CPU idles. We treat this as a spatial data management problem, where anchors are spatial objects, views are range queries, and decoded Gaussians are shared derived data, and propose GDM-GS, which removes redundancy at three levels. Within a view, an anchor index and an occluder index answer each view as a holed-frustum range query, so out-of-view and provably hidden anchors are never decoded. Across views, shared materialization decodes each requested anchor once per group of consecutive views while preserving each view's selection. Across processors, a hybrid pipeline balances selections between the CPU and the GPU before grouped decoding under bounded memory. Experiments on large-scale public scenes show that GDM-GS substantially reduces trajectory rendering latency while preserving image quality.

AI.tldr: 将结构化3DGS的轨迹渲染重构为空间数据管理问题，提出GDM-GS，在视图内、跨视图、跨处理器三个层面消除冗余，降低轨迹渲染延迟。
AI.motivation: 结构化3DGS逐视图渲染轨迹时存在三重冗余：每帧需投影全部锚点做选择、相邻帧重复解码同一批锚点、且全流程绑定GPU而CPU闲置。作者据此把锚点视作空间对象、视图视作范围查询、解码高斯视作共享派生数据。
AI.method: GDM-GS：①视图内，构建锚点索引与遮挡体索引，将每帧处理为"带洞视锥"范围查询，跳过视锥外与可证伪隐藏的锚点；②跨视图，共享物化，对一组连续视图中的每个被请求锚点仅解码一次，同时保留各视图原有的选择结果；③跨处理器，混合流水线在CPU与GPU间均衡锚点选择，再做有界内存下的分组解码。
AI.result: 在大规模公开场景上的实验显示，GDM-GS显著降低轨迹渲染延迟，同时保持图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 将轨迹渲染视作空间数据管理问题、分层去冗余是一种有效且可迁移的加速范式；摘要未给出具体倍率、基线对比与开源信息，需查正文验证量化收益与泛化性。

title: Learning a Task-Adaptive Low-Dimensional Semantic Space for Improved Visual Classification
summary: Semantic visual classification commonly aligns visual embeddings with semantic spaces induced by pretrained text encoders. However, such spaces are typically high-dimensional, weakly aligned with visual feature geometry, and insufficiently discriminative for downstream classification tasks. We propose TaSS, a framework for learning a task-adaptive low-dimensional semantic space that preserves semantic structure while explicitly optimizing class separability. TaSS is constructed through a parameterized geometry transformation of pretrained text embeddings that enlarges inter-class margins via distance reshaping and improves intra-class compactness through prototype-preserving semantic constraints. The resulting semantic space maintains meaningful semantic relationships while producing a discriminative geometry tailored for classification. Frozen visual encoder features are subsequently aligned to TaSS using a lightweight MLP, enabling improved discriminative learning without fine-tuning pretrained backbones. We further provide theoretical analysis showing that TaSS preserves semantic consistency while enforcing enhanced inter-class separation and controlled intra-class variance. Extensive experiments on skeleton-based human action recognition, video classification, and image classification benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing semantic alignment approaches, with gains exceeding 3 percentage points on average and up to 8.5 points on challenging datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出TaSS框架，通过参数化几何变换将预训练文本嵌入映射为任务自适应的低维语义空间，扩大类间距、保持原型语义结构，再用轻量MLP将冻结视觉特征对齐到该空间，无需微调骨干即可提升分类判别性。
AI.motivation: 预训练文本编码器诱导的语义空间通常高维、与视觉特征几何弱对齐、且判别性不足，直接用于下游判别任务存在类间可分性差与类内松散的问题。
AI.method: 对预训练文本嵌入施加参数化几何变换，构建低维任务自适应语义空间：通过距离重塑扩大类间margin，借助原型保持的语义约束提升类内紧致度；随后用轻量MLP将冻结视觉编码器特征对齐至TaSS，并给出语义一致性、类间分离增强与类内方差受控的理论分析。
AI.result: 在骨架人体动作识别、视频分类与图像分类基准上稳定优于现有语义对齐方法，平均提升超3个百分点，困难数据集最高提升8.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 面向分类任务改造语义空间几何结构，是提升语义-视觉对齐判别性的一种低成本有效途径，可与冻结骨干网络搭配使用。

title: AsymEEF: Bimanual Manipulation with Asymmetric End Effectors
summary: Teleoperated demonstrations are costly to collect and rarely reusable across end-effectors with different kinematics and action spaces. This burden grows in bimanual manipulation, where each end-effector pair may require new data. We present AsymEEF, a framework for executable cross-end-effector demonstration generation and unified bimanual policy learning. Given a small source dataset, AsymEEF transfers demonstrations to heterogeneous combinations of two-, three-, and five-fingered end-effectors without additional teleoperation. Kinematic teacher anchors provide geometric supervision, while sparse real-world X-Calib anchors correct discrepancies in grasp execution. A shared encoder maps wrist poses and actuator states to a morphology-agnostic latent space, and a morphology-conditioned decoder reconstructs target commands. Generated trajectories undergo replay filtering for task-level executability. The representation also supports a unified bimanual visuomotor policy trained across multiple pairs. Across four simulated and six real-world tasks, AsymEEF improves replay success over adapted transfer baselines, achieves a mean replay-valid expansion gain of 16.6 times in simulation, and is evaluated through downstream policy training on real robots. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: AsymEEF 框架将少量源示教数据迁移生成到异构双手末端执行器（2/3/5 指组合），并学习统一的形态无关双手视觉运动策略。
AI.motivation: 遥操作示教采集成本高、跨末端执行器（不同运动学与动作空间）复用性差；双臂操作中每更换一对末端执行器几乎都需重新采集数据。
AI.method: 以小规模源数据集为输入：用运动学教师锚点提供几何监督，用稀疏的真实 X-Calib 锚点校正抓取执行偏差；共享编码器将腕部位姿与执行器状态映射到形态无关隐空间，形态条件解码器重建目标指令；生成轨迹经回放过滤保证任务级可执行性；该表征同时用于训练跨多末端器对的统一双手视觉运动策略。
AI.result: 在 4 个仿真与 6 个真实任务中，回放成功率优于自适应迁移基线；仿真中平均获得 16.6 倍回放有效的数据扩展增益，并在真实机器人上完成下游策略训练评估。
AI.conclusion: 形态条件隐空间 + 双锚点校正 + 回放过滤是一条可行、可执行且可复用的跨末端执行器示教生成与统一策略学习路线，可作为 VLA 示教增广的补充手段。

title: Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots
summary: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.

AI.tldr: A ROS2 + Gazebo system combining frontier exploration, Grounding DINO open-vocabulary detection, depth-based 3D localization, semantic mapping and Nav2 goal execution for natural-language target navigation; detects 3/5 targets and succeeds on 2/2 commands in TurtleBot3 simulation without task-specific training.
AI.motivation: Bridging open-vocabulary visual grounding with classical ROS mapping/navigation stacks is non-trivial; the authors aim to show an end-to-end integration on lightweight, CPU-only hardware.
AI.method: Engineering pipeline: frontier-based autonomous exploration; Grounding DINO with text prompts on RGB; depth-to-3D projection into world frame; semantic map accumulation; natural-language query resolution to navigation goals handed to Nav2.
AI.result: In Gazebo indoor scene with TurtleBot3, autonomous exploration covered the room, 3 of 5 target objects detected, 2 of 2 language commands executed successfully; failures attributed to detection uncertainty, depth localization error, incomplete coverage.
AI.conclusion: Open-vocabulary grounding models can be plugged into classical navigation pipelines, but simulation-only evaluation and lack of a learned/iterative grounding strategy limit the contribution to a feasibility demonstration.

title: sqrtVINS-Based 360 Visual-Inertial SLAM Systems: Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge 2026 Entry
comment: 2026 Hilti x Trimble SLAM Challenge at ICRA 2026 (2nd Place in the SLAM Category)
summary: This report describes our submission to the 2026 Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge. The system is a 360-camera visual-inertial pipeline that uses only the provided dual-fisheye image streams and IMU measurements. First, raw images are preprocessed with low-light enhancement and static/dynamic masking, and then fed into a $\sqrt{\text{VINS}}$ frontend as the local odometry, with deep learning-based SuperPoint features, ELSED line segments, and LightGlue matching. The resulting trajectory is refined using a GTSAM-based backend that performs tightly-coupled factor graph optimization with SALAD global descriptor and visual bundle adjustment (BA). The backend performs local-to-global structureless BA, tightly regularized intrinsic and extrinsic refinement, and global scale adjustment supported by the known inter-camera baseline and cross-view constraints. The design targets long indoor sequences with dark regions, repetitive corridors, dynamic objects, and limited geometric parallax, while keeping the pipeline reproducible in the provided ROS2 workspace. Fig. 1 demonstrates that our proposed method aligns well with the floorplan across several indoor sequences.

AI.tldr: 面向2026 Hilti-Trimble SLAM挑战赛的360°相机视觉惯性管线：仅用双鱼眼图像与IMU，结合低光增强、动静掩码、sqrt-VINS前端（SuperPoint+ELSED+LightGlue）与GTSAM后端（SALAD回环、BA、内外参正则化与全局尺度对齐），在暗区、重复走廊、动态物体与低视差的室内长序列上表现稳健。
AI.motivation: 室内长序列SLAM面临暗光区域、几何结构重复的走廊、动态物体干扰以及360相机有限视差等挑战，需要一个在给定ROS2工作区内可复现的高鲁棒性定位与建图方案。
AI.method: 预处理：低光增强+静态/动态掩码；前端：sqrt-VINS紧耦合视觉惯性里程计，采用SuperPoint深度学习特征、ELSED线段与LightGlue匹配；后端：基于GTSAM的因子图优化，融合SALAD全局描述子回环检测、视觉BA（局部到全局的无结构BA）、严格正则化的内外参联合精化，并利用已知相机基线与跨视角约束进行全局尺度调整。
AI.result: 在多个室内序列上，估计轨迹与楼层平面图吻合良好（据图1），验证了管线在挑战赛数据上的可用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了一套完整、可复现的实时360视觉惯性SLAM工程方案，其价值主要在于多传感器紧耦合与鲁棒前端的工程整合，属于挑战赛型SLAM系统报告，新颖方法论与真机部署级证据有限。

title: OrthoMark: Place Recognition with Point-Anchored Orthographic Height Mark
summary: LiDAR place recognition provides the loop closures of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(SLAM). Perspective from Z-axis, a gravity-aligned scan is an orthographic map of the scene, and a revisit from another position and heading moves this map rigidly in the plane, a motion that a polar Fourier spectrum ignores and phase correlation recovers. Along the vertical, the heights of the returns describe the structures, but which heights are observed depends on the range, because the sensor's vertical field of view cuts nearby structures low; height thus misleads a global key, yet is decisive once two scans are aligned and compared cell by cell where they overlap. We present \method, a training-free method built on one principle: two LiDAR scans can only be compared through features computed from the same geometric surfaces in both scans. \method retrieves candidates with a translation- and rotation-invariant polar spectrum of the bird's-eye view (BEV), 1.9,KB per keyframe, and verifies each candidate by estimating its planar pose through phase correlation and scoring it with \emph{point-anchored height columns}: every BEV cell keeps a 16-bit mask of the heights of its own returns; within a session, the score is weighted by the expected overlap of the two scans' sensing ranges, computed from their distance. We show that this vertical link pays off in verification but hurts in retrieval, where what a height slice contains depends on the range to the structure. For single robot, \method has the highest AP of the training-free methods without 3D registration on the KITTI development sequences; across robots, on all multi-robot sequences, it matches or exceeds RING++ at 1/350 of its descriptor size and closes more inter-robot loops than the learned BEVPlace++ on all tests.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、跨机器人LiDAR地点识别方法，用BEV极坐标Fourier谱做旋转/平移不变的检索，用相位相关估计平面位姿，再用"点锚定高度柱"验证，检索快、描述子仅1.9KB。
AI.motivation: LiDAR回环检测的关键难点：竖直方向的高度信息对检索有误导（观测到的高度受距离与垂直FOV影响），但在对齐后逐格验证时又具判别力；且需跨机器人、无需训练与3D配准的轻量方案。
AI.method: 核心原则：两次扫描只能通过由同一几何表面计算出的特征比较。检索：BEV极坐标Fourier谱，对平移和航向旋转不变，每关键帧1.9KB。验证：相位相关求平面位姿，用点锚定高度柱打分——每个BEV单元保存16-bit高度掩码；会话内按两扫描感知范围随距离的期望重叠加权。
AI.result: 单机器人：在KITTI开发序列上，是无3D配准免训练方法中AP最高。跨机器人：在所有多机器人序列上匹配或超过RING++（描述子仅为其1/350），在全部测试中闭环数超过学习式BEVPlace++。
AI.conclusion: 高度/竖直信息在验证阶段有效、在检索阶段有害这一结构性观察，可指导设计检索-验证解耦的免训练地点识别流水线，实现轻量、跨平台的多机器人SLAM回环。

title: ExtremeDrive: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Critical Driving
summary: Existing autonomous driving datasets and benchmarks provide extensive resources for routine driving, yet real-world data covering safety-critical scenarios and extreme environmental conditions remain limited. To address this gap, we present ExtremeDrive, a real-world dataset and benchmark covering emergency maneuvers, complex traffic interactions, and adverse conditions such as slippery or snow-covered roads, alongside routine driving. The dataset comprises 589 driving scenes curated from a larger pool of real-world driving recordings, with calibrated and aligned multisensor data and reviewed annotations of road structure and traffic participants. We further establish a benchmark to evaluate planned trajectories through simulated vehicle execution, measuring safety-related metrics and driving performance. Experiments at equal training set sizes show that incorporating critical driving data reduces trajectory prediction errors and improves mean critical-success rates in critical scenarios. ExtremeDrive provides a unified resource for learning and evaluating autonomous driving in safety-critical scenarios and extreme environmental conditions.

AI.tldr: ExtremeDrive：面向安全关键场景与极端环境条件的真实世界自动驾驶数据集与基准，含589个场景、多传感器标定对齐数据及轨迹规划评测。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶数据集多覆盖常规驾驶，缺乏安全关键场景（紧急机动、复杂交互）与极端环境（湿滑、积雪路面）的真实数据，限制了相关模型的学习与评测。
AI.method: 从大规模真实驾驶记录中筛选589个场景，提供标定对齐的多传感器数据与经审核的道路结构、交通参与者标注；构建基于仿真车辆执行的规划轨迹评测基准，衡量安全指标与驾驶性能；在等量训练集下对比加入关键驾驶数据的效果。
AI.result: 等训练规模实验中，引入关键驾驶数据降低了轨迹预测误差，并提升了关键场景的平均关键成功率。
AI.conclusion: ExtremeDrive为安全关键与极端环境下的自动驾驶学习与评测提供统一资源，但其价值主要在于数据与基准层面。

title: PerturbJEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning of Cellular Perturbation Responses
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Identifying the drug and dose that produced a cellular response requires preserving treatment effects within each cellular background. A joint-embedding predictor can match its targets while ignoring the intervention if its encoder preserves differences across backgrounds but erases differences between treated and control populations within each one. We call this failure interventional contrast collapse. PerturbJEPA encodes the difference in mean gene expression between treated and control populations as an effect vector. It aligns the displacement between their latent centroids with this vector and regularizes the vectors to preserve variation across population pairs. We show that the measured displacements cannot all coincide within a batch when effect-vector variation exceeds the root-mean-square alignment error. Trained with separate drug and dose ranking objectives, the model predicts candidate responses from a common control population and matches them to the observed response without cell pairing or expression reconstruction. We evaluate 3,592 Tahoe-100M queries on held-out combinations of known interventions and cellular backgrounds, each with over 700 drug-dose candidates in a fixed, background-specific catalog. PerturbJEPA achieves 91.46% macro joint drug-dose Recall@1, exceeding STATE by 3.40 percentage points (95% drug-cluster bootstrap interval of 1.72 to 5.07 points). Controlled diagnostics show that treatment-control differences can shrink even when representations remain globally dispersed. With the drug ranking objective fixed, adding effect-vector regularization to alignment raises joint Recall@1 from 18.57% to 87.47%.

AI.tldr: PerturbJEPA 通过对比均值基因表达效应向量的潜空间对齐与效应向量正则化，避免“干预对比坍缩”，在 Tahoe-100M 留出组合上取得 91.46% 宏平均药物-剂量联合 Recall@1。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测器可能仅保留细胞背景差异而抹除同一背景内处理组与对照组的差异（干预对比坍缩），导致无法识别产生细胞响应的药物与剂量。
AI.method: 将处理组与对照组平均基因表达之差编码为效应向量；对齐两组潜质心位移与该向量，并正则化向量以保持跨群体对的变异；以独立的药物与剂量排序目标训练，从公共对照群体预测候选响应并与观测响应匹配，无需细胞配对或表达重建；给出位移不能全部重合的理论条件。
AI.result: 3,592 条 Tahoe-100M 查询（固定背景特异目录、每个超 700 个药物-剂量候选）上宏平均联合 Recall@1 达 91.46%，比 STATE 高 3.40 个百分点（95% bootstrap 区间 1.72–5.07）；固定药物排序目标时，加入效应向量正则化使对齐的联合 Recall@1 从 18.57% 提升至 87.47%。
AI.conclusion: 对齐项与效应向量方差正则化的组合是防止对比坍缩的关键，诊断显示表征全局分散并不能保证处理-对照差异被保留。

title: SCoRe: Support-Calibrated Role Fusion for Training-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
summary: We present SCoRe (Support-Calibrated Role fusion), a framework to utilize two complementary vision foundation model-based (VFM) segmenters for training-free cross-domain few-shot segmentation (CD-FSS). Our approach is based on the observation that current VFMs for CD-FSS possess capabilities where one model locates the correct object, while another model computes the better contour. Our approach uses: 1. a method to identify a VFM segmenter to lead Few-Shot Segmentation (FSS) task for a given concept, 2. a novel deterministic boundary correction method using bands of near- and far-pixels at the lead segmenter's predicted boundary of an object, and 3. a region correction mechanism for the other segmenter to conservatively prune components, fill holes, and bridge short gaps on the lead segmenter's predicted masks to improve accuracy. We evaluate SCoRe using RSRM and FSS-SAM3 across 3,314 matched five-shot episodes from 10 datasets. SCoRe achieves 72.738% foreground mIoU averaged across datasets, a gain of 5.210 percentage points over RSRM (paired 95% CI [4.618, 5.972]), with per-dataset gains up to 8.461 points over the strongest standalone method and the best point estimate on 7 of 10 datasets.

AI.tldr: SCoRe: training-free cross-domain few-shot segmentation via fusing two VFM segmenters, using one as "lead" locator and the other for deterministic boundary/region correction.
AI.motivation: Current VFM-based CD-FSS methods are complementary: one tends to localize the object correctly, another yields better contours; single-model pipelines waste this complementarity.
AI.method: Three components: (1) a criterion to select which VFM segmenter leads the FSS task for a given concept; (2) deterministic boundary correction using near-/far-pixel bands around the lead model's predicted boundary; (3) region correction by the secondary segmenter—conservative component pruning, hole filling, and gap bridging on the lead masks.
AI.result: Evaluated with RSRM and FSS-SAM3 over 3,314 matched five-shot episodes from 10 datasets; 72.738% mean foreground mIoU, +5.210 pts over RSRM (95% CI [4.618, 5.972]), up to +8.461 pts over the strongest standalone method, best point estimate on 7/10 datasets.
AI.conclusion: Test-time fusion of complementary VFMs with cheap deterministic mask refinements gives solid, training-free CD-FSS gains; yet it remains 2D semantic segmentation without embodied or 3D grounding.

title: Stability Principle Inherent in Wheel Gait of Planar X-shaped Walker Generated Using Constant Torque Drive and Mechanical Stoppers
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of IEEE ICRA 2026. This author version corrects the author names in one reference; the scientific content remains unchanged
summary: Since the late 19th century when the first walking toys were developed, it has been known that mechanical stoppers at the hip joint are crucial for generating stable passive dynamic walking. Recent research on passive-dynamic and limit-cycle walkers has also confirmed that mechanical stoppers at the hip and knee joints are effective for generating stable walking motion, but theoretical research on how this mechanical constraint enhances the overall gait stability remains insufficient. This paper introduces a planar X-shaped walker equipped with mechanical stoppers at the hip joint, and investigates the effect of the mechanical constraint on the stability of the wheel gait generated by constant torque drive on a downslope. By simply falling forward while using the stoppers to constrain itself to the target impact posture, the robot can generate a highly stable wheel gait. We divide the motion of one step into four phases, derive approximate analytical solutions for the state error transition function matrix in each phase using a linearized model, and analyze the increase or decrease in the state error norm using metrics such as its maximum singular value. Numerical simulations demonstrate that while two phases are unstable in terms of the increase in the state error norm, the remaining two phases are stable, resulting in overall asymptotic stability.

AI.tldr: 通过平面X形双足（带髋关节机械限位）在斜坡恒扭矩驱动下生成轮式步态，将一步分为四相并用线性化模型给出误差转移矩阵近似解析解，借最大奇异值分析稳定性。
AI.motivation: 自19世纪末的行走玩具起即知髋关节机械限位对被动动态行走稳定性至关重要，近期被动动态与极限环行走研究也证实髋/膝限位有效，但"机械约束如何提升整体步态稳定性"的理论分析不足。
AI.method: 设计带髋关节机械限位的平面X形行走器，下坡恒扭矩驱动；将单步运动划分为四个相位，基于线性化模型推导各相位状态误差转移函数矩阵的近似解析解，用最大奇异值等指标量化误差范数的增减。
AI.result: 数值仿真表明：四相中有两相误差范数增长（不稳定），另两相收缩（稳定），二者合成后整体呈渐近稳定；机器人仅靠前倾并被限位约束到目标碰撞姿态即可获得高稳定轮式步态。
AI.conclusion: 机械限位通过"前倾+姿态约束"简化并强化了步态收敛，分相位误差传播分析可从理论上解释被动动态行走的稳定机制。

title: JEPTERA: A Platform Agnostic JEPA-Assisted Model Predictive Planner for Urban UAV Navigation
summary: Urban navigation for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) requires planning that accounts for environmental geometry, vehicle dynamics, and moving obstacles. This paper presents JEPTERA, a navigation architecture that integrates a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), Model Predictive Control (MPC), PID control, and a safety layer. JEPA predicts the UAV's motion response to candidate commands for MPC action selection, while the safety layer checks trajectories against occupied space and predicted obstacle motion. Simulator adapters and platform-specific YAML configurations separate the planning core from simulator interfaces. An ablation study evaluated six configurations across three gym scenarios, totaling 180 runs. The complete architecture achieved the highest aggregate success rate, completing 28 of 30 runs. Additional tests completed one route across three city maps without collisions. Separate integration tests demonstrated operation in Gazebo/ROS 2, MuJoCo, and CARLA without modifying the core planning logic. These results support the feasibility of the integrated architecture for simulated urban UAV navigation and its portability across simulator interfaces.

AI.tldr: JEPTERA：将JEPA运动预测、MPC、PID与安全层集成的城市无人机导航架构，通过仿真器适配器与YAML配置解耦规划核心，在三个gym场景180次运行中取得28/30最高成功率，并在Gazebo/ROS 2、MuJoCo、CARLA中免改核心逻辑运行。
AI.motivation: 城市环境下UAV导航需同时处理环境几何、机体动力学与动态障碍；现有规划方案往往依赖特定仿真接口、难以复用，且缺乏对指令响应的预测模型与安全性校验的统一框架。
AI.method: 分层架构：JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）预测UAV对候选指令的运动响应，供MPC做动作选择；PID负责底层控制跟踪；安全层基于占据空间与预测障碍运动对轨迹进行校验。仿真器适配层+平台特定YAML配置将规划核心与仿真接口分离。消融实验覆盖6种配置×3个gym场景共180次运行。
AI.result: 完整架构取得最高总体成功率28/30；在3张城市地图上完成一条路线且无碰撞；Gazebo/ROS 2、MuJoCo、CARLA集成测试均无需修改核心规划逻辑即可运行。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持该集成架构用于仿真城市UAV导航的可行性及其跨仿真器接口的可移植性；但证据限于仿真与单路线测试，尚缺真实飞行验证与动态障碍的大规模量化评估。

title: From Joint Risk to Decision Invariance: Decision-Preserving Regularization for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Exemplar-free continual learning seeks to minimize joint risk over all seen tasks, yet historical data are unavailable for direct optimization. We observe that, for classification, preserving the model's decisions on previously learned classes helps retain old knowledge. This motivates Decision-Preserving Regularization (DPR). Penalizing changes in all pairwise old-class logit margins reduces algebraically to a centered relative-logit penalty. We further apply spectral whitening to remove the classifier's spectral scale bias. Because the global classifier supplies the decision constraints for the next stage, it must remain calibrated across all seen classes despite the drift of stored old-class statistics during representation updates. We therefore fit a closed-form affine map from paired current-task features to transport old-class Gaussian means and covariances into the updated feature space, then calibrate the global classifier using these distributions and current-task features. Across CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet-Subset, and ImageNet-1K under cold-start protocols, comparisons with state-of-the-art methods show that DPR achieves higher accuracy in most settings while remaining highly efficient. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出Decision-Preserving Regularization (DPR)：在无样本持续学习中，通过对旧类logit对的边际变化做惩罚（代数上等价于中心化相对logit惩罚），并结合谱白化去除分类器尺度偏差；同时用闭式仿射映射把旧类高斯的均值/协方差迁移到更新后的特征空间以保持全局分类器校准。
AI.motivation: 无样本持续学习（exemplar-free CL）需在无历史数据条件下最小化全体任务联合风险。作者观察到：对分类任务而言，保持模型对已学类别的决策不变即可帮助保留旧知识，故以此为出发点设计正则项。
AI.method: 1) DPR：惩罚所有旧类之间成对logit margin的变化，可代数化简为中性的相对logit惩罚（centered relative-logit penalty）；2) 谱白化（spectral whitening）消除分类器的谱尺度偏差；3) 全局分类器需为下一阶段提供决策约束，故拟合当前任务特征到旧类高斯均值/协方差的闭式仿射映射，在表示漂移后迁移旧类统计量；4) 用迁移后的分布与当前任务特征校准全局分类器。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet、ImageNet-Subset、ImageNet-1K的cold-start协议下，与SOTA方法相比，DPR在多数设置取得更高准确率，且计算效率高。
AI.conclusion: 决策保持视角可有效替代样本回放；相对logit惩罚+谱白化+闭式仿射统计迁移构成一个轻量、高效的无样本持续学习方案。摘要仅报告分类基准结果，缺少机器人/具身场景验证，亦无开源的实证说明，属通用机器学习方法。

title: Example-Based Spatial Guidance for Training-Free Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 51 pages, including references, checklist, and appendix
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models often synthesize policy-violating content, necessitating robust safeguards and rigorous evaluation frameworks. However, current approaches remain largely monolithic in both execution and evaluation, limited to coarse-grained categorization within broad unsafe concepts. Such approaches fail to account for the specific constituent factors of a violation, resulting in weak learning signals and allowing model collapse to bypass safety checks. To overcome these limitations, we propose Example-Based Spatial Guidance (EBSG), a training-free method that utilizes user-editable exemplar packs to provide granular spatial guidance for precise concept steering. Unlike existing methods that coarsely steer the entire image away from a broad concept, EBSG decomposes these categories into specific sub-concepts via exemplar text-image pairs, providing explicit, localized steering signals for more robust safety control. Furthermore, we introduce a vision language model (VLM)-based evaluation protocol that provides a fine-grained assessment, avoiding the pitfall of conventional binary evaluators that permit model collapse to bypass safety checks. Empirically, EBSG achieves state-of-the-art erasure performance across diverse safety datasets and concept categories, spanning four nudity benchmarks, seven I2P harmful-concept slices, and four MJA metaphor categories, while supporting multi-concept removal and transferring to a modern backbone, SD3.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的EBSG方法，利用可编辑示例包为T2I扩散模型提供细粒度空间引导以精准擦除违规概念，并配套VLM细粒度评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I安全防护在训练与评测上均为单体式、粗粒度：仅按宽泛不安全概念做粗略分类，忽略违规的具体构成因素，导致学习信号弱，模型坍缩即可绕过安全检查。
AI.method: Example-Based Spatial Guidance（EBSG）：免训练推理时方法，用用户可编辑的示例文本-图像对将宽泛类别分解为具体子概念，提供显式、局部化的空间引导信号，实现精确概念转向而非整体远离；同时提出基于VLM的细粒度评估协议替代二分类评测。
AI.result: 在4个裸露基准、7个I2P有害概念切片、4个MJA隐喻类别上取得SOTA擦除性能，支持多概念同时移除，并可迁移至SD3主干。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、空间局部化的示例引导优于粗粒度概念擦除，配合细粒度VLM评测可更可靠地实现T2I内容安全控制。

title: ASCG: Adaptive Spatial Classifier Guidance for Surgical Concept Suppression in Diffusion Models
comment: 9 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: While text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models achieve remarkable quality, they risk producing harmful content. Existing safety mechanisms often rely on indiscriminate, global interventions that induce unintended semantic drift and degrade image quality. To address this, we propose Adaptive Spatial Classifier Guidance (ASCG), a necessity-driven framework that employs probabilistic monitoring to activate guidance selectively upon harm detection. By leveraging Grad-CAM for localized suppression, ASCG effectively removes harmful concepts while preserving superior semantic fidelity compared to conventional methods. Furthermore, we overcome the limitations of traditional metrics like NudeNet---which fails to assess semantic integrity---by introducing a VLM-based evaluation framework to provide a fine-grained, robust analysis of both safety and context preservation. Our results demonstrate that ASCG not only balances safety and fidelity but also exhibits remarkable plug-and-play synergy with existing frameworks to establish state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 该文提出自适应空间分类器引导（ASCG），用概率监控在检测到有害概念时才触发引导，并借Grad-CAM做局部抑制，同时引入基于VLM的细粒度评测框架，兼顾安全性与语义保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I扩散模型安全机制多采用无差别的全局干预，导致非预期的语义漂移与图像质量下降，且NudeNet等传统指标无法评估语义完整性。
AI.method: 必要性驱动的框架：概率监控选择性激活引导；Grad-CAM实现局部化有害概念抑制；配套VLM评测框架进行安全性与上下文保真度的细粒度分析。
AI.result: 在去除有害概念的同时保持更优的语义保真度，安全与保真取得平衡；并可即插即用地与现有框架协同，达到SOTA水平。
AI.conclusion: ASCG以必要性驱动的局部引导替代全局干预，配合VLM评测，为T2I安全提供更好权衡与可组合性。

title: PixelBench: Evaluating Language Models for Pixel-Art Creation
summary: Pixel art is widely used in games and digital content creation, requiring readable forms, coherent spatial relationships, and harmonious colors under limited resolution and palette constraints. Language models show growing promise in visual creation, yet their pixel art creation capabilities lack systematic evaluation. We introduce PixelBench, formalizing text-to-image generation and instruction-guided editing for pixel art and providing a benchmark for these tasks. We further present a creation environment in which language model agents invoke drawing tools through code to generate and edit pixel art. We assess the quality of generated artwork through human evaluation and employ a multimodal large language model as a judge, validating the agreement between its automated assessments and human preferences. We compare language models and configurations across diverse subjects and canvas sizes. In our experiments, GPT-6 Astra achieves both the highest average judge score and the best average human rank, highlighting the potential of general-purpose language models for pixel art creation. We release the tasks, all artworks, the human rankings, and the judge protocol.

AI.tldr: PixelBench：面向像素画文本生成与指令编辑的基准，含代码调用绘图工具的智能体创作环境、人工评测与MLLM评判协议。
AI.motivation: 像素画需在有限分辨率与调色板下保证可读性、空间一致性与色彩协调；语言模型在视觉创作上潜力渐显，但其像素画创作能力缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 形式化文本到像素画生成与指令引导编辑两类任务，构建基准与评测环境：智能体通过代码调用绘图工具生成/编辑像素画；采用人工评价与多模态大模型评判并验证二者一致性；在不同题材与画布尺寸上比较多种模型与配置。
AI.result: GPT-6 Astra 获得最高平均评判分数与最佳平均人工排名，显示通用语言模型在像素画创作上的潜力；发布任务、全部作品、人工排名与评判协议。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了像素画创作的系统化评测框架与基准，并说明通用语言模型可作为具备工具使用能力的视觉创作代理，但整体属于基准/评测类贡献。

title: Event-Guided Stereo Video Super-Resolution
summary: Stereo Video Super-Resolution (SVSR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution stereo videos by exploiting temporal cues across consecutive frames and complementary spatial cues between stereo views. However, existing methods struggle to recover high-frequency texture details under rapid motion and complex illumination, compromising reconstruction quality and stereo consistency. Event cameras provide valuable motion and texture cues with high temporal resolution and wide dynamic range, yet their potential for SVSR remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present the first investigation of event-guided SVSR and propose a novel framework. Specifically, we develop an Event-Guided Texture Enhancement (EGTE) module that combines bidirectional temporal feature propagation with event-guided texture refinement to restore high-frequency details in complex motion regions. Subsequently, we introduce a Cross-View Texture Interaction (CVTI) module to model cross-view spatial correspondences and aggregate cross-view complementary texture information. With this design, our method effectively integrates event-driven motion and texture information, inter-frame temporal dependencies, and cross-view spatial relationships to recover motion-affected details and maintain stereo consistency. Extensive experiments on both real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing super-resolution methods in reconstruction quality and stereo consistency. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 首个事件相机引导的立体视频超分框架，提出EGTE与CVTI模块融合事件驱动运动纹理、帧间时序与跨视角空间对应，恢复快速运动下的高频细节并保持立体一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有SVSR方法在快速运动和复杂光照下难以恢复高频纹理细节，且立体一致性受损；事件相机具备高时间分辨率与宽动态范围的运动/纹理线索，但其在SVSR中的潜力尚未被挖掘。
AI.method: 提出事件引导SVSR框架：Event-Guided Texture Enhancement (EGTE) 模块将双向时序特征传播与事件引导的纹理细化结合，恢复复杂运动区域高频细节；Cross-View Texture Interaction (CVTI) 模块建模跨视角空间对应并聚合互补纹理信息，统一融合事件信息、时序依赖与跨视角关系。
AI.result: 在真实与合成数据集上的大量实验表明，方法在重建质量与立体一致性上均稳定优于现有超分方法。
AI.conclusion: 事件引导为立体视频超分提供了有效的运动与纹理补充信号，配合跨视角交互可同时提升细节恢复与立体一致性。

title: Instructions Before Actions: Prospective and Retrospective Language Supervision for Driving Vision-Language-Action Data
summary: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models can accept navigation instructions, yet predicting a driver's trajectory does not establish that a model follows the instruction. We study how driving-language supervision is collected and evaluated, distinguishing prospective instructions issued before an action from retrospective labels written after observing it. We develop ADVLAT-Engine to synchronize spoken instructions, road-scene video, and vehicle trajectories, and compare three navigation apps on 48 replayed routes. On 87 maneuvers announced by both Google Maps and a passenger, the passenger uses more scene-dependent language. We evaluate four open driving VLAs before and after fine-tuning on prospective navigation-app drives. Fine-tuning reduces passenger-drive trajectory error by 23-59%, but instruction effects remain inconsistent. At real intersections, counterfactual instructions reveal stronger responsiveness: fine-tuned Alpamayo~2 Super gains 31 and 18 accuracy points at 15 and 5~m, while Qwen-Drive follows alternative maneuvers more reliably with a discrete command than with a sentence. We additionally collected retrospective annotations from four people for the driving recordings and describe controlled comparisons of annotation content, timing, and downstream learning; those analyses are pending. Our findings separate maneuver prediction from instruction-following and establish a framework for comparing prospective and retrospective supervision.

AI.tldr: ADVLAT-Engine 同步语音指令、道路视频与车辆轨迹，区分"行动前的前瞻性指令"与"行动后的回溯性标注"，并以此评测四个开源驾驶VLA是否真正遵循指令。
AI.motivation: 驾驶VLA能输出轨迹并不等于"遵循指令"；现有驾驶语言监督多为事后回溯标注，与部署时的前瞻性指令分布不一致，导致指令跟随评测失真。
AI.method: 构建 ADVLAT-Engine 多模态时间同步采集/回放管线；在48条复现路线上对比3个导航应用（含 Google Maps 与乘客口述）的语言；对4个开源驾驶VLA做导航应用前瞻性数据微调；在真实路口用反事实指令测试响应性；另收集4人回溯标注用于内容/时序/下游学习的受控对比（分析待完成）。
AI.result: 前瞻性数据微调使乘客驾驶轨迹误差降低23–59%，但指令效应不稳定；路口反事实测试显示微调后 Alpamayo 2 Super 在15m和5m处分别提升31和18个准确率点，Qwen-Drive 在离散命令下比自然语句更可靠地执行替代机动。
AI.conclusion: 将"机动预测"与"指令跟随"解耦，提出前瞻/回溯监督的可比框架；初步表明离散结构化命令与前瞻性监督更利于指令遵循，回溯标注对比分析尚未完成。

title: Counterfactual Feature Steering for Adjacency-Preserving Identity Unlearning
summary: Identity unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models is increasingly important for privacy, safety, and ethical deployment, as it aims to remove the model's ability to generate specific individuals. In this work, we study identity unlearning with \emph{adjacency preservation}, where the goal is to remove a target individual's identity while preserving related non-target identities. We propose Counterfactual Feature Steering (CFS), a method requiring one-time SAE training that performs bounded inference-time concept editing in the latent space of a sparse autoencoder attached to the text encoder. CFS derives a target direction by contrasting forget and retain distributions, then applies a per-token projection proportional to each token's current alignment with this direction, yielding counterfactual representations that suppress the target while limiting collateral damage. To evaluate adjacency preservation, we introduce the Adjacency-Weighted Unlearning Score (AWUS), which measures the tradeoff between target erasure and collateral damage, and extend it to face-specific identity similarity using ArcFace. Across 4,000 prompts derived from Celeb-100, spanning 100 celebrity identities, CFS achieves the strongest evaluated tradeoff between identity erasure of target identities and preservation of adjacent and generic concepts, while remaining stable across intervention strengths where other steering-based methods degrade. Independent ArcFace evaluation and a 10,000-caption COCO study further examine identity and general preservation. Quantitative nudity-suppression benchmarks and qualitative artistic-style examples provide evidence of transfer beyond identities on SD~1.4.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实特征引导（CFS）：在文本编码器所附稀疏自编码器潜空间中做有界推理期概念编辑，实现身份遗忘同时保留邻近身份，并提出 AWUS 指标评估擦除-连带损伤权衡。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型的身份遗忘需在移除目标个体身份的同时保留相邻非目标身份（邻接保持），而现有方法往往带来较大连带损伤或稳定性不足。
AI.method: 一次性训练 SAE 挂接于文本编码器；通过对遗忘集与保留集分布做对比得到目标方向向量；再按每个 token 与该方向的当前对齐度做按比例投影，生成反事实表示以抑制目标并限制连带影响；引入 AWUS 指标及扩展的 ArcFace 身份相似度评估。
AI.result: 在 Celeb-100 衍生的 4000 条提示（100 个名人身份）上，CFS 取得最佳的目标擦除与邻接/通用概念保持权衡，且在其他引导类方法退化的干预强度区间内保持稳定；ArcFace 独立评估与 10000 条 COCO 字幕实验验证身份与通用能力保持；定量裸体抑制基准与定性艺术风格示例显示在 SD 1.4 上可跨概念迁移。
AI.conclusion: 推理期潜空间有界概念编辑可有效实现身份遗忘与邻接保持的良性权衡，且具备一定跨概念迁移性。

title: Defect-Aware Masked Autoencoders for Unsupervised Clustering of Steel Surface Defects
summary: Reliable recognition of steel surface defects is essential for automated quality inspection, but supervised methods require manually annotated images that are costly to produce. This creates a need for methods that can learn useful defect representations directly from unlabelled surface images. This work presents Defect aware MAE, a label free masked autoencoder for clustering steel surface defects. Each image is divided into 196 patches, with 147 masked and 49 processed by a Vision Transformer encoder. Texture energy based masking preferentially hides structurally informative patches, while a shallow decoder reconstructs HOG descriptors that capture local texture and edge orientation. Strong augmentation and an intermediate layer readout are used to form the final image features. Pretraining uses no class labels, bounding boxes, detection branch, or contrastive loss. On the held out NEU DET split, UMAP followed by Ward clustering achieves 98.6% Hungarian matched accuracy, 0.968 NMI, 0.967 ARI, and 0.838 silhouette score. Under an identical encoder and training schedule, it exceeds a SimCLR contrastive baseline in accuracy, NMI, ARI and silhouette scores across 5 seeds.

AI.tldr: Defect-aware MAE: a label-free masked autoencoder that clusters steel surface defects, using texture-energy-based patch masking and a shallow decoder that reconstructs HOG descriptors, then UMAP + Ward clustering.
AI.motivation: Supervised steel surface defect recognition needs costly manual annotations; the aim is to learn useful defect representations from unlabeled surface images, without labels, bounding boxes, detection branches, or contrastive losses.
AI.method: Each image is split into 196 patches; 147 are masked and 49 go through a ViT encoder. Masking preferentially hides structurally informative patches based on texture energy. A shallow decoder reconstructs HOG descriptors capturing local texture and edge orientation. Strong augmentation plus an intermediate-layer readout form the final image features. Pretraining is fully label-free.
AI.result: On a held-out NEU-DET split: 98.6% Hungarian-matched clustering accuracy, 0.968 NMI, 0.967 ARI, 0.838 silhouette. With identical encoder and training schedule, it beats a SimCLR baseline on accuracy, NMI, ARI and silhouette across 5 seeds.
AI.conclusion: Texture-aware masking combined with HOG-based reconstruction targets yields strong unsupervised defect representations and clustering for industrial surface inspection, a self-supervised alternative to annotation-heavy supervised pipelines.

title: Competent Autonomous Driving Through Fine Tuning Vision Language Action Models with Symbolic Traffic Rules
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a unified approach to perception, reasoning, and control for autonomous driving, but accurate action prediction alone does not establish compliance with traffic regulations. This paper presents a rule-guided VLA framework that incorporates symbolic traffic-rule feedback into policy optimisation. The framework combines supervised fine-tuning on expert demonstrations with reinforcement learning (RL) refinement using a reward that encourages encoded-rule compliance while penalising deviations from expert actions. Selected provisions of the United Kingdom Highway Code are formalised as executable first-order logic rules using PyReason, covering speed adaptation, following distance, and road-user priority. A frozen vision-language model extracts scene predicates, which are combined with vehicle-state information to assess the projected consequences of candidate control actions. Offline evaluation on held-out data collected in the CARLA simulator compares three group-based RL methods. The results show improvements in both action prediction accuracy and encoded-rule compliance over the supervised baseline. The best-performing variant increases the overall rule pass rate from 92.9% to 97.6%, with zero observed violations of the encoded road-user-priority check in the evaluated samples. These findings support symbolic rule feedback as a means of improving VLA policy alignment with explicit traffic-rule criteria.

AI.tldr: 提出一种规则引导的VLA框架：先用专家示范做监督微调，再用带符号交通规则奖励的强化学习精修，将UK Highway Code部分条款用PyReason形式化为一阶逻辑规则，评估候选控制动作的后果。
AI.motivation: VLA模型能统一感知、推理与控制，但仅靠准确的动作预测无法保证遵守交通法规，需要显式引入规则约束以对齐策略。
AI.method: 监督微调 + 组式RL（比较三种group-based方法）精修；奖励鼓励满足编码规则并惩罚偏离专家动作；用PyReason将UK Highway Code关于限速适应、跟车距离、路权优先的条款形式化为可执行一阶逻辑；冻结VLM抽取场景谓词，结合车辆状态评估候选动作的投影后果。
AI.result: CARLA模拟器留出数据离线评估显示动作预测精度与规则合规性均优于监督基线；最佳变体将整体规则通过率从92.9%提升至97.6%，评估样本中未观察到路权优先检查违规。
AI.conclusion: 符号规则反馈可有效提升VLA策略与显式交通规则标准的一致性；但仅限CARLA离线评估，缺乏闭环与真实路测验证。

title: RAMP: Rethinking Multimodal Evaluation through Answer Readout Protocols
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are often evaluated by converting model outputs into discrete answers. The conversion protocol determines which scores become predictions and can strongly influence the reported results. We introduce RAMP (Readout Aware Multimodal Protocol), a systematic framework that compares direct yes/no token logits, surface-form scores, and typed or reversed A/B interfaces under fixed model checkpoints and paired visual questions. On 500 POPE adversarial questions, typed versus bare readout changes accuracy by $-20.2$ percentage points for SmolVLM-256M, $-16.4$ for TinyLLaVA-1.1B, and $+1.8$ for Qwen2.5-VL-3B. Paired transitions reveal extensive prediction changes even when the net accuracy difference is small: 79 of 104 binary ChartQA items change correctness for SmolVLM-500M, despite a $+1.0$-point net difference. We further analyze prompt wording, candidate forms, option position, cross-task effects, and calibration. An independent offline replay reproduces 16,140 first-token decisions from saved raw scores with exact agreement. Our findings establish answer readout as a measurable component of multimodal evaluation and provide a reproducible protocol for analyzing model comparisons.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RAMP 框架，系统比较 MLLM 在多模态评测中不同答案读出（readout）协议（yes/no logits、表面形式分数、typed/reversed A/B 接口）对准确率与预测的影响，并给出可复现的分析协议与离线重放验证。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型评测常将模型输出转换为离散答案，转换协议决定了哪些分数成为预测，可能强烈影响报告结果，而这一点此前缺乏系统量化。
AI.method: 在固定模型 checkpoint 与配对视觉问题上，对比直接 yes/no token logits、表面形式打分、typed 或 reversed A/B 接口；在 POPE 对抗问题（500 题）与 ChartQA 二分类子集上做配对转移分析，并进一步分析提示措辞、候选形式、选项位置、跨任务效应与校准；用离线重放从保存的原始分数复现首 token 决策。
AI.result: POPE 上 typed 与 bare readout 的准确率差异为 SmolVLM-256M −20.2 个点、TinyLLaVA-1.1B −16.4 个点、Qwen2.5-VL-3B +1.8 个点；即使净差异很小，预测翻转也很普遍：SmolVLM-500M 在 ChartQA 104 个二分类题中有 79 个正确性改变，而净差异仅 +1.0 点。离线重放对 16,140 个首 token 决策实现完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 答案读出是可测量的多模态评测组件，不同读出协议会显著改变模型间比较结论，因此需要报告读出细节并采用可复现的配对分析协议。

title: Learning and Verifying Progress: Closed-Loop Agentic Planning with Progress-Enhanced Execution for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Long-horizon vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to track instruction progress and recover from local errors before they propagate across subtasks. However, executors trained on expert trajectories encounter policy-induced state shifts during deployment, and their stop signals do not reliably indicate subtask completion. We introduce Learning and Verifying Progress for VLN (LeaP-VLN), an agentic VLN system that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification through plan--execute--verify--recover cycles. LeaP-VLN leverages progress both explicitly, through a progress verifier that verifies subtask completion before the agent advances and triggers dual-phase recovery upon route deviation, and implicitly, by co-training the executor on progress reasoning and action prediction to enhance the executor's progress awareness and corrective control. To adapt the executor to this closed-loop interface, we propose a two-stage progress-enhanced curriculum: behavior cloning on expert demonstrations, followed by joint training on demonstrations, expert action corrections, and progress-reasoning supervision. Policy-generated trajectories expose the executor to both intra-subtask drift and inter-subtask state shifts, aligning training with the deviations encountered during closed-loop execution. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates among monocular methods trained without additional navigation datasets, while real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness of LeaP-VLN in long-horizon navigation.

AI.tldr: LeaP-VLN 将视觉语言导航拆为“规划—执行—验证—恢复”闭环：进度验证器独立校验子任务完成，执行器则通过进度推理与动作预测联合训练获得进度感知与纠错能力，并用两阶段课程（专家示范行为克隆 + 示范/专家纠正/进度推理监督联合训练）适配闭环接口。
AI.motivation: 长程 VLN 中，基于专家轨迹训练的执行器在部署时会遭遇策略诱导的状态分布偏移，且其停止信号并不可靠地指示子任务完成，导致局部错误沿子任务链传播。因此需要显式的进度追踪与独立验证机制。
AI.method: 提出 LeaP-VLN 智能体式系统：外环为 plan–execute–verify–recover 循环，进度验证器在子任务推进前确认完成，偏离路线时触发双阶段恢复；内环将进度推理与动作预测联合训练以增强执行器进度感知与纠正控制。训练采用两阶段进度增强课程：先专家示范行为克隆，再在示范、专家动作纠正与进度推理监督上联合训练，并使用策略生成轨迹引入子任务内漂移与子任务间状态偏移。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 上取得单目、且未使用额外导航数据集训练方法中的 SOTA 成功率；真实环境实验进一步验证了长程导航中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式进度验证 + 隐式进度感知执行 + 闭环课程训练能有效抑制误差累积，说明“验证者/恢复模块”是长程具身导航的重要架构组件，具备实机可迁移性。

title: Room for Supervision: Training-Free Dataset Distillation for Object Detection
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) reduces storage and training costs by compressing large datasets into small collections. Most existing methods focus on image classification, where each image typically has a single category label. In contrast, object detection requires accurate category and bounding box annotations for multiple objects, together with visual content consistent with those annotations. Existing detection distillation pipelines rely on learned models and can alter the spatial relationships between objects and their backgrounds. We introduce GRASP, which packs dense native supervision into limited pixels without network training or inference. GRASP jointly searches over image selections and spatial layouts using convex allocation subproblems that penalize insufficient object resolution, excessive image compression, and padding that source context cannot fill. During composition, each selected image is cropped around all annotated objects and expanded into surrounding context without reducing object scale. The resized regions are then combined into distilled images, preserving the spatial layout within each region and retaining all original class labels and bounding box annotations. We evaluate GRASP on MS COCO and PASCAL VOC with compression ratios ranging from 0.25\% to 2\%. GRASP constructs the 1\% MS COCO dataset in under two minutes. Under a common training protocol using hard labels, GRASP achieves the state of the art with both CNN and ViT backbones. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: GRASP：无需模型训练/推理的检测数据集蒸馏方法，联合搜索图像选择与空间布局，把稠密的目标检测标注打包进极少像素，在COCO/VOC上0.25%–2%压缩率下用硬标签训练达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集蒸馏多面向单标签图像分类；目标检测需要对多目标的类别与边界框精确标注，且视觉内容须与标注一致。已有检测蒸馏流程依赖学习模型，并可能改变目标与其背景间的空间关系。
AI.method: GRASP将图像选择与空间布局联合建模为凸分配子问题，惩罚三项：目标分辨率不足、图像过度压缩、无法被源上下文填充的padding。合成阶段对每张选中图像围绕其全部标注目标裁剪，并在不缩小目标尺度的前提下向周边上下文扩展，再将缩放后的区域拼接为蒸馏图像，保持各区域内部空间布局，保留全部原始类别标签与边界框标注。全程无网络训练或推理。
AI.result: 在MS COCO与PASCAL VOC上以0.25%–2%压缩率评测；构建1% MS COCO数据集耗时不到两分钟；在通用硬标签训练协议下，CNN与ViT骨干均取得SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 面向目标检测的数据集蒸馏可在不依赖学习模型的前提下，通过显式布局优化与保尺度裁剪拼接保留原生稠密监督，实现高效且强竞争力的压缩数据集构建；该思路可推广至其他需稠密标注的任务。

title: VIVID: A Visual Harness for Agentic Video Editing
summary: Video editing requires agents to make editing decisions grounded in audiovisual observations and precise temporal localization, and to evaluate their effects in rendered outputs. General-purpose coding agents possess strong comprehension, reasoning, and code execution capabilities, while media interaction and evidence management mechanisms tailored to video tasks can further unlock their editing potential. We introduce VIVID, a visual harness that supports multiple native coding agents in video post-production without additional model training. VIVID provides tools for on-demand video inspection, audio analysis, and transcription, and preserves observations alongside their corresponding media versions and temporal coordinates. Agents can actively retrieve these observations as they reason, perform edits using their native coding and shell tools, and inspect rendered outputs to guide subsequent revisions. On AgenticVBench, comprising 100 tasks across Assembly, Repair, Sequencing, and Repurpose, Codex with VIVID achieves an average score of 58.6%, an improvement of 20.2 percentage points over native Codex. The same harness also integrates with Claude Code and OpenCode, achieving average scores of 55.1% and 37.1%, respectively, both substantially exceeding their native baselines. These results highlight VIVID's potential as a reusable visual harness for extending the capabilities of general-purpose coding agents to video editing.

AI.tldr: VIVID：无需训练的"视觉执行环境（visual harness）"，为通用编码智能体接入视频检查、音频分析与转写工具，并以"媒体版本+时间坐标"管理观察证据，支持主动检索、原生代码/Shell编辑、渲染回看迭代。AgenticVBench(100任务，Assembly/Repair/Sequencing/Repurpose)上Codex+VIVID平均58.6%，较原生Codex提升20.2点；Claude Code 55.1%、OpenCode 37.1%。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑要求智能体基于视听观察做决策、精确定位时间区间，并在渲染产物上自评效果。通用编码智能体已有较强理解/推理/代码执行能力，但缺少适配视频任务的媒体交互与证据管理机制，导致其编辑潜力未被释放；作者希望在不额外训练模型的前提下补齐这一"工具与记忆层"。
AI.method: 提出VIVID视觉harness：1）工具层：按需视频抽帧/片段检查、音频分析、语音转写；2）证据层：将观察结果与对应媒体版本（version）和时间坐标（timestamp/interval）绑定存档，支持按需检索；3）执行层：智能体沿用原生coding/shell工具做剪辑；4）闭环层：检查渲染输出并驱动后续修订。整体为推理-检索-编辑-验证的迭代智能体循环，model-agnostic，可插拔多个原生编码智能体（Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode），无训练。
AI.result: 在AgenticVBench（100任务，涵盖Assemble/Repair/Sequencing/Repurpose四类）上：Codex+VIVID平均58.6%，相对原生Codex提升+20.2pp；Claude Code平均55.1%、OpenCode平均37.1%，均显著超过各自原生基线，表明harness增益跨模型可迁移。
AI.conclusion: VIVID展示了"视觉harness+证据管理"这一可复用范式，可将通用编码智能体的能力延伸到视频后期制作等长时序、需精确定位的媒体任务；其价值在于基础设施而非新模型，具备跨智能体泛化性。

title: ARMFUL: Learning Whole-Arm Grasp Configurations for Single-Arm Pickup of Large Objects
summary: Many everyday objects, such as storage boxes, baskets, and chairs, are too large or heavy for a gripper to grasp, yet a single arm can still pick them up by wrapping around and supporting them. Such grasps are hard to learn: wrapping motions are difficult to teleoperate, and existing datasets contain little whole-arm pickup data. We introduce WAG (Whole-Arm Grasp Dataset), the first large-scale dataset for single-arm pickup of large objects, with 1.7~million joint configurations across 793 objects. We sample configurations directly in joint space, execute each through squeeze and lift primitives in simulation, and stress-test survivors under active shaking and external forces. To demonstrate the utility of WAG and accomplish the whole-arm pickup task, we develop ARMFUL, a whole-arm pickup pipeline that pairs a diffusion model trained on WAG, generating whole-arm grasps from the object's point cloud, with a motion planner that reaches them collision-free before the same squeeze-and-lift execution. In simulation, ARMFUL reaches 85.4\% lift success on training and 69.9\% on held-out objects, and it lifts the object in 70 of 100 trials on a physical Franka arm across 10 IKEA objects.

AI.tldr: 提出WAG数据集（1.7M关节配置、793物体、仿真中squeeze+lift并加抖动/外力压力测试）与ARMFUL流水线（点云扩散模型生成全身臂抓取+无碰撞运动规划），仿真85.4%/69.9%，真机Franka在10个IKEA物体上100次试验成功70次。
AI.motivation: 大件物体（储物箱、篮子、椅子）超出夹爪能力，但单臂环抱并托举即可搬运；此类wrap环绕动作难以遥操采集，现有数据集缺乏全身臂抓取数据，导致该技能难以学习。
AI.method: 直接在关节空间采样配置，经squeeze与lift原语在仿真中执行筛选，再用主动抖动与外力做鲁棒性压力测试，构成WAG数据；ARMFUL用WAG训练的扩散模型从物体点云生成全身臂抓取位姿，配合运动规划器无碰撞到达并复用同一squeeze-lift执行。
AI.result: 仿真中训练物体提升成功率85.4%、未见物体69.9%；真实Franka机械臂在10个IKEA物体上100次试验成功70次。
AI.conclusion: 关节空间采样+物理过滤可自动生成大规模全身臂抓取数据，扩散策略加运动规划能将该能力迁移到真实机器人，验证了数据驱动全身臂环抱抓取的可行性。

title: STARS: Stage-Adaptive Responsibility Separation for Shadow Removal in Remote Sensing Images
summary: Shadows are a ubiquitous radiative attenuation phenomenon in remote sensing images and can severely affect high-resolution remote sensing interpretation tasks. In shadow removal, although introducing a mask prior provides explicit positional information for the restoration network, it also causes non-shadow regions to be modulated by the shadow prior, producing a systematic brightness shift; notably, this phenomenon is independent of whether the mask is accurate. In remote sensing images, non-shadow regions usually occupy a larger proportion, so a small shift over these regions incurs a much higher cost on whole-image metrics than an equal gain in shadow regions. Adopting a task-decoupling perspective, we therefore decompose shadow removal into two tasks, shadow-region restoration and non-shadow-region identity, within a cascaded architecture, and handle them sequentially. Based on this insight, we propose STARS, a cascaded shadow removal framework that separates regional responsibilities across stages. The method retains the advantages of the shadow mask while resolving the degradation of non-shadow regions, without requiring a complex parallel dual-branch structure. Meanwhile, to introduce large-model prior knowledge into remote sensing tasks, we further design a Feature Selection and Fusion Adapter (FSFA). We conduct extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets, UAV-SC+, ISTD+ and WSRD+ 2026, demonstrating the superiority of STARS. The framework shows that decoupling regional responsibilities can resolve the intrinsic contradiction of mask priors, providing a new direction for image restoration with region heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 提出级联式阴影去除框架 STARS，将任务解耦为"阴影区域复原"与"非阴影区域恒等保持"两个阶段，并设计大模型先验的特征选择融合适配器 FSFA。
AI.motivation: 掩膜先验虽为复原网络提供显式位置信息，但会使非阴影区域被阴影先验调制，产生系统性亮度偏移，且该偏移与掩膜准确度无关；遥感图像中非阴影区域占比大，微小偏移在全图指标上的代价远高于阴影区域的等量增益。
AI.method: 从任务解耦视角将阴影去除拆分为阴影区域复原与非阴影区域恒等两个子任务，在级联架构中顺序处理，分阶段分配区域责任，避免复杂的并行双分支结构；同时设计特征选择与融合适配器（FSFA），将大模型先验知识引入遥感任务。
AI.result: 在 UAV-SC+、ISTD+ 与 WSRD+ 2026 三个基准数据集上进行了大量实验，验证了 STARS 的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 区域责任解耦可化解掩膜先验的内在矛盾，为存在区域异质性的图像复原问题提供了新方向。

title: Design of the Secure Smart Scooter with Automatic Lane Detection
comment: 4 pages, Published in 16th IEEE International Conference on Service Operations and Logistics, and Informatics (IEEE SOLI 2022)
summary: The authors present a prototype of an electric scooter that uses computer vision to determine driving lanes and automatically modify vehicle configuration. Scooters steer on sidewalks, bike paths, or car lanes. The government imposes speed limits on the lanes in which electric scooters drive. Featuring computer vision, electric scooters can determine driving lanes and automatically modify vehicle configuration. However, such systems' safety is still a concern, and research into such vehicle systems' safety and security aspects is proceeding. First, we will present our vehicular setup. Then, we will present our implemented scooter with safety constraints. Finally, we present our security prototype for such an electric scooter.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于计算机视觉识别行驶车道并自动调整车辆配置的电动滑板车原型，涵盖硬件设置、带安全约束的实现以及安全（Security）原型。
AI.motivation: 政府按车道（人行道、自行车道、机动车道）对电动滑板车限速，需让车辆自动识别所处车道并动态调整配置以合规；同时此类系统的安全性与信息安全仍存疑，需系统性研究。
AI.method: 视觉感知车道分类 + 车辆配置自动切换的车载原型系统；叠加安全约束设计，并构建面向该系统的安全原型（威胁/攻击面验证）。
AI.result: 摘要仅给出原型框架与三个组成部分（车载设置、带安全约束的滑板车、安全原型），未提供量化实验、数据集或评估指标。
AI.conclusion: 工作偏系统原型与安全/可靠性论证，缺少可复现的方法细节与实证数据，可作为车规级视觉感知+安全性的背景参考。

title: Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material is available as an ancillary file
summary: Generating consistent multi-view RGB images and normal maps from a single input image provides complementary appearance and geometric cues for 3D reconstruction. However, maintaining cross-view consistency requires information exchange across viewpoints, and dense cross-view attention becomes computationally expensive as the number of views and spatial resolution increase. In this paper, we propose Global-Local Proxy Attention (GLPA) to reduce cross-view communication costs while preserving fine-grained within-view processing. Specifically, GLPA retains full-resolution interactions within each view and uses compact global proxies for cross-view communication. To further leverage the exchanged information, GLPA incorporates iterative proxy refinement, which rebuilds the proxies from updated features and reuses the same attention parameters for subsequent interactions within a single denoising step. We evaluate GLPA on two structurally different diffusion backbones, FLUX and Stable Diffusion. Experiments on FLUX show that GLPA achieves a $2.65\times$ speedup in attention computation per denoising step over dense attention, while improving reconstruction IoU from 0.6849 to 0.7019 and reducing NVS LPIPS from 0.086 to 0.076. Results on Stable Diffusion further demonstrate the effectiveness of GLPA, with a $1.80\times$ attention speedup and improvements across all five quality metrics.

AI.tldr: GLPA：在扩散模型多视图生成中，视图内保留全分辨率注意力，视图间用紧凑的“全局代理”token 通信，并迭代重建代理，从而在降低跨视图注意力成本的同时保持一致性。
AI.motivation: 从单图生成一致的多视图 RGB 与法线图可为三维重建提供外观与几何线索，但跨视图一致性需要视图间信息交换；稠密的跨视图注意力随视图数与分辨率增长而计算昂贵。
AI.method: 提出 Global-Local Proxy Attention (GLPA)：视图内维持全分辨率交互，跨视图通过紧凑的全局代理（proxy tokens）进行通信；引入迭代式代理精化，在单次去噪步内由更新后的特征重建代理并复用同一组注意力参数进行后续交互。在 FLUX 与 Stable Diffusion 两种结构不同的扩散骨干上验证。
AI.result: FLUX 上每去噪步注意力计算相比稠密注意力提速 2.65×，重建 IoU 由 0.6849 升至 0.7019，NVS LPIPS 由 0.086 降至 0.076；Stable Diffusion 上提速 1.80×，五项质量指标均改善。
AI.conclusion: 以“局部全分辨率 + 全局代理跨视图”的注意力设计可在显著降低多视图注意力开销的同时提升跨视图一致性与重建质量，且对多种扩散骨干具有通用性。

title: QASK-Edit: Adaptive Sparse Attention Across Queries and Key Sources for Efficient Video Editing
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in generation based video editing, but suffer from high inference latency due to the long token sequences formed by conditioning inputs and generated videos. Although training-free sparse attention reduces this cost, existing methods typically apply a fixed retention ratio or a single threshold shared across all tokens. In this work, we view video editing as conditional generation and identify a key insight: attention demand varies significantly both across different key sources (e.g., source videos, reference images, audio, text, and generated videos) and across queries within each source. Motivated by this, we propose QASK-Edit (Query-Adaptive Sparsity over Key Sources for Video Editing), a training-free sparse attention framework that allocates computation independently for each query and key source. Specifically, for each query, QASK-Edit considers both the attention mass and approximation risk of each block. It then evaluates candidate routing thresholds against each key source's risk budget, choosing exact computation or approximations to dynamically adjust sparsity for each query. Extensive experiments on three video editing models demonstrate that QASK-Edit achieves up to $1.46\times$ end-to-end speedup over dense attention pipeline while preserving both editing quality and unedited region fidelity. Furthermore, QASK-Edit generalizes directly to Reference-to-Video generation, delivering up to $1.36\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality.

AI.tldr: QASK-Edit：面向视频编辑DiT的免训练稀疏注意力框架，按每个query与每种key来源独立分配计算量，兼顾注意力质量与近似风险，实现最高1.46×端到端加速且保持编辑质量与非编辑区域保真。
AI.motivation: DiT在视频编辑中因条件输入与生成视频构成超长token序列而推理延迟高；现有免训练稀疏注意力采用固定保留率或全局单一阈值，忽略了不同key来源（源视频、参考图、音频、文本、生成视频）之间以及同一来源内不同query的注意力需求差异。
AI.method: 将视频编辑建模为条件生成，提出QASK-Edit：为每个query的每个key来源独立分配计算；对每个query同时估计各block的注意力质量与近似风险，用各key来源的风险预算评估候选路由阈值，从而在精确计算与近似之间动态选择，逐query自适应调整稀疏度。
AI.result: 在三个视频编辑模型上，相对稠密注意力流水线实现最高1.46×端到端加速，同时保持编辑质量与非编辑区域保真度；并可直接泛化到Reference-to-Video生成，取得最高1.36×加速且维持生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度的query级、来源级稀疏分配优于固定保留率/单一阈值策略；该框架具有跨模型与跨任务的免训练泛化性，为大模型视频编辑的推理效率提供了可复用方案。

title: SG-ODOM: Event-Driven Proprioceptive State Estimation with Stability-Gated Contact Updates for Legged Robots
summary: Reliable proprioceptive state estimation for legged robots fuses inertial sensing with kinematic sensing from leg encoders. The latter assumes a foot is stationary during the stance phase; however, physical foot touchdown does not necessarily provide a stationary reference for odometry, particularly during impact and load transfer. Repeatedly applying kinematic corrections throughout the same contact phase can introduce redundant or unreliable information. We present SG-ODOM, a proprioceptive odometry framework that uses stability-gated contact selection to schedule kinematic updates. Following physical touchdown, a stability gate accepts the contact for state estimation only after the foot reaches a sufficiently stable support condition. The resulting validated touchdown event triggers an estimator correction, while additional timeout updates bound the maximum duration of uninterrupted IMU propagation. The framework is evaluated on multiple legged platforms, both quadrupedal and humanoid robots, against representative state-of-the-art proprioceptive estimators. Across the evaluated sequences, SG-ODOM demonstrates competitive or superior estimation accuracy, reducing Relative Pose Error (RPE) by up to 25% compared to the baseline estimator on outdoor sequences from the GrandTour dataset. Source code: this https URL . Video: this https URL

AI.tldr: SG-ODOM: 用"稳定门控触地选择"决定何时施加腿部运动学修正的足式机器人本体感知里程计框架，在多平台（四足+人形）上取得有竞争力或更优精度，户外序列RPE最高降低25%。
AI.motivation: 传统腿部里程计假设支撑相内足端静止，但物理触地（impact、load transfer）并不立即构成可靠的静止参考；在同一接触相位内反复施加运动学修正会引入冗余甚至错误信息。
AI.method: 提出稳定性门控（stability gate）接触选择机制：物理触地后先判定足端是否达到足够稳定的支撑状态，仅通过门控的"已验证触地事件"才触发EKF类估计器修正；辅以超时更新来限制IMU纯递推的最大持续时间。属于松耦合IMU+腿编码器融合流程中的调度策略改进。
AI.result: 在四足与人形多平台上与代表性SOTA本体感知估计器对比，精度相当或更优；GrandTour户外序列RPE相对基线最高降低约25%。开源代码与视频。
AI.conclusion: "何时修正"与"如何修正"同等重要：将触地检测与稳定支撑判定解耦，可显著提升足式本体感知里程计鲁棒性；方法轻量、易集成，但属调度层改进而非新的估计器架构。

title: TaF-Foundation: Wrench-Grounded Cross-Sensor Tactile Representations
summary: Tactile sensing is essential for contact-rich manipulation, yet heterogeneous sensing mechanisms and observation formats hinder cross-hardware transfer. Since physical contact is governed by Newtonian mechanics, we ground tactile representations in six-dimensional wrenches, establishing a common physical reference across sensing mechanisms. Specifically, we pair tactile observations from all sensors with wrench measurements, enabling shared physical supervision without requiring direct tactile-to-tactile pairing between sensors. To support learning at scale, we develop a dedicated acquisition platform and collect over 100 million paired tactile observations and wrench measurements from 24 sensors spanning four families of sensing principles. Building on this dataset, our framework combines sensor-specific input adaptation with a shared tactile encoder. By learning to reconstruct wrenches, the encoder maps observations from different sensors into a shared, continuous feature space grounded in contact physics. To leverage these representations for manipulation, we introduce TaF-Policy, which integrates tactile features with visual observations and robot states to generate action chunks. We evaluate the learned representations through wrench estimation, cross-sensor retrieval, few-shot adaptation to unseen sensors, and robotic manipulation. On the core benchmark, our method reduces single-frame force RMSE by 17.1% and improves cross-sensor retrieval R@1 by 13.11 percentage points over the strongest baseline. In manipulation experiments, TaF-Policy achieves average success rates of 51.33% across three simulated tasks and 46.25% across four real-world tasks, compared with 47.33% and 23.75%, respectively, for the strongest baselines evaluated on the same task sets. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 以六维力/力矩（wrench）作为跨传感器触觉表征的物理锚点，构建1亿+配对触觉-力数据（24传感器、4类原理），学习共享触觉编码器，并提出TaF-Policy将触觉特征与视觉、本体状态融合生成动作块。
AI.motivation: 触觉对富接触操作至关重要，但异构传感机理与观测格式差异阻碍跨硬件迁移；由于物理接触均受牛顿力学约束，可用六维wrench建立跨传感器的统一物理参考，从而避免传感器间直接触觉-触觉配对。
AI.method: 搭建专用采集平台采集>1亿触觉观测与wrench测量；框架采用传感器特定输入适配 + 共享触觉编码器，以重构wrench为监督信号，将不同传感器观测映射到统一连续特征空间；下游TaF-Policy融合触觉特征、视觉观测与机器人状态，输出action chunk。
AI.result: 单帧力RMSE较最强基线降低17.1%，跨传感器检索R@1提升13.11个百分点；仿真三任务平均成功率51.33%（基线47.33%），真实四任务46.25%（基线23.75%）。
AI.conclusion: 以wrench为物理基础的表征可有效统一异构触觉传感，显著提升跨传感器泛化与真实操作成功率，真实环境中相对基线近乎翻倍，验证了物理接地表征对富接触操作的价值。

title: ACiT: Proprioceptive-Prior Action Chunking with Inverted Transformers
summary: Visuomotor policies condition action prediction on visual and proprioceptive observations. While historical proprioceptive sequences carry rich dynamic priors, current methods treat them as equal to high-dimensional vision, causing the proprioceptive signal to be overwhelmed. To identify what is lost in equal-conditioning fusion, we analyze proprioceptive data and find that strong inter-joint coupling is the key action-determining structure. This finding aligns with the neural sensorimotor loop, in which proprioception first forms a body-centered prior and vision is later calibrated via parietal remapping. Inspired by this, we propose ACiT, Proprioceptive-Prior Action Chunking with Inverted Transformers, which reinforces historical joint-coupling as the primary condition with vision as a later calibration. This design is instantiated through three modules: Inverted State Encoding builds a proprioceptive prior via per-joint tokens and inter-joint self-attention. State-Visual Grounding lets joint tokens query visual evidence, making vision goal- and calibration-only. Inverted Action Chunking decodes per-joint trajectories independently. ACiT improves success rates on most LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world tasks, with the largest gains on those that require dynamics and coordination. The same conditioning design transferred to the VLA backbone pi_0-ACiT yields significant gains with better execution efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 ACiT，将历史本体感受（关节耦合）作为主要条件、视觉作为后续校准，通过倒置状态编码、状态-视觉接地与倒置动作分块解码，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 与真实机器人任务上提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态视觉运动策略将高维视觉与本体感受信号等权融合，导致富含动力学先验的关节序列信号被视觉淹没；作者发现关节间强耦合是决定动作的关键结构，且与神经感觉运动环路中"本体感受先形成体心先验、视觉后经顶叶重映射校准"的机制相符。
AI.method: 三模块设计：1) Inverted State Encoding，以每关节 token 与关节间自注意力构建本体感受先验；2) State-Visual Grounding，让关节 token 查询视觉证据，使视觉仅承担目标指示与校准作用；3) Inverted Action Chunking，独立解码每关节轨迹。该条件化范式还可迁移到 VLA 主干 pi_0（pi_0-ACiT）。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 多数任务及真实世界任务上成功率提升，在需要动力学与协调的任务上增益最大；迁移至 pi_0 主干后获得显著提升且执行效率更好。
AI.conclusion: 本体感受应作为主导条件、视觉作为校准信号的非对称条件化设计，是提升操作策略动力学建模与协调能力的有效途径，并具备跨主干（含 VLA）的可迁移性。

title: AVD: A Multi-Sensor Teleoperated Wheelchair Platform with Safety-Aware Control
summary: Electric wheelchairs predominantly rely on manual joystick interfaces, which present critical barriers to independent mobility for individuals with severe motor and visual impairments. This paper presents AVD (Autonomous Vehicle Drive), a dependable teleoperation architecture for assistive mobility that unifies perception, communication, embedded control, and remote supervision in a single low-cost platform built entirely from commercially available hardware. The central engineering contribution is a safety-oriented design framework: control authority follows a static hierarchy, a manual emergency stop and the occupant's joystick pre-empt remote commands, and the on-board sensing layer has stop-only authority. The compute design partitions primary and safety functions and specifies a heartbeat-driven safe-state transition for the fault cases considered. The sensing stack this framework depends on is characterized against measured data: per-channel acquisition latency, a 2,025-scan LiDAR degradation campaign spanning five target configurations and a control under water mist, airborne dust, and direct aperture occlusion, and attitude measurements across static inclines to 47 degrees. The lowest pooled environmental-condition mean retained 76.6% of the clear-baseline forward-sector yield, and no scan lost the sector completely. A logged vibration-induced inertial dropout occurred while LiDAR and camera logging continued, illustrating complementary channel behavior. The result is a documented prototype and an explicit validation path for a deployable wheelchair implementation.

AI.tldr: 提出AVD低成本遥控辅助轮椅架构，统一感知、通信、嵌入式控制与远程监督，给出静态控制权限层级与安全状态切换设计，并对传感器栈做实测表征。
AI.motivation: 电动轮椅主要依赖手动摇杆，重度运动与视觉障碍者无法独立出行，需要可靠的远程操作与安全保障方案。
AI.method: 硬件全商用件搭建；控制权限静态分层（手动急停与乘坐者摇杆优先，车载感知仅有停止权）；计算分区隔离主功能与安全功能，心跳驱动安全状态切换；实测通道延迟、2025次LiDAR退化实验（五种目标配置+水雾/粉尘/遮挡）、47度静态倾角姿态测量。
AI.result: 最差环境条件平均保留76.6%的清晰基线前扇区回波产出，无扫描完全丢失该扇区；记录到振动导致惯性掉线而LiDAR与相机日志持续，体现通道互补性。
AI.conclusion: 产出有文档的原型与明确的验证路径，为可部署轮椅实现提供参考，但缺乏真实用户闭环自主导航实验。

title: Selective Sensor Acquisition for Multimodal Place Recognition
