summary: Multimodal Place Recognition (PR) can improve robustness, but most systems rigidly read and process every sensor for every query, even when the primary sensor is sufficient, with implications for energy consumption, second sensor update rate, and domain-specific considerations such as passive stealth. We introduce selective, controllable sensor acquisition, where a user specifies a desired second sensor usage rate and the system acquires the additional sensor only when the primary sensor's estimated performance is sufficiently poor. An online threshold adjustment achieves the requested usage rate by adapting to recent primary sensor performance, directing additional sensing towards queries where fusion is most likely to help without calibration specific to sensor modality, PR method, or environment. The approach requires only a PR method that produces a match score and applies to both single-frame and sequence-based PR. Our system, across multiple datasets, PR descriptors, and sensor combinations, recovers 55% of the available PR performance gain while using the second sensor on only 25% of queries, and 81% while using it on 50%. We further analyse alternative acquisition decision mechanisms and usage-rate control methods, and examine performance when the second sensor is stronger than, comparable to, or weaker than the primary sensor.

AI.tldr: 提出"选择性可控传感器采集"的多模态位置识别(PR)框架：用户指定第二传感器使用率，系统仅在主传感器估计性能较差时才采集第二传感器；通过在线阈值自适应调节以达成目标使用率，无需针对传感器模态/PR方法/环境标定。
AI.motivation: 多模态PR虽提升鲁棒性，但现有系统对每个查询都刚性读取并处理全部传感器，造成能耗、第二传感器更新率受限，以及被动隐身等领域约束。需要"按需融合"。
AI.method: 仅利用PR方法输出的匹配分数作为主传感器性能估计，设置阈值决定是否触发第二传感器采集；在线自适应调整阈值以匹配用户设定的使用率，将额外感知导向最可能从融合中获益的查询。与传感器模态、PR方法、环境解耦，兼容单帧与序列式PR。
AI.result: 在多数据集、多PR描述子、多传感器组合上，仅用25%查询的第二传感器即回收55%可用PR性能增益，50%使用率时回收81%；并分析了其它采集决策机制与使用率控制方法，以及第二传感器强于/相当/弱于主传感器时的表现。
AI.conclusion: 只需匹配分数的选择性采集机制可低成本地在大幅降低第二传感器使用的同时保留多数融合收益，具备跨模态与跨环境通用性，适合能耗/更新率/隐蔽性受限的部署场景。

title: CLIFT: Contrastive LiDAR Instance Features for 3D Pedestrian Tracking
summary: A social robot has to keep track of the people around it over time to plan its motion, a task handled by 3D multi-object tracking. For the LiDAR modality, trackers usually sit on top of a detector and link its detections across frames with a separate motion model or re-identification network. We instead show how a 3D LiDAR detector itself can be turned into a tracker by adding an instance-level contrastive objective on its intermediate voxel features. Each embedding is read from the voxels inside a detected box, and boxes are matched across frames by cosine similarity and the Hungarian algorithm, without a motion model. The detector backbone is fine-tuned together with this objective, which learns identity-aware features while leaving detection accuracy essen- tially intact. Because the method uses only the voxel features that Li- DAR detectors already produce, it is backbone-agnostic. On the JRDB 3D tracking leaderboard our LiDAR-only tracker ranks first on HOTA (38.58) and IDF1 (37.99), 13.04 and 9.30 points above the next pub- lished method, and second on MOTA and OSPA. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 在LiDAR检测器的中间体素特征上加入实例级对比学习目标，使检测器本身兼具跟踪能力；仅用余弦相似度+匈牙利匹配跨帧关联，无需运动模型，在JRDB 3D跟踪榜HOTA/IDF1第一。
AI.motivation: 社交机器人需持续跟踪周围行人以规划运动（3D多目标跟踪）。现有LiDAR跟踪器通常"检测器+独立运动模型/re-ID网络"的二阶段串联范式，结构冗余、依赖额外模块。
AI.method: 在LiDAR检测器骨干的体素特征上增加实例级对比损失，从检测框内体素读出embedding；跨帧用余弦相似度与匈牙利算法做关联，不使用运动模型；骨干与对比目标联合微调，获得身份感知特征。方法只依赖检测器已有体素特征，与骨干无关（backbone-agnostic）。
AI.result: JRDB 3D跟踪排行榜上，纯LiDAR跟踪器HOTA 38.58、IDF1 37.99均列第一，分别高出次优已发表方法13.04与9.30点；MOTA与OSPA列第二；检测精度基本不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 将跟踪能力隐式内嵌于检测器特征是一种简洁有效的方案，省去运动模型与独立re-ID分支，且具骨干通用性；提供了3D MOT的轻量化新范式。

title: Robotic Reward Models in the Foundation-Model Era
summary: Robotic reward models (RRMs) use foundation models to replace per-task reward engineering with reusable, task-conditioned evaluation. Yet under one name, their outputs answer different questions, from whether a task succeeded to which execution is better. This survey organizes 114 methods into five semantic families by the question their native outputs answer: Outcome, Absolute Progress, Relative, Temporal Value, and Hybrid. Within this taxonomy, we review how model design determines what an evaluator can judge, how raw experience becomes supervision, and how existing evaluation practice tests the result. The review exposes a gap: agreement with demonstration order and downstream policy gains do not show whether a reward tracks task fulfillment. We therefore introduce RRM-Bench-1K, 1,117 real-robot videos of closed-loop executions with task-state and camera-evidence labels, and four contrast suites that separate the credited condition from its usual cues. A unified study of 27 evaluators shows that the strongest final scores rank whole executions well enough for selection and filtering. Dense credit, however, follows the progression of an execution more closely than its task state, and no evaluator signals when the decisive view is missing. How much fidelity a reward model needs therefore depends on the decision it drives. We outline directions from real-failure supervision to metrics that separate task state from chronology, and open-source RRM-Hub, a toolbox in which 14 existing RRMs can be readily applied and new evaluators tested on the same capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本综述将114种机器人奖励模型按"原生输出回答的问题"分为Outcome、Absolute Progress、Relative、Temporal Value、Hybrid五类，指出现有评测（偏好一致性、下游策略收益）无法验证奖励是否真正反映任务完成度，并提出RRM-Bench-1K（1117段真实机器人闭环视频+任务状态与相机证据标签+4组对照）与RRM-Hub工具箱，对27个评测器进行统一研究。
AI.motivation: 机器人奖励模型（RRM）被用于以基础模型替代逐任务奖励工程，但同名之下其输出实际回答不同问题（任务是否成功、哪次执行更好、进度多少等），导致概念混淆；同时现有评测实践（与示教顺序的一致性、下游策略增益）无法证明奖励信号真正追踪任务完成情况，缺乏可诊断的评测基准。
AI.method: 基于"原生输出回答何种问题"建立五类语义分类法（Outcome、Absolute Progress、Relative、Temporal Value、Hybrid）组织114种方法；分析模型设计如何决定评测能力、原始经验如何转化为监督信号、现有评测实践如何检验结果。构建RRM-Bench-1K：1117段真实机器人闭环执行视频，标注任务状态与相机证据，并设计四组对照套件以分离被归因条件与其常见相关线索；对27个评测器做统一对比研究；开源RRM-Hub工具箱，支持14个现有RRM直接调用。
AI.result: 最强评测器的最终分数能较好地对整段执行排序，足以支持选择与筛选；但稠密信用（dense credit）更多跟随执行的时间推进而非任务状态，且没有任何评测器能在决定性视角缺失时给出信号。表明奖励模型所需保真度取决于其驱动的下游决策。
AI.conclusion: 提出面向真实失败监督的研究方向，以及将任务状态与时间顺序解耦的评测指标；开源RRM-Hub以在同一能力维度上比较与测试新旧评测器。核心结论：RRM评测应从"排序一致性"转向"任务状态保真度"。

title: A Seismic Foundation Model for Dense Feature Extraction
summary: Deep-learning-based seismic interpretation is constrained by scarce high-quality annotations, and most existing models are trained separately for individual tasks. We present SeisDFE, a 7B-parameter seismic foundation model for dense feature extraction, pretrained on 5.34 million 2D images derived from more than 500 seismic volumes. A three-stage pretraining strategy, combining discriminative self-supervised learning, Gram feature anchoring, and multi-resolution adaptation, improves feature discriminability while preserving spatial coherence. With its encoder frozen, SeisDFE supports seismic facies classification, salt detection, fault detection, and relative geologic time estimation. It outperforms existing seismic foundation models on all four tasks and a natural-image-pretrained model on all but fault detection, with the largest gains under scarce supervision: using only two annotated sections of the F3 dataset, it improves whole-volume mIoU by 12-19 percentage points over the baselines. The learned features remain effective with task-specific decoders and extend to synthetic-to-field transfer and sparse 3D geobody interpretation. These results show that large-scale seismic pretraining organizes geological information into dense representations that are directly reusable across interpretation tasks.

AI.tldr: SeisDFE：7B 参数地震基础模型，在 534 万张来自 500+ 地震体的 2D 图像上三阶段预训练（判别式自监督 + Gram 特征锚定 + 多分辨率适配），冻结编码器支持地震相分类、盐体检测、断层检测与相对地质时间估计四类稠密任务，少样本下提升显著。
AI.motivation: 地震解释深度学习受限于高质量标注稀缺，且现有模型多为单任务分别训练，缺乏可复用的稠密表征。
AI.method: 构建 7B 参数地震基础模型用于稠密特征提取；数据为 500+ 地震体切出的 534 万幅 2D 图像；三阶段预训练：判别式自监督学习、Gram 矩阵特征锚定以保持空间相干性、多分辨率适配；编码器冻结，接轻量任务解码头（分相/盐体/断层/RGT）。
AI.result: 在四个任务上均优于现有地震基础模型；除断层检测外优于自然图像预训练模型；F3 数据集仅用 2 个标注剖面时，全数据体 mIoU 相对基线提升 12–19 个百分点；特征可迁移到合成到野外迁移与稀疏 3D 地质体解释。
AI.conclusion: 大规模地震域预训练可将地质信息组织为可直接复用的稠密表征，少监督条件下收益最大，支持多任务解码器与跨域迁移。

title: STA: A Split Temporal Adversary Method for Evaluating Robustness of Multimodal RL-based Driving Policies
summary: Multimodal reinforcement learning (MRL) offers a promising paradigm for autonomous driving by jointly leveraging complementary sensor observations to learn effective decision-making policies. However, its effectiveness critically depends on temporal alignment across modalities, making temporal inconsistency a fundamental vulnerability. Even subtle misalignment or latency can corrupt fused representations and ultimately lead to decision failures. Existing studies have explored adversarial attacks to induce cross-modal temporal inconsistencies, thereby enabling systematic evaluation of the temporal robustness of MRL policies. However, existing methods remain limited in generality, realism, and adaptivity. To address these limitations, we propose the Split Temporal Adversary (STA), which formulates multimodal temporal attacks as a unified decision process that jointly optimizes attack timing and modality selection under realistic policy-aware and budget-constrained settings. STA includes two mechanisms: a) a unified multimodal temporal perturbation mechanism that delays observations via historical states, removing the need for modality-specific noise; b) a split multimodal adversarial decision mechanism that jointly optimizes attack timing and modality selection through adaptive optimization while leveraging the victim policy's clean actions to identify sensitive decision patterns. We provide a theoretical analysis of the induced distribution shift and a modality selection principle. Experiments in the CARLA simulator show that STA more than doubles the collision rate of the strongest baseline against PPO while using 17.8\% fewer attack attempts, and that it generalizes to a VLM-based driving policy. These results reveal temporal consistency as a critical vulnerability, highlighting temporal robustness as essential for safe autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 提出Split Temporal Adversary (STA)，将多模态时序攻击建模为统一的决策过程，在预算约束与策略感知条件下联合优化攻击时机与模态选择，通过历史状态延迟观测实现跨模态时序扰动，在CARLA上使PPO碰撞率翻倍以上且减少17.8%攻击次数，并可迁移至VLM驾驶策略。
AI.motivation: 多模态强化学习（MRL）用于自动驾驶时依赖跨模态时间对齐，细微错位或延迟即可破坏融合表征并导致决策失败。现有诱导跨模态时序不一致的攻击方法在通用性、真实性和自适应性上均受限，需要更系统的时序鲁棒性评测手段。
AI.method: 1) 统一多模态时序扰动机制：通过回放历史状态延迟观测施加扰动，无需模态特定噪声；2) 分裂式多模态对抗决策机制：以自适应优化联合优化攻击时机与模态选择，并利用受害者策略的干净动作识别敏感决策模式；同时给出分布偏移的理论分析与模态选择原则。
AI.result: CARLA仿真中，对PPO攻击的碰撞率超过最强基线两倍以上，且攻击尝试次数减少17.8%；方法可泛化到基于VLM的驾驶策略。
AI.conclusion: 时序一致性是多模态驾驶策略的关键脆弱点；时序鲁棒性应作为安全自动驾驶的必要评估维度，STA可作为通用时序鲁棒性评测工具。

title: UNITE: Consolidating Embodied VLM Specialists via Shared-Anchor One-Bit Factorization
summary: Embodied capabilities such as visual grounding, spatial reasoning, navigation, and driving understanding are often developed in separate vision-language specialists fine-tuned from a common pretrained this http URL the specialists separately multiplies storage, whereas merging them into one dense model forces conflicting task updates to share parameters and loses part of each specialist's this http URL introduce UNITE, a framework that consolidates such specialists into a compact shared-backbone mixture of experts. UNITE keeps the feed-forward block of each specialist as a routable expert and represents the expert bank through a shared-anchor one-bit factorization: a shared floating-point anchor plus expert-specific, row-scaled binary this http URL anchor is optimized jointly with the scales and signs through closed-form alternating updates, using only source weights and no calibration this http URL adaptation then adjusts token-level expert selection with the backbone and experts frozen, updating fewer than $0.6$M parameters ($<0.01\%$ of the $8.8$B active parameters). Built from four Qwen3-VL-8B specialists, the complete UNITE model occupies $20.3$ GB, $1.16\times$ the storage of one dense specialist and $59.6\%$ below the uncompressed MoE. Across $22$ benchmarks and R2R Val-Unseen, UNITE matches six static merging methods in mean retention of best-specialist performance, leads all of them on Scan2Cap, ScanQA, and all four navigation metrics, and surpasses every source specialist on all five 3D scene understanding benchmarks (up to $+19.1$ on Scan2Cap) and on R2R navigation. Relative to the uncompressed MoE, factorization is nearly lossless on $21$ of $22$ benchmarks; the exception is VSI-Bench, where frame-count experiments suggest impaired use of cross-frame this http URL thus consolidates complementary embodied capabilities near single-model storage.

AI.tldr: UNITE将多个具身视觉语言专家模型压缩为共享骨干的MoE：FFN块作为可路由专家，用共享浮点锚点+专家特定行缩放二值分解表示专家库，闭式交替更新，仅需源权重无需校准数据；推理期仅调<0.6M参数的路由。四个Qwen3-VL-8B专家合并后20.3GB（单模型1.16倍），22个基准上多数持平或超越专家。
AI.motivation: 具身能力（视觉定位、空间推理、导航、驾驶）通常由独立微调的视觉语言专家承载，分开存储成本线性增长；而直接稠密合并会因任务更新冲突共享参数、丢失各专家能力。需要一种既压缩又保能力的整合方案。
AI.method: 共享骨干MoE：保留各专家FFN为路由专家；专家库用共享锚点一比特因子化（共享浮点锚+专家特定行缩放二值符号），通过闭式交替更新优化锚、尺度与符号，仅用源权重、无需校准数据；再冻结骨干与专家，仅微调token级路由（<0.6M参数，<0.01%）。
AI.result: 四专家合成模型20.3GB，为单专家1.16倍、比未压缩MoE低59.6%；22基准+R2R Val-Unseen上平均保留率与六种静态合并方法相当，在Scan2Cap、ScanQA及四项导航指标领先；在五个3D场景理解基准及R2R导航上超过所有源专家（Scan2Cap最高+19.1）；相对未压缩MoE在21/22基准近乎无损，仅VSI-Bench因跨帧信息使用受损而退化。
AI.conclusion: UNITE以接近单模型的存储实现了互补具身能力的整合，为多专家具身系统提供可扩展的部署路径；局限在于时间/跨帧推理类任务（如VSI-Bench）的保留不足。

title: Deep Learning for Satellite-Based Mountain Hazard Screening: A Retrospective Failure Analysis on the 2021 Chamoli Rock-Ice Avalanche
summary: The approach utilizes 10 bands from Sentinel-2 imagery, along with terrain information, in a deep learning pipeline to classify potential hazard sources in any given mountainous region. The performance of our model has been evaluated against the data collected during the rock-ice avalanche event in the Chamoli region in the Indian Himalayas on 7th February 2021. U-Net performs segmentation of the detected land surface in the satellite image, detects changes in the identify candidate hazard zones, and then the following steps are performed to calculate the potential energy using the Monte Carlo sampling for steepest descent (D8) flow paths, finding the exposed structures in the downstream locations, and ranking the zones depending on the risk score. In comparison to the simple spectral rule, our approach achieved the higher macro F1 score of 0.648 (as compared to 0.519). But the F1 score in case of rock and soil was low, being in the range of 0.3s. In case of optical change detection in winter, it's only that northeast-facing slope which couldn't be detected, as it was under 73% of shade prior to the incident. The parameters have been set for this particular scene alone and not independently; hence, this is a retrospective test, and this test locates a failure which has occurred earlier. The primary contribution of this paper is locating the pipeline leak.

AI.tldr: 用 Sentinel-2 十波段+地形数据训练深度学习流水线，对山区潜在灾害源做分割、变化检测、蒙特卡洛 D8 流路势能计算与风险排序，并以 2021 年 Chamoli 岩冰崩事件作回顾性验证。
AI.motivation: 山区岩冰崩等灾害源隐蔽、下游承灾体暴露，需要在大范围山区自动识别潜在灾害源并给出风险排序，替代简单光谱阈值规则的漏检问题。
AI.method: U-Net 对 Sentinel-2（10 波段）加地形信息进行地表分割；通过光学影像变化检测定位疑似灾害带；再沿 D8 最陡下降路径用 Monte Carlo 采样估计势能/运动可达范围，识别下游暴露结构，按风险评分排序。
AI.result: 宏平均 F1 达 0.648，优于简单光谱规则的 0.519；但岩石与土壤类 F1 仅约 0.3；冬季光学变化检测中未被检出的是东北向坡面，事发前约 73% 被阴影遮挡。参数为单场景调优、属回顾性测试。
AI.conclusion: 方法在真实事件上可定位已发生的失效源，但类别不均衡与阴影遮挡仍是主要误差来源；论文核心贡献是暴露并诊断该流水线的失败环节。

title: Non-Imaging Optical Tactile Sensors for Robotics: Transduction Principles, System Integration, and Robotic Applications
summary: Non-imaging optical tactile sensors encode contact through changes in optical intensity, wavelength, spectra, or photon counts, offering diverse architectures for robotic touch. Their usefulness depends on whether contact variables can be reliably distinguished from coupled mechanical and environmental effects, and whether the resulting information can be delivered in time to guide action. This review develops a unified framework linking mechanical load transmission, optical encoding, readout, and tactile inference to robotic task requirements. It examines reflective and waveguide-based devices, micro/nanofibers, fiber gratings, interferometric and resonant structures, and mechanoluminescent composites. Three considerations emerge across these approaches. First, high optical sensitivity supports accurate tactile estimation only when target variables remain identifiable under the relevant contact and calibration conditions. Second, spatial coverage and feedback timing must be assessed at the system level, accounting for multiplexing, acquisition, demodulation, and inference. Third, device characterization, offline recognition, and closed-loop robotic performance provide distinct levels of evidence and require different evaluation criteria. Representative studies illustrate how these considerations shape force estimation, contact localization, slip correction and distributed interaction. This review concludes with priorities for calibration transfer, reliable interfaces, scalable readout, and task-based validation, providing a basis for selecting and developing non-imaging optical tactile architectures for robotics.

AI.tldr: 综述提出统一框架，将机械载荷传递、光学编码、读出与触觉推断联系到机器人任务需求，系统梳理反射式/波导式、微纳光纤、光纤光栅、干涉与谐振结构、力致发光复合材料等非成像光学触觉传感器，并提炼三条核心考量：可辨识性、系统级时空性能、证据分级。
AI.motivation: 非成像光学触觉传感器架构多样，但其价值取决于接触变量能否与耦合的机械、环境效应可靠区分，以及信息能否及时传递给动作。领域缺少把器件机理、读出与机器人任务需求打通的分析框架。
AI.method: 综述性分析：建立"机械载荷传递—光学编码—读出—触觉推断"的统一框架，按架构分类评述（反射式与波导器件、微纳光纤、光纤光栅、干涉/谐振结构、力致发光复合材料），并从可辨识性、系统级空间覆盖与时序（复用、采集、解调、推断）、证据层级（器件表征、离线识别、闭环机器人性能）三方面提出评估准则。
AI.result: 通过代表性研究说明上述考量如何影响力估计、接触定位、滑移修正与分布式交互任务；指出高光学灵敏度仅在目标变量可辨识时才有意义，时空性能须在系统层面评估，不同证据层级需不同评价标准。
AI.conclusion: 给出未来优先方向：标定迁移、可靠接口、可扩展读出、基于任务的验证，为机器人非成像光学触觉架构的选型与开发提供依据。

title: EEGProbe: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand EEG? A Benchmark for Signal-Grounded EEG Signals Evaluation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal capabilities across scientific and biomedical domains, yet their ability to understand electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains unclear. We introduce EEGProbe, a signal-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose VLMs can extract and reason from minimally processed, channel-wise EEG without task-specific feature engineering or EEG-specific adaptation. EEGProbe contains 620 EEG-centered questions across 13 subtasks and three capability categories: EEG Signal Classification, EEG Cross-modal Alignment, and EEG Neurophysiological Reasoning. To reduce shortcut-based answering, EEGProbe preserves the temporal structure of the recordings where possible, minimizes benchmark-induced processing, and applies signal-necessity testing followed by expert verification. We evaluate 11 representative open- and closed-source VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves an overall score of only 41.63\%, with cross-modal EEG alignment emerging as a major bottleneck. We further examine model behavior from a neurophysiological perspective and analyze how temporal, spectral, spatial, and physiological EEG structure relates to model successes and failures. Inference-time neurophysiological guidance can reshape model predictions by helping models recognize the neurophysiological patterns present in the input and connect them with relevant neurological knowledge, narrowing the gap between general multimodal competence and EEG understanding. EEGProbe provides a testbed for current VLMs and a basis for developing future multimodal models that can interpret EEG evidence more reliably. The EEGProbe benchmark will be publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: EEGProbe：面向通用视觉语言模型的EEG信号理解基准，含13个子任务、620道题、三大能力类别，11个VLM零样本评测最佳仅41.63%。
AI.motivation: VLM在科学与生物医学多模态任务上表现强劲，但其是否能从原始、逐通道、少处理的EEG中提取并推理神经生理信息尚不清楚，缺少避免捷径答题的严格评测手段。
AI.method: 构建EEGProbe基准：13个子任务、620个EEG中心问题，覆盖信号分类、跨模态对齐、神经生理推理三类能力；尽量保留记录时间结构、最小化基准引入的处理，并采用信号必要性测试与专家校验以抑制捷径；对11个开源/闭源VLM统一零样本评测，并从时域/频域/空域/生理结构角度做行为分析及推理时神经生理引导实验。
AI.result: 最强模型GPT-5.6 Sol总体仅41.63%，跨模态EEG对齐为最大瓶颈；推理时神经生理引导可改变预测，帮助模型识别输入中的生理模式并关联神经科学知识，缩小通用多模态能力与EEG理解之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前通用VLM的EEG理解能力显著不足，EEGProbe为评估与改进多模态模型提供测试平台与基准，基准将公开。

title: ThermoSight: From Appearance to Internal Thermofluid Fields via Physics-Guided Neural Reconstruction
summary: Most neural reconstruction methods focus on reproducing scene appearance, yet inferring physical states from visual observations is essential for machine understanding of the physical world. Reconstructing the internal temperature and soot fields of radiating thermofluids such as flames is challenging yet essential for improving energy efficiency and assessing heat exposure and fire spread. In flames, temperature and soot concentration jointly govern visible emission, and soot self-absorption alters the light that reaches each camera. With limited views, changes in the two fields can offset one another in the recorded RGB images, making temperature and soot difficult to disentangle. ThermoSight, a physics-guided neural framework for scientific imaging, jointly reconstructs continuous three-dimensional temperature and soot volume fraction fields from limited calibrated flame images without field-level ground truth during optimization. A differentiable spectral model links these fields to measured RGB through thermal emission, self-absorption, and calibrated camera responses. Temperature-dependent emission spectra and wavelength-dependent attenuation constrain shared fields across RGB channels, reducing temperature-soot ambiguity. Chromaticity consistency, observation-derived spatial constraints, and soot regularization complement intensity fitting. In a synthetic ablation, wavelength-resolved attenuation reduces temperature RMSE in the hot, sooty region from 234 to 112 K relative to a three-channel approximation, with nearly identical RGB PSNR (65.23 vs. 65.24 dB). Measured data yield coherent fields and competitive RGB reconstructions. These results demonstrate that physics-guided neural fields recover interpretable internal physical quantities beyond visually consistent appearance.

AI.tldr: ThermoSight: a physics-guided neural field framework that jointly reconstructs 3D temperature and soot volume fraction fields of flames from limited calibrated RGB images, using a differentiable spectral model with wavelength-resolved emission and self-absorption.
AI.motivation: Neural reconstruction typically only reproduces appearance, but machine physical understanding needs latent physical state. Flame temperature and soot jointly drive emission and absorption, and under few views their changes compensate each other in RGB, making the two fields ill-posed and hard to disentangle without field-level ground truth.
AI.method: Differentiable spectral model linking temperature (with temperature-dependent Planck-like emission spectra) and soot volume fraction to observed RGB via thermal emission, self-absorption and calibrated camera response; wavelength-dependent attenuation shared across RGB channels constrains the two fields and reduces ambiguity. Regularizers: chromaticity consistency, observation-derived spatial constraints, soot regularization. Optimized purely from images.
AI.result: Synthetic ablation: wavelength-resolved attenuation cuts temperature RMSE in hot sooty region from 234 K to 112 K vs. 3-channel approximation, with near-identical RGB PSNR (65.23 vs 65.24 dB). Real measured flame data give coherent fields and competitive RGB reconstruction.
AI.conclusion: Physics-guided neural fields can recover interpretable internal physical quantities beyond visually consistent appearance, extending neural reconstruction from radiance to physical state in scientific imaging.

title: PhaseCLIP: Phase-Aware Frequency-Domain Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Few-Shot Remote-Sensing Classification
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code will be released at this https URL upon publication
summary: Remote-sensing (RS) image scene classification aims to assign a semantic category to an overhead image, and in practice must often do so from only a handful of labelled examples, since annotation requires expert interpretation and the resulting labels transfer poorly across sensors and regions. Recent progress has come from adapting vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP, through learned prompts or feature adapters. Although effective, these methods construct their representation entirely in the spatial domain. RS scenes are dominated by periodic texture and regular geometry, which the Fourier spectrum describes compactly through an amplitude component, carrying texture and contrast statistics, and a phase component, carrying spatial structure. Existing frequency-domain adaptation of VLMs either exploits amplitude alone or does not separate amplitude from phase, leaving the structural component unused. In this article, we propose PhaseCLIP, which inserts phase-capable spectral modules and a feature-gating module into a frozen CLIP visual encoder and trains only 1.30% of its parameters. Because the amplitude and phase pathways share an identical parameter layout, a single weight set is learned on phase and transferred exactly to amplitude, giving a two-stage scheme that adds no parameters. Experiments on five public RS datasets, EuroSAT, PatternNet, UC Merced, LSRS and RSSCN7, against eight baselines under a matched protocol, show that PhaseCLIP attains 84.28% mean accuracy and is the best method in 23 of 30 dataset-by-shot cells, with phase contributing 1.93 points overall and 4.36 points on the most difficult dataset. Because the modules act on the spectrum of image patches and transformer tokens and leave the text encoder untouched, the approach can be extended to other RS sensors and tasks, and to other domains in which class evidence lies in spatial structure.

AI.tldr: PhaseCLIP在冻结的CLIP视觉编码器中插入可产生相位谱表示的模块与特征门控，仅训练1.30%参数；振幅与相位通路共享同一权重布局，在相位上学到的权重可无损迁移到振幅，实现零额外参数的两阶段方案，在5个遥感数据集上平均84.28%，30个设置格中23个最优。
AI.motivation: 遥感场景分类需在极少标注样本下进行，因为标注依赖专家且跨传感器/区域迁移差。现有VLM（如CLIP）适配方法（提示学习、特征适配器）全部在空域构建表征，浪费了遥感场景中周期性纹理与规则几何所对应的紧凑傅里叶描述；已有频域适配要么只用振幅，要么不分离振幅与相位，结构信息未利用。
AI.method: 在冻结CLIP视觉编码器中加入具备相位处理能力的谱域模块与特征门控模块，仅微调1.30%参数；模块作用于图像块与transformer token的频谱，文本编码器保持不变；利用振幅/相位通路参数布局相同，用单一权重集先在相位上学习再精确迁移到振幅，形成不增加参数的两阶段训练。
AI.result: 在EuroSAT、PatternNet、UC Merced、LSRS、RSSCN7五个公开数据集、匹配协议下与8个基线对比，平均准确率84.28%，30个"数据集×样本数"单元中23个取得最优；相位通路总体贡献1.93个百分点，在最难数据集上贡献4.36个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 相位谱信息对遥感少样本场景分类是有效且紧凑的表征补充；由于模块只作用于频谱且不改动文本编码器，方法可扩展到其他遥感传感器与任务，以及类别证据存在于空间结构的其他领域。

title: VA-Assembly: View-Aligned Score Guidance for Training-Free 3D Part Assembly
summary: Image-to-3D foundation models have improved 3D reconstruction, but typically produce monolithic representations without explicit part-level structure. Part-aware generation and learning-based assembly methods often require part-level supervision, category-specific priors, or paired part-layout training data. We instead consider a practical but underexplored setting in which independently prepared or generated 3D parts have no predefined inter-part relationships, shared coordinate frames, or consistent scales, and must be assembled into a reference-consistent object from a single image. We present VA-Assembly, a training-free framework for 3D part assembly through part-level transformation estimation using view-aligned diffusion guidance. Given a reference image and fixed 3D part geometries, VA-Assembly optimizes each part's translation, rotation, and scale. We condition a frozen view-conditioned diffusion model on same-view renderings of a reference-derived monolithic 3D representation, producing score gradients geometrically aligned with the part configuration. This guidance provides multi-view structural cues under large initial misalignment. By repurposing pretrained visual-structural priors as transformation-level supervision, VA-Assembly requires no annotated part layouts, predefined part taxonomies, category-specific assembly training, or bounding-box-based layout initialization. Experiments compare VA-Assembly with geometric registration and compositional layout baselines using each baseline's supported transformation components, showing improved part-wise transformation estimation. Ablation studies show that view-aligned conditioning, rather than diffusion guidance alone, is critical for reliable transformation gradients. Updating only part transformations preserves explicit component separability and supports component-level editing, replacement, and reconfiguration.

AI.tldr: VA-Assembly：无需训练的单图3D部件装配框架，利用视角对齐的扩散模型分数梯度优化各部件（固定几何）的平移、旋转、尺度。
AI.motivation: 现有image-to-3D基础模型输出整体式表示，缺乏显式部件结构；部件级生成与装配方法依赖部件级监督、类别先验或成对部件-布局训练数据。作者关注更实用的设定：独立准备/生成、无预定义相互关系、无共享坐标系、尺度不一致的3D部件，需仅凭单张参考图装配成一致的物体。
AI.method: 冻结的视角条件扩散模型以"参考图→整体式3D表示的同视角渲染"为条件，产生与部件构型几何对齐的分数梯度，指导每个部件的t/r/s优化；多视角结构线索可应对大初始错位；将预训练视觉-结构先验转用为变换级监督，无需标注布局、部件分类法、类别特定训练或框初始化。
AI.result: 与几何配准及组合式布局基线（按各自支持的变换分量对比）相比，部件级变换估计更优；消融显示视角对齐条件（而非仅扩散引导）是获得可靠变换梯度的关键；仅更新部件变换可保持组件可分离性，支持部件级编辑、替换与重配置。
AI.conclusion: 训练免费的扩散引导部件装配是可行路线，把2D图像先验转化为3D部件变换监督；局限在于依赖初始整体重建质量，单图歧义下未验证真实机器人操作场景。

title: QTOP: Scaling Humanoid Motion Tracking with Quantile Critics
summary: Learning human motion tracking policies through reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a core capability that underpins a majority of recent progress in humanoid whole-body control. However, achieving generalization to unseen motions at high fidelity requires jointly scaling training to thousands of GPU and dataset hours. This work hypothesizes that motion tracking is inherently compute-bound because training on a diverse set of motions introduces learning interference, similar to multi-task RL. To tackle this, we propose Quantile Tracking Optimization (QTOP), which improves sample efficiency by introducing a distributional advantage estimate conditioned on state and reference pairs. QTOP outperforms on and off-policy RL baselines both in simulation and real-world tracking scenarios on multiple datasets by up to 10\%. Furthermore, we establish a scaling law for QTOP and find that, aside from scaling predictably, dataset size has minimal impact on performance for moderately sized GPU hour regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出 Quantile Tracking Optimization (QTOP)，通过以「状态-参考」对为条件的分布式优势估计提升人形全身运动跟踪 RL 的样本效率，仿真与真机多数据集上优于 on/off-policy 基线约 10%，并给出缩放律。
AI.motivation: 人形全身控制中，高保真泛化到未见运动需数千 GPU 小时与海量数据的联合扩展；作者假设运动跟踪本质上是计算受限（compute-bound），因为多运动混合训练会带来类似多任务 RL 的学习干扰。
AI.method: QTOP：在 RL 策略学习中加入以状态与参考动作对（state–reference pair）为条件的分布式（分位数/quantile）优势估计，用以缓解多运动混合训练中的梯度/价值估计干扰，从而提升样本效率；并在不同数据规模与 GPU 小时预算下拟合缩放律。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界跟踪场景中，跨多个数据集相对 on-policy 与 off-policy RL 基线提升最高约 10%；并建立 QTOP 的缩放律，发现除可预测的规模收益外，在中等 GPU 小时区间内数据集规模对性能影响很小。
AI.conclusion: 运动跟踪的性能瓶颈主要来自计算而非数据量，用参考条件化的分布式优势估计可有效提升样本效率；该结论为后续大规模人形控制训练的资源分配（算力优先于数据规模）提供实证指导。

title: TRR: A Thermal Interaction Engine for Robot Simulation and RGBT Data Generation
summary: A robot's actions change the thermal conditions of its next interaction: heat retained after release, carried with objects or stored beneath the surface can change a later contact's outcome despite similar current temperatures. Training trajectories must capture how these effects connect earlier actions to later observations and task outcomes. We present TRR, a \emph{Thermal Robot Renderer} that attaches spatial and depth-resolved thermal state to both contact partners, updates local heat exchange through contact, transport and separation, and generates synchronized RGB--thermal (RGBT) observations and event-local task checks on one execution clock. Controlled interventions show why retained heat, spatial transport and internal storage matter for subsequent contact outcomes. From the same state, TRR produces a paired six-task benchmark of 2,224 static--dynamic pairs, that is, 4,448 trajectories with synchronized dual-view observations, states and actions. Visible thermal history raises safe contact-site selection from 75.0\% to 91.7\% on a dedicated learning corpus, and training on dynamic histories raises simulated transfer completion by 50 percentage points under a new heating procedure with shared feedback execution. We demonstrate RGBT observation adapters on MuJoCo and Isaac Sim, report an engineering inventory of ten prepared robot configurations and six demonstrated camera viewpoints, and describe a developer workflow that carries an existing robot scene to exported RGBT records. The benchmark, the workflow and the platform resources described in Section 6 form the first items of a planned public release. Demonstrations and resource updates are available on the project page.

AI.tldr: TRR是一个"热机器人渲染器"，把带空间与深度分辨率的热状态附加到接触双方，按接触/搬运/分离更新局部热交换，并同步生成RGB--热(RGBT)观测与任务检查，构建了2,224对静态-动态配对(4,448条轨迹)的六任务基准。
AI.motivation: 机器人当前动作会改变下一次交互的热学条件（残留热、随物体搬运的热、表层下储热），仅靠当前温度相同的观测无法预测后续接触结果；而现有机器人学习数据几乎不记录热历史，导致动作-热效应-后果之间的长时依赖缺失。
AI.method: 提出TRR热渲染器：为接触双方维护空间化、深度分辨的热状态；通过接触传导、物体搬运携带、分离与内部储热建模局部热交换；在同一执行时钟上生成同步的RGB-热双视角观测、状态、动作与事件局部任务判定。做了受控干预实验验证残留热/空间搬运/内部储热的作用，并提供MuJoCo与Isaac Sim的RGBT观测适配器、工程清单与场景导出开发者工作流。
AI.result: 受控干预证实残留热、空间搬运与内部储热显著影响后续接触结果；可见热历史使安全接触点选择成功率从75.0%提升到91.7%；在新的加热流程与共享反馈执行设定下，用动态热历史训练使仿真迁移完成率提升50个百分点；给出10种机器人配置、6个已演示视角的工程清单。
AI.conclusion: TRR将热物理历史纳入机器人数据生成与观测，是首个系统化的RGBT机器人热基准/平台雏形，随项目页公开；但其证据主要来自仿真与受控实验，缺乏真机验证，热学保真度仍待检验。

title: Correspondence-Free Camera Pose Estimation by Matching Moments
comment: 65 pages, including references and appendices; under review
summary: The blind perspective-$n$-point (PnP) problem is to estimate the pose of a calibrated camera from 2D and 3D point sets with unknown correspondences. We show that, for complete, noiseless observations, fourteen permutation-invariant image moments up to order four identify a fixed camera pose for almost every 3D point set containing at least twenty points. Our learning-free method, MomentPnP, matches these moments between the observed 2D points and the projected 3D points to initialize a camera pose without correspondences and refines the pose and correspondence weights using expectation--maximization. Across the test sets of three benchmarks, our method reduces median rotation error by $5$--$170\times$ relative to the best learned baseline, both with and without outliers. We recover accurate poses even with as many outliers as inliers. On dense ETH3D scans, pose accuracy improves as the point sets grow, even as individual correspondences become harder to resolve.

AI.tldr: 提出无学习框架 MomentPnP，用十四阶以内、置换不变的四阶图像矩从 2D/3D 点集中识别相机位姿，实现无对应关系的盲 PnP 初始化，再用 EM 联合精化位姿与对应权重。
AI.motivation: 盲 PnP（对应关系未知）是位姿估计的难点，现有学习式方法精度有限且依赖训练数据；作者希望给出可证明可辨识性的无学习方案。
AI.method: 理论证明：对完整无噪观测，至多四阶的 14 个置换不变矩可几乎处处唯一确定固定相机位姿（点集≥20点）。据此在观测 2D 点与投影 3D 点间匹配矩以初始化位姿，无需对应；随后用期望最大化迭代优化位姿与对应权重。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试集上，相对最佳学习基线中位旋转误差降低 5–170 倍；含与内点数相当的外点时仍能准确恢复位姿；在密集 ETH3D 扫描上点集越稠密位姿精度越高。
AI.conclusion: 置换不变矩为盲 PnP 提供了坚实的可辨识性基础与无需训练的高精度实用方案，在强外点下鲁棒。

title: An Efficient Training Paradigm for Image Restoration via Improved Fréchet Loss
summary: Diffusion-based image restoration achieves strong perceptual quality but typically relies on iterative sampling, leading to slow inference. Existing single-step methods often use diffusion distillation or adversarial training, complicating optimization. To simplify training, we propose FDIR, a framework for training single-pass generative restoration models through regression-style supervised optimization using directly computable objectives. To realize this paradigm, FDIR employs the Fréchet distance to match the feature distributions of restored and real images in frozen representation spaces, providing explicit distribution-level supervision. To better accommodate image restoration, we incorporate local patch features to capture fine-grained restoration discrepancies. Moreover, we introduce instance-adaptive statistics by combining the feature moments of each SR-HQ pair with synchronized historical statistics, allowing distribution matching to incorporate input-specific correspondence while retaining distribution-level context. FDIR optimizes only the LoRA parameters of the restoration backbone. Experiments demonstrate strong perceptual restoration quality and efficient training, suggesting a simpler paradigm for generative image restoration.

AI.tldr: FDIR: 用回归式监督（Fréchet 距离特征分布匹配）单步训练生成式图像复原模型，仅优化 LoRA 参数。
AI.motivation: 扩散式复原感知质量好但需迭代采样、推理慢；单步方法依赖扩散蒸馏或对抗训练，优化流程复杂。目标是简化训练，用可直接计算的目标做回归式监督。
AI.method: 在冻结表征空间中用 Fréchet 距离匹配复原图与真实图的特征分布，提供显式分布级监督；引入局部 patch 特征捕捉细粒度差异；用每个 SR-HQ 对的特征矩与同步历史统计量组合出实例自适应统计量，兼顾输入对应性与分布上下文；仅训练复原骨干的 LoRA 参数，实现单次前向生成式复原。
AI.result: 实验报告了较强的感知复原质量与高效训练，摘要未给出具体指标与数据集。
AI.conclusion: 提出一条更简单的生成式图像复原训练范式：以回归风格的可计算目标替代蒸馏/对抗训练，验证了单步生成的可行性，可推广至其他低级视觉生成任务。

title: Interpretable deep concepts of organoid morphology
summary: Image-based classification of organoid morphologies can indicate drug response, viability, or successful differentiation. In recent work, learned representations outperform handcrafted features as the basis for downstream classifiers. However, their black-box nature hides the morphological cues a classifier relies on. Based on the foundation models DINOv3 (general-purpose) and ViTAMIn-O (organoid-specific), we train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to learn interpretable concepts related to distinct organoid morphologies. We annotate concepts with spatial labels (organoid, organoid wall, background) and compute their dataset specificity and task relevance across five tasks. The spatial labels of DINOv3 concepts yield coarse organoid segmentations on out-of-domain datasets. Filtering concepts by spatial label in the DINOv3-SAE improves downstream AUROC for three of the five tasks. Qualitative analysis of the most relevant concepts further reveals a confounding factor introduced by our preprocessing in one task. Through such insights, interpretable concepts could help improve the reliability of classifiers and guide the future development of organoid representation models. The trained SAEs will be made available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 基于 DINOv3 与 ViTAMIn-O 训练稀疏自编码器，学习与类器官形态相关的可解释概念，并用空间标签与任务相关性指标评估其可解释性与在下游任务中的作用。
AI.motivation: 类器官图像分类中，学习到的表征优于手工特征，但其黑箱性质隐藏了分类器依赖的形态线索，缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 在通用基础模型 DINOv3 与类器官专用模型 ViTAMIn-O 上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）以获得可解释概念；为概念标注空间标签（类器官、类器官壁、背景），并计算其在五个任务上的数据集特异性和任务相关性；按空间标签过滤概念后评估下游 AUROC。
AI.result: DINOv3 概念的空间标签可在域外数据集上得到粗略类器官分割；在 DINOv3-SAE 中按空间标签过滤概念可在五个任务中的三个任务上提升下游 AUROC；定性分析中最相关概念揭示了预处理引入的混淆因素。
AI.conclusion: 可解释概念有助于提升分类器可靠性，并指导类器官表征模型的后续开发；训练好的 SAE 将在发表后开放。

title: Vision-Language Model-Based Phase-OTDR Event Classification
summary: Phase-sensitive optical time-domain reflectometry (Phase-OTDR) enables distributed vibration sensing, but reliable event classification has traditionally relied on fully supervised models that require extensive annotated data. This study examines the adaptability of a Vision-Language Model (VLM) for Phase-OTDR event recognition through few-shot learning. Raw samples are converted into Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) dB-magnitude spectrogram mosaics, color-mapped and resized to RGB images, and processed by a Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) image encoder; few-shot adaptation optimizes only the Tip-Adapter-F cache keys, leaving both encoders unchanged. Under a leakage-controlled protocol (train-side support/validation pool of 512 images per class, fixed held-out test of 120 per class, no test-set access during selection, 20 distinct support-sampling trials), the selected configuration (the ViT-L-14 Vision Transformer encoder with OpenAI weights, 128 shots per class) reaches 96.81 +/- 0.42% accuracy and a macro-averaged F1 score of 96.79 +/- 0.42% on the held-out test set; a label-efficient 16-shot setting, that is, 96 labeled support images at adaptation time across the six classes, already attains 90.17 +/- 0.81%. Tip-Adapter-F clearly outperforms both zero-shot CLIP and the standard training-free Tip-Adapter, and prompt and backbone analyses show that performance is stable across Vision Transformer encoders and insensitive to prompt wording at the selected operating point. Overall, CLIP visual features carry a transferable structure that a lightweight support cache turns into a label-efficient Phase-OTDR event classifier. The code and the corresponding image dataset are made publicly available on GitHub to support further research: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该文将Phase-OTDR原始信号转为STFT dB幅度谱图并彩色映射为RGB图像，用冻结的CLIP ViT-L-14编码器配合Tip-Adapter-F小样本适配，在无泄漏协议下实现96.81%的六类事件识别准确率，16-shot（每类约16张标注）仍达90.17%。
AI.motivation: Phase-OTDR分布式振动传感的事件分类长期依赖全监督模型与大量标注数据，标注成本高；作者希望探究预训练视觉-语言模型的迁移能力能否以极低标注成本完成事件识别。
AI.method: 信号域→图像域转换：原始采样做STFT取dB幅度谱图，拼接为mosaic后伪彩色映射并缩放为RGB输入；使用OpenAI权重的CLIP ViT-L-14图像编码器，仅优化Tip-Adapter-F的缓存键（support cache），文本与图像编码器均冻结；采用泄漏控制协议（每类512张支持/验证池、每类120张固定留出测试、选择阶段不接触测试集、20次独立支持采样）进行配置选择与评估，并做提示词与骨干网络敏感性分析。
AI.result: 选定配置（ViT-L-14 + 128 shots/类）在留出测试集上达96.81±0.42%准确率与96.79±0.42%宏平均F1；16-shot（六类共96张标注支持图像）即达90.17±0.81%。Tip-Adapter-F显著优于zero-shot CLIP与免训练Tip-Adapter；性能对ViT系列骨干稳定、在选定工作点对提示词措辞不敏感。
AI.conclusion: CLIP视觉特征具备可迁移结构，仅用轻量支持缓存即可转化为标签高效的Phase-OTDR事件分类器；代码与图像数据集已开源，为该交叉方向提供可复现基线。

title: When Is the Expensive Method Worth It? A Content-Driven Analysis of Classical Bayer Demosaicing
summary: Demosaicing reconstructs a full-colour image from a single-sensor colour-filter-array (CFA) mosaic, where only one colour is measured per pixel. Classical methods make different assumptions about images, from simple averaging to directional edge-aware interpolation, and the directional methods cost markedly more compute. We ask a practical question that a per-image quality ranking does not answer: for a given image, is the expensive directional method worth its cost? Using a controlled simulate-reconstruct pipeline on 80 benchmark images from four public datasets (Kodak, McMaster, BSD100, Urban100), six classical methods, and image-content descriptors fixed before any results were seen, we show that the quality gain of the edge-aware method (Menon 2007) over the best cheap linear method is not constant. It ranges from $-6.6$ to $+6.8$ dB, and on 31% of images it is zero or negative, meaning a cheap method matches or beats the expensive one. The gain is also predictable from content: it correlates with mean image saturation at $r=-0.86$ ($p<10^{-6}$). We then build an interpretable depth-2 decision tree that recommends the best cheap method from image descriptors, beating an always-pick-the-most-common baseline by 20.0 percentage points under leave-one-image-out validation. The analysis uses no deep learning, and every step can be inspected.

AI.tldr: 本篇为免深度学习、可解释的经验分析：在80张基准图上用受控的仿真-重建流水线证明,边缘感知去马赛克(Menon 2007)相对最佳廉价线性方法的增益并非常数(-6.6至+6.8 dB,31%图像为零或负),且增益可由图像饱和度预测(r=-0.86),并构建深度2决策树按内容推荐最廉价方法。
AI.motivation: 去马赛克中方向性(边缘感知)插值比线性平均耗时显著更高,但"逐图质量排名"无法回答实际工程问题:对某张具体图像,昂贵方法是否值得其代价。作者希望把这种代价-收益判断变成事前可预测、可执行的选择。
AI.method: 在Kodak、McMaster、BSD100、Urban100四个公开数据集的80张图上构建受控simulate-reconstruct流程;比较六种经典去马赛克方法;图像内容描述子在看到任何结果前固定,避免选择性偏差;以相关性分析与深度2决策树(全流程可检视、无深度学习)对增益进行建模与推荐。
AI.result: 边缘感知方法相对最佳廉价线性方法的增益在-6.6至+6.8 dB间波动,31%的图像增益≤0;增益与平均饱和度强相关(r=-0.86, p<1e-6);深度2决策树推荐廉价方法,在留一图像交叉验证下比"总选最常见方法"基线提升20.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 昂贵的方向性去马赛克并非普适更优,其收益高度依赖图像内容且可从事前描述子预测,因此可用极轻量的可解释规则替代逐图盲目调用高成本算法,为成像流水线中的自适应算法选择提供了实证依据。

title: LiDSeg: Linear DehazeFormer Guidance for Efficient Semantic Segmentation in Adverse Weather Conditions
summary: Robust semantic segmentation in adverse weather is essential for safety-critical autonomous systems. Existing restore-then-segment pipelines introduce latency and prioritize pixel-level restoration over semantic discriminability, while domain adaptation methods often face representation bottlenecks and computational complexity. We introduce LiDSeg, a framework that uses reconstruction-informed guidance to improve segmentation under adverse weather. During training, a lightweight guidance encoder is jointly optimized with the segmentation branch using segmentation and auxiliary reconstruction objectives. At inference, the reconstruction decoder is discarded, while the guidance encoder is retained to extract weather-robust features. A lightweight gated fusion module integrates these features into the segmentation branch, preserving clear-weather accuracy while improving adverse-weather robustness. On Foggy Cityscapes, LiDSeg limits the clear-to-dense-fog mIoU degradation to 2.5-2.8 percentage points, reducing the baseline performance drop by more than fivefold. On the official ACDC test server, LiDSeg-PIDNet achieves 75.07% pooled all-condition mIoU, comparable to supervised HRNet-W48 at 75.0%, while remaining substantially smaller. The gains generalize zero-shot to Foggy Driving and Foggy Zurich without training on real-fog images. LiDSeg adds only 1.9-3.1M parameters across several models, with total model sizes of 5.2-39.5M parameters and no inference-time reconstruction overhead. It delivers real-time inference on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: LiDSeg用训练时的重建辅助任务指导分割：轻量引导编码器与分割分支联合优化（分割+重建目标），推理时丢弃重建解码器，保留引导编码器并经门控融合注入分割分支，实现恶劣天气下的鲁棒语义分割且无推理额外开销。
AI.motivation: 现有"先复原再分割"流程存在延迟高、偏向像素级复原而非语义判别性的问题；域适应方法则受表征瓶颈与计算复杂度限制。目标是低开销、无需真雾数据即可提升恶劣天气分割鲁棒性。
AI.method: 训练阶段：轻量引导编码器与分割网络联合训练，附加重建目标作为表征正则；推理阶段：移除重建解码器，保留引导编码器提取天气鲁棒特征，通过轻量门控融合模块（1.9–3.1M 额外参数）注入分割分支。
AI.result: Foggy Cityscapes 上晴→浓雾 mIoU 下降仅 2.5–2.8 点，较基线退化幅度缩小五倍以上；ACDC 官方测试服务器上 LiDSeg-PIDNet 全条件池化 mIoU 75.07%，与 HRNet-W48（75.0%）相当但模型显著更小；零样本泛化到 Foggy Driving 与 Foggy Zurich；总参数 5.2–39.5M，无推理期重建开销，Jetson AGX Orin 上实时。
AI.conclusion: 将重建作为训练期辅助表征学习而非推理期复原步骤，可在几乎不增参数量的前提下显著提升恶劣天气分割鲁棒性，兼顾精度、效率与边缘部署可行性。

title: MVSTF: Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion for LiDAR-Based Moving Object Segmentation
summary: Autonomous mobile robots confront significant chal lenges in recognizing the motion properties of objects in dy namic environments. However, existing methods are hindered by limitations such as boundary ambiguity, occlusion, viewpoint constraints, and training complexity. In this paper, we propose an innovative end-to-end Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion network, named MVSTF, which utilizes sequential point clouds to generate multi-view images and feature differences, and designs a multi-branch network to extract spatio-temporal and dimen sional features in parallel, and realizes high-precision moving object segmentation. First, sequential point clouds are utilized to generate multi-view images and feature differences. Then, an end-to-end multi-branch network including Dual Down-sampling Blocks (DDB), Spatial Attention Blocks (SAB), Multi-Kernel Convolutional Neural Network blocks (MKCNN), Dual Feature Fusion Blocks (DFFB), and the Point Fusion (PF) module, is designed to extract motion features from feature differences and geometric and semantic features from multi-view images. Finally, an auxiliary semantic head is introduced to further improve the algorithm's robustness and the model's interpretability. This work is validated on the SemanticKITTI and KITTI-Road bench marks, achieving state-of-the-art results on the SemanticKITTI MOS validation set and the KITTI-Road validation set, and competitive results on the hidden SemanticKITTI-MOS test set. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MVSTF：端到端多视角时空融合网络，用序列点云生成多视角图像与特征差分，多分支并行提取时空/几何/语义特征，实现高精度运动目标分割，在SemanticKITTI与KITTI-Road上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 动态环境下机器人需识别物体运动属性，但现有方法受边界模糊、遮挡、视角约束与训练复杂度限制。
AI.method: 由序列点云生成多视角图像与特征差分；设计含DDB、SAB、MKCNN、DFFB与Point Fusion模块的多分支端到端网络，分别从差分中提取运动特征、从多视角图像中提取几何与语义特征；引入辅助语义头提升鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI MOS验证集与KITTI-Road验证集上取得SOTA，在SemanticKITTI-MOS隐藏测试集上具竞争力；代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 多视角时空融合思路可有效规避单视角边界模糊与遮挡问题，为移动机器人移动物体分割提供实用方案。

title: Multi-Rate Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling
summary: Flow-matching point-cloud upsamplers refine sparse inputs into dense point clouds by integrating a learned velocity field with a fixed temporal discretization. However, local reconstruction requirements vary substantially across a shape, while a shared solver budget applies the same temporal resolution everywhere. We propose Multi-Rate Flow Matching (MRFM), a patch-adaptive framework that selects an integration budget for each local patch at inference time while keeping the learned velocity field frozen. MRFM relaxes the discrete budget into a continuous variable, optimizes it online through differentiable soft rollouts using an input-derived geometric fidelity objective, and projects the result back to a discrete budget for the final solver rollout. Experiments on PU1K and PUGAN show strong reconstruction quality, while matched-budget permutation and multi-factor analyses demonstrate that the benefit depends on patch-specific allocation rather than on the step distribution alone. MRFM is accuracy-oriented and intentionally uses additional test-time optimization to obtain more suitable local temporal resolutions.

AI.tldr: MRFM为流匹配点云上采样引入patch自适应积分预算：将离散步数松弛为连续变量，用可微soft rollout与输入导出的几何保真目标在线优化，再投影回离散预算完成最终求解，速度场保持冻结。
AI.motivation: 流匹配点云上采样器通常对整个形状使用统一的时间离散步数和固定的求解器预算，但不同局部区域的几何重建难度差异大，导致计算分配不合理（简单区域过算、复杂区域欠算）。
AI.method: Multi-Rate Flow Matching (MRFM)：推理阶段为每个局部patch选择积分预算。具体做法为（1）把离散步数预算松弛为连续变量；（2）在冻结速度场下，通过可微soft rollout，以由输入导出的几何保真度目标在线（测试时优化）求解该连续预算；（3）将优化结果投影回离散步数，执行最终求解器rollout。
AI.result: 在PU1K与PUGAN上取得较强的重建质量；匹配预算的置换实验与多因素消融表明，收益来自patch级的差异化分配，而不仅是步数分布本身。
AI.conclusion: 局部自适应的时间分辨率分配可显著提升流匹配点云上采样的效率-精度权衡；方法面向精度，刻意采用额外测试时优化，代价是推理开销增加。

title: ProSE: Probing Reconstruction Error for Semantic-guided Expert Skipping in MoE-MLLMs
summary: Mixture-of-Experts Multimodal Large Language Models (MoE-MLLMs) offer scalable inference through sparse expert activation, yet substantial computational redundancy remains among the activated experts. Existing expert skipping methods typically calibrate thresholds based on target skipping ratios or final-output divergence, overlooking the accumulation of skipping-induced error across layers and the varying semantic importance of individual tokens. To address that, we propose ProSE, a training-free, semantic-guided expert skipping framework that probes layer-wise reconstruction error to promote representation consistency compared with default activation. Specifically, we construct query-aware semantic masks to identify salient visual tokens and progressively calibrate modality-specific skipping thresholds for each MoE layer. By minimizing masked reconstruction error under a given budget, ProSE maintains semantic consistency after skipping and allows adaptive expert allocation under limited activation budgets. Extensive experiments on 9 benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements on average over existing expert skipping methods, particularly under aggressive skipping settings. ProSE maintains over 96\% performance on KimiVL-A3B-Inst with 83\% expert skipping and accelerates prefilling by $1.7\times$.

AI.tldr: ProSE：一种免训练、语义引导的 MoE-MLLM 专家跳过框架，通过逐层探针重构误差与查询感知语义掩码，逐步校准各 MoE 层的模态专属跳过阈值，在有限激活预算下自适应分配专家。
AI.motivation: MoE-MLLM 虽通过稀疏专家激活实现可扩展推理，但被激活专家之间仍存在大量计算冗余。现有专家跳过方法多以目标跳过率为导向或依据最终输出偏差来标定阈值，忽略了跳过误差在层间的累积效应，以及不同 token 在语义重要性上的差异。
AI.method: 免训练框架 ProSE：1) 逐层探测重构误差，以默认激活的表示为参照提升表示一致性；2) 构建查询感知语义掩码，识别显著视觉 token；3) 在给定激活预算下最小化掩码重构误差，逐层渐进校准各 MoE 层的模态专属跳过阈值，实现跳过后的语义一致性与自适应专家分配。
AI.result: 在 9 个基准上平均优于现有专家跳过方法，激进跳过设置下优势更明显；KimiVL-A3B-Inst 上实现 83% 专家跳过仍保持 96% 以上性能，prefill 加速 1.7×。
AI.conclusion: 以重构误差与语义重要性为核心的逐层阈值校准，比目标跳过率或输出偏差导向的策略更有效，可在高跳过率下维持多模态推理性能并带来实际推理加速；但整体属于推理效率优化，与 Physical AI/具身智能核心议题关联有限。

title: Driving the Style: Velocity-Conditioned Whole-Body Control from Motion Demonstrations
summary: Achieving human-like behavior on humanoid robots has advanced rapidly by leveraging motion-capture demonstrations rather than hand-crafted cost functions. Adversarial imitation supplies a style signal that lets a policy fulfill a task while adhering to a desired style, but is difficult to transfer to hardware. Whole-body tracking through reinforcement learning instead deploys reliably and imitates demonstrations faithfully, but the resulting policies are conditioned on the future reference, so they require a reference trajectory at runtime and can fail when the motion differs from the training data. We train a humanoid policy directly with whole-body tracking rewards while restricting its actor to compact locomotion commands and robot observations. Reference motion supervises the reward and privileged critic, without supplying reference joint trajectories to the actor or requiring teacher distillation. The demonstrated style is thereby encoded in the policy through the tracking reward, so the robot reproduces the whole-body style under commanded velocities. Trained on a single random-walk motion and commanded with velocity profiles from held-out motions, our policy reaches at least 98\% success in simulation and completes every trial on the Unitree G1. On held-out slow walking, whole-body tracking drops to 2\% success and command-conditioned distillation to 56\%, and both fail on the real robot. On the trained motions, the joint position error of our policy stays within 8\% of whole-body tracking, and it has a higher style coverage than adversarial motion priors (AMP), which fell on the real robot without a safety crane.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用全身跟踪（whole-body tracking）奖励训练人形策略、但把 actor 限制为紧凑运动指令+机器人本体观测（不接收未来参考轨迹），参考动作只监督奖励与特权 critic，无需教师蒸馏；在 Unitree G1 真实机器人上全部试验成功，且保持接近跟踪法的关节误差与更高风格覆盖。
AI.motivation: 对抗式模仿（AMP）能提供风格信号但难以迁移到实机；强化学习全身跟踪虽可可靠部署且忠实模仿，却以未来参考轨迹为条件，运行时必须提供参考轨迹，且遇到分布外动作会失败。作者希望保留跟踪法的可部署性与风格保真度，同时让策略摆脱对运行时参考轨迹的依赖。
AI.method: 用全身跟踪奖励直接训练人形策略：参考动作仅用于构造奖励与特权 critic 的价值估计，actor 的输入只有紧凑的运动指令（速度）与机器人观测；不向 actor 提供参考关节轨迹，也不做 teacher-student 蒸馏。风格通过跟踪奖励隐式编码进策略，使机器人在被指令速度下复现整体动作风格。实验用单条随机行走动作训练，在留出动作的速度曲线上评测（仿真 + Unitree G1 实机），并与全身跟踪、指令条件蒸馏、AMP 对比。
AI.result: 以留出动作的速度曲线驱动时，仿真成功率≥98%，实机全部试验完成；对比之下，全身跟踪在留出的慢速行走上成功率降至 2%，指令条件蒸馏降至 56%，两者在实机上均失败。在训练过的动作上，本方法关节位置误差与全身跟踪相差在 8% 以内，且风格覆盖度高于 AMP（AMP 在无安全吊架下于实机摔倒）。
AI.conclusion: 参考动作可仅作为奖励/critic 的监督信号，即可把全身风格蒸馏进仅以指令和本体感知为输入的策略，从而获得可部署、对参考轨迹分布外情形鲁棒的类人运动策略，优于跟踪法、蒸馏法和对抗式模仿基线。

title: Certified, Not Explained: Exact Token Erasure in Gated Vision State Space Models
summary: Vision models built on Mamba are often explained through their selective step size Delta, on the assumption that a token the scan does not admit cannot influence the prediction. We test that in a concept bottleneck model for lung-nodule malignancy built on a single gated, bidirectional selective state-space block. The answer becomes an interpretability framework: a guarantee, a procedure that checks it, and a pre-registered audit of what it explains. For a fixed gate pattern, masking the input of the causal convolution of the block and giving closed tokens zero weight at readout makes the concept and task logits exactly invariant to the closed tokens. Gating Delta is neither necessary nor sufficient. On LIDC-IDRI, a path-by-path knockout over 15 cross-validated models agrees with this in every run: the largest logit change is exactly 0 whenever the conditions hold and between 4.1 and 6.7 when they do not. The gated model reaches a pooled out-of-fold AUROC of 0.8425 +/- 0.0085, level with an ungated Mamba bottleneck (0.8428). The guarantee belongs to the masked model, not to the gate as an explanation. Post-hoc rankers, which inherit the guarantee on this model, order tokens better than the gate. Gate maps from a model trained on permuted labels are as close to the real maps as two real-label seeds are to each other. Under retraining, the tokens of the gate carry more task information than random tokens and, on shifted crops, more than central ones, but no more than the tokens chosen by hidden attention. We therefore read the gate as a certified support set produced by mask supervision. Splitting the Oracle Impurity Score into own-concept and cross-concept parts reveals differences the aggregate score misses. Partitioning the readout reduced leakage slightly under an earlier recipe, and the final model sits at, rather than below, the level implied by correlations among the true concepts.

AI.tldr: 在基于门控双向选择性状态空间块的肺结节恶性概念瓶颈模型中，作者证明可解释性来自"掩码+闭合token读出零权重"而非门控Δ：给出精确不变性保证、检验流程与预注册审计，LIDC-IDRI上15折模型的逐路knockout完全印证（满足条件时logit变化恰为0，不满足时为4.1–6.7），AUROC 0.8425，与无门控Mamba持平。
AI.motivation: 视觉Mamba常被解释为"选择性步长Δ/门控"决定token是否被扫描接纳，进而影响预测；作者质疑这一假设，需要实证检验门控是否真的是解释性的因果载体。
AI.method: 构建单一门控双向选择性SSM块的肺结节恶性概念瓶颈模型；提出不变性条件——固定门控模式时，对块内因果卷积输入做掩码、并在读出处给闭合token零权重，则概念与任务logit对闭合token精确不变；用逐路径knockout在15个交叉验证模型上验证；对比后验排序器、隐藏注意力、标签置换训练的门控图；将Oracle Impurity Score分解为自身概念与跨概念两部分；并做读出处分区实验。
AI.result: 满足条件时最大logit变化恰为0，否则4.1–6.7；池化out-of-fold AUROC 0.8425±0.0085，与无门控Mamba瓶颈（0.8428）相当；后验排序器在继承保证前提下排序优于门控；置换标签训练出的门控图与真实图距离与两个真实种子之间的差异相当，说明门控图不可作为解释；重训练下门控token携带的任务信息多于随机token、在偏移裁剪上多于中心token，但不优于隐藏注意力所选token；分解后的Oracle Impurity Score揭示聚合分数掩盖的差异。
AI.conclusion: 门控Δ既非解释的充分条件也非必要条件；保证属于被掩码的模型结构而非门本身。门控应被解读为掩码监督产出的"经认证支持集"，而非解释性证据。

title: SciWorldBench: Do Video World Models Really Understand Scientific Experiments?
comment: Preprint. Benchmark paper with paired scientific experiments for evaluating video world models. 8 pages of main text, 16 pages including figures and references
summary: While the ability of video generation models to accurately depict scientific phenomena has received growing attention, determining whether these models genuinely understand the underlying principles remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate video samples in isolation, making it difficult to expose models that simply fit superficial visual priors. In scientific experiments, a small change in one condition produces a markedly different outcome even when the rest of the setup remains fixed. Capitalizing on this sensitivity, we introduce SciWorldBench, a benchmark comprising paired scientific experiments. Each pair varies a single condition in an otherwise fixed setup, yielding two mutually exclusive expected outcomes. Each generation prompt specifies the condition but omits the expected outcome. We evaluate ten text-and-image-to-video (TI2V) models using an independent vision-language model (VLM) that assesses each video without access to the condition text or the label identifying the correct outcome. A pair is scored as correct only when both videos depict their respective scientifically correct outcomes. Across all ten models, we find that the two videos in an experimental pair frequently depict the same outcome even though the conditions require different results. This recurring failure suggests that current video world models struggle to apply the underlying scientific principles reliably during generation. We will publicly release the benchmark dataset and open-source the evaluation code.

AI.tldr: SciWorldBench：用"单变量对照"配对科学实验视频基准，检验视频生成模型是否真正理解科学原理；10个TI2V模型普遍在同一配对的两种不同条件下生成相同结果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成评测多为孤立样本打分，难以识别只拟合表层视觉先验、并未掌握科学规律的模型；需要一个能暴露"理解缺失"的评测协议。
AI.method: 构建成对的科学实验数据：每对仅改变一个条件、其余装置固定，并对应两个互斥的正确结果；提示词只给条件、不给结果标签。用独立VLM在不可见条件文本与正确标签的盲评设置下逐视频判定，配对双方均正确才计为正确。
AI.result: 评测10个文本+图像到视频（TI2V）模型，普遍出现在条件不同、应有不同结果的配对中仍生成同一结果的失败模式，说明当前视频世界模型难以在生成中可靠应用科学原理。
AI.conclusion: 提出以"控制变量敏感性"为核心的世界模型理解能力评测范式；将公开数据集与开源评测代码，但论文为基准/评测类工作，未提出生成方法层面的新洞见。

title: Can Image Generators Hold a Scene Together When Space Is Broken Apart?
summary: Image generators are good at drawing scenes in which things that belong together appear next to each other. In almost every image they generate, and in almost every benchmark used to evaluate these images, "belonging to the same whole" and "adjacent to each other" go together. Therefore, we cannot know whether the model truly grasps the scene as a whole, or simply makes each part connect with its adjacent parts. We propose GJBench to disentangle the two. It requires the model to draw a scene as a scattered jigsaw puzzle: an image is cut into interlocking pieces, then moved apart and rotated. Thus, the spatial plausibility of the scene exists only in how these pieces collectively point to a whole. The model may have a reference image, a target layout, both, or neither. We separately evaluate three requirements: whether the scene is broken down into a specified number of separate pieces, whether the pieces interlock, and whether the pieces can reconstruct the reference scene. While every open and closed model we evaluated could draw these scenes well as a whole, none could keep them together as scattered puzzle pieces, and the three requirements categorized failures into different patterns. The models draw separate pieces but miscount them in different ways, and unless their outlines are provided, the pieces rarely interlock, and their content does not reconstruct the reference image. We also found that the target layout helps the puzzle pieces fit together, while the reference image improves neither their count nor their fit. These findings show that keeping a scene continuous across space that the canvas no longer shows remains an open problem for image generators.

AI.tldr: 提出GJBench基准，将"整体场景连贯性"与"相邻局部连接性"解耦：要求模型把场景画成分散、互相咬合并可拼回原图的拼图块，考察碎片数、咬合与重建三项能力。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成器与评测基准中，"属于同一整体"与"空间相邻"高度耦合，无法判断模型是真正理解整体场景，还是仅让相邻局部相连，因此需要解耦二者的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建GJBench：将图像切割为互锁拼图块后分离并旋转，使空间合理性只体现在碎片共同指向的整体上；设置参考图、目标布局、二者兼有或均无四种条件，分别评测三项指标——是否按指定数量分成独立碎片、碎片是否互锁、碎片能否重建参考场景，并评测多个开源与闭源模型。
AI.result: 所有评测模型均能良好绘制完整场景，但均无法生成分散拼图块；三类要求呈现不同失败模式：碎片可分离但数量计数错误（方式各异），除非提供轮廓，否则碎片极少互锁，且内容无法重建参考图。目标布局有助碎片咬合，参考图对数量与咬合均无提升。
AI.conclusion: 在画布不再显式承载空间连续性时维持场景跨空间一致性，仍是图像生成器的开放难题；模型当前的场景理解高度依赖相邻性归纳偏置。

title: Palmprint Decomposer: Interpretable and Editable Factorization via Synthetic Learning and Instance-Wise Refinement
summary: Palmprint recognition and synthesis methods focus on extracting discriminative textures or generating images with varied textures and appearances. However, they do not generally provide an explicit image-level representation that separates palmprint texture from its underlying base appearance for independent analysis or controlled editing. We introduce Palmprint Decomposer, an interpretable framework that represents a palmprint through independently editable factors and reconstructs the image through a multiplicative composition model. A color map and a light map characterize the base appearance, while a structure map and a global texture strength parameter describe texture modulation. However, accurate reconstruction alone does not guarantee separation of palmprint texture from base appearance, as fine palmprint textures may leak into the estimated base appearance. To mitigate this ambiguity, we train the decomposer exclusively on synthetic data with direct factor supervision, using asymmetric decoding paths and decomposition constraints to suppress texture leakage. Instance-Wise Refinement further improves real-image reconstruction by directly optimizing the predicted factors for each input without relying on the trained network. Experiments across seven datasets demonstrate high reconstruction fidelity, with the extracted structure maps generally achieving verification performance comparable to the original images. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves better factor separation while preserving more discriminative palmprint texture information.

AI.tldr: 提出 Palmprint Decomposer，一个可解释的掌纹图像分解框架，用可独立编辑的因子（颜色图、光照图、结构图、全局纹理强度）通过乘性合成模型重建图像；仅在合成数据上以非对称解码与分解约束训练以抑制纹理泄漏，并用 Instance-Wise Refinement 提升真实图像重建。
AI.motivation: 现有掌纹识别与合成方法只关注判别性纹理提取或生成多样纹理图像，缺乏显式的图像级表示来分离掌纹纹理与底层基础外观，因而无法独立分析或可控编辑。同时发现仅追求高保真重建不足以保证分离，细纹理易泄漏进基础外观。
AI.method: 1) 乘性分解模型：颜色图+光照图表示基础外观，结构图+全局纹理强度表示纹理调制；2) 仅在具有因子直接监督的合成数据上训练，配合非对称解码路径与分解约束抑制纹理泄漏；3) Instance-Wise Refinement：对每个输入直接优化预测因子，不依赖训练网络，提升真实图像重建。
AI.result: 在七个数据集上实现高重建保真度；提取的结构图在验证任务上性能与原始图像相当；相比现有方法因子分离更好且保留更多判别性掌纹纹理信息。
AI.conclusion: 显式可分解的图像级表示可在保持识别判别性的同时实现纹理与外观的解耦与可控编辑，但依赖合成数据监督，实际价值局限于生物特征识别领域。

title: EviBridge: Encoding Predictive Visual Evidence for Proactive Interaction
summary: Tool-handover interaction calls for preparation before a response is warranted. The model waits until interaction cues appear, then prepares while assessing whether the accumulating evidence supports a response or calls for cancellation. We introduce EviBridge, a framework that integrates predictive visual representations into a vision-language interaction model for joint state and tool prediction. A trainable evidence interface maps features from a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder into the language decoder alongside native visual inputs, preserving their temporal context and using only observations available at each decision time. The framework has two instantiations. EviBridge-E distinguishes recent from historical evidence and encodes the timing and spatial location of each observation. EviBridge-I preserves the temporal order of pooled V-JEPA 2 features and interaction turns and generates dedicated interaction tokens. We evaluate on FuGIBench, a streaming-video benchmark for preparation, response, and cancellation in tool-handover assistance. The best-performing variants of EviBridge-E and EviBridge-I achieve Overall scores of 0.6448 and 0.5892, compared with 0.2178 and 0.5327 for their respective task-adapted native baselines. These gains span target handovers, long waits, and cancelled requests, demonstrating the value of predictive visual evidence for interaction decisions.

AI.tldr: EviBridge将冻结的V-JEPA 2预测性视觉表征通过可训练"证据接口"注入视觉语言交互模型，实现工具交接场景下的流式状态预测与响应/取消决策。
AI.motivation: 工具交接交互需要在响应前进行"准备"：模型需等待交互线索出现，并持续评估累积证据是否支持响应还是应当取消。现有VLM缺乏对预测性视觉证据的时间建模能力。
AI.method: 以冻结V-JEPA 2编码器为视觉证据源，设计可训练证据接口将其特征与原生视觉输入一同映射进语言解码器，保留时间上下文且仅使用各决策时刻可见的观测。两个实例：EviBridge-E区分近期与历史证据并编码每次观测的时序与空间位置；EviBridge-I保留池化V-JEPA 2特征与交互轮次的时间顺序并生成专用交互token。
AI.result: 在流式视频基准FuGIBench上，EviBridge-E与EviBridge-I最佳变体Overall得分0.6448与0.5892，对应任务适配的native基线分别为0.2178与0.5327，提升覆盖目标交接、长等待与取消请求三类场景。
AI.conclusion: 预测性视觉证据对工具交接交互决策有明确价值；轻量证据接口即可显著提升VLM的在线准备与响应/取消判断能力。

title: Transferable Neural CBFs via Generalized Closure
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC 2027)
summary: Classical control barrier functions (CBFs) provide safety constraints for controllers, but designing them by hand is difficult for underactuated vehicles and the resulting safe sets can be overly conservative. Neural CBFs can learn more informative barriers from data, yet a learned barrier is usually verified only for one fixed obstacle configuration. We study whether one neural barrier can be reused across environments by expressing the state relative to each obstacle. The key gap is that these relative coordinates may discard information needed to predict their own evolution. We give a generalized closure condition that represents this missing information as a residual and a lifting theorem that transfers a verified relative-coordinate barrier to every obstacle in a family. A rank test also identifies when symmetry alone cannot justify the transfer. We validate the conditions on a double integrator, a planar aircraft, and a 12-state quadrotor. Coordinates that fail the test lead to obstacle penetration or to a barrier condition that fails near hover, whereas body-frame coordinates close exactly for the quadrotor. The resulting barrier transfers to new maps without retraining and is effective in the reported deployment and fast-start experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出相对坐标下神经控制屏障函数(CBF)的可迁移性理论：用广义闭合条件与"提升定理"把已验证的相对坐标屏障迁移到整个障碍族，并用秩检验判定对称性是否足以支撑迁移；在双积分器、平面飞行器和12状态四旋翼上验证，机体坐标对四旋翼精确闭合、无需重训即可迁移到新地图。
AI.motivation: 经典CBF为控制器提供安全约束，但对欠驱动载具手工设计困难且保守；神经CBF可从数据学习更具信息量的屏障，然而学到的屏障通常只对单一固定障碍构型验证，无法跨环境复用。作者希望探究：能否通过将状态表示为相对各障碍的坐标，使一个神经屏障在多个环境中复用。核心缺口在于相对坐标可能丢弃预测自身演化所需的信息。
AI.method: 引入"广义闭合条件"，把相对坐标丢失的信息显式表示为残差项；给出提升定理（lifting theorem），在闭合条件满足时把已验证的相对坐标屏障迁移到一整个障碍族；设计秩检验，识别仅靠对称性无法正当化迁移的情形。在双积分器、平面飞行器与12状态四旋翼三类系统上进行验证与对比实验。
AI.result: 未通过秩检验的坐标会导致障碍穿透，或在悬停附近出现屏障条件失效；而四旋翼的机体坐标精确闭合。所得屏障无需重新训练即可迁移到新地图，并在所报告的部署与快速启动实验中有效。
AI.conclusion: 相对坐标下的神经CBF能否跨障碍复用，取决于其演化动力学的闭合性；该闭合性可由残差刻画并用秩检验判定。满足条件时，单个经学习的相对坐标屏障可安全迁移到障碍族中的每个对象，为欠驱动系统的可复用安全滤波提供了有理论保证、且经多系统（含四旋翼飞行实验）验证的方案。

title: ReAccess: Look Once, Stay Focused with Efficient Test Time Memory
summary: Despite recent advances, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with fine-grained visual understanding, often failing to effectively utilize critical evidence already encoded in their visual representations. Existing approaches address this limitation through repeated visual processing or explicit reasoning, introducing substantial computational overhead. In this paper, we propose ReAccess, a lightweight framework that preserves and reuses question-relevant visual evidence through compact associative memory. Constructed during a single visual prefill, the memory supports progressive evidence retrieval that steers both attention queries and hidden representations, enabling effective visual grounding without repeated image encoding or explicit reasoning traces. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in both general visual understanding and fine-grained perception, while achieving substantially faster inference than existing reasoning-intensive approaches, demonstrating a promising path to efficient multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: ReAccess：一种轻量框架，在单次视觉 prefill 中构建紧凑的关联记忆（associative memory）以保留问题相关视觉证据，并通过渐进式证据检索调制注意力 query 与隐表示，从而在不重复编码图像、不生成显式推理链的情况下提升细粒度视觉理解。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在细粒度视觉理解上表现不佳，往往未能利用视觉表示中已编码的关键证据；已有补救方案（重复视觉处理、显式推理）带来显著计算开销。
AI.method: 提出 ReAccess：在单次视觉 prefill 阶段构建紧凑关联记忆，缓存与问题相关的视觉证据；推理时进行渐进式证据检索，用检索结果同时引导注意力 query 与隐藏表示，实现视觉 grounding。
AI.result: 在通用视觉理解与细粒度感知任务上取得一致提升，且推理速度显著快于现有 reasoning-intensive 方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过"记忆化—检索"替代重复编码与显式推理，为高效多模态推理提供了一条可行路径，但论文仍属通用 VLM 方法，未涉及具身或机器人任务验证。

title: Learning What the True Labels Would Teach: Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning with Unlabeled Data
summary: In class-incremental learning with unlabeled data, each task brings only class names and unlabeled images, so CLIP's zero-shot predictions replace labels. Existing methods train on hard pseudo-labels, but a wrong one gives the true class zero probability, which self-training often confirms. We argue that each image should carry its label posterior, as an analytic classifier trained on posteriors equals the true-label one in expectation. The zero-shot prediction is not this posterior, as its class proportions confound name bias with true imbalance and it ignores other images. We propose Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning (PACIL), which corrects the class prior with a prior selection rule and refines each distribution by a fixed-prior von Mises-Fisher mixture on whitened features. These soft labels train the classifier and replace labels to select its fusion weight with zero-shot CLIP by closed-form leave-one-out cross-validation. We prove that posterior targets minimize the mean-square gap to the true-label prediction and that their argmax widens this gap only through ambiguous images. The fusion weight selected with soft labels loses at most their distance to the posteriors in expected correct decisions. PACIL has the best average incremental accuracy among methods trained without labels on all 18 settings.

AI.tldr: PACIL: 在无标签类增量学习中用"标签后验"软标签替代硬伪标签，通过先验选择规则校正类先验并用固定先验vMF混合模型精炼分布，再用闭式留一交叉验证选择与零样本CLIP的融合权重。
AI.motivation: 无标签类增量学习中CLIP零样本预测被当作伪标签，但硬伪标签会给真实类零概率并自我强化；零样本预测本身受类名偏置与真实不均衡混杂影响，且不考虑图像间关系，并非真正的标签后验。
AI.method: 提出PACIL：1) 用先验选择规则校正零样本预测的类先验并整理为标签后验；2) 在whitened特征上用固定先验von Mises-Fisher混合模型对每个分布精炼；3) 用软标签训练分类器，并以闭式留一交叉验证选择分类器与零样本CLIP的融合权重。理论上证明后验软标签最小化与真实标签预测的均方误差，argmax偏差仅来自模糊样本，融合权重误差界有限。
AI.result: 在全部18个设置中，PACIL在无标签训练方法里取得最佳平均增量准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以后验软标签替代硬伪标签在理论上有依据且在无标签类增量学习基准上实证最优；但缺少真实机器人/部署证据，属通用ML方法。

title: TacBridge: Learning Unified Tactile Representations through Cross-Sensor Correspondence
summary: Optical tactile sensors record tactile videos that capture local deformation and its temporal evolution during contact, supporting robot manipulation, force estimation, and tactile representation learning. Differences in imaging geometry, background appearance, illumination, resolution, and deformation response lead to sensor-dependent observations of the same contact across GelSight, DIGIT, GelSlim, TacTip, and other optical tactile sensors. This variability limits representation transfer and the joint use of multi-sensor data. We introduce TacBridge, a framework for learning unified representations from multi-sensor tactile videos through cross-sensor correspondence. Specifically, multi-sensor masked tactile-video pre-training learns spatiotemporal representations across sensors. We then train the same masked model jointly on same-sensor and cross-sensor reconstruction, using paired source and target videos of matched contact events. Experiments on cross-sensor translation and downstream perception demonstrate the cross-sensor generalization and task transferability of the learned tactile representations.

AI.tldr: TacBridge：通过跨传感器对应关系对多传感器触觉视频做掩码视频预训练与联合重构，学习统一触觉表征，提升跨传感器迁移。
AI.motivation: GelSight、DIGIT、GelSlim、TacTip 等光学触觉传感器在成像几何、背景、光照、分辨率与形变响应上差异大，同一接触的观测呈传感器依赖，导致表征难以迁移、多传感器数据难以联合利用。
AI.method: 先用多传感器掩码触觉视频预训练学习跨传感器时空表征；再用匹配接触事件的源/目标配对视频，在同一掩码模型上联合进行同传感器与跨传感器重构训练。
AI.result: 在跨传感器翻译与下游感知任务上验证了所学触觉表征的跨传感器泛化性与任务可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 跨传感器对应关系约束的掩码视频建模可作为统一光学触觉表征的有效途径，支持多传感器数据联合使用。

title: vividRGB: Various visual cue detection in RGB photographs with forced focused attention
comment: 32 pages including supplementary material; 6 numbered figures and a graphical summary
summary: Natural photographs contain dense, overlapping structures that can be weakly expressed in feature maps from whole-image vision encoders. We introduce forced focused attention (FFA) and its Python implementation, vividRGB. FFA is an encoder-agnostic inference-time procedure that applies a frozen encoder to enlarged, overlapping local crops, averages inverse-aligned reflections, and reconstructs a feature field in source coordinates. We evaluate 50 high-resolution photographs from grassland vegetation, fungal networks, airborne forests, coral reefs, and phytoplankton microscopy, using DINOv3 ViT-B/16. Across the five domains, FFA at 5% or 10% focus produces higher mean RGB-edge boundary F1 than direct DINOv3 encoding and automatic SAM3 masks. Domain means range from 0.244 to 0.596 for FFA, versus 0.028-0.076 for direct DINOv3 and 0.020-0.090 for SAM3. Qualitative feature maps also show finer appearance structure. These results concern RGB-edge preservation rather than verified species, traits, or biological segmentation. Narrower focus generally improves boundary preservation, while extraction time and GPU energy use increase sharply and gains diminish at finer settings. FFA may be useful for relatively small, high-resolution ecological image collections where dense visual cues matter. The alpha release vividRGB 0.1.0 and versioned research resources support reproducible cue inspection.

AI.tldr: FFA：冻结编码器+局部重叠裁剪推理时特征场重建，提升细结构边界保真度
AI.motivation: 整图视觉编码器对密集重叠细结构（植被、菌丝网、珊瑚、浮游生物）的特征响应弱，需在推理阶段提升局部细节表达，且不改动编码器。
AI.method: 提出 forced focused attention (FFA)：编码器无关的推理时流程，对放大后的重叠局部裁剪块运行冻结编码器，对反向对齐的翻转结果取平均，再在源坐标重建特征场；开源 vividRGB 0.1.0 实现。用 DINOv3 ViT-B/16 在 5 个生态域 50 张高分辨率照片上评测，指标为 RGB 边缘边界 F1。
AI.result: FFA（5%/10% focus）各域平均边界 F1 为 0.244–0.596，显著高于直接 DINOv3（0.028–0.076）与 SAM3 自动掩码（0.020–0.090），定性特征图亦更细腻；更窄 focus 提升边界保真但提取时间与 GPU 能耗急剧增加、收益递减。
AI.conclusion: FFA 为免训练、推理时的特征增强手段，适用于规模较小的高分辨率生态图像集合中的视觉线索检查；但仅验证 RGB 边缘保持，未涉及物种、性状或生物分割正确性。

title: ROSE: A Shared Cross-Embodiment Facial-Motion Latent Space for Humanoid Robot Expression
summary: Natural, coherent full-face dynamic expressions are central to making humanoid robots socially approachable, yet existing systems commonly realize only limited lip motion or scripted expressions. The limitation is both physical and algorithmic. A compact head leaves little room for densely packed, independently controllable actuation; meanwhile, learned systems often generate an avatar video, landmarks, or facial parameters and then infer actuator commands through visual retargeting. This render-and-invert path adds latency and artifacts, and it does not reliably transfer generated behavior to a physical robot. We present ROSE (RObot facial expression through Shared motion Embeddings), a framework that integrates biomimetic hardware, cross-embodiment motion representation learning, and multimodal motion generation. On the hardware side, we build a flexible tendon-sheath transmission structure that integrates 34 actuators into a 19.5 cm biomimetic head. By decoupling actuator placement from facial action points, it enables coordinated full-face expression within a compact volume. On the algorithmic side, ROSE-VAE learns an identity-independent shared facial-motion latent space from human, digital-human, and robot observations. ROSE-Flow directly maps text, audio, or their combination to trajectories in this motion space without using video as a generator input. ROSE-ACT then converts these trajectories into constrained actuator commands. Our system demonstrates how high-density biomimetic hardware and a shared executable facial-motion representation can jointly unify cross-embodiment learning, multimodal generation, and physical robot expression.

AI.tldr: ROSE integrates 34-actuator tendon-sheath biomimetic robot head, a shared cross-embodiment facial-motion latent space (ROSE-VAE), a text/audio-to-motion flow model (ROSE-Flow), and a constrained actuator mapping (ROSE-ACT) to realize coherent full-face dynamic expressions on a physical humanoid robot.
AI.motivation: Existing robot facial systems only achieve limited lip motion or scripted expressions. The bottleneck is twofold: compact heads cannot host densely packed independent actuators, and learned pipelines generate avatars/landmarks/parameters then retarget via render-and-invert, adding latency, artifacts, and unreliable transfer to physical hardware.
AI.method: Hardware: flexible tendon-sheath transmission decoupling actuator placement from facial action points, packing 34 actuators into a 19.5 cm head for coordinated full-face motion. Algorithm: ROSE-VAE learns an identity-independent shared facial-motion latent from human, digital-human, and robot data; ROSE-Flow maps text/audio or combined modality directly to latent trajectories without video as generator input; ROSE-ACT converts trajectories into constrained actuator commands.
AI.result: A system is built that unifies cross-embodiment facial-motion learning, multimodal (text/audio) generation, and physical robot expression without visual retargeting; details of quantitative evaluation and user studies are not given in the abstract.
AI.conclusion: High-density biomimetic hardware plus a shared executable facial-motion representation enables direct end-to-end generation of natural full-face robot expressions, offering a paradigm that bypasses render-and-invert retargeting for social humanoid robots.

title: FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Equal contribution: Qixuan Wu and Xiaole Yang. Corresponding authors: Yuguang Yang and Baochang Zhang
summary: Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. We present Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment (FAVR), a lightweight framework for flow-aware visual conditioning of frozen VLA policies. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74-2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks.
