On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.

AI.tldr: FAVR：一种轻量插件框架，用线性TTT维护时序视觉状态，并在流式动作生成过程中按"流感知门控"注入动作条件视觉特征，以冻结VLA策略为前提提升操作成功率，仅需1.74–2.19M可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频表示含丰富时序信息，但难以有效融入现有VLA策略；全量微调代价高且可能破坏原策略能力，需要轻量、可解释的视觉条件注入方式。
AI.method: 以冻结VLA为基座：1) 线性Test-Time Training维护紧凑时序视觉状态；2) 利用冻结动作头的仿射结构，显式刻画注入视觉特征对预测动作速度的影响；3) 将沿流步的通道选择建模为箱约束优化，给出FISTA求解器与基于对角化/重缩放的闭式近似。5000步适配、约2M可训练参数。
AI.result: RoboTwin 2.0上LingBot-VLA由87.12%→90.04%（干净）、86.88%→89.38%（随机化）；5任务受控消融显示流感知门控相对全程共享门控将平均成功率从72.0%提升到82.0%（+10点）。
AI.conclusion: 在冻结VLA上做流感知的视觉残差对齐是高效可行的增益路径，逐流步自适应视觉条件优于静态门控；但证据限于仿真基准，缺少真机验证与开源信息。

title: Inverse Kinematics in Endoscopic Scenarios using MoveIt
summary: Inverse kinematics are critical in many robotic applications, yet standard MoveIt-based solvers struggle in confined scenarios. This paper provides a benchmark of the available solvers and compares multiple practical modifications for improving the performance of the solvers. Splitting the IK problem into two parts results in the best performance, leading to a 100% success rate under 100 ms in an endoscopic tank scenario.

AI.tldr: MoveIt逆运动学求解器在受限场景下表现不佳，本文基准测试多种求解器并提出改进，将IK问题拆分为两部分可在内窥镜水箱场景中实现100毫秒内100%成功率。
AI.motivation: 标准基于MoveIt的IK求解器在狭窄/受限空间（如内窥镜等受限机器人应用）中成功率低、耗时长，需要系统性评估可用求解器并寻找实用改进方案。
AI.method: 对现有可用IK求解器进行基准对比，并比较多种工程化修改；核心改进为将IK问题分解为两个子问题进行求解。
AI.result: 问题拆分方案性能最优，在内窥镜水箱场景下实现100ms内100%求解成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将IK问题拆分为两部分是提升受限场景IK性能的有效手段，可作为MoveIt求解器的实用替代方案。

title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
summary: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce \textsc{MedJev}, a \emph{system one} vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multimodal forward pass, without any autoregressive generation process. For fast inference, \textsc{MedJev} removes the upper language layers and the generative output pathway, while keeping the full vision pathway and all visual tokens. On this shortened backbone, a decision head scores each candidate by pretrained query--key matching and refines the scores with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual, coupling the pretrained matching structure with task-specific nonlinear discrimination. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, \textsc{MedJev}-4B improves both accuracy and speed over the original model on each of four medical image classification and visual question answering benchmarks, with an absolute accuracy gain of \textbf{7.93\%} and a \textbf{6.04$\times$} end-to-end speedup. Further comparison with 20 cutting-edge models shows that \textsc{MedJev}-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance and inference speed among 4B--9B general and medical VLMs, indicating that direct multimodal decision making is an effective route to fast and effective medical image understanding.

AI.tldr: MedJev：将医学VLM改造为“system one”式决策模型，去掉上层语言层与自回归生成，用候选答案打分头做单次多模态前向决策，精度+7.93%，端到端提速6.04倍。
AI.motivation: 医学影像VLM依赖自回归生成推理与答案token，导致推理延迟随回答长度增长，且需从自由文本中解析答案，带来可避免的延迟与决策错误。作者希望绕开生成式解码，直接得到决策。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.5-4B基础上截断上部语言层并移除生成式输出通路，保留完整视觉通路与全部视觉token；在缩短的主干上加决策头，先用预训练query–key匹配为每个候选答案打分，再用轻量MLP残差精炼分数，从而在单次多模态前向中完成候选判别，无需任何自回归生成。
AI.result: 在四个医学图像分类与医学VQA基准上，MedJev-4B相对原模型在准确率与速度上均提升，绝对准确率增益7.93%，端到端加速6.04倍；与20个前沿模型对比，在4B–9B通用与医学VLM中达到SOTA性能与最快推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 直接式多模态决策（判别式打分替代生成式推理）是快速且有效的医学图像理解路径。不过该收益高度依赖多选候选设定，方法本身为领域特化的效率优化，对通用VLM决策与物理AI/具身系统的泛化性尚未验证。

title: Digits in Notation Are Not Numbers: A Scoring Pitfall in PDF-to-Markdown Conversion of Japanese Technical Documents (Preliminary Evaluation)
summary: Converting PDFs to Markdown is now routine preprocessing for search and language models, yet scoring the numbers in the output is easy to get wrong. We evaluate MinerU, a plain-text OCR baseline (NDLOCR-Lite), and a deterministic post-processing pipeline (anchor insertion, footnote reordering, fixes of look-alike characters in fixed contexts, gated formula repair using two independent OCR partners, and heading reconstruction) on 48 public Japanese pages (three documents), text-layer and rasterized. Our pre-specified number-and-unit F1 favored the OCR baseline (0.575 vs 0.397), and a disagreement check between the two engines seemed to flag about half of the converter's number errors (54.6%). Both were artifacts. The scorer counted digits in the converter's notation (image-link paths, HTML attributes), which plain text lacks. With the notation removed (a post-hoc check), the F1 scores tie (0.575 vs 0.594), and the check flags only 13% of number errors, because most errors are misses that both engines share. What remains: the OCR baseline has a lower body character error rate (0.012 vs 0.053 rasterized). The pipeline raises extra-number recall at page level (+0.145; the document-level interval touches 0), mostly by restoring page numbers, but lowers heading-level agreement (0.133 to 0.061) and leaves spurious formulas unchanged; its formula repair never fires. A pre-specified precision gate for its flags (0.80, human-judged) is met at 0.929, yet the post-processing hypothesis fails on its improvement items. We recommend scoring numbers after removing notation and checking critical figures against the source. By the pre-specified criteria, the study stays a technical report.

AI.tldr: 论文评估了MinerU、纯文本OCR基线(NDLOCR-Lite)及确定性后处理流水线在48页日文文档PDF转Markdown任务上的数字/单位抽取表现，发现预注册指标(数字F1、双引擎不一致检测)均因评分器把图片链接路径与HTML属性中的数字计入而产生假象；去除记号后两引擎F1持平(0.575 vs 0.594)，不一致检测仅覆盖13%错误。
AI.motivation: PDF→Markdown已成为检索与语言模型的标准预处理步骤，但对输出中"数字"的评测极易出错；作者希望建立一个可复现、预注册的日文文档OCR/转换评测，并验证后处理流水线（锚点插入、脚注重排、形近字修复、门控公式修复、标题重建）是否真正提升质量。
AI.method: 在3份公开日文文档、48页（文本层与栅格化两种输入）上对比MinerU、NDLOCR-Lite纯文本OCR基线与一条确定性后处理流水线；预注册数字-单位F1与双OCR引擎不一致检测，并做人类判定的精度门(0.80)；随后进行事后检查，剔除记号(图片链接路径、HTML属性)后重新评分。
AI.result: 预注册F1偏向OCR基线(0.575 vs 0.397)，不一致检测报告标记了约54.6%的转换器数字错误——两者皆为评分假象；去除记号后F1持平(0.575 vs 0.594，基线略优)，不一致检测仅覆盖13%错误(多数为两引擎共同漏检)。OCR基线正文CER更低(栅格化0.012 vs 0.053)；流水线将页级多余数字召回提升+0.145(文档级置信区间含0)，主要来自恢复页码，但标题级一致性下降(0.133→0.061)，伪公式未被修正，公式修复从未触发；标记精度门以0.929通过。
AI.conclusion: 后处理假设在其改进项上不成立：确定性后处理未带来实质数字抽取收益，门控公式修复失效。建议数字化评测应先剔除标记类数字再计算指标，并对关键数值回溯原文档核验；按预注册标准，该研究定位为技术报告。

title: Sparse Attention for Visual Generation: Toward Algorithm-System Co-Design
summary: Rapid advances in image and video generation have enabled high-fidelity synthesis at higher resolutions and longer durations, making the quadratic cost of dense self-attention a major bottleneck as visual token sequences grow. Sparse attention seeks to preserve generation quality at lower computational cost by retaining informative query-key interactions and omitting less consequential ones, with end-to-end gains depending on the cost of constructing sparse support and the efficiency with which the system maps the resulting workload to hardware. We survey sparse attention for visual generation through a 4+1+3 analytical framework that links algorithmic design to system implementation. The framework examines how static and dynamic methods use source information and the evidence derived from it to decide which interactions to retain and at what granularity, while accounting for the roles of reuse in reducing repeated computation and correction in compensating for omitted contributions. We relate these algorithmic choices to their implementation on hardware through the framework's three system dimensions of data organization, execution, and dataflow. We summarize common evaluation metrics and discuss open challenges and research directions, providing researchers and practitioners with a reference for the joint design of sparse attention algorithms and systems.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇视觉生成中稀疏注意力的综述，提出"4+1+3"分析框架，将算法设计（静态/动态稀疏、来源信息、证据、粒度、复用、修正）与硬件实现（数据组织、执行、数据流）联系起来，并总结评测指标与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 图像/视频生成向高分辨率、长时长发展，视觉token序列膨胀，密集自注意力的二次复杂度成为主要瓶颈；稀疏注意力虽可降本，但端到端收益取决于稀疏支撑集构建成本与硬件映射效率，需算法与系统协同设计。
AI.method: 综述性分析框架：4个算法维度（静态/动态方法如何利用来源信息与证据决定保留哪些query-key交互及粒度）+1个跨切面（复用减少重复计算、修正补偿被省略贡献）+3个系统维度（数据组织、执行、数据流）。
AI.result: 系统梳理稀疏注意力的算法设计空间与其硬件实现对应关系，归纳常用评测指标，并指出开放问题与研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力的有效增益来自算法稀疏性与系统效率的联合优化，作者为研究者与工程实践者提供了算法—系统协同设计的参考框架。

title: POKE: Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, but attention-based scores do not directly measure a token's effect on the predicted action. We define action sensitivity as the magnitude of the first-order action change when a token is replaced by its camera's mean token and estimate it for all tokens with a single backward pass. Computing it online is costly: scoring on the full (unpruned) graph needs an extra forward pass at every control step. Scoring on the pruned forward pass is cheaper but causes scoring-graph lock-in: removed tokens lose their direct paths through later layers and tend to receive lower scores, making those locations less likely to return. On replayed observations, even with a random conditioning mask, pruned-graph scoring re-selects 59% of the mask's tokens, versus 6% expected by chance; attention histories show a similar bias. POKE (Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently) computes full-graph action sensitivities offline and distills them into a student with under 0.3M parameters. At inference, the student scores the current observation without backpropagation or previous masks, and score-guided diversity selection retains the tokens. Keeping 32 of 512 visual tokens on LIBERO, POKE achieves 95.2% success on OpenVLA-OFT and 90.8% on $\pi_{0.5}$ at $1.85\times$ and $1.26\times$ speedups, outperforming attention-, diversity-, and distillation-based pruners, with larger margins on LIBERO-Plus.

AI.tldr: POKE用离线全图动作敏感度蒸馏出<0.3M的小评分器，在线对VLA视觉token打分，无需反向传播即可剪枝；512保留32时LIBERO成功率95.2%（OpenVLA-OFT）/90.8%（π0.5），加速1.85×/1.26×。
AI.motivation: VLA推理成本高，视觉token剪枝可降本，但现有注意力分数并不直接度量token对预测动作的影响。作者提出"动作敏感度"（token被替换为相机均值token时动作的一阶变化幅度），并指出两个在线估计难题：(1) 全图打分需每步额外前向；(2) 在已剪枝图上打分会导致"打分图锁定"——被删token失去后续层的直连路径，分数持续偏低难以复现（实测重复选中率59%，随机期望6%）。
AI.method: 离线在完整计算图上用单次反向传播计算全部token的动作敏感度，蒸馏到<0.3M参数的student网络；推理时student只需对当前观测前向打分，无需反向传播、也不依赖历史mask；结合分数引导的多样性选择保留token。
AI.result: LIBERO上512个视觉token保留32个：OpenVLA-OFT成功率95.2%（1.85×加速），π0.5成功率90.8%（1.26×加速），优于注意力型、多样性型与蒸馏型剪枝基线，在LIBERO-Plus上优势更大。另定量揭示剪枝图打分的偏差现象。
AI.conclusion: 以"任务相关（动作敏感度）+离线蒸馏"替代注意力启发式，是VLA视觉token剪枝的有效范式；避免在线打分图锁定是保证剪枝稳定性的关键，student式轻量打分器可在几乎零开销下实现在线剪枝。

title: FlowRow: Learning Navigation Behaviors in Agricultural Environments with Long-Horizon Goal-Conditioned Flow Matching Policies
summary: Autonomous monitoring and intervention in semi-structured agricultural environments, such as orchards and vineyards, require mobile robots to navigate to locations across diverse field configurations. This entails performing navigation behaviors including in-row driving, row turning and skipping, and inter-row traversal. Recent learning-based approaches have enabled robust in-row navigation from onboard perception, but navigation across rows typically requires a priori knowledge of field geometry to specify and tune row-transition maneuvers, preventing arbitrary transitions between rows. We address this challenge by framing navigation in these environments as a goal-directed navigation task, where a long-horizon goal is expressed relative to the robot and a planner generates local paths based on the goal and the robot's perceptual observations. We present FlowRow, a flow-matching-based local planner which models the distribution of diverse agricultural navigation behaviors as $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ paths using the long-horizon goal and depth perception. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce RowNavBench, a navigation benchmark for semi-structured agricultural environments developed in Isaac Sim, comprising 900 episodes across grape vineyards, lemon orchards, and apple orchards with varying row lengths, row and plant spacings, plant positions, and weed growth. FlowRow achieves 87% success, compared to 44% for the strongest generative behavior cloning baseline retrained on the same demonstrations. We will release our benchmark, data, and code upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: FlowRow 将半结构化农业环境（葡萄园、果园）中的跨行导航表述为以长时域目标为条件的局部规划问题，用基于流匹配（flow matching）的生成式局部规划器在 SE(2) 上建模多样导航行为分布，并基于 Isaac Sim 构建 RowNavBench 基准（900 个 episode）。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式行内导航依赖机载感知已较鲁棒，但跨行/行切换（行转弯、跳行、行间穿越）通常需要先验田间几何来指定并调参，无法在任意两行间自由过渡，限制了自主监测与干预任务对全场覆盖的需求。
AI.method: 把导航重述为目标导向任务：长时域目标以相对机器人坐标表达，规划器结合该目标与深度感知生成局部路径。FlowRow 使用 flow matching 学习 SE(2) 局部路径的条件分布，以多模态方式覆盖行内驾驶、行转弯、跳行与行间穿越等行为；同时在 Isaac Sim 中构建 RowNavBench，涵盖葡萄园、柠檬园与苹果园，变化行长、行距/株距、株位与杂草生长，共 900 个 episode 用于系统评测。
AI.result: FlowRow 成功率达 87%；在同一示教数据上重训的最强生成式行为克隆基线为 44%。
AI.conclusion: 以相对长时域目标为条件的生成式局部规划可免去手工指定行切换机动与几何先验，实现任意行间过渡；作者承诺接收后开源基准、数据与代码。当前证据限于仿真基准，缺少真实果园部署验证。

title: ScoutCache: Efficient Few-Step Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Conditional Readout and Selective Caching
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient long video generation, but inference still incurs substantial computational costs from repeated denoising and KV cache operations. Existing acceleration methods reduce parts of this overhead, while historical KV reading and cache construction remain costly across video chunks. To address these challenges, we propose ScoutCache, a training-free framework that jointly optimizes denoising, historical KV reading, and cache construction. We observe that shallow feature changes provide useful information for estimating clean latent updates, while historical KV dependence varies across Transformer layers and attention heads but remains relatively stable across video chunks. Based on these observations, we develop Conditional Denoising Readout (CDR) to estimate intermediate denoising updates from shallow feature changes and known noise variations. We further introduce Output Risk Guided Historical KV Reading (ORHR) to allocate historical reading budgets based on attention output perturbations, and Content and Coverage Guided Sparse Cache Construction (CCSC) to reduce cache construction costs by selecting informative spatial tokens while maintaining spatial coverage. Extensive experiments on Self-Forcing and LongLive using VBench and MovieGen demonstrate that ScoutCache achieves up to 2.28$\times$ and 1.86$\times$ speedups, respectively, while consistently improving generation quality without modifying pretrained model parameters.

AI.tldr: ScoutCache：免训练框架，联合优化少步自回归视频扩散的降噪、历史KV读取与缓存构建，实现最长视频生成加速
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散虽降低采样步数，但重复降噪、历史KV读取与KV缓存构建在跨视频块时仍带来大量计算开销；已有加速方法只覆盖部分环节。
AI.method: 三项观察驱动设计：浅层特征变化可用于估计干净潜变量更新；历史KV依赖因层/头而异但跨块稳定。据此提出CDR（条件降噪读出，由浅层特征变化+已知噪声变化估计中间降噪更新）、ORHR（输出风险引导的历史KV读取，按注意力输出扰动分配读取预算）、CCSC（内容与覆盖度引导的稀疏缓存构建，在保持空间覆盖下选取信息量大的空间token）。
AI.result: 在Self-Forcing与LongLive上，基于VBench与MovieGen评测：分别实现最高2.28×和1.86×加速，且生成质量持续提升，不修改预训练参数。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨视频块的冗余结构（浅层特征可预测、KV依赖稳定）实现免训练的端到端推理加速，兼顾效率与质量，但属于视频生成推理系统优化，非具身/3D核心方向。

title: Body of Evidence: Triangulating 3D Human Pose with Geometry-Conditioned Depth
summary: Even in multi-camera setups, occlusions can leave individual body joints with only a single usable 2D observation. Such an observation defines a viewing ray but leaves the joint's depth undetermined. We introduce Body of Evidence (BoE), a multi-view 3D human pose estimator that predicts per-camera joint depths alongside 2D joint locations. To reduce monocular depth ambiguity, we propose geometry-conditioned depth prediction, which combines image features with previously reconstructed 3D body geometry as contextual depth cues. We further introduce learnable depth-aware triangulation (LDAT), which augments differentiable algebraic triangulation with predicted depth constraints, enabling reconstruction even from a single contributing camera while preserving the benefits of geometric triangulation when multiple views are available. The reconstructed 3D poses subsequently guide depth prediction in the next iteration, allowing depth estimates and 3D geometry to progressively refine each other. Experiments on CMU Panoptic demonstrate state-of-the-art in-domain performance and superior average performance across evaluated camera subsets and unseen camera arrangements. BoE is particularly effective under sparse camera coverage, outperforming the previous state of the art by 10.6 AP25 points in the challenging three-camera setting.

AI.tldr: BoE：多视角3D人体姿态估计器，联合预测每相机2D关节与关节深度，用几何条件深度预测降低单目深度歧义，并以可学习深度感知三角化（LDAT）实现单相机可重建、多视角更优的迭代互精化。
AI.motivation: 多相机系统中遮挡仍常使某些关节仅有一个可用2D观测，该观测只确定一条视线射线，深度不可定，导致稀疏相机覆盖下重建失败。
AI.method: (1) 几何条件深度预测：将图像特征与上一轮重建的3D人体几何作为上下文深度线索融合；(2) 可学习深度感知三角化LDAT：在可微代数三角化中引入预测深度约束，单相机即可求解，多视角时保留几何三角化优势；(3) 迭代框架：重建3D姿态反过来引导下一轮深度预测，深度与几何逐步互精化。在CMU Panoptic上评测多相机子集与未见相机布局。
AI.result: CMU Panoptic上域内性能达SOTA，在各相机子集与未见相机排布下平均性能更优；稀疏覆盖尤为有效，三相机设置下较前SOTA提升10.6 AP25。
AI.conclusion: 将深度估计与几何三角化耦合为可迭代互精化框架，可有效缓解单视角深度歧义，显著提升稀疏多视角3D人体姿态重建鲁棒性。

title: Dataset Distillation for Handwritten Text Recognition: An Empirical Study
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) replaces large training datasets with smaller synthetic ones to reduce computational costs. While traditionally used for classification, we present, to our knowledge, the first DD study for line-level handwritten text recognition (HTR). Unlike classification tasks, which use discrete labels, HTR employs unaligned sequences from a virtually infinite output space as labels. To adapt classification-based DD methods to this scenario, we define text pseudo-classes by clustering transcriptions based on character n-grams. We adapt gradient matching (GM), distribution matching (DM) and trajectory matching (MTT) to a Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) trained with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC). In this process, synthetic line images are generated by optimising only the pixels of real starting lines (either randomly chosen or selected as text medoids), while keeping their original transcriptions fixed. Across four datasets (IAM, George Washington, READ\,2016, LAM) and three budgets (1--10\,\% of the training lines), no distilled set outperforms its real initialisation lines. Random lines prove better than medoids, and further optimisation only degrades recognition. Methodologically, DM lowers its objective without benefit, while GM and MTT barely move theirs. We turn these findings into guidelines for evaluating data compression in HTR.

AI.tldr: 首个面向行级手写文本识别(HTR)的数据集蒸馏研究：用字符 n-gram 聚类转录文本构造伪类，将GM/DM/MTT迁移到CTC训练的CRNN，但四数据集三预算下蒸馏集均不优于其真实初始线，随机线优于medoid，进一步优化反而损害识别。
AI.motivation: 数据集蒸馏(DD)已在分类任务上降低训练成本，但HTR使用无对齐、来自近乎无限输出空间的序列标签，无法直接套用基于离散标签的DD方法；作者希望验证DD在行级手写文本识别上的可行性与边界。
AI.method: 以字符n-gram对转录文本聚类定义"文本伪类"；将梯度匹配(GM)、分布匹配(DM)、轨迹匹配(MTT)适配到以CTC训练的CRNN；合成样本仅优化真实起始行图像像素(随机挑选或选为文本medoid)，转录标签保持固定。
AI.result: 在IAM、George Washington、READ 2016、LAM四个数据集及1–10%训练行预算下，没有任何蒸馏集优于其真实初始化行；随机初始化优于medoid；额外优化只降低识别性能；DM目标下降但无收益，GM与MTT目标几乎不动。
AI.conclusion: 现有分类式DD方法难以有效迁移到序列级HTR；作者据此提出在HTR中评估数据压缩的准则（需以真实行初始化、以随机基线对照、监控目标-性能解耦等）。属负面结果/方法论警示，非核心区贡献。

title: WiTac: Wrist-Informed Tactile Representations for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Similar tactile contacts can call for different corrections depending on the configuration of the hand, object and target. Rather than supplying touch and wrist vision separately, fusing them before policy injection better grounds tactile features in visual context, yielding more accurate contact representations. We introduce Wrist-Informed Tactile Representations (WiTac), a pretrained encoder that learns such representations before action generation. Pretrained on nearly 300 hours of SharpaDex data, WiTac deeply fuses tactile signals with hand motion and wrist views into a comprehensive contact representation. Conditioning downstream VLA policies (GR00T N1.7 and $\pi_{0.5}$) on WiTac substantially improves task success over vision-only base policies across four contact-rich manipulation tasks (+28.8% and +15.0% on average), and further outperforms a wrist-free tactile encoder by 18.8% and 7.5%, respectively. Offline analyses further show that incorporating wrist vision yields more accurate contact descriptors, stronger joint task-contact discrimination, greater feature stability under tactile noise, and clearer action-direction readout from similar this http URL page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: WiTac：将触觉信号与手腕视角、手部运动在策略注入前深度融合的预训练触觉编码器，在300小时SharpaDex数据上预训练，为VLA策略提供更好的接触表征。
AI.motivation: 相同触觉接触在不同手-物-目标构型下需要不同修正，单独提供触觉与手腕视觉难以将触觉特征锚定在视觉上下文中，导致接触表征不准确。
AI.method: 提出WiTac预训练编码器，在动作生成前将触觉信号与手部运动、手腕视图深度融合为统一接触表征；以该表征条件化下游VLA策略（GR00T N1.7与π0.5）。
AI.result: 在四项接触丰富操作任务上，相对纯视觉基线平均成功率提升+28.8%（GR00T N1.7）与+15.0%（π0.5）；相对无手腕视觉的触觉编码器分别提升18.8%与7.5%。离线分析显示接触描述更准确、任务-接触联合判别更强、触觉噪声下特征更稳定、动作方向可读性更清晰。
AI.conclusion: 在策略注入前进行触觉-视觉深度融合是提升接触丰富操作性能的有效范式，手腕视觉为触觉提供关键上下文。

title: Multi-CONDOR: Learning Multistable Motion Primitives from Demonstration
summary: Dynamical-system-based motion policies provide a framework for learning reactive robot motions with stability and convergence properties. Many manipulation tasks, however, admit several distinct goals or a continuous set of acceptable outcomes, requiring motion primitives that preserve these alternatives. Accommodating both goal structures within a unified framework with continuous, autonomous dynamics remains an open challenge. We propose a CONDOR-based framework, multi-CONDOR, for learning motion primitives with either multiple discrete attractors or a continuous attracting goal contour. The approach combines imitation learning with losses that encourage agreement between the learned task dynamics and latent reference systems encoding the desired attraction structure. We provide a Lyapunov-based analysis of the convergence properties of the learned motion dynamics. We evaluate the framework on simulated benchmarks with discrete goals, qualitative examples with continuous goal contours, and robotic grasping experiments. In simulation, multi-CONDOR reduces trajectory RMSE by approximately 72% compared with separately learned single-goal motion primitives selected by a state machine. For tasks with two and three goals, respectively, it reduces the fraction of evaluated initial states ending outside the goal tolerance from StableNODE's 0.31% and 7.29% to 0% in both settings. Experiments with a Franka Emika robot arm demonstrate successful grasping of a container by either of its two handles using motions learned from demonstrations. Together, these results show multi-CONDOR combines motion reproduction with the flexibility to converge to alternative valid outcomes.

AI.tldr: Multi-CONDOR: 基于扩散/神经ODE式运动策略框架，学习具多离散吸引子或连续吸引目标流形的动力学运动基元，含Lyapunov收敛性分析，并在仿真基准与Franka机械臂抓取上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有动力学系统式（DS）运动策略多以单一吸引子为收敛目标，但大量操作任务允许多个离散目标或连续可接受结果集，需保留这些替代解；如何在统一框架下用连续自治动力学同时表达两类目标结构尚无成熟方案。
AI.method: 将模仿学习与隐式参考系统（编码期望吸引结构）一致性损失结合，训练带多吸引子/吸引流形的运动基元；给出基于Lyapunov的收敛性分析；对比基线为状态机调度的单目标基元与StableNODE，并做仿真的离散目标基准、连续目标定性示例及Franka双把手容器抓取实验。
AI.result: 仿真轨迹RMSE较单目标基元+状态机降低约72%；双目标与三目标任务中，评估初始状态落在容差外的比例由StableNODE的0.31%与7.29%均降为0%；Franka实机演示可学会从示范中由容器任一抓手完成抓取。
AI.conclusion: multi-CONDOR在保持运动复现精度的同时，赋予动力学对多目标/连续目标集的替代收敛能力，兼顾稳定性与灵活性；局限在于实机证据规模较小，连续目标流形主要为定性验证。

title: MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space
summary: Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.

AI.tldr: MetricHand：几何感知的 flow matching 框架，在度量世界坐标系下进行 4D 手部重建，联合恢复世界平移、全局朝向、MANO articulation 与形状。
AI.motivation: 自我中心手部运动可为灵巧操作与 VLA 预训练提供物理监督，但需精确、时序一致的度量世界空间 4D 手部重建。现有方法把弱透视下的逐帧估计"提升"到世界坐标，忽略近距离下关节相关深度变化，导致平移、朝向与 articulation 误差耦合，且在遮挡下恶化。
AI.method: 将手-物交互区域的深度先验编码为关节关联表示（保留局部空间结构与度量尺度），与视觉特征融合，用于粗尺度度量估计并作为时序生成每一步的 conditioning；以 flow matching 生成框架联合建模世界平移、全局朝向、MANO 参数与形状，结构先验与时序上下文支撑部分遮挡下的估计。
AI.result: 相对 HaWoR：相机空间 MPJPE 降低 49.3% 与 52.9%，绝对世界空间 MPJPE 降低 28.7% 与 21.7%，腕部定位误差降低 48.5% 与 37.9%；世界空间加速度误差下降 44.2% 与 64.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以显式度量深度几何先验替代弱透视提升，可解耦平移/朝向/articulation 误差，同时提升绝对定位精度与时序一致性，为自我中心手部运动监督提供更可靠的 4D 度量重建。

title: What Makes a Good Move? Learning to Act from Experience in Visual Worlds
summary: Learning visual policies requires turning interaction experience into guidance for individual decisions. Trajectory outcomes obscure action quality, while unguided exploration can revisit familiar situations. We present \textsc{LightAct}, an experience-learning framework that connects skill-guided exploration with policy internalization. Interaction segments are summarized into experience entries and consolidated into a game-specific skill that guides root collection toward broader state coverage. At each root, candidate actions are compared through short rollouts under a shared frozen policy. Environment-reported score gains are averaged across continuations and normalized into relative action rewards, producing reusable supervision for reinforcement learning. Policy training uses a compact dataset of just 1,024 decision roots collected in a single source game and paired with their action rewards. Across 170 GameWorld tasks spanning 34 games, \textsc{LightAct} improves overall progress by 23.6, 29.2, and 13.0 percentage points at the 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, respectively, with our strongest model competitive with reported proprietary-model results. Ablations show broader root-state coverage with skill guidance and consistent gains across three policy optimizers. Case studies show how rollouts distinguish actions with identical immediate gains.

AI.tldr: LightAct：将交互片段总结为经验条目并提炼为游戏专属技能引导根状态采集，再用冻结策略短rollout、按续跑平均归一化得分增益生成相对动作奖励，仅用单游戏1024个决策根做RL训练。
AI.motivation: 轨迹级结果掩盖单步动作质量，而无引导探索易重复访问熟悉状态；需要把交互经验转化为对个体决策的监督，并提升状态覆盖度。
AI.method: 技能引导探索（经验条目→游戏专属技能→引导根采集）+冻结策略下短rollout对比候选动作+跨续跑平均并归一化为相对动作奖励+紧凑数据集上的强化学习策略内化。
AI.result: 在34款游戏170个GameWorld任务上，2B/4B/9B规模分别提升23.6/29.2/13.0个百分点，最强模型接近报告中的专有模型；消融显示技能引导带来更广根状态覆盖，三种策略优化器一致增益；案例表明rollout能区分即时增益相同的动作。
AI.conclusion: 以经验提炼技能+相对动作奖励的方式可高效完成“经验→策略”内化，数据需求极小且跨优化器稳健，但验证限于模拟游戏环境，实体机器人/具身迁移证据缺失。

title: CoopDistill: Equilibrium-Guided Multi-Agent Policy Distillation for Cooperative Driving
summary: Cooperative driving extends autonomous driving from individual vehicle decisions to joint maneuvers that improve traffic safety and efficiency. Optimization-based methods impose safety constraints but often fix paths to simplify multi-vehicle planning, limiting spatial flexibility. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) explores alternatives through interaction, but coordinated learning and safe execution remain challenging. Their integration nevertheless faces challenges in exploration efficiency, experience allocation, and execution reliability. To address these challenges, this paper proposes CoopDistill, an equilibrium-guided multi-agent policy distillation framework. A potential-game (PG) formulation provides a fixed-path longitudinal reference, around which a residual MARL policy learns longitudinal acceleration, conflict-approach timing, and lateral path corrections. A hard-case curriculum concentrates experience on interactions that PG leaves unresolved or substantially delayed. A comparative rollout selector evaluates the joint consequences of learned corrections against PG before choosing the executed action. Experiments in merging, roundabout, and intersection scenarios compare CoopDistill with six baselines at four connected automated vehicle penetration levels. Relative to PG, success improves by 2.1--27.1 percentage points and delay decreases by 7.3--27.3\%, with no observed collisions. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: CoopDistill：以势博弈（PG）提供固定路径纵向参考，残差MARL策略学习纵向加速度、冲突接近时机与横向路径修正，并配合难例课程与对比rollout选择器，在多车协同场景中提升成功率、降低延误且无碰撞。
AI.motivation: 基于优化的协同驾驶方法依赖固定路径以简化多车规划，牺牲空间灵活性；MARL虽具灵活性但协同学习与安全执行困难。两者结合还面临探索效率、经验分配与执行可靠性问题。
AI.method: 提出均衡引导的多智能体策略蒸馏框架CoopDistill：(1) 势博弈 formulate 提供固定路径纵向参考轨迹；(2) 残差MARL策略在该参考周围学习纵向加速度、冲突接近时机与横向路径修正；(3) 难例课程将经验集中于PG未解或显著延迟的交互情形；(4) 对比rollout选择器在执行前评估学习修正与PG的联合后果以择优执行。
AI.result: 在汇入、环岛与交叉口三类场景、四种CAV渗透率下与六个基线对比：相对PG成功率提升2.1–27.1个百分点，延误下降7.3–27.3%，未观察到碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 将均衡/优化先验与残差MARL蒸馏相结合，可在保留PG安全性的同时获得空间灵活性，课程学习与执行前rollout筛选是可靠性的关键保障；方法仍在仿真中验证，缺乏实车与真实交通数据支撑。

title: MORE: Merge Once, Route Early for Training-Free Multi-Subject Composition from Large LoRA Pools
summary: Public hubs offer many personalized LoRAs per text-to-image backbone, yet composing two of them in one image remains fragile. In FLUX, keeping a pool of $K=10$ or $20$ subject LoRAs loaded makes their deltas interfere, and even loading only the two requested LoRAs keeps both subjects in fewer than 4% of images: one subject vanishes, the two fuse, or the image splits into a collage. We present MORE (Merge Once, Route Early), a training-free two-stage pipeline for FLUX. Merge once: the whole pool is folded into a single fixed-rank adapter by the subspace-regression router of SSR-Merge, made reliable by ridge, rank and calibration choices, and factored exactly into a shared part and per-subject parts. Route early: during the first 30% of the denoising steps each subject's part is gated to its layout region; a decaying soft attention bias ties every region to its own subject tokens, and a cyclic swap guidance extrapolates away from the prediction with the subjects' regions permuted, which counteracts region homogenization. On held-out seeds, MORE keeps both subjects in 94.2% ($K=10$) and 78.3% ($K=20$) of images, against 50.8% / 35.8% for FreeFuse and 25.0% / 24.2% for LoRAShop, and reaches an ImageReward of 1.32 (best baseline 0.07), while all $K$ subjects stay in one adapter. With layouts inferred automatically it still keeps both subjects in 70.0% / 55.0% of images.

AI.tldr: MORE：面向 FLUX 的无训练两阶段 LoRA 组合方法，先"一次合并"（用 SSR-Merge 的岭回归子空间路由器把 K 个 LoRA 池折叠为单个定秩适配器，并精确分解为共享部分与逐主体部分），再"早期路由"（在去噪前 30% 步内将各主体部分门控到其布局区域，配以衰减软注意力偏置与循环置换引导）。
AI.motivation: 公共 hub 上同一 T2I 主干（FLUX）有大量个性化 LoRA，但同时组合两个 LoRA 极不稳定：共存 10/20 个主体 LoRA 时增量互相干扰；即便只加载所需两个，两个主体同时出现的图像不足 4%（主体消失、融合或拼贴）。已有 LoRAShop、FreeFuse 等方案成功率仍低，需要一种无需训练、可扩展且保持全池在单一适配器内的组合机制。
AI.method: 无训练两阶段管线：(1) Merge once——用 SSR-Merge 的子空间回归路由器将整个 LoRA 池折叠为一个固定秩适配器，通过岭回归、秩选择与校准提升可靠性，并精确分解为共享部分与逐主体部分；(2) Route early——在去噪前 30% 步对每个主体部分按其布局区域门控，使用随步衰减的软注意力偏置把区域与对应主体 token 绑定，并采用"循环互换引导"（对主体区域做置换后的预测进行外推）以抑制区域同质化。
AI.result: 在留出种子下，K=10 时双主体共存率 94.2%、K=20 时 78.3%，显著优于 FreeFuse（50.8%/35.8%）与 LoRAShop（25.0%/24.2%）；ImageReward 达 1.32（最佳基线 0.07），且全部 K 个主体仍驻留于单一适配器。布局改为自动推断后，仍能保持 70.0%/55.0% 的双主体成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过"一次合并 + 早期区域路由"的解耦设计，MORE 在无训练条件下大幅提升多 LoRA 组合的稳定性与可扩展性，兼具单适配器存储效率与自动布局下的可用性；对需要多主体一致性图像生成的具身/仿真资产构建管线有间接价值。

title: State-Message Interaction Adapter for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including the appendix
summary: Cross-domain few-shot segmentation adapts natural-image pretrained encoders to medical or industrial domains from a few pixel-annotated support masks. Within frozen DINOv3, intermediate per-head attention messages already carry target-background distinctions that baseline final-layer similarities and predictions do not consistently reflect. We propose the State-Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA) to learn how per-head messages should update each receiving token representation while keeping pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen. Inserted right after per-head aggregation, SMIA conditions the transformation of each head's aggregated output (message) on each patch's pre-attention feature (state), allowing similar contextual messages to produce distinct or opposing updates depending on the receiving position. Because scarce support masks cover only limited state-message combinations, a shared low-rank bilinear map confines the learned interactions to low-dimensional state, message, and output subspaces. Added before each adapted block's frozen FFN, these updates yield adapted features that are refined by frozen FFNs and deeper blocks for linear readout. With only 0.51M trainable parameters and single-pass, support-free inference, SMIA achieves six-dataset mean mIoUs of 77.40% at 5 shots and 80.99% at 10 shots across 20 medical and industrial tasks, surpassing the strongest prior methods by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points. In controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone, SMIA also outperforms parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX with a better precision-recall balance.

AI.tldr: 在冻结的DINOv3中，逐头注意力消息已蕴含目标-背景判别信息。作者提出状态-消息交互适配器SMIA，在每头聚合后以patch的注意力前特征(state)调制消息(message)的更新，并用共享低秩双线性映射约束学习空间，仅0.51M可训练参数，跨20个医学/工业任务取得5-shot 77.40%、10-shot 80.99%的平均mIoU。
AI.motivation: 跨域小样本分割需将自然图像预训练的编码器迁移到医学/工业域，仅有少量像素级support掩码。观察发现冻结DINOv3的中间层逐头注意力消息中已含目标-背景区分信号，而基线所用的末层相似度/预测不能稳定反映该信号；同时有限support掩码只覆盖极少的state-message组合，直接学习交互易过拟合。
AI.method: 保持预训练注意力与FFN参数冻结，在每个block的逐头聚合之后插入SMIA：以patch的注意力前特征作为state，条件化各头聚合输出的message变换，使相同上下文消息在接收位置不同时产生不同甚至相反的更新；采用共享低秩双线性映射，将交互限制在低维state、message与输出子空间；更新在冻结FFN之前注入，由冻结FFN与更深层block进一步精炼，最终线性读出。推理为单次前向、无需support。
AI.result: 0.51M可训练参数下，20个医学与工业任务上6数据集平均mIoU：5-shot 77.40%，10-shot 80.99%，较最强先前方法分别提升+3.61与+3.93个百分点；在同为DINOv3骨干的三基准10-shot对照实验中优于参数匹配的AdaptFormer、LoRA与ParaX，且精确率-召回率平衡更优。
AI.conclusion: 冻结大模型内部注意力消息本身携带可迁移的判别信息，通过轻量、低秩、state条件的消息-状态交互适配即可高效实现跨域小样本分割，参数极少且推理无需support，优于同类参数高效微调方案。

title: MedicalDPO: Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization for CT to PET Translation
summary: CT-to-PET synthesis estimates functional PET images from anatomical CT scans for auxiliary analysis, representation pretraining, and missing-modality completion. Brownian Bridge diffusion models can produce multiple PET candidates of different quality under the same CT condition, exposing an intra-condition quality hierarchy. Candidate quality spans complementary spatial, structural, and intensity dimensions, while DPO-only fine-tuning may compromise absolute synthesis fidelity. We propose MedicalDPO which converts this hierarchy into preference supervision automatically constructed from paired CT-PET training data. Multiple candidates are ranked across the three fidelity dimensions, and strict cross-metric verification retains preferred-rejected pairs with consistent quality separation. Relative denoising-error preference optimization is jointly trained with the original Brownian Bridge objective to anchor the pretrained CT-to-PET mapping, while condition-balanced multi-pair rotation distributes preference supervision across CT conditions. Experiments on BBDM and CPDM show improvements across LPIPS, MAE, SSIM, and PSNR. Further analyses demonstrate metric complementarity and clear pair separation, while ablations show that the original training objective prevents the substantial degradation caused by DPO-only fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: MedicalDPO将Brownian Bridge扩散模型同条件下多候选的"质量层级"自动转化为偏好监督：三 fidelity 维度排序+严格跨指标一致性校验构造偏好对，并与原BB去噪目标联合训练。
AI.motivation: CT→PET合成中，Brownian Bridge扩散模型在同一CT条件下可采样出质量各异的多个候选，暴露了"条件内质量层级"，但仅用DPO微调会损害绝对合成保真度，需要一种既利用该层级又不破坏预训练映射的对齐方法。
AI.method: 自动构造偏好数据：多候选按空间、结构、强度三维度排序，严格跨指标验证保留质量分离一致的preferred-rejected对；采用相对去噪误差偏好优化，与原始Brownian Bridge目标联合训练以锚定CT→PET映射；并用条件均衡的多对轮转把偏好监督分摊到各CT条件。在BBDM与CPDM上验证。
AI.result: 在BBDM与CPDM上，LPIPS、MAE、SSIM、PSNR均提升；分析显示三指标互补、偏好对分离明显；消融表明保留原训练目标可避免DPO-only微调带来的显著性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散采样的条件内质量层级转为自动偏好监督、并在DPO类优化中锚定原始生成目标，是提升医学跨模态合成保真度的有效范式。

title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
comment: 31 pages: 8-page main paper, references, and supplementary material. Project page: this https URL
summary: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarness, a harness that lets frozen models use force without demonstrations or finetuning. After calibrating hand force from a wrist sensor or joint torques alone, ForceHarness addresses the first challenge with self-terminating force primitives that regulate force on their own and return at a contact event. To address the second challenge, a physics translation layer turns each force trace into physical quantities with uncertainty as the tool result. To evaluate ForceHarness against expert force controllers and learned policies under identical conditions, we also build HiddenPhys, a seven-task MuJoCo benchmark with hidden physical variables. On a real arm without a wrist force sensor, ForceHarness raises the zero-shot success rate of GPT-6 Astra from 3.3% to 90.0%. In simulation, it adds 17.5 percentage points on the public ForceBench suite and 34.3 percentage points on HiddenPhys, surpassing force-aware policies trained on demonstrations on both benchmarks and matching hand-written expert controllers on HiddenPhys. Ablations further show that smaller models make significantly better decisions when given physical quantities rather than raw force values.

AI.tldr: ForceHarness 让冻结的多模态模型在无示教、无微调下使用力觉：以自终止力原语在模型之下闭环力控制，并用物理量+不确定性的"翻译层"把力迹反馈给模型；真实机械臂零样本成功率 3.3%→90.0%。
AI.motivation: 前沿多模态模型可从图像零样本控制机器人，但接触力任务依赖图像无法呈现的力信息。将力引入仅 API 的冻结模型面临两点：接触动力学远快于模型决策频率；冻结模型无法解读原始力流。因此需要在模型之下闭环、并把力转换成模型可推理的形式。
AI.method: ForceHarness 框架：(1) 仅凭腕部传感器或关节力矩标定手部力；(2) 自终止力原语（self-terminating force primitives）自主调节接触力并在接触事件处返回，实现力层面高频闭环；(3) 物理翻译层将力轨迹转换为带不确定性的物理量作为工具返回结果。另构建 HiddenPhys——七任务 MuJoCo 基准，含隐藏物理变量。
AI.result: 真实机械臂（无腕力传感器）上 GPT-6 Astra 零样本成功率 3.3%→90.0%；仿真中 ForceBench +17.5pp，HiddenPhys +34.3pp，超过基于示教训练的力感知策略，在 HiddenPhys 上追平手写专家控制器。消融显示小模型在给定物理量时决策显著优于原始力值。
AI.conclusion: 把力觉以"结构化物理量+分层控制原语"注入冻结大模型，是免训练接触丰富操作的有效路径；为 API-only 模型提供高频底层接口可显著提升零样本力控能力。

title: Beyond Family Labels: A Taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Prior for Avian 3D Shape Recovery
summary: Recovering 3D pose and shape of birds from single images is bottlenecked by the long tail of avian diversity: out of ~10,000 species, only a few dozen have 3D-labeled training data, and in-the-wild test sets routinely contain species never seen at training. Generalizing across clades is therefore a central problem. The current state of the art, AniMer+, mitigates it with a family-level contrastive loss that conveys only a binary same-family indicator per pair and discards the continuous structure of the species tree. We propose a taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck prior on the shape code of the AVES parametric bird mesh model: a multivariate Gaussian whose covariance decays exponentially with Linnaean rank distance, with a learnable selection strength and noise scale. The prior generalizes family contrastive into a continuous, generative form, exposing the graded cross- and within-family similarity that a binary indicator cannot, and brings continuous comparative phylogenetics in as a biology-grounded inductive bias for the long tail. Our method improves over AniMer+ on both metrics of the unseen-species CowBird benchmark and on CtrlAVES3D, while remaining comparable on seen-species CUB. A permutation ablation isolates taxonomic structure from generic Gaussian smoothing, and a rank-granularity ablation identifies cross-order distinctions (the structure beyond a family-vs-not indicator) as the dominant source of the unseen-species gain.

AI.tldr: 提出分类学Ornstein-Uhlenbeck先验，作用于AVES参数化鸟类网格模型的形状编码，将族级二值对比损失推广为连续生成式高斯基先验，提升单图鸟类3D姿态形状在未见物种上的泛化。
AI.motivation: 鸟类约1万种，仅数十种有3D标注；现有SOTA AniMer+仅用族级二值对比损失，丢弃了物种树的连续结构，跨支系泛化受限。
AI.method: 在形状码上施加多元高斯先验，协方差随林奈分类阶元距离指数衰减，选择强度与噪声尺度可学习；把连续比较系统发育学作为生物学归纳偏置，替代族级二值对比。
AI.result: 在未见物种CowBird基准两项指标与CtrlAVES3D上均优于AniMer+，在已见物种CUB上相当。置换消融区分分类结构与通用高斯平滑的贡献；阶元粒度消融显示跨目差异（超越family/not指示的结构）是主要增益来源。
AI.conclusion: 蕴含分类层级的连续先验是长尾泛化的有效归纳偏置，且增益来自细粒度分类阶元结构而非简单正则化；方法特定于鸟类形态，需迁移验证。

title: GRAZE: Text-Free Grasp Synthesis for Unseen Objects from Human Gaze
summary: Text-conditioned hand-object interaction (HOI) generation provides intuitive semantic control, but language is an indirect way to specify where an interaction should occur on an object. Naming the part to grasp requires object-specific words, and naming the approach side requires a reference frame that a prompt lacks. We propose GRAZE (GRAsp from gaZE), which generates hand-object grasp motion from recorded gaze instead of object and part names. Its Geometry-Aware Gaze Encoding (GeoGaze) maps gaze rays to cues on object geometry, and cross-attention conditions a diffusion Transformer on these cues. We also introduce HOT3D-Grasp, a grasp-centered benchmark with object-disjoint folds built on HOT3D recordings. On unseen objects, GRAZE grasps the target part more often than the strongest text-conditioned baseline (49.3% vs. 43.6%), achieves the highest grasp success (66.3% vs. 46.6%), and transfers without fine-tuning to GazeHOI (45.3% vs. 33.8%). Gaze conveys the approach side: when gaze is rotated around the object, the approach turns with it in 59.1% of cases, against 20.5% for a text model retrained with clock words. On the same backbone, a text prompt names parts better, but gaze adds the approach side. Given both, GRAZE keeps the prompt's part accuracy and follows gaze.

AI.tldr: GRAZE 用录制眼动（gaze ray）替代文本提示来条件化HOI抓取动作生成，通过几何感知 gaze 编码（GeoGaze）把视线映射到物体几何线索上，并用 cross-attention 条件化 diffusion Transformer；同时提出基于HOT3D的物体不交叉基准 HOT3D-Grasp。
AI.motivation: 文本条件虽语义直观，却不适合指定"抓哪里"：命名部位需要物体专有词汇，命名接近方向需要参考系，而 prompt 无法提供。眼动天然携带空间与方向信息。
AI.method: GeoGaze 将 gaze 射线映射到物体表面几何线索（射线与网格/点云求交得到的命中点、法向、局部坐标系等），再以 cross-attention 把这些线索注入 diffusion Transformer 主干（与文本条件共享同一 backbone）。构建 HOT3D-Grasp 基准，按物体划分（object-disjoint）折以评估跨物体泛化。
AI.result: 未见物体上：命中目标部位率 49.3% vs 最强文本基线 43.6%；抓取成功率 66.3% vs 46.6%；零微调迁移到 GazeHOI 达 45.3% vs 33.8%。视线绕物体旋转时接近方向随之改变的比例 59.1%，时钟词重训文本模型仅 20.5%。文本在"命名部位"上更优，gaze 补充"接近方向"；二者同时给定时可保持文本的部位精度并跟随 gaze。
AI.conclusion: gaze 是文本条件的有力补充/替代模态，可表达文本难以描述的空间-方向意图；gaze 与文本互补，融合可兼顾语义精度与空间可控性。主要局限在于依赖录制眼动输入（非纯 prompt 端到端控制），且眼动获取在真实机器人上需额外硬件。

title: CivilBench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Information Integration in Civil Engineering
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support. However, the extent to which current VLMs possess the reasoning capabilities required for reliable engineering judgments remains unclear. In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios. CivilBench covers three major task families: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, encompassing numerical reasoning, structural damage assessment, risk inference, causal analysis, and repair planning. The benchmark is constructed through a systematic pipeline of domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, expert annotation, question design, and quality verification. Evaluation of representative state-of-the-art VLMs reveals substantial limitations in domain-specific reasoning, with Sequential Reasoning emerging as a major bottleneck, particularly when models must infer numerical relationships from sparse structured observations. Further experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can alleviate these limitations, although their effectiveness depends on the model's ability to reliably interpret and use the available evidence. CivilBench provides a capability-oriented testbed for identifying reasoning limitations and evaluating progress toward reliable AI-assisted engineering decision-making. The benchmark will be publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 CivilBench 基准，系统评测视觉语言模型（VLM）在土木与灾害工程场景中的推理能力，涵盖序列推理、图像结构理解与开放世界理解三大任务族。
AI.motivation: LLM/VLM 已大量用于灾害评估、结构分析与工程决策支持，但这些模型是否具备可靠工程判断所需的推理能力尚不清楚，缺少能力导向的系统评测手段。
AI.method: 构建领域数据收集、工程化描述生成、专家标注、题目设计与质量校验的流水线，形成覆盖数值推理、结构损伤评估、风险推断、因果分析与修复规划的多任务基准；对代表性 SOTA VLM 进行评测，并考察数值先验与外部知识的干预效果。
AI.result: 现有 VLM 在领域特定推理上存在明显不足，序列推理为主要瓶颈，尤其难以从稀疏结构化观测中推断数值关系；数值先验与外部知识可缓解但不根本解决，效果依赖模型对证据的可靠解读。
AI.conclusion: CivilBench 提供了面向能力维度的测试平台，用于定位 VLM 工程推理短板并衡量向可靠 AI 辅助工程决策的进展；基准将公开。

title: Source-Free Domain Adaptation for Multi-Label Image Classification: A Framework, Baselines, and Benchmark
summary: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a model trained on a labelled source domain to an unlabelled target domain without access to the source data. Almost the entire SFDA literature assumes mutually exclusive classes, yet many deployed settings are multi-label. This paper formulates SFDA for multi-label classification and establishes the first benchmark for it: five adaptation tasks over six datasets spanning remote sensing, natural, clipart-style and driving imagery, with four single-label SFDA methods extended to provide the first baselines and a published multi-label method run alongside them, over three seeds. The benchmark shows that extending a single-label method is unreliable rather than merely suboptimal: half of the extended baselines fail to improve on the unadapted source model at all, and on two of the five tasks none of them does. The failures are not incidental. Nearest-centroid pseudo-labelling, softmax-based confidence, the diversity term of information maximization and confidence-weighted prototype construction each rely on mutual exclusivity, and each fails differently without it, so replacing the softmax with per-class sigmoids is a valid but insufficient extension. Multi-label Prototype Alignment with Contrastive Teaching (MPACT) is proposed in response, a mean-teacher framework whose objective, prototype construction and alignment term are each reconsidered for overlapping label sets. It attains the best average on every reported metric and is the only method that improves on the unadapted source model on all five tasks. The analysis further introduces a prototype-agreement diagnostic separating feature-space alignment from self-reinforcing agreement with the classifier, and reports a negative result for confidence-based pseudo-label filtering.

AI.tldr: 提出多标签源自由域适应(SFDA)问题并建立首个基准:5个任务/6数据集,扩展4个单标签方法;指出softmax互斥假设导致多数扩展失败,提出MPACT(均值教师+原型对齐+对比教学)。
AI.motivation: 现有SFDA文献几乎全部假设类别互斥,而实际部署场景多为多标签;直接将单标签方法扩展到多标签不可靠,需系统诊断失效原因并给出针对性方法。
AI.method: 构建首个多标签SFDA基准(遥感、自然、clipart、驾驶图像,4个单标签SFDA方法扩展基线+1个已发表多标签方法,3个随机种子);分析最近质心伪标签、softmax置信度、信息最大化多样性项、置信度加权原型构造在重叠标签下的分别失效模式;提出MPACT——均值教师框架,重新设计目标函数、原型构造与对齐项,并引入原型一致性诊断区分特征空间对齐与分类器自强化一致。
AI.result: 一半扩展基线相对未适应源模型无提升,5个任务中2个任务全部基线均无提升;MPACT在所有报告指标上取得最佳平均,且是唯一在全部5个任务上均优于未适应源模型的方法;置信度伪标签过滤呈负面结果。
AI.conclusion: 多标签SFDA不是单标签方法的简单替换(如sigmoid替代softmax),需在目标、原型与对齐层面重新设计;基准与诊断工具为后续研究提供可靠评价基础。

title: VAE Rhythm: Temporal Decoding Traces for AI-Generated Video Detection
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Visible artifacts are an unreliable cue for detecting generated videos, because newer generators learn to remove them. We instead detect a trace left by the generation pipeline itself. Most video generators decode latents with a 3D causal VAE that groups consecutive frames in time, so the fidelity of generated frames rises and falls periodically with their position in a group. We call this periodic trace VAE Rhythm. Real videos are captured frame by frame and do not have it. To reveal it without training, we propose a phase scan. The scan reconstructs a clip with an off-the-shelf VAE from successive start offsets and measures the periodicity of the reconstruction error across these offsets. We find VAE Rhythm in most of the 39 variants of 31 generators we test, including the closed-source Sora, Kling 3.0 and Seedance 2.0. We use the rhythm as a zero-shot score, as a plug-in for existing detectors and as a data engine that pairs real videos with their VAE reconstructions to train our detector CaDet. On DF26, the training-free rhythm score outperforms all 15 retrained baselines, and as a plug-in it improves all 19 tested detectors by 6.7% to 23.7% AUROC. CaDet achieves the best AUROC on AIGVDBench, DF26 and three 2026 closed-source models, and its variant trained without any generated video still exceeds 90% on AIGVDBench.

AI.tldr: 提出"VAE Rhythm"：3D因果VAE按时间分组解码使生成帧保真度随组内位置周期性涨落，可用免训练相位扫描检出，并训练出检测器CaDet。
AI.motivation: 视觉伪影会随生成器升级被消除，不可靠；需要抓住生成管线固有的、难以去除的痕迹。
AI.method: 相位扫描：用现成VAE以不同起始偏移重建片段，度量重建误差随偏移的周期性；将节奏作为零样本分数、现有检测器的插件，以及配对真实视频与VAE重建的数据引擎训练CaDet。
AI.result: 在31个生成器的39个变体中多数检出该节奏（含Sora、Kling 3.0、Seedance 2.0）；DF26上免训练分数优于15个重训基线，插件使19个检测器AUROC提升6.7%–23.7%；CaDet在AIGVDBench、DF26及三个2026闭源模型上AUROC最佳。
AI.conclusion: 生成管线的周期性重建痕迹是比视觉伪影更稳健的取证线索，且可零样本迁移与复用。

title: ReuseMem: One Memory, Multiple Goals in Robot Manipulation
summary: Robots that work alongside people should be able to use what they have seen when new requests arise. The same experience may later support identifying an object or returning it to its original location, although these uses were unknown during observation. ReuseMem learns to use one visual memory for multiple later manipulation goals. It records visual features independently of future goals, retrieves complementary evidence for each request, and combines it with the current scene through a lightweight action interface. Retrieval is supervised by how well candidate evidence supports expert-action prediction across different current states, linking memory selection to its use in manipulation. Repeated visual features are stored once, and memory computations that remain unchanged during action generation are reused. Experiments on four simulation tasks and two physical scenarios demonstrate reuse of a common recording across different requests. With matched action adaptation, ReuseMem improves joint goal completion on the benchmark tasks by 24.5 percentage points over uniform memory. These findings show that one memory can support multiple later manipulation goals as the scene changes.

AI.tldr: ReuseMem: 单一视觉记忆学习多用途检索，支持多种后续操作目标，联合完成率较uniform memory提升24.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 机器人观测时所记录的信息其后续用途未知（可能是物体识别、也可能是回到原位），现有方法通常为特定任务构建记忆，难以在场景变化下复用同一份经验。
AI.method: 目标无关地记录视觉特征，单次存储重复特征、复用动作生成中不变的内存计算；针对每个请求检索互补证据，经轻量动作接口与当前场景融合；检索模块以候选证据对专家动作预测的支持度进行监督，从而把记忆选择与操作使用绑定。
AI.result: 四个仿真任务与两个物理场景验证了跨请求复用同一记录；动作适配对齐时，基准任务联合目标完成率比uniform memory提升24.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 一份记忆可在场景变化中支持多个后续操作目标，记忆检索应以其对操作的贡献为监督信号。

title: IGRecon4D: Dynamic-Object-Aware Feed-Forward Reconstruction of Driving Scenes
summary: Feed-forward 4D driving-scene reconstruction enables efficient modeling of dynamic autonomous-driving scenes, but current methods suffer from two complementary failure modes: semantic leakage of traffic participants into the static representation and geometric drift of Gaussian locations across viewpoints. We propose \textbf{IGRecon4D}, a feed-forward dynamic scene reconstruction framework that addresses these failures with training-time instance-prior distillation and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning. Specifically, an instance-level semantic branch provides a potentially dynamic participant prior, which is distilled into dynamic-mask learning through the Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint to encourage high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions prone to dynamic-static leakage. In parallel, sparse LiDAR measurements guide dense depth estimation, and the resulting depths are back-projected to anchor Gaussian positions for improved multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger traffic-participant-region reconstruction under cross-dataset evaluation.

AI.tldr: IGRecon4D：前馈4D驾驶场景重建框架，用实例先验蒸馏+LiDAR锚定高斯定位，解决动静态语义泄漏与多视角几何漂移。
AI.motivation: 前馈式动态驾驶场景重建存在两个互补失效模式：(1) 交通参与者语义泄漏进静态表示；(2) 高斯位置跨视角几何漂移。需同时解决语义解耦与几何一致性。
AI.method: 实例级语义分支提供"潜在动态参与者"先验，通过 Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint 蒸馏进动态掩码学习，提升交通参与者区域高召回定位；并行地，稀疏LiDAR监督稠密深度估计，深度反投影以锚定高斯位置，改善多视角几何一致性。整体为训练期先验蒸馏+LiDAR锚定，推理保持前馈。
AI.result: Waymo Open Dataset 上全图重建提升；nuScenes 零样本跨数据集评估中交通参与者区域重建更强。
AI.conclusion: 实例先验蒸馏与LiDAR深度锚定可有效缓解语义泄漏与几何漂移，且具备跨数据集的零样本泛化能力；属于前馈4D重建的增量改进。

title: Linglong Agent Service: A Runtime for Centralized Agent Reasoning and Distributed Execution
summary: LLM agents can use remote tools and cloud sandboxes, but integrating reasoning, session state, and heterogeneous execution sites remains a runtime design problem. We present Linglong Agent Service (agentsvc), a self-hosted HTTP service and embeddable Python runtime that treats execution site as a configurable dimension alongside model, tools, and context. A parent service retains inference orchestration, tool descriptions, and conversation history; each inference request selects one child environment for file, shell, terminal, and MCP operations. Direct HTTP and child-initiated WebSocket tunnels carry the same application interfaces, including portable request context and centrally managed updates. The normal core path requires no third-party Python packages, with an optional Windows pseudo-terminal dependency. We further present online_debugger as the process-scale special case of execution-site separation: an instrumented program submits exception evidence, executes session-scoped inspection tools inside the incident process, and resumes the same diagnostic session. Its default prompt requires failing-then-passing reproduction evidence for source changes, while runtime patch activation and failed-call recovery remain unimplemented. We explain the design through constrained expected-utility reasoning, compare concrete mechanisms with Hermes Agent, Pi, Codex, and Claude Code, and report implementation and regression-test evidence. The current evidence establishes executable contracts, not performance advantages, repair accuracy, or production recovery. The source code is open source under the MIT license at this https URL .

AI.tldr: agentsvc：自托管HTTP服务+可嵌入Python运行时，将"执行站点"（本地/云沙箱/隧道）作为与模型、工具、上下文并列的可配置维度；另提出online_debugger作为进程级特例，在事故进程内执行会话级检查工具并续接受损会话。
AI.motivation: LLM agent虽可使用远程工具与云沙箱，但推理编排、会话状态与异构执行站点之间的集成仍是运行时设计难题；缺少统一的执行站点抽象，也缺少在故障进程内进行诊断与恢复的机制。
AI.method: （1）父服务保留推理编排、工具描述与对话历史，每次推理请求选择一个子环境执行文件/Shell/终端/MCP操作；直接HTTP与子端发起的WebSocket隧道承载同一应用接口，支持可移植请求上下文与集中式更新；核心路径零第三方Python依赖（Windows PTY为可选依赖）。（2）online_debugger：被插桩程序提交异常证据，在事故进程内执行会话级检查工具，并可恢复同一诊断会话；默认提示要求源码修改前提供"失败→通过"的复现证据。设计论证基于受限期望效用推理，并与Hermes Agent、Pi、Codex、Claude Code做机制对比。
AI.result: 给出可执行契约与回归测试证据；运行时补丁激活与失败调用恢复尚未实现；作者明确当前证据只确立接口契约，而非性能优势、修复准确率或生产级恢复能力。代码以MIT协议开源。
AI.conclusion: 将"执行站点"提升为一等可配置维度的agent运行时设计是可行的，进程内诊断可作为其特例化实例；但缺少定量评测，实用价值与性能收益有待验证。

title: How to Explain your Unexplainable Video Anomaly Detector
comment: This paper has been accepted at the RWS workshop WACV 2027
summary: Weakly-supervised Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) models assign anomaly scores from high-dimensional features, and their predictions remain unexplained. Saliency maps show where a model looks but not what it relies on, and the descriptions produced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are generated by branches that the anomaly score never reads. To address this faithfulness gap, we propose \textbf{Explain The Unexplainable (ETU)}, a classifier-agnostic framework that audits frozen VAD models through counterfactual interventions in their feature space. ETU maps video features to a discrete dependency graph of agents, actions and outcomes ($A_r \to A_a \to A_o$), regenerates the features by graph-conditioned diffusion with selected nodes of the graph masked, and measures the change in the score of a frozen detector; one set of interventions is applied unchanged to every detector. The generator is trained only to reconstruct the input features, so it cannot learn the contrast it is asked to measure, and we validate the audit with experiments that test every alternative explanation of its results, from the cost of regeneration to random deletions of matched size. On UCF-Crime features obtained from a CLIP encoder, we show that substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, and that removing the outcome chain of the graph ($\Delta_{rel}$) changes the anomaly score of all six audited detectors far more than removing the same number of random nodes, even though the random deletion perturbs the features about as much. We show that this targeted behavior comes from the divergence objective of the graph embedding. Without it, the two interventions become indistinguishable, and with a divergence objective in the generator as well, the score change of the detector follows the displacement of the reconstruction rather than the semantics that were removed.

AI.tldr: ETU：用图条件扩散做反事实干预，审计冻结的弱监督视频异常检测模型，证明其依赖(A_r→A_a→A_o)图中的结果链语义。
AI.motivation: 弱监督VAD的异常分数来自高维特征，预测不可解释；显著性图只显示"看哪里"而非"依赖什么"，VLM描述由异常分数从不读取的分支生成，存在忠实性（faithfulness）缺口。
AI.method: 提出分类器无关的ETU框架：将视频特征映射为agent/action/outcome的离散依赖图，用图条件扩散在掩码节点下重生成特征，测量冻结检测器分数变化；生成器仅训练重建、故无法学习被测量的对比；同一组干预对所有检测器通用；用重新生成代价、等量随机删除等对照实验剔除替代解释。
AI.result: UCF-Crime（CLIP特征）上，替换场景语义使多数检测器分数降幅最大；移除结果链(Δ_rel)引起全部六个检测器的分数变化远大于等量随机删点，尽管后者对特征扰动幅度相当；图嵌入中的散度目标决定该行为——去掉则该效应消失，把散度目标也加到生成器中，检测器分数变化转而跟随重建位移而非被移除的语义。
AI.conclusion: 反事实图干预可给出忠实、跨检测器可迁移的VAD解释；散度目标是把语义依赖与重建伪影解耦的关键。

title: Region-VAD: Video Anomaly Localization and Detection via Region Selection
comment: This paper has been accepted in the RWS workshop at WACV 2027
summary: Anomalies are local events, yet weakly supervised video anomaly detection scores them globally. Most methods pool an entire frame into a single vector, rank frames by that vector, and derive a location afterwards as a saliency map of the score. Full-frame pooling mixes the anomaly with its background, so a detector can reach competitive benchmark scores from scene context without being able to show where in the scene the anomaly occurs. We introduce Region-VAD, which first selects a region and then detects the anomaly from that region alone. Region-VAD selects an explicit rectangle over the tokens of a frozen foundation model and scores anomalousness only from the tokens inside the box, through attention pooling followed by a standard temporal head. The rectangle is not learned, it is the box in which the frozen tokens change most between consecutive segments, in all four feature projections of the encoder, and it is found by exhaustive search over the rectangles of the token grid. Only the pooling and the temporal head are trained, from video-level labels without boxes, masks or frame-level annotations, and no trained component reads a token outside the selected region. Experiments on five datasets, with one localizer configuration shared by all datasets and backbones, show that Region-VAD achieves state-of-the-art anomaly localization on UCF-Crime and MSAD at competitive detection performance.

AI.tldr: Region-VAD 先选区域再检测：在冻结基础模型的 token 网格上穷举搜索相邻片段特征变化最大的矩形框，仅用框内 token 做注意力池化与时间头评分，实现弱监督视频异常检测与定位。
AI.motivation: 异常是局部事件，但现有弱监督视频异常检测（VAD）在全帧池化成单一向量后按帧排序，再用显著性图反推位置。全帧池化会把异常与其背景混合，使检测器可仅凭场景上下文取得不错的基准分数，却无法指出异常发生的位置，即检测与定位脱耦。
AI.method: 基于冻结基础模型的 token 特征，在 token 网格上穷举矩形，选取在四个编码器投影中相邻片段间 token 变化最大的框作为区域；该框不由学习得到。仅训练注意力池化与标准时间头，只用视频级标签，无需框、掩码或帧级标注，且所有可训练组件不读取选区外的 token。
AI.result: 五个数据集的实验表明，单一定位器配置（跨数据集与骨干共享）下，Region-VAD 在 UCF-Crime 与 MSAD 上取得最优异常定位性能，检测性能具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将"先定位区域、后评分"显式化可消除全帧池化带来的上下文捷径，在弱监督设定下同时提升定位质量与检测表现，且方法通用、轻量。

title: Scribble Once, Segment the Sequence: Bidirectional Temporal Consistency for Weakly Supervised Segmentation in Echocardiography Sequences
summary: Temporal medical image segmentation relies on pixel-wise annotations, which are prohibitively expensive for long image sequences. Existing weakly-supervised methods reduce the annotation burden per frame but still require repeated annotations across the sequence. Furthermore, sparse supervision can result in temporally unstable representations. Addressing both challenges requires a model that can leverage strong spatial priors from large-scale pretraining while minimizing reliance on dense annotations. Frozen 2D vision foundation models provide a promising basis for this by offering transferable spatial representations with low trainable parameters. However, their lack of explicit temporal modeling limits their ability to propagate reliable information across anatomical sequences. To address this, we present a weakly-supervised framework for temporal segmentation from a single scribble-annotated frame, with all remaining frames left unlabeled. The framework combines parameter-efficient adaptation of DINOv3 encoders present in the mean-teacher architecture. Furthermore, a set of complementary losses, including a temporal loss helps generate reliable segmentation priors for the unlabeled frames. This formulation decouples annotation costs from sequence length while retaining the transferable spatial knowledge of the pretrained encoder. Extensive experiments on the publicly available CAMUS and CardiacNet datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms other scribble-supervised methods. These results show that accurate and temporally consistent segmentation can be achieved from extremely sparse supervision, substantially reducing annotation requirements for temporal echocardiographic segmentation and providing a practical framework for scalable clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出基于DINOv3冻结编码器参数高效适配的弱监督时序医学图像分割框架，仅用单帧涂鸦标注即可完成整段序列分割。
AI.motivation: 时序医学图像分割依赖逐像素标注，长序列标注成本极高；现有弱监督方法仍需多帧重复标注，且稀疏监督导致时序表示不稳定。需同时利用大规模预训练的空间先验并摆脱稠密标注依赖。
AI.method: 在mean-teacher架构中对2D视觉基础模型DINOv3编码器做参数高效适配（frozen backbone + PEFT），仅给定一帧scribble标注，其余帧无标签；设计一组互补损失（含时序一致性损失）在无标注帧上生成可靠的伪标签先验；将标注成本与序列长度解耦。
AI.result: 在公开CAMUS与CardiacNet数据集上优于其他scribble监督方法，在极稀疏监督下获得准确且时序一致的分割结果。
AI.conclusion: 验证了冻结2D基础模型+轻量适配+时序伪标签可替代稠密逐帧标注，显著降低时序超声心动图分割的标注需求，具备临床可扩展性；但方法本身面向医学影像域，未涉及通用视觉/机器人或3D重建任务。

title: WinDEX: Metric 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild for Dexterous Teleoperation and Policy Learning
summary: Human manipulation data are widely used to train robots for human-like dexterity. However, low-cost, large-scale collection in the wild remains challenging. Existing methods remain limited in geometrically grounded metric-scale reconstruction, real-world generalization and inference speed. We present WinDEX, integrating (1) geometric-temporal optimization for metric 3D hand annotation from in-the-wild egocentric stereo videos, combined with visual-inertial SLAM for world-frame reconstruction; (2) WinDEX-Net, an end-to-end, fisheye-native network combining calibrated stereo, local detail and temporal context, with a data-model flywheel of model-assisted annotation and retraining; (3) distilled models for offline reconstruction and causal streaming, supporting reinforcement learning and teleoperation; and (4) low-cost CyberCap stereo-inertial capture, forming the WinDEX-Hand dataset with 1,000 hours of training annotations and held-out human-annotated in-the-wild 2D and independent optical motion-capture evaluation sets. Offline reconstruction runs at 43.61 FPS and causal streaming at 171 FPS. On held-out data, offline reconstruction achieves state-of-the-art accuracy: 14.5 pixels in-the-wild reprojection error and, with visual-inertial odometry, 37.29 mm world-frame joint error. We achieve 7.6 and 3.6 times the task success rates of reinforcement learning policies trained with WiLoR and HaWoR motion references, respectively, and demonstrate real-time arm-hand teleoperation. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: WinDEX：基于第一人称立体视觉+惯性SLAM的野外手部操作数据采集与度量级重建系统，含WinDEX-Net端到端鱼眼网络、蒸馏因果流式模型、低成本CyberCap硬件与1000小时WinDEX-Hand数据集；离线43.61 FPS、因果流式171 FPS，野外重投影误差14.5 px、世界系关节误差37.29 mm。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习人类灵巧操作需大规模野外人手数据，但低成本采集难；现有方法在度量尺度几何重建、真实泛化与推理速度上均受限。
AI.method: (1) 几何-时序优化做度量3D手部标注，结合视觉-惯性SLAM获取世界系位姿；(2) WinDEX-Net 鱼眼原生端到端网络，融合标定立体、局部细节与时间上下文，配模型辅助标注-重训练数据飞轮；(3) 蒸馏模型支持离线重建与因果流式，服务RL与遥操作；(4) 低成本CyberCap立体-惯性采集硬件。
AI.result: 离线43.61 FPS、因果流式171 FPS；野外重投影误差14.5 px，结合VIO世界系关节误差37.29 mm，达SOTA；RL策略任务成功率较WiLoR、HaWoR参考分别提升7.6倍与3.6倍；实现实时臂-手遥操作。
AI.conclusion: 构建了从采集硬件、标注优化、端到端网络到流式蒸馏与RL/遥操作应用的完整数据-模型闭环，证明野外规模化人手操作数据可支撑灵巧操作学习。

title: Model-based neural network for global floodplains analysis
summary: We address the super-resolution of multispectral remote sensing imagery for long-term floodplain monitoring, enhancing Landsat acquisitions towards Sentinel-2 resolution. Exploiting the period during which both missions observed the same areas, we build DLhasa-L2S , to our knowledge the first paired dataset dedicated to multispectral super-resolution for river analysis. It covers the Lhasa River (Tibet), whose strong anthropogenic changes and diverse hydromorphological profiles make it an ideal study area. We developed two model-based neural networks: a forward-backward (FB) plug-and-play scheme and an unfolded FB scheme. We compared them against learned neural networks baselines (SwinIR, RDN) on synthetic data, on real scenes, and through a statistical test over the whole real paired Landsat-Sentinel dataset. The unfolded network achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM on the real RGB components with fast inference, offering the best trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. For NDWI-based water segmentation, its performance shows no statistically significant difference from that of the best methods.

AI.tldr: 构建首个多光谱遥感超分配对数据集 DLhasa-L2S（Landsat→Sentinel-2，拉萨河），提出前向-后向即插即用与展开式两种模型驱动网络，并在合成/真实数据及统计检验下与 SwinIR、RDN 对比。
AI.motivation: 长期洪泛平原监测需要统一分辨率的多时相影像，Landsat 与 Sentinel-2 分辨率不匹配阻碍河流形态分析；同时缺乏针对河流分析的多光谱超分配对基准。
AI.method: 利用两任务同期重叠观测构建配对数据集；以遥感成像退化模型为基础，设计前向-后向 plug-and-play 方案与展开式（unfolded）网络两种模型驱动方法；对比学习型基线 SwinIR、RDN，在合成数据、真实场景及全量真实配对集上做统计显著性检验。
AI.result: 展开式网络在真实 RGB 波段取得最高 PSNR/SSIM 且推理速度快，精度-算力折中最优；基于 NDWI 的水体分割性能与最佳方法无统计显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 模型驱动展开网络可作为 Landsat→Sentinel-2 多光谱超分的实用方案，DLhasa-L2S 为该方向提供可复现配对基准。

title: DRaGAN: Dynamic Graph Attention Network for Multi-Radar Point Cloud Encoding in Automotive Radar Perception
comment: Accepted to 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)
summary: Radar represents a key modality for weather-robust perception. Unlike optical sensors such as camera and LiDAR, radar can penetrate fog, rain and snow due to its longer wavelength, and recent hardware advances have steadily improved its spatial resolution, thus making it increasingly relevant for autonomous systems. While processing raw radar data requires substantial memory computation, most existing work has focused on preprocessed point-cloud data similar to LiDAR. However, the sparse radar points and sensor-relative anisotropy make LiDAR-oriented encoders suboptimal. To address this problem, we present DRaGAN, a dynamic graph attention network for multi-radar point clouds. DRaGAN introduces a sensor-relative Fourier encoding of angle and range to capture fixed-aperture radar characteristics, gated short- and long-range hub nodes along each sensor's line of sight for efficient local-global message passing, and attention-guided dynamic rewiring that prunes weak edges and adds a bounded number of latent connections restricted to two-hop neighborhoods. This reduces the number of processed edges in deeper layers while preserving representation quality. On TruckScenes, DRaGAN improves test NDS by 10.10 points over the evaluated RadarGNN baseline and reduces the reported model FLOP count by 63.7%. This trade-off includes an increase in model latency from 40 to 53.16 ms and in trainable parameters from 1.2M to 1.7M on the evaluated implementations. Code and pretrained models are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: DRaGAN：面向多雷达点云的动态图注意力网络，用传感器相对傅里叶编码、门控短/长程枢纽节点与注意力引导动态重连，提升稀疏雷达点云编码效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 雷达具备雨雾穿透能力且分辨率提升，适合全天候感知；但直接处理原始雷达数据内存与计算开销大，主流做法沿用类LiDAR点云，而雷达点稀疏且存在传感器相对各向异性，LiDAR导向的编码器并非最优。
AI.method: 构建动态图注意力网络：1）角度与距离的传感器相对傅里叶编码以刻画固定孔径雷达特性；2）沿每台雷达视线的门控短/长程枢纽节点，实现高效的局部-全局消息传递；3）注意力引导的动态重连，剪除弱边并在两跳邻域内加入有界数量的隐连接，从而在保持表征质量的同时减少深层处理的边数。
AI.result: 在TruckScenes上，测试NDS较RadarGNN基线提升10.10点，模型FLOPs降低63.7%；代价是延迟从40 ms增至53.16 ms，可训练参数从1.2M增至1.7M。
AI.conclusion: 动态图重连可在雷达点云编码中显著削减计算量并提升检测性能，适合作为雷达基线编码器；但延迟与参数略有上升，且仅在单一数据集上验证，需更多泛化与实时性评估。

title: Polygraph: Large-Scale Multi-Session Trajectory Optimization using Pose Graphs
summary: Robots, vehicles, and wearable devices often traverse the same environment many times. Each pass produces its own trajectory from onboard visual or visual-inertial odometry. These trajectories are locally accurate but drift over time and live in unrelated coordinate frames. Turning many such independent trajectories into one globally consistent set is the large-scale multi-session trajectory optimization problem. Existing solutions largely work offline. All sessions must be available up front, one session is fixed as the reference frame, and a single fused map is then optimized. This paper presents Polygraph, a multi-session trajectory optimization pipeline that processes sessions online, one keyframe and one spatial cluster at a time, and never builds a 3D map. Keyframes are grouped into local clusters. When a cluster closes, it is matched against every other session through learned image retrieval. Candidate pairs are verified with sparse feature matching, monocular metric depth, and robust pose estimation. A two-tier consensus gate admits a cross-session edge into the shared pose graph only once independent evidence corroborates it. A cheap incremental solve keeps the graph current, and a periodic robust batch solve prunes outliers. We evaluate Polygraph on stereo outdoor driving, HoloLens and iPad indoor traversals, legged indoor locomotion with a Boston Dynamics Spot, and large-scale outdoor vehicle and handheld routes. Against the closest prior work on the same GPU model, using its reported timings, Polygraph runs faster, commits fewer loop-closure edges, and matches or improves on accuracy.

AI.tldr: Polygraph：在线多会话轨迹优化流水线，按关键帧与局部簇增量处理，通过学习式图像检索+稀疏特征匹配+单目度量深度+稳健位姿估计验证跨会话回环，并以两级一致性门控、增量求解与周期鲁棒批求解实现全局一致轨迹，无需建3D地图。
AI.motivation: 机器人、车辆、可穿戴设备多次穿越同一环境，各自产生局部准确但存在漂移、坐标系互不相关（unrelated coordinate frames）的轨迹；现有大规模多会话轨迹优化方法多为离线，需预先给定全部会话并固定一个参考会话、构建单一融合地图，难以在线增量使用。
AI.method: 以关键帧局部簇为单位在线处理：簇闭合时通过学习式图像检索与所有其他会话匹配，候选对经稀疏特征匹配、单目度量深度与稳健位姿估计验证；两级共识门控仅在独立证据互相印证后接纳跨会话边进入共享位姿图；廉价增量优化保持图最新，周期性鲁棒批优化剔除离群边；全程不构建3D地图。
AI.result: 在立体室外驾驶、HoloLens与iPad室内、Boston Dynamics Spot足式室内行走、以及大规模室外车载与手持路线上评测；在与最接近的此前工作相同的GPU模型、按其报告耗时的比较下，速度更快、提交的回环边更少、精度持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种无需建图、可在线增量的多会话轨迹优化方案，通过检索-验证-门控-两级求解的流水线实现跨会话全局一致性，在多种平台与场景中验证了效率与精度优势。

title: Beyond Token Stacking: Multi-scale Visual Modulation and Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration for MLLMs
summary: Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly and follow two main paradigms: one involves concatenating visual and textual tokens for input into Large Language Model (LLM), while the other injects visual knowledge into Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) of the LLM. However, the former introduces a large number of redundant visual tokens, substantially increasing computational overhead. The latter reduces sequence length but removes images from the input stage entirely, which may hinder the activation of image-related knowledge. Moreover, naively injecting visual knowledge into the FFNs could induce activation distribution shifts due to cross-modal semantic discrepancies. To address these challenges, we develop Beyond Token Stacking (BTS), a novel visual enhancement framework for MLLMs. Specifically, we propose a Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) mechanism that injects multi-scale visual information at the input stage via modulation without increasing the token sequence length. Furthermore, we develop an Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) module that performs per-channel affine calibration to decouple visual injection from distribution alignment in the FFN layers, improving multimodal fusion stability while preserving language priors. Experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: BTS：在MLLM输入阶段用多尺度视觉调制（MVM）注入视觉信息而不增加token长度，并在FFN层用自适应融合特征校准（AFC）做逐通道仿射校准以解耦视觉注入与分布对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM两条范式各有缺陷：视觉token拼接引入大量冗余token、计算开销大；将视觉知识注入FFN虽缩短序列但移除了输入阶段的图像，可能阻碍图像相关知识激活，且朴素注入会因跨模态语义差异引发激活分布偏移。
AI.method: 提出BTS视觉增强框架：(1) MVM机制在多尺度上通过调制方式在输入阶段注入视觉信息，不增加token序列长度；(2) AFC模块在FFN层执行逐通道仿射校准，使视觉注入与分布对齐解耦，提升多模态融合稳定性并保留语言先验。
AI.result: 摘要仅声称取得state-of-the-art性能，未给出具体基准、指标数值或消融结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过输入阶段多尺度调制加FFN逐通道校准的组合，BTS在效率与多模态融合稳定性之间取得折中，但仍属通用MLLM架构改进，缺乏具体实证细节与机器人/3D相关证据。

title: RAGE: Residual-Adaptive Gating for Flow-Based Image Editing
summary: Recent inversion-free, flow-based image editing methods evolve the source image toward the target via a differential velocity field. We observe that this velocity field does not explicitly account for which regions should be preserved, leading to unintended drift in non-editing regions. To address this, we formulate source fidelity control as a stochastic optimal control problem in which a selective fidelity term on the editing residual is enforced along the editing trajectory. Solving this problem and approximating its solution yields the Residual Gating Principle: each latent component is pulled back toward the source with a gain that decays exponentially with the local residual magnitude, so that small deviations are suppressed while large, semantically meaningful edits pass through unimpeded. The proposed method, RAGE, requires only one lightweight gated interpolation per sampling step, involves no mask estimation, attention maps, retraining, or architecture-specific modifications, and is applied on top of FlowEdit-based editors. On PIE-Bench, RAGE achieves the best overall rank among 17 methods and substantially improves background preservation on both Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX backbones while maintaining competitive editing quality.

AI.tldr: RAGE将免反演的流式图像编辑中的源图像保真问题建模为随机最优控制，导出“残差门控原理”：每个隐分量以随局部残差幅值指数衰减的增益被拉回源图，从而抑制非编辑区域漂移、放行语义编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有 inversion-free 微分速度场编辑未显式约束哪些区域应保持，导致非编辑区域出现非预期漂移（背景失真）。
AI.method: 把源保真控制形式化为随机最优控制问题，在编辑轨迹上对编辑残差施加选择性保真项；求解并近似得到 Residual Gating Principle，即每采样步只需一次轻量门控插值，无需掩码估计、注意力图、重训练或架构修改，可直接叠加于 FlowEdit 类编辑器（SD3、FLUX）。
AI.result: PIE-Bench 上 17 种方法中综合排名第一，SD3 与 FLUX 骨干上背景保持显著提升，同时编辑质量保持竞争水平。
AI.conclusion: 以控制论视角将保真约束显式写入编辑轨迹，提供无需额外监督或架构改动的即插即用方案，可推广至其他基于速度场的生成编辑流程。

title: Cooperative Mobile Manipulation using Learned Dynamical Systems
summary: Cooperative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate their motions while ensuring whole-body collision avoidance and preserving task-relevant behaviors. We propose CALDS (Cooperative Adaptation of Learned Dynamical Systems), a framework that enables mobile manipulators to adapt learned single-agent behaviors for coordinated execution. Building on individual dynamical systems (DSs) learned from demonstrations, CALDS enables cooperative adaptation through two key components: Cooperative Policy Selection, which identifies compatible combinations of learned policies, and Temporal Adaptation, which ensures collision-free cooperation while preserving the spatial structure and convergence properties of the original behaviors. We evaluate CALDS across three diverse scenarios: assistive dressing, restaurant cleaning and serving, and drawer opening and object placement. Quantitative results demonstrate its effectiveness in improving task success and enabling safe, coordinated simultaneous execution while maintaining fidelity to demonstrated behaviors.

AI.tldr: CALDS：基于示教学习得到的单智能体动力学系统，通过协作策略选择与时间自适应，实现移动机械臂协作执行中的无碰协调。
AI.motivation: 协作移动操作需同时满足多机器人运动协调、全身碰撞避免与保持任务相关行为，直接复用单体示教策略难以协调，而重新学习多智能体策略成本高且易丢失示教行为特性。
AI.method: 以单体示教学习的动力系统（DS）为基础，提出两组件框架：(1) 协作策略选择——从已学策略池中筛选可兼容组合；(2) 时间自适应——在不改变原DS空间结构与收敛性的前提下施加时间调制，实现无碰同时执行。
AI.result: 在辅助穿衣、餐厅清洁与服务、开抽屉并放置物体三类场景中评估，定量指标显示任务成功率提升，并能安全地并行协作执行，同时保持对示教行为的保真度。
AI.conclusion: 示教学习的DS可被低成本地"组合+时间调制"为多机协作策略，兼顾安全性、成功率与行为保真，为移动操作协作提供了模块化复用范式。

title: BoBDeLaN: Bounded-Bandwidth Context Adaptation for Deep Lagrangian Robot Control
comment: Submitted to the 9th Annual Learning for Dynamics & Control Conference (L4DC 2027)
summary: Learned physics-based models provide structure for robot control, but uncertain payloads and unmodeled dynamics limit their predictive accuracy. Context-aware Deep Lagrangian Networks enable adaptation through a latent context inferred from measurement histories while retaining Lagrangian structure for each fixed context. However, this structure alone does not constrain sensitivity to measurement disturbances. We introduce BoBDeLaN, which combines a contracting, gain-bounded Recurrent Equilibrium Network context encoder with stable linear filtering to shape disturbance sensitivity across frequencies. This architecture guarantees exponential forgetting of the recurrent initialization and admits a finite-horizon, frequency-weighted bound on context perturbations, which extends to residual torque prediction under a Lipschitz continuity assumption on the context-conditioned dynamics model. We evaluate a low-pass realization within model predictive control on simulated and real hardware manipulation tasks, together with frequency-sensitivity analysis on real-robot data. Compared with an LSTM encoder using the same input filter, BoBDeLaN exhibits reduced high-frequency context sensitivity, lower residual torque prediction error, and smoother motion, with less degradation under injected disturbances.

AI.tldr: BoBDeLaN将收缩型、增益有界的循环平衡网络（REN）上下文编码器与稳定线性滤波相结合，嵌入上下文感知的Deep Lagrangian Network，实现对测量扰动的频率相关敏感性整形，并在MPC下完成仿真与真机实验验证。
AI.motivation: Context-aware DeLaN虽能通过隐上下文适应未知负载与未建模动力学，但拉格朗日结构本身不约束对测量扰动的敏感性，导致上下文估计易受高频噪声影响、残差力矩预测精度下降。
AI.method: 用收缩且增益有界的REN作为上下文编码器，保证对循环初始化的指数遗忘；配合稳定线性滤波器（低通实现）在频域上塑形扰动敏感性；给出有限时域、频率加权的上下文扰动界，并在上下文条件动力学模型Lipschitz假设下推广到残差力矩预测误差界；在MPC中部署低通实现，于仿真与真实机械臂操作任务及真机数据频率敏感性分析中评估。
AI.result: 相比使用相同输入滤波的LSTM编码器，BoBDeLaN高频上下文敏感性更低、残差力矩预测误差更小、运动更平滑，在注入扰动下性能退化更轻。
AI.conclusion: 在保持物理结构先验的同时显式设计扰动敏感性的频域特性，是提升学习型物理模型在真实机器人控制中鲁棒性的有效途径；收缩REN+稳定滤波提供了可证明的稳定性与误差界。

title: Oriented Semi-DETR for Semi-Supervised Aerial Object Detection
