summary: Semi-supervised object detection has recently been extended to DETR, where oriented boxes introduce an ambiguity that does not arise for axis-aligned boxes: the map from parameters to rectangles is two-to-one, since $(c_x,c_y,w,h,\theta)$ and $(c_x,c_y,h,w,\theta+\pi/2)$ denote the same rotated rectangle. Losses and matching costs are computed from the parameters, so two boxes that coincide in space can be far apart in the metric that drives training. A correctly localized student box is then penalized by the regression loss, and the inflated matching cost leads the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) filter to discard it. We propose Oriented Semi-DETR, which removes this ambiguity wherever a pseudo box enters training. Swap-aligned Target Selection regresses towards the encoding closer to the student prediction. A Swap-invariant Reliability Cost minimizes over the two encodings inside the matching cost, so the filter decides on geometry alone. Swap-aware Pseudo-label Denoising starts denoising earlier, ramps its loss weight linearly, and weights each query by the teacher score and encoding margin. All three are parameter-free and require no additional forward pass. Across all label ratios of DOTA-v2.0, Oriented Semi-DETR outperforms DETR-based supervised and semi-supervised baselines, with the largest gains at the strict IoU threshold.

AI.tldr: 指出旋转框参数到矩形是二对一映射，导致半监督DETR回归惩罚与匹配代价虚高，提出三种参数无关的交换对齐机制消除歧义。
AI.motivation: 半监督目标检测已扩展到DETR，但旋转框存在轴对齐框没有的编码歧义：$(c_x,c_y,w,h,\theta)$与$(c_x,c_y,h,w,\theta+\pi/2)$表示同一矩形。损失与匹配代价均基于参数计算，空间重合的框在驱动训练的度量下可能相距很远，造成定位正确的学生框被回归损失惩罚，虚高的匹配代价又使GMM滤波器将其丢弃。
AI.method: 提出Oriented Semi-DETR，在伪框进入训练的各环节消除歧义：Swap-aligned Target Selection向距学生预测更近的编码回归；Swap-invariant Reliability Cost在匹配代价内对两种编码取最小，使滤波仅依据几何判断；Swap-aware Pseudo-label Denoising提前启动去噪、线性斜坡损失权重，并按教师分数与编码margin加权每个query。三者均无参数、无需额外前向。
AI.result: 在DOTA-v2.0所有标签比例下优于DETR类监督与半监督基线，且在严格IoU阈值下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 旋转框编码歧义是半监督旋转DETR中被忽视的性能瓶颈，通过对偶编码感知的目标选择、匹配代价与去噪加权可零成本消除，严格定位指标受益最明显。

title: Investigating the Benefit of Transfer Learning from the Locus Coeruleus for Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta Segmentation
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027
summary: The substantia nigra pars compacta (SNpc) is a small midbrain nucleus that degenerates early in Parkinson's disease (PD). T1-weighted FLASH MRI enables its visualization and may support early detection of neurodegeneration. However, manual segmentation is difficult and time-consuming, and deep learning models often suffer from the limited availability of labeled data. Transfer learning (TL) may help by adapting pre-trained models to small datasets. We investigate whether TL from a model trained on the locus coeruleus (LC), a nucleus with a similar appearance in this sequence, improves SNpc segmentation. Several TL strategies were evaluated using a 3D U-Net. With as few as 5-14 labeled subjects, TL and training from scratch achieved similar performance, reaching a Dice similarity coefficient of up to 0.77, close to reported inter-rater agreement. No TL strategy differed significantly from training from scratch, suggesting that initialization from the LC offers no significant benefit for SNpc segmentation.

AI.tldr: 研究迁移学习（TL）能否借助在蓝斑（LC）上预训练的3D U-Net改善黑质致密部（SNpc）的T1-FLASH MRI分割，结论是TL与从零训练无显著差异。
AI.motivation: SNpc在帕金森病早期即发生退变，T1加权FLASH MRI可显示该核团，有望支持早期诊断；但人工分割困难耗时，深度学习又受标注数据稀缺限制，故尝试用外观相似核团（LC）的知识迁移缓解小样本问题。
AI.method: 以3D U-Net为骨干，在仅5–14例标注被试的小数据集上对比多种迁移学习策略（源自LC预训练模型）与从零训练（scratch）的分割性能，指标为Dice相似系数。
AI.result: 迁移学习最高Dice约0.77，接近文献报道的评审者间一致性；但各TL策略与从零训练之间均无统计学显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 从外观相似的LC核团初始化并不能为SNpc分割带来显著收益；在极小样本下，简单从零训练已足以达到相近精度，提示跨核团的TL收益有限，需另寻数据增强或自监督等小样本策略。

title: A Study on Performance Enhancement of a Webcam-Based Real-Time Eye-Tracking System
summary: This study proposes a real-time gaze-tracking system that uses a standard RGB webcam to estimate screen coordinates. The system combines ETH-XGaze-based gaze estimation with nine-point calibration and polynomial ridge regression. To reduce errors caused by changes in head position, it also applies a conditional residual correction derived from head and pose features extracted with RTMPose. Whether this correction is used depends on the reliability of the detected features and the characteristics of the calibration data. In a preliminary experiment, one participant completed trials at 12 screen targets. The resulting mean screen-coordinate error was 204.24 pixels, which was 35.83% lower than that of xgaze-js and 57.69% lower than that of gaze_tracker. The system produced valid gaze estimates for all 12 targets. These preliminary findings demonstrate the feasibility of combining user-specific calibration with conditional pose-based correction for webcam gaze tracking. Because the evaluation involved only one participant, further experiments with more participants and a wider range of postures are required.

AI.tldr: 基于ETH-XGaze的RGB网络摄像头视线估计系统，结合九点标定与多项式岭回归，并用RTMPose头部姿态特征做条件残差校正；单被试初步实验平均屏幕误差204.24像素。
AI.motivation: 普通RGB网络摄像头视线跟踪精度受头部位置变化影响大，现有开源方案（xgaze-js、gaze_tracker）误差偏高，需要更实用的低成本实时视线估计方案。
AI.method: 以ETH-XGaze预训练模型为视线估计基础，叠加九点标定与多项式岭回归做用户个性化映射；用RTMPose提取头姿特征构建残差校正项，依据特征可靠性与标定数据特性条件性启用该校正。
AI.result: 单被试12个屏幕目标实验：平均屏幕坐标误差204.24像素，较xgaze-js降低35.83%、较gaze_tracker降低57.69%，12个目标均输出有效估计。
AI.conclusion: 初步验证了"用户标定+条件姿态残差校正"在网络摄像头视线跟踪中的可行性，但仅一名被试、姿态范围有限，结论需更多被试与更广姿态条件的实验支撑。

title: QuantileGS: Quantile-Based Conformal Bounds on RGB Rendering Errors for Novel View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Uncertainty quantification for novel view synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assesses rendering reliability at unseen viewpoints. This reliability depends on the discrepancy between rendered and true colors, which cannot be measured without ground-truth images. We therefore quantify uncertainty in this unknown discrepancy through upper bounds on per-pixel RGB mean absolute error. However, learned bounds may underestimate these errors and overstate rendering reliability, motivating calibration to a prescribed coverage level. In this paper, we propose QuantileGS, a post-hoc framework that combines learned rendering-error quantiles with scale-normalized conformal calibration to produce spatially adaptive error bounds. The framework comprises three phases. Phase 1, Rendering-Error Computation, measures RGB mean absolute error between observed images and predictions from a frozen 3DGS model. Phase 2, Ordered Gaussian Quantile Fields, learns two scalar attributes per Gaussian to predict lower and upper rendering-error quantiles. Phase 3, Scale-Normalized Conformal Calibration, calibrates the upper prediction on held-out images, using the quantile gap to scale the correction. Under the stated assumptions, the resulting bounds provide finite-sample marginal coverage. At a nominal coverage level of 90%, calibration raises mean empirical test coverage from 69.6% to 89.6% on LLFF and from 80.1% to 92.1% on Mip-NeRF 360. On LF, coverage remains conservative at 96.3% before and 96.4% after calibration. Applications to active view selection, Gaussian pruning, and RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping illustrate how these bounds inform downstream decisions.

AI.tldr: QuantileGS: 一种事后框架，用有序高斯分位场学习逐像素RGB误差分位数，再用尺度归一化保形校准得到有限样本覆盖保证的空间自适应误差上界，用于3DGS新视角合成的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 3DGS新视角渲染的可靠性取决于渲染颜色与真实颜色的差异，但无真值图像时无法直接度量；学习得到的误差上界往往低估误差、过高估计可靠性，因此需要校准到指定覆盖率水平。
AI.method: 三阶段：(1) 在冻结的3DGS模型上计算观测图像与渲染图的RGB平均绝对误差；(2) Ordered Gaussian Quantile Fields，为每个高斯基元学习两个标量属性以预测误差的下、上分位数；(3) Scale-Normalized Conformal Calibration，在留出图像上校准上界预测，用分位间距缩放修正量，在给定假设下提供有限样本边缘覆盖保证。
AI.result: 名义覆盖率90%时，校准将测试集平均经验覆盖率从LLFF的69.6%提升到89.6%，Mip-NeRF 360从80.1%提升到92.1%；LF上保持保守，96.3%→96.4%。并应用于主动视角选择、高斯剪枝、RGB-D SLAM。
AI.conclusion: 将学习式误差分位数与保形校准结合，可在有限样本覆盖保证下给出空间自适应的3DGS渲染误差上界，且这些上界能有效支撑主动视角选择、剪枝与SLAM等下游决策。

title: ThinkWAM: Rethinking Latent Futures for Action Refinement
comment: 21 pages, including references and appendix. Project page: this https URL
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of future states. An initial action chunk may be flawed. A future prediction that is not conditioned on the chunk may fail to reflect the changes that the proposed actions would induce in visual representations, limiting its usefulness for refinement before execution. We introduce ThinkWAM, a latent WAM that establishes bidirectional feedback before execution through a proposal-rethink-refine loop: the policy first proposes a complete action chunk, the proposal corrects multi-horizon future latents through a learned residual, and the corrected latents are injected into a second pass of the same action head, which generates the executable chunk. An affordance-guided observation-action memory and a near-fine, far-coarse multi-horizon prediction scheme, both motivated by predictive coding, support this loop, and all prediction stays in latent space. ThinkWAM achieves 98.70% success on LIBERO, 84.76% on LIBERO-Plus without OOD fine-tuning, 85.75%/65.85% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Random, and 65.17% on RoboCasa24. ThinkWAM achieves 64.4% mean success across three real-world OOD conditions. The mean two-pass inference latency per action chunk is 153.48 ms on LIBERO, 164.61 ms on RoboTwin, and 101.2 ms on the Galaxea A1Z. Ablations show complementary gains from rethinking and affordance guidance. Diagnostics indicate that proposal-conditioned corrections change both predicted futures and action trajectories, showing that the corrected future representations improve the final action.

AI.tldr: ThinkWAM：在潜在空间构建"提议—重思—精修"双向反馈的世界-动作模型，用动作提案校正多视界未来潜变量，再回注动作头生成可执行动作块。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAM）中，动作生成与未来状态预测耦合松散：初始动作块可能有缺陷，而与动作无关的未来预测无法反映该动作将引起的视觉表征变化，因而难以在执行前用于纠正。作者希望在执行前建立动作→未来、未来→动作的双向反馈。
AI.method: ThinkWAM 为潜在世界-动作模型，采用提议-重思-精修循环：策略先输出完整动作块；该提案通过学习到的残差修正多视界未来潜变量（proposal-conditioned correction）；校正后的潜变量注入同一动作头的第二次前向，生成最终可执行动作块。辅助设计包括受预测编码启发的可供性引导观测-动作记忆，以及近细远粗（near-fine, far-coarse）的多视界预测方案；全部预测在隐空间完成，不生成像素。
AI.result: LIBERO 98.70%；LIBERO-Plus 未经 OOD 微调即 84.76%；RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Random 85.75%/65.85%；RoboCasa24 65.17%；真实世界三个 OOD 条件平均成功率 64.4%。两遍推理平均时延：LIBERO 153.48 ms、RoboTwin 164.61 ms、Galaxea A1Z 上 101.2 ms（每动作块）。消融显示重思与可供性引导增益互补；诊断表明提案条件化校正同时改变预测未来与动作轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 执行前的潜空间双向反馈（残差式未来校正 + 动作头二次前向）能在较低额外时延下显著提升操作策略的成功率与分布外鲁棒性，且泛化到真实机器人平台；可供性记忆与多视界尺度分配为有效补充组件。

title: Hybrid Optimization-Generative Motion Planning for Multiagent Affine Formations
summary: Formation maneuver control enables a multiagent system to cooperatively navigate through constrained environments in collective motion. While various formation controllers exist, they rely heavily on high-quality and dynamically feasible reference trajectories provided a priori, making formation motion planning (FMP) essential. To address the computational challenges for high-dimensional joint trajectories faced by conventional constrained optimization-based solutions, this paper introduces a hybrid optimization-generative framework with a focus on affine formations, which provide the necessary spatial flexibility. By formulating the planning task as a constrained Maximum-a-Posteriori estimation, we decouple multiagent objectives to leverage pre-trained single-agent diffusion priors for dynamic feasibility, obstacle avoidance, and smoothness. We then interleave the generative process with projected gradient descent (PGD) to strictly enforce affine geometric constraints with safety guarantees. Simulations demonstrate that our framework generates highly smooth, collision-free plans that are readily trackable by common distributed controllers and outperforms state-of-the-art planners in various metrics.

AI.tldr: 将多智能体仿射编队运动规划（FMP）建模为约束最大后验估计，解耦为单智能体扩散先验采样，并交替嵌入投影梯度下降以严格满足仿射几何与安全约束。
AI.motivation: 编队控制高度依赖事先给定的高质量、动态可行参考轨迹，而传统基于约束优化的联合轨迹规划在高维空间中计算代价过高；需在保持空间灵活性的同时生成可被分布式控制器跟踪的编队轨迹。
AI.method: 混合"优化+生成"框架：以仿射编队为对象，将规划任务写为约束MAP估计；通过目标解耦复用预训练单智能体扩散先验来保证动态可行性、避障与平滑性；在生成采样过程中交替执行投影梯度下降（PGD），严格施加仿射几何约束并给出安全保证。
AI.result: 仿真表明框架生成的轨迹高度平滑、无碰撞，可被常见分布式控制器直接跟踪，并在多项指标上优于现有SOTA规划器。
AI.conclusion: 扩散先验+PIGD投影的混合范式为高维编队规划提供了可行且可扩展的路径，但仍缺乏真实机器人/多机实验验证与实车可跟踪性的定量证据。

title: PLECTA: Overlap-aware instance segmentation of dense strand networks from binary masks
summary: Many materials and tissues, including carbon-nanotube sheets, collagen and paper, comprise overlapping strands whose arrangement influences their effective properties. Measuring this geometry from micrographs requires individual strands to be traced through crossings and signal gaps, which merge distinct strands or split one strand into disconnected fragments. We present PLECTA (from Latin plecta, a braid), a deterministic method that segments individual strands using only a binary image whose foreground pixels mark strand centrelines. At each junction, PLECTA selects which strand segments continue into one another while allowing segments to terminate. It formulates this decision as an exact maximum-weight partial-matching problem, with an explicit penalty for unpaired segments and no restriction on the number of segments entering a junction. The output permits crossing pixels to belong to multiple strands. On synthetic scenes, PLECTA resolved strand identities more accurately than three released alternatives at every density tested. The same ranking held on an independently published generator run at its own settings. A separate stage uses the corresponding greyscale micrograph to estimate which strand lies on top at each crossing. The complete workflow is demonstrated on scanning electron micrographs of carbon nanotube sheets, from raw images to individual strand instances with estimated crossing order, without manual annotations for training or as pipeline inputs.

AI.tldr: PLECTA：仅用二值中心线图像，将交叉处的片段延续判定建模为精确最大权部分匹配问题（对未配对片段显式惩罚、不限制进入交叉的片段数），从而确定性地分割重叠纤维束，并用灰度图估计交叉处的上下层关系。
AI.motivation: 碳纳米管薄膜、胶原、纸张等材料由重叠纤维/丝束构成，其排布决定有效性能；从显微图像测量该几何时，交叉点和信号缺失处会导致不同纤维被错误合并或同一纤维被切成碎片，现有方法易出现合并/断裂错误。
AI.method: 以二值前景像素标记丝束中心线为唯一输入，在局部交叉处对片段进行配对延续选择，形式化为最大权部分匹配（允许片段终止、不限制节点度数），输出允许交叉像素归属多条丝束；另设独立阶段利用对应灰度显微图推断每个交叉点的上下层级顺序；全流程无需人工标注。
AI.result: 在合成场景各测试密度下，丝束身份解析精度均优于三种已发布替代方法；在独立发布的生成器按其自身设置运行时，排序结果一致；完整流程在碳纳米管薄膜SEM图像上从原始图像实现到带交叉顺序的独立丝束实例。
AI.conclusion: PLECTA为重叠纤维状结构的拓扑感知追踪提供了确定性、可解释且无需训练数据的方案，适用于材料显微表征等场景；其价值偏材料科学图像分析，与具身智能/3D重建核心议题关联较弱。

title: FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
summary: Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors. These findings demonstrate the potential of foundation model features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and provide insights into their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks.

AI.tldr: 提出FM-Recon框架，将冻结的基础模型图像编码器特征精炼后注入展开式重建网络，用于加速心脏电影MRI重建，并在CMRxRecon2023上系统评估不同设置下基础模型特征的作用。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在多种医学影像任务中特征提取能力强，但其在MRI重建（尤其是展开式网络与含伪影输入条件下）的潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 利用冻结的基础模型图像编码器提取特征，设计特征精炼模块并将其集成到展开式（unrolled）重建网络的迭代结构中，在CMRxRecon2023数据集上跨不同加速倍数与重建配置做消融式系统评估。
AI.result: 基础模型能够从伪影污染的输入中提取有信息量的表征并提升重建性能，在中度加速因子下增益尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型特征对加速MRI重建有实用价值，且其有效集成方式对展开式重建网络很关键；未来可进一步探索更强适配策略与更广的临床应用。

title: AnachroBench: Evaluating Historical Consistency in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing Large Vision-Language Model benchmarks primarily evaluate visual understanding in general everyday scenarios, leaving historical consistency with a specified era and country largely underexplored. To address this gap, we propose AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark for evaluating historical consistency in visual scenes. It contains 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to the early 20th century, each pairing an original historical image with an anachronistic version containing a seamlessly inserted modern object. AnachroBench evaluates three aspects: Inserted Object Perception, which tests whether models detect the inserted modern object; Era-Country Consistency, which assesses whether the scene is consistent with the specified era and country; and Conditional Era-Country Consistency, which measures consistency judgments only when the inserted object is correctly perceived. A false consistency judgment occurs when a model perceives the modern object but still judges the scene as historically consistent. Overall, AnachroBench reveals a gap between inserted object perception and era-country consistency judgments, providing a targeted evaluation of this behavior.

AI.tldr: AnachroBench: 1600 组历史图像-篡改图像对（8 国，19 世纪末至 20 世纪初），评测 LVLM 的时代-国家一致性（历史一致性）判别能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LVLM 基准主要评测日常场景的视觉理解，缺乏对“指定时代与国家”历史一致性的考察；本文填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构造受控判别式基准：每对图像为一张原始历史照片与一张无缝插入现代物体的时代错乱版本，共 1600 对、8 国。设三个评测维度：(1) 插入物体感知；(2) 时代-国家一致性判断；(3) 条件一致性（仅在正确感知插入物体时统计一致性判断）。定义“假一致性”为模型察觉到现代物体却仍判定场景历史一致。
AI.result: 基准揭示插入物体感知与时代-国家一致性判断之间存在明显差距，且暴露出模型“假一致性”行为。
AI.conclusion: 历史一致性是 LVLM 的薄弱维度，需针对性评测；AnachroBench 提供了受控、可诊断的评测入口，但为纯基准性质，未提出方法或模型改进方案。

title: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating
summary: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.

AI.tldr: Déjà-Events：纯事件相机的前馈三维重建模型，通过从冻结的RGB教师模型(Déjà View)蒸馏token训练，并引入密度感知自适应门控，在单次前向中预测深度、位姿与点图，零样本超越现有事件方法。
AI.motivation: 事件相机在高速/低光下保持结构信息，但带稠密3D真值的事件数据集稀少且多样性差；同时事件在纹理缺失区近乎缺失，导致重复精炼步数增加时精度退化。
AI.method: 仅用事件的多视图前馈模型，单次前向输出深度、相机位姿与点图。以冻结的RGB教师（Déjà View，重复应用共享transformer块精炼token）的最终token为蒸馏目标，无需深度/位姿真值，仅训练约1%参数；另提出稀疏感知自适应门控，按事件密度逐patch调整共享块门控，使增加精炼步仍保持精度。仅在仿真数据上训练。
AI.result: EventScape上点图误差最低，零样本迁移至真实MVSEC与DSEC；DSEC上AbsRel 0.15 vs 最强基线0.30（减半），参数量约为其1/10；EventScape与DSEC深度误差最低，EventScape轨迹误差最低。
AI.conclusion: 无需3D标签的token蒸馏+稀疏感知门控可高效将RGB前馈重建能力迁移到事件模态，在仿真训练下实现真实场景零样本泛化，显著优于事件基线。

title: Fix, Don't Retake: Physics-Simulated Training for Correcting Patient Positioning Errors in Dental Panoramic Radiographs
summary: Patient-positioning errors can distort panoramic radiographs and lead to repeat examinations. This study investigated artificial intelligence for correcting these errors in existing images. A physics-based simulator generated paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from cone-beam computed tomography volumes, with controlled individual and combined positioning errors. Five approaches were compared: U-Net, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, an error-conditioned model, and a mixture of error-specific specialists. Evaluation used image similarity and geometric metrics across three test sets. All approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors, with U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperforming pix2pix and conditional diffusion.

AI.tldr: A physics-based simulator generates paired correct/mispositioned panoramic radiographs from CBCT volumes to train AI models (U-Net, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, error-conditioned model, mixture of specialists) that retrogradely correct patient-positioning-induced distortion in existing panoramics.
AI.motivation: Patient-positioning errors distort panoramic radiographs and cause repeat exams; rather than only preventing errors at acquisition, the authors target post-hoc correction of already-acquired images.
AI.method: A physics-based projection simulator produces paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from cone-beam CT volumes, with controlled single and combined positioning errors, providing supervised pairs for five restoration approaches: U-Net regression, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, an error-conditioned model, and a mixture of error-specific specialists; evaluated with image similarity and geometric metrics on three test sets.
AI.result: All methods improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric error versus mispositioned inputs; U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperformed pix2pix and conditional diffusion.
AI.conclusion: Simulator-generated paired data enables effective learned correction of positioning artifacts in panoramics, with task-specific/error-aware designs beating generic generative baselines; clinical validation remains future work.

title: Rotation-Invariant Machine Learning for Highly Symmetric Molecular Configurations
comment: NeurReps 2026 Extended Abstract Track (NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations)
summary: Atomistic machine learning can approximate expensive quantum mechanical calculations at a fraction of their computational cost, but accuracy depends strongly on how the three-dimensional atomic environments are represented. Invariant representations enable fast computation but can fail to distinguish geometrically distinct configurations, especially in highly symmetric environments. We introduce a lightweight benchmark to evaluate expressivity on $n$-fold symmetric configurations, and use it to expose degeneracies in both invariant and equivariant architectures. Guided by these results, we construct a new invariant basis for HIP-HOP which resolves most of the identified failures. On a methane simulation dataset, the extended basis achieves the lowest error among the HIP-HOP variants and has similar accuracy to EquiformerV3 while running $3.2\times$ faster at inference. These results show that carefully constructed invariant representations can mitigate key expressivity limitations while balancing accuracy and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出针对n重对称构型的轻量基准揭示不变/等变表示的表达力退化，并为HIP-HOP构造扩展不变基，在甲烷数据上精度接近EquiformerV3且推理快3.2倍。
AI.motivation: 原子尺度机器学习可低成本近似量子力学计算，但精度高度依赖3D原子环境表示；不变表示虽快，却在高度对称环境中难以区分几何上不同的构型，需要定量刻画并改进这种表达力缺陷。
AI.method: 构建评估n重对称构型表达力的轻量基准，用其暴露不变与等变架构中的表示简并；据此为HIP-HOP设计新的不变基函数（扩展基），并保持不变表示的高效性。
AI.result: 基准揭示了不变与等变模型的对称简并问题；扩展基在HIP-HOP各变体中误差最低，精度与EquiformerV3相当，推理速度提升3.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 精心构造的不变表示可在保持计算效率的同时缓解关键表达力局限，为原子模拟中精度-效率权衡提供可行路径。

title: Safe Physical Interaction of All-Electric Heavy-Duty Robotic Manipulators via Control Barrier Functions and Variable Impedance Control
summary: All-electric heavy-duty robotic manipulators are increasingly expected to operate close to tunnel walls, equipment, and other structures while retaining the force capability required for large-payload tasks. Accurate motion control alone does not address the resulting safety and interaction requirements. This paper develops a safety-aware physical-interaction architecture that combines variable impedance control (VIC) with control barrier functions (CBFs) on top of an established virtual decomposition control (VDC) framework for electromechanical linear actuator (EMLA)-driven manipulators. VIC continuously adapts the task-space stiffness and damping according to predicted proximity and contact risk, whereas a joint-velocity CBF filter enforces Cartesian workspace boundaries and the physical stroke limits induced by the closed-chain lift and tilt mechanisms. To account for nonideal realization of the filtered velocity by the inner VDC/EMLA dynamics, the CBF inequalities are tightened using a measured bound on the joint-velocity tracking error. Four configurations, namely VDC, VIC+VDC, CBF+VDC, and VIC+CBF+VDC, are evaluated under workspace, actuator-limit, and physical-interaction scenarios. VIC reduces the peak and RMS environment-interaction forces by 92.59% and 96.33%, respectively; both robust CBF configurations maintain positive workspace and EMLA safety margins, while VIC+CBF+VDC reduces the CBF intervention metric by 10.30% compared with CBF+VDC.

AI.tldr: 在VDC/EMLA框架上叠加可变阻抗控制(VIC)与鲁棒控制障碍函数(CBF)，实现重型机械臂的近壁安全物理交互。
AI.motivation: 全电动重型机械臂需在隧道壁等受限空间内保持大载荷力能力，仅靠精确运动控制无法满足安全与交互需求。
AI.method: 在虚拟分解控制(VDC)基础上叠加：VIC按预测的接近/接触风险连续调节任务空间刚度和阻尼；关节速度CBF滤波器施加笛卡尔工作空间边界及闭链举升/俯仰机构的行程限制，并用实测关节速度跟踪误差界收紧CBF不等式以补偿内环非理想跟踪。对比VDC、VIC+VDC、CBF+VDC、VIC+CBF+VDC四组配置。
AI.result: VIC使环境交互力峰值与RMS分别降低92.59%和96.33%；两种鲁棒CBF配置均保持正的安全裕度，VIC+CBF+VDC相对CBF+VDC将CBF干预指标降低10.30%。
AI.conclusion: VIC与CBF在VDC架构上互补有效，可在保持作业能力的同时提升受限空间交互安全性；但验证限于仿真/实验台场景，未见真实隧道部署证据。

title: A2A-UAV: A Multimodal Air-to-Air Dataset for UAV Detection and Identification
summary: The rapid growth of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in low-altitude airspace increases the risk of unauthorized intrusions, making reliable detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs essential for low-altitude airspace safety. However, the existing public UAV datasets are mostly acquired from fixed ground-based viewpoints and are limited to imaging or radio-frequency (RF) observations, which restricts the sensing coverage and deployment flexibility. To address this gap, we present A2A-UAV, a multimodal air-to-air dataset for UAV detection and identification. Specifically, 15 target UAVs of 13 commercial models were recorded at three outdoor sites under daytime and nighttime conditions by using a UAV-mounted platform equipped with an RGB-thermal gimbal camera, a panoramic camera, an RF spectrum analyzer, and a millimeter-wave radar. The dataset contains 105,294 time-aligned samples of RGB, panoramic, thermal, and RF time-frequency images and radar point clouds. Moreover, all 209,539 bounding boxes of the predominantly small UAV targets were manually annotated and cross-checked. Therefore, A2A-UAV provides a valuable resource for air-to-air UAV detection, identification, and multimodal fusion in low-altitude airspace.

AI.tldr: A2A-UAV: a multimodal air-to-air dataset (RGB, panoramic, thermal, RF spectrogram, mmWave point cloud) captured by a UAV-mounted platform over 15 target UAVs / 13 commercial models at 3 outdoor sites, day and night, with 105,294 time-aligned samples and 209,539 manually annotated small-target bounding boxes.
AI.motivation: Existing public UAV datasets come from fixed ground viewpoints and are limited to single modalities (RGB imaging or RF), which caps sensing coverage and deployment flexibility; reliable detection/identification of non-cooperative UAVs in low-altitude airspace requires air-to-air, multi-modal data.
AI.method: Data-collection effort rather than an algorithmic method: a UAV-mounted sensing payload (RGB-thermal gimbal camera, panoramic camera, RF spectrum analyzer, mmWave radar) records 15 target UAVs of 13 models at three outdoor sites under daytime and nighttime; samples are time-aligned across modalities into RGB/panoramic/thermal/RF time-frequency images and radar point clouds; bounding boxes for predominantly small targets are manually annotated and cross-checked.
AI.result: 105,294 time-aligned multimodal samples and 209,539 cross-checked bounding boxes; coverage of day/night, three sites, 13 commercial models, and four heterogeneous sensing modalities for air-to-air detection and identification.
AI.conclusion: A2A-UAV offers a resource for air-to-air UAV detection, identification, and multimodal fusion in low-altitude airspace; no baseline or downstream method is reported in the abstract.

title: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
summary: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.

AI.tldr: MovieRoll：基座到蒸馏的流式视频生成框架，结合WinTF多步训练、HieraKV分层KV缓存压缩、CuLT-DMD长滚出分布匹配蒸馏，实现训练时长外（最长60s）的稳定流式生成。
AI.motivation: 流式视频生成需在训练时长之外保持质量，同时要处理自生成历史引起的误差累积与不断增长的KV缓存开销，现有方法难以兼顾长时程一致性与推理效率。
AI.method: 1) Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF)：在渐进噪声级别上联合去噪窗口内chunk，窗口内双向注意力、对历史因果访问，得到稳健多步基座；2) HieraKV：利用逐层注意力模式，浅层保留完整历史、深层保留sink-近期历史，缓存降低约78%；3) CuLT-DMD：长自rollout中固定参数、平均局部梯度后更新，单次更新仅保留一个局部计算图，实现几步生成器的长rollout高效训练；4) 推理端KV重计算界定时域上下文、AnnealCFG引导退火至干净端点；辅以FBCA注意力与PS-VAE流式解码。
AI.result: 在HeliosBench上，MovieRoll-Base仅用≤15s视频训练，在30s处仍保持竞争力；MovieRoll-Distilled在单事件与多事件评测（最长60s）中总分最高，兼顾自然度持续性与主动运动。
AI.conclusion: 分层缓存压缩+长rollout蒸馏+推理期上下文界定的组合，可有效缓解流式视频生成的时域外推瓶颈，为长视频流式生成提供了可复用的基座-蒸馏范式。

title: Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion for Decomposable Generative Models
summary: Generative model pre-training typically optimizes a model as a whole without explicitly organizing its parameters for selective reuse. Decomposable pre-training instead learns reusable components for downstream adaptation while retaining strong generative performance. However, existing knowledge diversion methods incur substantial parameter overhead through weight factorization and rely on fixed component assignments to induce specialization, potentially compromising in-distribution generation quality. We therefore propose Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion (SGKDiv), which learns how generative knowledge is shared and specialized for effective generation and selective downstream reuse. SGKDiv constructs Knowledge Units from paired feed-forward channels, preserving native computational structure without SVD-based reparameterization. Calibrated condition-wise routing combines a shared usage prior with conditional adjustments, while complementary regularization shapes their allocation, diversity, and magnitude. Together, these designs replace predefined component assignments with adaptively learned and explicitly regulated knowledge specialization. Experiments across diverse model and training settings demonstrate better in-distribution generation than dense and MoE baselines, alongside stronger downstream adaptation than representative PEFT methods across eight datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出 Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion (SGKDiv)，用成对前馈通道构造 Knowledge Unit，替代 SVD 权重分解，配合校准的逐条件路由与互补正则，实现可分解预训练中的知识共享与特化。
AI.motivation: 现有可分解预训练方法通过权重分解实现知识复用，参数开销大，且依赖固定的成分分配来诱导特化，可能损害分布内生成质量。
AI.method: SGKDiv 以成对前馈通道构成 Knowledge Unit，保留原生计算结构、无需 SVD 重参数化；采用校准的 condition-wise routing，将共享使用先验与条件调整结合；并用正则项从分配、多样性与幅度三方面塑造知识特化，以自适应学习取代预定义成分指派。
AI.result: 在多类模型与训练设置下，分布内生成效果优于稠密模型与 MoE 基线；在八个数据集上的下游适配优于代表性 PEFT 方法。
AI.conclusion: 以通道配对与自适应路由实现轻量、可复用的可分解预训练，兼顾生成质量与下游选择性复用。

title: Symmetry Detection with Patch Embedding Models by Means of a Scalar Product Transform
summary: We present a transformation of vector embeddings representing image patches into scores for point reflection symmetry at the crossing points of patches. The transformation is heavily inspired by the Gradient Product Transform, but it uses the vector embeddings instead of the grayscale gradients. We therefore call it the "Scalar Product Transform" (SPT). Unlike deep learning models for symmetry detection, the method does not require a specific training step tailored for symmetry detection, but it works with arbitrary pre-trained patch embedding models. We have tested the method with DINOv3 and Franca. In our tests, the method outperformed the Gradient Product Transform and was even better than EquiSym, a convolutional neural network specifically designed and trained for symmetry detection. Although the runtime of the SPT is greater than that of EquiSym, the SPT has the advantage that it directly yields a bounding box for the symmetric region.

AI.tldr: 提出 Scalar Product Transform (SPT)，将图像块的预训练向量嵌入转换为块交叉点处的点反射对称性得分，无需专门训练即可结合 DINOv3、Franca 等任意预训练嵌入模型使用。
AI.motivation: 对称性检测通常依赖为任务专门训练的深度网络（如 EquiSym），成本高且不通用；作者希望直接复用现成的自监督块嵌入来完成对称检测。
AI.method: 受 Gradient Product Transform 启发，用 patch embedding 向量替代灰度梯度，在 patch 交叉点处计算标量积变换，得到点反射对称性响应图，并直接给出对称区域边界框。
AI.result: 在 DINOv3 与 Franca 嵌入上测试，性能优于 Gradient Product Transform，甚至超过专门设计训练的 CNN 方法 EquiSym；运行时间高于 EquiSym，但可直接输出对称区域边界框。
AI.conclusion: 预训练块嵌入可零训练迁移到几何对称检测任务，是一种轻量、通用的后处理式方案，代价是计算开销较高。

title: Exploring the link between predictive uncertainty and the sim-to-real gap in deep learning models utilizing synthetic data
summary: Today, state-of-the-art methods for quality control (QC) are based on Machine Vision, combining deep learning (DL) models with camera-based inspection. Yet, the integration of such solutions in industrial applications is often impeded by data sparsity and trust in model reliability. While synthetic data offers a promising approach to generate the necessary data with perfect annotations, it poses risks related to performance degradation due to the possible occurrence of the sim-to-real gap. This study conducts experiments using the ensemble method to estimate the predictive uncertainty of DL models trained on synthetic data. The results show that predictive uncertainty increases under the sim-to-real domain shift. However, the observed performance drop is dominated by a systematic sim-to-real bias rather than by ensemble this http URL findings contribute to the effective utilization of synthetic data in industrial settings while highlighting the importance of risk assessment for the deployment of DL solutions for QC tasks.

AI.tldr: 研究基于合成数据训练的深度质检模型的集成预测不确定性在sim-to-real域偏移下的变化，发现不确定性升高但性能下降主要由系统性sim-to-real偏差而非集成本身导致。
AI.motivation: 工业质检中深度学习部署受制于数据稀缺与模型可靠性信任不足；合成数据可提供完美标注，但存在sim-to-real gap风险，需评估不确定性估计能否预警该风险。
AI.method: 用集成方法（ensemble）估计在合成数据上训练的DL模型预测不确定性，并在真实域下进行实验对比分析。
AI.result: 预测不确定性在sim-to-real域偏移下显著上升，可表征域差异；但实际性能下降由系统性sim-to-real偏差主导，而非集成本身不确定性所致。
AI.conclusion: 集成不确定性可作为域偏移的风险信号，助力合成数据在工业质检中的安全使用，并强调部署前风险评估的必要性。

title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
summary: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and local advantages to refine decisions, responses, and silence across multi-turn interactions. We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion. ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.

AI.tldr: ALIVE：支持主动监控、流式任务协调与主动寻求反馈的交互式流式视频LLM，配套ALIVE-SFT-288K/ALIVE-RL-3K两阶段数据与BACA信用分配强化学习方法，并提出FSI-Bench评测反馈寻求与后续任务完成。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频LLM虽能持续观察世界，但通常孤立地处理用户请求，缺乏在长时间视频流中主动判断何时响应、何时沉默、以及主动向用户寻求反馈的交互能力。
AI.method: 构建288K对比式监督微调数据与3K强化学习数据两阶段训练：对比式SFT教模型"何时、如何"响应；RL阶段提出Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment（BACA），融合轨迹级与局部优势，在多轮交互中优化决策、回复与沉默策略；另构建FSI-Bench评测反馈寻求及任务完成。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准与FSI-Bench上取得最高综合得分，体现较强的流式理解与交互能力。
AI.conclusion: 将流式视频理解与主动交互（监控、协调、反馈寻求）统一建模，为持续观察场景下的通用交互式视频助手提供了训练范式与评测基准；摘要未给出具体数值与真实部署证据。

title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.

AI.tldr: WeVisForensics: 一个 agentic 视频伪造检测框架，主调查 agent 调度可自进化的多模态（视觉/音频）检验子 agent 库，配合双时间尺度策略优化 DTPO 与 ForenCue-30K 数据集，平均检测准确率 95.2%。
AI.motivation: 视频生成能力快速提升，需要基于显式取证证据的可靠检测。现有方法要么依赖单次 chain-of-thought 推理，忽略短时或局部伪影；要么依赖预定义多 agent 流程，检验选择缺乏灵活性。且仅优化调查策略无法直接提升固定专家的取证能力。
AI.method: 提出主调查 agent + 自进化检验员子 agent 库的层级 agentic 框架，学习检查何种伪影类型、在哪个时间窗、何时终止；两层 agent 通过交互共享反馈。DTPO 双时间尺度策略优化：调查者用快速 RL，检验员用较慢的细化，并以标注的伪影区间为引导。构建 ForenCue-30K 数据集，含角色特定取证标注、交互轨迹与 RL 训练池。
AI.result: 在 in-domain、out-of-domain 及 agentic 基准上平均检测准确率 95.2%，超出最强先前检测器 9.0 个百分点，且结论可定位到局部证据。
AI.conclusion: 层级式自进化取证 agent 与双时间尺度策略优化结合，可显著提升视频伪造检测的准确率与证据可解释性；不涉及机器人或 3D 重建，属通用多模态取证 agent 系统。

title: Data-Driven Predictive Control for Autonomous Vehicle Racing under Varying Friction
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the 2027 European Control Conference (ECC). Code and data: this https URL
summary: Data-driven predictive control (DPC) predicts future outputs by combining recorded input-output trajectory data such that the combined trajectory approximately matches a measured initial trajectory and tracks a provided reference. This paper investigates to what extent and under which conditions DPC using data pooled across operating conditions retains the prediction accuracy of DPC using data from the current operating condition. In autonomous vehicle racing, the tire-road friction varies between racetrack sections and tire sets. If the initial trajectory and the recorded data originate from different frictions, prediction accuracy of DPC degrades. Ensuring the frictions match requires knowing the friction during recording and estimating the current friction explicitly. Instead, we pool data recorded at different frictions. We compare the prediction accuracy of DPC using data recorded under the current friction (matched), a different friction (mismatched) and data pooled from both frictions. We evaluate in simulation and small-scale vehicle experiments in the Cyber-Physical Mobility Lab (CPM Lab). Our results show that pooled data keep the multi-step root-mean-square prediction error within 1.5 times that of matched data, whereas mismatched data increase it by a factor of 2.2 to 3.4. To assess how this prediction accuracy carries over to control, we evaluate the tracking error from the raceline in closed loop. In simulation, DPC with pooled data tracks comparably to nonlinear model predictive control (13.7 cm versus 13.3 cm) and close to DPC with matched data in the CPM Lab, differing by 0.1 cm on the low-friction tires (1.6 cm versus 1.5 cm) and by 0.2 cm on the high-friction tires (0.9 cm versus 1.1 cm). DPC thus provides partial adaptation to varying friction, without a dedicated adaptation method.

AI.tldr: 研究数据驱动预测控制(DPC)在跨工况数据池化时的预测精度保持性，验证池化数据可实现部分摩擦自适应而无需显式辨识。
AI.motivation: DPC依赖记录轨迹与初始轨迹的一致性；自动驾驶赛车中轮胎-路面摩擦随赛道段和轮胎组变化，若初始轨迹与记录数据摩擦不匹配会导致精度下降。传统做法需记录时已知摩擦并显式估计当前摩擦，成本高且易错。作者希望探讨能否通过混合不同摩擦工况的数据来规避显式摩擦估计。
AI.method: 将当前摩擦、不同摩擦（失配）及两者混合（pooled）三类数据分别用于DPC，比较其多步预测精度；在仿真与Cyber-Physical Mobility Lab(CPM Lab)小型车辆实验中评估多步RMSE预测误差，并闭环评估赛道中心线跟踪误差，与NMPC及匹配数据DPC对比。
AI.result: 池化数据的多步RMSE保持在匹配数据的1.5倍以内，而失配数据误差放大2.2–3.4倍。闭环中，仿真下池化DPC跟踪误差13.7cm，接近NMPC的13.3cm；CPM Lab中与匹配数据DPC相差仅0.1cm（低摩擦1.6 vs 1.5cm）和0.2cm（高摩擦0.9 vs 1.1cm）。
AI.conclusion: 池化跨摩擦数据可在无专用自适应机制的情况下为DPC提供部分摩擦自适应性，是一种低成本、可行的鲁棒性增强手段；同时说明数据池化的边界条件——精度保持依赖于混合而非替代匹配数据。

title: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. This mismatch can produce accurate rendered masks from incomplete 3D selections since alpha-blended feature supervision concentrates learning on dominant contributors while leaving occluded or low-contribution Gaussians weakly supervised. We propose VODA, a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to group per-pixel contributors and directly supervises all Gaussians in selected depth clusters, bypassing contribution-weighted gradient delivery. To evaluate volumetric completeness, we introduce Removal-3D, a synthetic object-removal benchmark, and the Removal Depth Error (RDE), a metric comparing predicted and ground-truth depth changes. Across four rendering-based baselines, VODA consistently improves volumetric segmentation on Removal-3D while maintaining or improving performance on LERF and ScanNet. Further analysis shows that VODA recovers lower-contribution Gaussians, while simple gradient reweighting and spatial propagation fail to reproduce comparable gains.

AI.tldr: VODA提出一种即插即用的监督目标，利用局部深度结构对像素贡献者分组，直接监督被选深度簇中的全部高斯，解决渲染视图监督导致遮挡/低贡献高斯欠监督的问题；并提出Removal-3D基准与RDE指标评估体素级分割完整性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯分割方法在渲染视图上训练与评估，与3D本质不匹配：alpha混合的特征监督集中在主导贡献高斯上，遮挡或低贡献高斯监督微弱，导致渲染掩码准确但3D选择不完整。作者希望直接在3D层面监督所有高斯以获得体素级完整分割。
AI.method: VODA：即插即用的监督目标。基于局部深度结构将每个像素的贡献高斯按深度分组/聚类，对所选深度簇内的所有高斯直接施加监督，绕过贡献加权（alpha混合）的梯度传递路径。评估方面构建Removal-3D合成物体移除基准，并提出Removal Depth Error（RDE）指标，比较预测与真值的深度变化以衡量移除后的体积完整性。
AI.result: 在四个基于渲染的基线方法上，VODA在Removal-3D上一致提升体积分割效果，同时在LERF与ScanNet上保持或提升性能。进一步分析表明VODA能恢复低贡献高斯，而简单的梯度重加权与空间传播无法复现同等收益。
AI.conclusion: 渲染视图监督与3D分割目标存在本质错配，直接用深度感知的簇级监督可显著改善高斯体积分割完整性；VODA具备即插即用性，且新增基准RDE为体素级完整性评估提供了可量化手段。

title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
summary: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. Delegating perception reduces this burden, yet sparse sampling can miss decisive details, and per-frame descriptions can preserve context growth. We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning. The planner controls where to inspect, what to resolve, and how densely to sample. Perception sub-agents process native audio-video in independent contexts and return compact, temporally grounded evidence for iterative search and verification. Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost. A paired LVBench subset ablation shows lower planner input and higher accuracy. With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone, VideoNexus improves over the official Video-GAIA ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation. These results support compact evidence exchange for combining detailed observation with efficient planning and reasoning.

AI.tldr: VideoNexus：无训练的"规划器+感知子智能体"分离框架，在独立上下文中原生处理音视频，仅返回紧凑的时序可定位证据，支持迭代检索与验证，提升长视频问答效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 长视频中即使证据存在，密集视觉序列的处理仍同时压迫感知与推理；把帧回传给规划器会持续累积视觉上下文，而稀疏采样会漏掉决定性细节、逐帧描述又会造成上下文膨胀。
AI.method: 训练无关框架：规划器决定检查位置、需澄清内容与采样密度；感知子智能体在独立上下文中处理原生音视频，返回紧凑且带时间戳的证据，供迭代搜索与验证。
AI.result: Gemini 3.8 Flash 双角色下，LVBench 全集 88.6%，比同骨架静态摄入和内置 agentic 处理分别高 3.6/1.1 点，API 成本仅为后者 44%；配对子集消融显示规划器输入更少、精度更高；Kimi K3 骨架下较官方 Video-GAIA ReAct 高 8.5 点。
AI.conclusion: 以紧凑证据交换替代视觉上下文累积，可将细粒度观察与高效规划推理结合，为长视频智能体提供可复用的系统设计范式。

title: Portrait Fitness as a Pretext: Probing Implicit Demographic Bias in VLMs
summary: We audit face-related bias in VLMs using BALPORTRAITS, a new balanced dataset of 9,000 fictional portraits across ethnicity, gender, and age segments. Sixteen VLMs estimate portrait fitness scores for occupations, brands, activities, and banking or insurance products within an advertising-casting framework designed to avoid direct inference of protected attributes. Item-level estimations are aggregated with scenario-specific prestige scores to compare rankings across demographic groups. While the magnitude and direction of these biases vary across scenarios, model families, and demographic dimensions, with age, ethnicity, and gender contributing differently depending on the task, we find demographic dispersion across all evaluated models, with a majority of pairwise segment differences reaching statistical significance. This study introduces a controlled protocol to assess implicit face-related associations and demonstrates that single-scenario or single-attribute audits are insufficient.

AI.tldr: 用新构建的9,000张跨族群/性别/年龄均衡虚构人像数据集BALPORTRAITS，在"广告选角"框架下审计16个VLM对职业、品牌、活动及金融产品的隐式面部关联偏好。
AI.motivation: VLM可能基于人脸产生人口属性相关的隐性偏见，而单一场景、单一属性审计不足，且直接推断受保护属性的做法本身存在问题，需要可控、规避直接属性推断的审计协议。
AI.method: 构建族裔/性别/年龄均衡的9,000张虚构人像数据集；16个VLM在广告选角框架下为职业、品牌、活动、银行保险产品给出人像"适配度"打分；条目级分数与场景声望分聚合，比较不同人口群体的排序差异，并用统计显著性检验成对群体差异。
AI.result: 偏见的大小与方向随场景、模型家族与人口维度变化，年龄/族裔/性别在不同任务中贡献不同；但所有被评估模型均存在人口学离散度，多数成对群体差异达到统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一套可控的隐式面部关联审计协议，证明单场景或单属性审计不足以刻画VLM的偏见结构，需多场景、多属性联合评估。

title: Flexible Multi-Stack Super-Resolution of Clinical Brain MRI Using Hetero-Orientation Variational Encoding: Expert Reader Evaluation in a Nigerian Cohort
summary: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p<.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p<.001). Code at this http URL

AI.tldr: MS-HVED：序列无关的多堆栈脑MRI超分辨框架，用多尺度高斯后验+视野感知PoG融合+物理驱动域随机化，并在尼日利亚队列真实临床盲评中显著优于监督基线。
AI.motivation: 临床常规脑MRI多为快速各向异性2D采集，方向、层厚、覆盖范围各异且部分重叠；现有学习式超分依赖单一欠约束输入或理想化固定多堆栈几何，难以适配真实异构采集。
AI.method: 将可用的轴位/冠状位/矢状位堆栈各自独立编码为多尺度高斯后验，用视野感知的高斯乘积（Product-of-Gaussians）融合，抑制无支撑区域贡献；训练时采用物理驱动的域随机化，模拟倾斜采集、部分覆盖与成像伪影，实现序列无关的灵活多输入超分。
AI.result: 合成基准上重建保真度具竞争力或更优，并提升下游组织分割；30例尼日利亚队列外部验证（并入44例、7名神经放射专家的盲评研究）中，尼日利亚队列210组配对评估有187组偏好MS-HVED；全临床队列总质量分5.93 vs 4.49（p<.001），缺失轴位或冠状位输入时优势仍显著。
AI.conclusion: 视野感知多堆栈融合结合域随机化可有效应对真实临床异构采集，跨人群外部验证与专家盲评支持其泛化性与临床可用性；代码已开源。

title: Quality and Similarity Indicators for Video-Based Heart Rate and Respiratory Rate Fusion: A Controlled Evaluation
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables; with 14 pages supplementary material included
summary: Camera-based heart rate (HR) and respiratory rate (RR) estimates vary in reliability from window to window, and a common remedy is to fuse several extraction methods with weights from reference-free signal quality indicators. However, few studies test whether these indicators identify the most accurate method in each window or outperform simpler fusion. We evaluate 11 quality indicators and 8 inter-method similarity measures for fusing 7 HR and 10 RR extractors on four public datasets (75 test subjects). Filters, indicator directions, weighting parameters and a learned ridge baseline are selected on a separate five-subject set before testing. Fusion is compared with equal averaging, a constant typical-rate predictor, the best single method selected in advance and in hindsight, and a per-window oracle with a permutation-based null, using subject-level bootstrap confidence intervals. For HR, quality-weighted fusion reduced mean absolute error by 10.9% [5.2, 18.4] relative to averaging and by 15.6% [8.1, 23.1] relative to the method selected in advance, and was statistically indistinguishable from the best method selected in hindsight. Weighting methods by their agreement did not improve on averaging. For RR, the indicators could not identify the more accurate estimates: sharpened quality weighting increased error (-2.6% [-4.8, -0.8]), fused estimates were uncorrelated with the reference (r <= 0.22), and averaging was less accurate than the typical-rate predictor (-3.1% [-6.1, -0.4]). With a second respiratory reference, apparent RR gains reflected estimates moving toward its typical rate. Quality-guided fusion is worthwhile for video HR; for RR, 30-s windows improved estimates but not fusion.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了11种无参考信号质量指标与8种方法间相似度度量，用于融合7种心率(HR)与10种呼吸率(RR)提取器，并在4个公开数据集(75名受试者)上检验其是否优于简单平均、典型值预测器和预先/事后选定的最佳方法。
AI.motivation: 基于摄像头的HR/RR估计逐窗可靠性波动大，常用做法是用无参考质量指标加权融合多种提取方法，但鲜有研究验证这些指标是否真能逐窗挑出最准方法，或是否优于更简单的融合策略。
AI.method: 在独立5人集合上选定滤波器、指标方向、加权参数及学习的ridge基线，随后在4个公开数据集(75测试受试者)上进行测试。对比对象包含等权平均、常数典型心率预测器、预先/事后最佳单一方法、以及逐窗oracle(带置换检验零假设)；融合方案由质量加权与相似度加权两类构成；采用受试者级bootstrap置信区间。
AI.result: HR方面，质量加权融合相对等权平均MAE降低10.9% [5.2, 18.4]，相对预先选定最佳方法降低15.6% [8.1, 23.1]，与事后最佳方法在统计上无差异；相似度加权未优于平均。RR方面指标无法识别更准确估计：锐化质量加权反而升高误差(-2.6% [-4.8, -0.8])，融合估计与参考几乎不相关(r≤0.22)，等权平均劣于典型速率预测器(-3.1% [-6.1, -0.4])；换用第二呼吸参考后，表面增益实为估计向该参考典型速率靠拢所致。
AI.conclusion: 质量引导融合对视频HR有价值，但对RR无益；对RR而言，30秒窗口可提升估计精度但不改善融合效果。该工作为rPPG/远程生理测量的融合策略选择提供了严格的负结果与基准对照。

title: Power Line Detection in Point Clouds with Point-SAM and RANSAC
summary: This article deals with the problem of detecting the position of power lines in airborne laser scanning point clouds. We address both the problem of segmenting power lines from background like ground and vegetation and of identifying individual lines. For segmentation we compare a rule-based approach with one based on transfer learning (Point-SAM). For individual line detection, we derive the mathematical formulas for RANSAC applied to 3D catenaries and compare it with a non-parametric method (TriplClust). All methods are evaluated on a newly created dataset "PowLiDFR", which we make publicly available. The samples have been taken from the French project LiDAR HD and cover a variety of terrain layouts and point cloud resolutions. On this dataset, an unsupervised transfer learning outperformed a mere rule-based segmentation, and for individual power line detection, RANSAC was better in following the shape of catenaries than the non-parametric algorithm.

AI.tldr: 对比规则法与 Point-SAM 迁移学习做电力线分割，并给出三维悬链线 RANSAC 公式与 TriplClust 对比，发布 PowLiDFR 数据集；迁移学习分割更优，RANSAC 更贴合导线形状。
AI.motivation: 机载激光扫描点云中电力线定位（前景分割与单根线识别）是输电走廊巡检与三维重建的关键环节，需在多样地形与分辨率下稳健区分电力线与地面/植被，并可靠参数化单根导线。
AI.method: 分割方面对比规则法（基于几何/高度/回波特征）与基于迁移学习的分割器 Point-SAM（无监督域迁移）；单线检测方面推导了适用于三维悬链线的 RANSAC 参数化公式，并与非参数聚类方法 TriplClust 对比。全部方法在新建数据集 PowLiDFR（源自法国 LiDAR HD 项目，公开）上评估。
AI.result: 无监督迁移学习分割优于纯规则分割；单线检测中 RANSAC 在拟合悬链线形状（连续性、走向一致性）上优于非参数 TriplClust。数据集覆盖多种地形布局与点云分辨率。
AI.conclusion: 规则法与参数化 RANSAC 仍是强基线，预训练分割模型的零样本迁移可提升前景分割质量；公开数据集 PowLiDFR 为电力线检测提供可复现评测基准。

title: [CLS] and [EOS] Tokens are not Enough for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning
comment: Accepted to TMM. Code is available at: this https URL
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to empower models to continuously acquire new knowledge while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. With the advent of vision-language models like CLIP, leveraging their cross-modal alignment capabilities to address CIL challenges has emerged as a dominant paradigm. Existing methods leverage CLIP's global representations (i.e., the visual [CLS] token and the textual [EOS] token) for cross-modal alignment. While achieving effective classification, they overlook the rich patch-level visual features and token-level textual semantics inherent in CLIP. For example, the [CLS] token aggregates local information to capture the general concept of "cat", while the patch-level details retain specific localized features essential for recognition, such as the tail, fur, and face. We propose PACE (PAtch-token Cross-modal Enhancement) to uncover the long-neglected local representations within CLIP. First, based on the global representations like [CLS] token and [EOS] token, we identify the top-k most crucial visual patches and textual tokens. Subsequently, to better utilize the extracted key local features, we design a cross-modal fusion module. This module leverages local textual semantics to refine visual representations, while augmenting textual semantics with local visual features. As the fusion module is shared across all tasks, directly fine-tuning it on new tasks would interfere with the knowledge learned from previous tasks, leading to catastrophic forgetting. To alleviate this, we employ a projection-based update strategy to effectively preserve the critical parameter space of previous tasks during the adaptation to new tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PACE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple CIL benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出PACE方法，利用CLIP中被忽视的patch级视觉与token级文本局部表示，通过top-k关键局部特征选择与跨模态融合模块增强类增量学习，并用投影式更新策略保护旧任务参数。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的类增量学习方法仅利用全局表示（视觉[CLS]与文本[EOS]）做跨模态对齐，忽略了CLIP固有的细粒度patch级视觉特征和token级文本语义，而这些局部信息对具体类别识别至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 基于全局[CLS]/[EOS]表示筛选top-k最关键的视觉patch与文本token；2) 设计跨模态融合模块，用局部文本语义精炼视觉表示、同时用局部视觉特征增强文本语义；3) 由于融合模块跨任务共享，采用基于投影的更新策略，在新任务适配时保留旧任务的关键参数子空间以缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个类增量学习基准上，PACE显著优于现有最先进方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 挖掘CLIP局部表示并结合参数投影更新，是提升类增量学习性能的有效途径，可作为CLIP基增量学习范式的一种通用增强。

title: Out of Sight, Into Memory: Compact Visual Latents Retain Local Evidence in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
summary: Question answering over ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing scenes poses a tension for multimodal large language models: global overviews obscure small objects and local attributes, whereas detailed crops consume substantial context. Compressing inspected crops into short sequences of continuous visual latents offers a compact memory once crop tokens are discarded, yet diagnostic studies on natural images find that models often ignore latent content, leaving unclear whether compact latents can retain fine-grained targets lost in downsampled UHR remote sensing scenes. To isolate evidence retention from region selection, we encode high-resolution crops into latent memory tokens for frozen backbones and evaluate both their predictive utility and content dependence. Across two generations of Qwen-VL on LRS-GRO, a 64-token memory achieves 7.6- to 9.9-fold compression of retained crop tokens and improves accuracy by 2.5 to 4.8 percentage points over the downsampled global image alone, recovering most of the high-resolution crop gain with consistent behavior on XLRS-Bench. Substituting memory from another image or another region of the same scene reduces accuracy by 5.8 to 7.4 percentage points and yields lower accuracy than removing memory altogether, demonstrating that predictions depend on the encoded regional evidence. Restoring the source crop within the same model reduces the accuracy loss caused by zeroing or removing memory. These findings establish that compact visual latents retain useful local evidence in UHR remote sensing and identify evidence availability as a key factor governing their contribution.

AI.tldr: 该文研究在超高分辨率遥感场景问答中，将高分辨率裁剪块压缩为少量连续视觉latent记忆token，能否保留细粒度局部证据；在冻结backbone的Qwen-VL上验证，64-token记忆实现7.6–9.9倍压缩并较降采样全局图提升2.5–4.8个百分点，且替换/移除记忆会显著降分，证明预测依赖所编码的区域证据。
AI.motivation: UHR遥感场景对多模态大模型构成矛盾：全局概览丢失小目标与局部属性，而详尽裁剪消耗大量上下文。虽可将裁剪压缩为短序列连续视觉latent作为紧凑记忆，但自然图像上的诊断研究显示模型常忽略latent内容，因此需验证在UHR遥感中紧凑latent能否保留降采样后丢失的细粒度目标。
AI.method: 为把"证据保留"与"区域选择"解耦，将高分辨率裁剪块编码为latent memory token，用于冻结backbone；在Qwen-VL两代模型上于LRS-GRO与XLRS-Bench评测，通过替换为其他图像或其他区域的记忆、零化/移除记忆、恢复源裁剪等消融，评估预测效用与内容依赖性。
AI.result: 64-token记忆对保留裁剪token实现7.6–9.9倍压缩，较仅用降采样全局图准确率提升2.5–4.8个百分点，基本恢复高分辨率裁剪带来的增益，XLRS-Bench上表现一致；替换为其他图像/同场景其他区域的记忆使准确率下降5.8–7.4个百分点，且低于完全移除记忆；恢复源裁剪可减轻零化或移除记忆导致的精度损失。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑视觉latent可在UHR遥感中保留有用的局部证据，证据可得性是决定其贡献的关键因素；该结论为面向超高分辨率输入的紧凑记忆式多模态问答提供实证依据。

title: Balanced Twin Weight Factorization for Efficient MLLMs
summary: Weight Factorization (WF) methods aim to reduce a model's latency, memory, or both. These typically decompose a pretrained model into two or more factors that approximate the original model weights with fewer parameters and floating point operations (FLOPs). However, translating fewer FLOPs into reduced latency is challenging for WF methods in practice due to overhead introduced by replacing a single large weight matrix with multiple smaller ones. To address this, we propose Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF), which uses the unique structure of factorized models to simultaneously lower latency and increase learning capacity. Specifically, BTWF operates in the shared basis WF setting, where two or more layers are decomposed into a shared basis matrix and a layer-specific mixing matrix. If these shared layers have the same input (i.e., are twins), then we need only perform this shared forward pass once, reducing inference time. However, twin layers are often of varying sizes, and methods from prior work tend to favor the larger layer. In contrast, our approach boosts performance by combining Factor Component Balancing (FCB), which ensures every shared member is well represented in the selected factors, with Block Contribution Balancing (BCB), which considers downstream model effects. Further, we also show that an overparameterized BTWF, where some layer's factors result in higher FLOPs than the original during training, can boost task performance without additional resources at test time. Experiments on six models over nine benchmarks show BTWF obtains a 2-6% gain over the state-of-the-art without expensive finetuning (1-3.5% gain with it) at comparable computational costs.

AI.tldr: BTWF利用"孪生层共享基"结构，将共享基前向只算一次以降低延迟，并用因子组件平衡(FCB)与模块贡献平衡(BCB)保证各共享层在因子中被充分表示，甚至允许训练时过参数化而不增加测试开销。
AI.motivation: 权重因子化(WF)虽能减少参数与FLOPs，但把单个大矩阵替换为多个小矩阵会带来额外开销，难以转化为真实延迟下降；同时现有共享基方法在孪生层尺寸不一时偏向大层，牺牲小层表示质量。
AI.method: 在共享基WF设定下，将两个及以上同输入层（孪生层）分解为共享基矩阵+层特定混合矩阵，共享前向仅执行一次；提出FCB确保每个共享成员在选中因子中被良好表示，BCB进一步考虑因子的下游模块贡献；并探索训练期过参数化（某些层因子FLOPs高于原模型）以提升任务性能，测试时无额外资源。
AI.result: 在6个模型、9个基准上，BTWF在可比计算成本下相较SOTA提升2-6%（无需昂贵微调），经微调后提升1-3.5%。
AI.conclusion: BTWF将因子化的结构优势转化为真实延迟收益，同时提升学习容量，是一种实用的结构复用式压缩与加速方案。

title: Event-Triggered Visual Perception for Real-Time Harvest Outcome Estimation in Mechanical Blueberry Harvesting
summary: Mechanical blueberry harvesting requires a balance between removing ripe fruit and avoiding premature removal of unripe berries that could remain on the bush for a later harvest. However, operators generally lack real-time information about the maturity composition of the fruit being collected. This study develops an event-triggered machine-vision system that measures the maturity of harvested blueberries directly on the harvester. When a filled crate is moved by the machine, an RGB image is automatically captured and analysed using a three-class detector that identifies ripe, semi-ripe, and unripe berries. The system operates locally on the existing CPU-only industrial computer and therefore requires neither continuous image processing nor dedicated GPU hardware. During field testing, 79 crate images containing 48,634 visible blueberries in manually verified reference annotations were evaluated. The vision system estimated an overall ripe-fruit fraction of 90.22%, compared with 90.97% determined manually. Per-image ripe-fruit estimates showed a mean absolute error of 0.935 percentage points and a Pearson correlation of r=0.967. Maturity estimates remained similar between the two sides of the harvester for which the light conditions varied despite poorer absolute counting performance under direct sunlight. All field events were processed within the available 14 s per-side crate interval. The proposed approach provides a practical means of quantifying one component of harvest selectivity while the machine is operating. Such information could support operator decision-making and, when combined with measurements of fruit recovery and losses, contribute to future feedback-based control of mechanical harvesting.

AI.tldr: 在蓝莓采收机上部署事件触发的机器视觉系统，利用现有CPU工控机在料箱装满移动瞬间抓拍图像，用三分类检测器（成熟/半熟/未熟）估算已采果实的成熟度比例，79箱、48634个果实实测MAE 0.935个百分点，r=0.967。
AI.motivation: 机械采收需要在"摘取成熟果"与"保留未熟果待后续采收"之间取得平衡，但操作者缺乏采收中果实成熟度构成的实时信息，无法据此调节采收选择性。
AI.method: 事件触发式视觉：料箱装满被机器移动时自动触发RGB成像；三类别检测器识别成熟、半熟、未熟蓝莓；模型仅在既有CPU-only工业计算机本地推理，无需持续处理，也无需GPU。以人工校核标注的79张料箱图像（48634个可见果实）为参考进行评估，并比较采收机两侧不同光照条件下的表现。
AI.result: 系统估计整体成熟果比例为90.22%，人工测定为90.97%；逐图成熟比例的MAE为0.935个百分点，Pearson r=0.967。两侧成熟度估计接近，但直射阳光下绝对计数性能较差；全部田间事件均在每侧14秒料箱间隔内完成处理。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为机器作业过程中量化采收选择性提供了一个实用手段，可辅助操作者决策；若结合果实回收率与损失测量，有望支撑未来基于反馈的机械采收控制。

title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
summary: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.

AI.tldr: LynnReal-Hand：手部驱动的交互式视频世界模型，通过10万交互片段数据集、手部感知监督、因果流映射少步生成、区域感知分数蒸馏及轻量Ultra-Fast-VAE，实现540p实时流式生成（单H200 18.03 FPS）。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型仅支持文本与相机控制，缺乏直接物体交互的精细控制；手作为自然交互界面时，手-物体动力学复杂加之实时性要求高，难以将连续手部动作转化为连贯视觉响应。
AI.method: 1) 构建10万条真实+合成环境的手部交互片段数据集与手部感知监督；2) 学习因果流映射（causal flow map）实现少步生成；3) 提出区域感知分数蒸馏，融合视频与图像先验精修交互动力学与外观；4) 提出紧凑视频解码器Ultra-Fast-VAE降低推理开销，实现流式实时生成。
AI.result: HandBench上优于现有方法：全序列模型FVD 181.67、MANO Dice 93.02；三步因果模型MANO Dice 92.49；单H200 540p流式达18.03 FPS，延迟741ms，峰值显存34.89GB。承诺开源数据、权重与代码。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将精确手-物交互建模与高效流式生成统一，验证了手部驱动视频世界模型的实时可行性，并以数据、模型与代码开放推动后续研究。

title: Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
summary: Persistent spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents to operate reliably in environments they repeatedly encounter. It requires recognizing revisited places despite viewpoint changes, distinguishing them from similar-looking rooms, and updating memories as environments change. Yet existing evaluations often leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit. We introduce ReSpaceBench, a benchmark comprising 3,244 questions across 590 synthetic and real-home scenes, organized into 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking, and downstream reasoning. Controlled walkthroughs define visits by physical room entry and deliberately include same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes. Our evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks reveals substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated zero-shot model achieves 50.5% overall accuracy and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, compared with 90.1% for human annotators. The evaluated agentic frameworks offer no overall improvement over direct inference with the same base model. Analysis of agent execution traces reveals evidence omissions and incorrect cross-visit room associations as major failure modes, suggesting that iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory. Further analyses expose a gap between recognizing familiar rooms and identifying the correct visited room, while annotation-guided sampling highlights the importance of preserving intervening visits and transitions. We also provide RS-30K, a separate training dataset from synthetic sources with no template, scene, route, or video overlap with the benchmark. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B raises overall accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%, with the largest gains in association and improvements extending to real-life scenes.

AI.tldr: ReSpaceBench：3,244题/590场景（合成+真实家庭）的空间持久理解基准，9类任务覆盖房间关联、持久状态追踪与下游推理；32个模型最强零样本仅50.5%（人类90.1%），并发布RS-30K微调集，Qwen3-VL-8B从35.5%提升至60.4%。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需在重复到访的环境中具备持久空间理解：跨视角识别重访地点、与同类房间区分、并随环境变化更新记忆。但现有评测通常把跨访问的物理地点身份（place identity）留作隐式假设，缺乏受控、可量化的评估。
AI.method: 构建ReSpaceBench：590个合成与真实家庭场景、3,244个问题、9项任务，按"进入物理房间"定义访问（受控走查），刻意引入同类型房间干扰项与跨会话物体变化；评测32个模型与3个agentic视频理解框架，并做执行轨迹错误分析、标注引导采样分析；另提供无模板/场景/路线/视频重叠的RS-30K训练集用于微调。
AI.result: 最强零样本模型总体50.5%、450题子集52.2%，人类标注者90.1%；agentic框架相对同基座直接推理无整体增益。主要失败模式为证据遗漏与跨访问房间错误关联；并发现"识别熟悉房间"与"定位到正确的曾访问房间"之间存在差距。微调Qwen3-VL-8B使总体从35.5%升至60.4%，增益集中于关联任务并迁移到真实场景。
AI.conclusion: 跨访问的显式地点身份与记忆一致性是当前多模态/具身模型的关键短板，单纯迭代式证据检索不足以保证持久空间记忆；受控基准加针对性的关联型训练数据可显著改善，且效率优于现有agentic包装流程。

title: GHySSeg: Real-Time Geometric Ground and Road Segmentation for Hybrid Solid-State LiDAR
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible. HySoLiD-Drive dataset: this https URL
summary: Hybrid solid-state LiDAR sensors are making their way into production vehicles, yet the data they produce differs structurally from that of the established spinning mechanical sensors behind today's autonomous-driving datasets: it is ring-free, dense, cluttered, and concentrated in a frontal field of view. The classical geometric methods that autonomous vehicles rely on for drivable space computation and navigation assume the ordered ring-and-column structure of a 360-degree spinning LiDAR and degrade or fail on this data, while learned alternatives are computationally heavy, hard to certify, and trained almost exclusively on spinning-LiDAR data. We demonstrate that the same dense, per-curve geometry is instead an opportunity to close the divide between the industry's preferred sensors and autonomous-driving research. We present GHySSeg, a purely geometric method that segments ground and drivable road from a single hybrid solid-state LiDAR frame by tracing each scan curve and reading two geometric signatures, a step in height and a fold-back in range, with no training and no graphics processing unit. To evaluate it, we release HySoLiD-Drive, the first public benchmark dedicated to ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR, comprising 100 manually labeled and 7000 unlabeled frames recorded by two vehicles in real driving. On this benchmark, GHySSeg surpasses both geometric and learned state-of-the-art baselines across ground and road segmentation, reaching an intersection-over-union of 0.907 for road and 0.896 for ground at over 0.96 precision, while running in real time at about 22 milliseconds per frame on a single core.

AI.tldr: GHySSeg：面向混合固态LiDAR的无训练纯几何地面/道路分割方法，配合首个公开基准HySoLiD-Drive（100真值帧+7000无标注帧），单帧约22ms，road IoU 0.907、ground IoU 0.896（精度>0.96）。
AI.motivation: 车规混合固态LiDAR已量产，但其数据无环、密集、噪声杂点多、集中前视视场，与旋转式机械LiDAR的环-列有序结构不同；传统几何方法（依赖环结构）退化失效，学习方法计算重、难认证且几乎只训练于旋转式数据。作者希望用这类传感器固有的"逐曲线稠密几何"弥合工业传感器与自动驾驶研究之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: GHySSeg为纯几何、无需训练、无需GPU的方法：对单帧逐条扫描曲线（scan curve）追踪，提取两种几何特征——高度阶跃（step in height）与量程回折（fold-back in range），据此分割地面与可行驶道路。同时发布HySoLiD-Drive基准，含两辆车真实道路采集的100帧人工标注与7000帧无标注数据。
AI.result: 在HySoLiD-Drive上，ground与road分割均超越几何与学习类SOTA基线；road IoU 0.907、ground IoU 0.896，精度超过0.96；单核约22ms/帧，达到实时。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明混合固态LiDAR的非规则稠密结构并非障碍而是可利用的几何先验，轻量、可解释、可认证的纯几何方法在新型传感器上可优于学习方法，并为该传感器形态提供了首个公开评测基准，有利于产业传感器与学术研究的对接。

title: Lazy-MOSAIC: Accelerating Skill-Centric Manipulation Planning with Learned Skill-Effect World Models
summary: Long-horizon manipulation tasks require a robot to perform a sequence of physical interactions with its environment, typically combining several different skills. Planning such behaviors efficiently is challenging: given a library of parameterized skills, solutions lie in a vast hybrid space of skill sequences and their parameters, and evaluating each candidate skill's feasibility and effect with a high-fidelity world model such as a physics simulator is computationally expensive. MOSAIC, a recent skill-centric approach, lets the skills guide a non-sequential search toward the regions of this space where they are likely to succeed; however, it pays the full cost of simulation for every parameterized skill it considers. In this work, we introduce Lazy-MOSAIC, a lazy planning framework that instead searches over hypothesized skill outcomes. A cheap learned skill-effect world model predicts, in a fraction of a millisecond, a skill's feasibility and the world state it produces. Lazy-MOSAIC then uses these predictions to focus expensive simulation on promising candidate skills and, when a hypothesis is invalidated, repairs only the affected part of the search, while ensuring that every skill in a returned plan is validated in simulation. We evaluate Lazy-MOSAIC on cluttered-shelf retrieval tasks of increasing difficulty and demonstrate it on a physical robot, showing that it plans substantially faster than baselines with fewer simulator queries, while matching or exceeding their success rate in every setting. Visit this http URL .

AI.tldr: Lazy-MOSAIC：用学习得到的「技能效果世界模型」在亚毫秒级预测候选技能的可执行性与结果状态，以假设式搜索替代逐参数仿真，仅在假设被推翻时局部修复搜索，且保证返回计划中每个技能都经仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 长程操作需要在「技能序列 + 连续参数」的混合空间内搜索，用物理仿真评估每个候选技能代价高昂；MOSAIC 虽借技能引导非顺序搜索缩小区域，但仍对每个参数化技能付出完整仿真开销，效率受限。
AI.method: 在 MOSAIC 的技能中心非顺序搜索框架上引入惰性（lazy）评估：(1) 训练轻量技能效果世界模型，毫秒级以下预测技能可行性与后继世界状态；(2) 用预测对候选技能排序/筛选，把昂贵仿真集中在最有希望的候选上；(3) 假设失效时只对搜索图中受影响的部分做局部修复（增量重规划）；(4) 最终返回计划逐技能在仿真中验证，保证正确性。
AI.result: 在难度递增的杂乱货架取物任务上，仿真查询数显著少于基线、规划速度大幅提升；在各设置下成功率与基线持平或更高；并在真实机器人上完成演示。
AI.conclusion: 将「技能效果预测」作为搜索中的惰性启发式，并把仿真当作验证器而非评估器，是降低长程技能规划仿真成本的有效范式；学习模型的不精确性由局部修复与仿真验证兜底，兼顾效率与可靠性。

title: DuoFlow: Towards Synchronized Speech and Motion Generation with Fine-Grained Control
summary: An embodied speaker's expressiveness depends not only on what is said, but also on how the voice sounds and how the body moves. However, existing joint speech-motion generation models are largely driven implicitly by transcript semantics or intermediate speech representations, offering little explicit control over motion hierarchy, body parts, or vocal style. To bridge this gap, we construct MotionSpeech, a structured benchmark for controllable joint speech-motion generation that includes transcripts, voice-style descriptions, and motion conditions at two hierarchical levels. Building on this benchmark, we propose DuoFlow, a dual-stream latent flow transformer that jointly denoises speech and motion under a shared noise level and a unified second-based temporal coordinate. Modality-specific residual connectors inject structured conditions into the corresponding streams, layer-wise bidirectional cross-modal attention coordinates their generation, and a monotonic phoneme pathway combines normalized progress anchors with CTC supervision to strengthen speech temporal modeling. DuoFlow provides a unified interface for fine-grained motion and vocal-style control and demonstrates the ability to synthesize high-quality, synchronized, and instruction-consistent speech-motion sequences.

AI.tldr: 构建 MotionSpeech 基准（含转录、音色描述与两级运动条件），并提出双流潜空间流变换器 DuoFlow，在共享噪声水平与统一时间坐标下联合去噪语音与动作，实现细粒度运动与音色可控的说话-动作同步生成。
AI.motivation: 现有语音-动作联合生成模型多由文本语义或中间语音表示隐式驱动，缺乏对运动层级、身体部位与音色风格的显式控制。
AI.method: MotionSpeech 双层级运动条件 + 音色描述基准；DuoFlow 双流潜空间流匹配/扩散 Transformer，共享噪声等级与统一以秒为单位的时间坐标；模态特定残差连接器注入结构化条件；逐层双向跨模态注意力协调两流；单调音素通路结合归一化进度锚点与 CTC 监督强化语音时序建模。
AI.result: 提供统一的细粒度运动与音色控制接口，可合成高质量、同步且与指令一致的语音-动作序列。
AI.conclusion: 显式层级与风格条件可有效提升联合语音-动作生成的可控性与同步质量，为可控具身说话人生成建立了结构化范式与基准。

title: How Much Does Saliency Accuracy Matter for Saliency-Guided 360-degree Image Compression?
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII 2027)
summary: Saliency-guided coding allocates bits to the regions viewers are most likely to attend, but accurate 360-degree saliency prediction is computationally expensive, an obstacle for low-latency immersive streaming applications such as robot teleoperation. We quantify how much saliency-prediction accuracy actually translates into compression gain. Building on a saliency-guided rate-distortion-optimized (RDO) learned codec, modified so that the training-time latent mask is driven by ground-truth saliency, which yields a single, predictor-agnostic codec, we evaluate saliency predictors spanning two orders of magnitude in compute on both the learned codec and H.265/HEVC. The results show that higher saliency-prediction accuracy yields diminishing compression gains: a lightweight predictor fast enough for live use (52 frames per second) captures 65% of the ground-truth oracle's bit-rate saving, a 3.3x heavier one reaches 74%, and a further 38x increase in compute adds no measurable benefit, on either codec. Therefore, lightweight predictors might also be a practical choice for latency-constrained 360-degree streaming.

AI.tldr: 量化360度显著性预测精度对压缩增益的贡献：采用真值显著性驱动隐掩码训练的RDO学习编解码器，测试跨度两个数量级算力的预测器。轻量预测器（52fps）已获oracle 65%码率节省，3.3倍算力达74%，再增38倍无额外收益（H.265同样成立）。
AI.motivation: 机器人遥操作等低延迟沉浸式流媒体需要显著性引导编码，但精确360度显著性预测计算开销大，需明确精度到压缩增益的实际转化关系以决定是否值得投入高算力预测器。
AI.method: 在显著性引导的率失真优化（RDO）学习编解码器基础上，将训练时隐空间掩码改由真值显著性驱动，得到预测器无关的单一编解码器；随后在同一编解码器与H.265/HEVC上评测算力跨两个数量级的多个显著性预测器，比较其码率节省。
AI.result: 压缩增益随预测精度提升呈递减效应：52fps轻量预测器取得真值oracle码率节省的65%，算力高3.3倍者达74%，再增加38倍算力无可测收益；该规律在两种编解码器上一致。
AI.conclusion: 对延迟受限的360度沉浸式流媒体（如机器人遥操作），轻量显著性预测器已是实用选择；高精度显著性预测的边际压缩收益有限，不值得其为代价。

title: Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out.
